4996.description: The Big-Eared Ginger, a favorite shipboard pet, is just about the most playful kitten in Summerset. Its over-sized sound catchers enable it to hear every tiny motion within range before it pounces upon it.
4996.name: Big-Eared Ginger Kitten
4996.hint: Acquired by finding its seven Runebox Fragments in Karnwasten, and combining them.

4999.description: "Praxis mandates silk shirtings when attending our weekly Ancestral Homage ceremonies," says designer Estinwe of Shimmerene, "Show pride in your heritage with this shimmering update of a classic, time-tested pattern."
4999.name: Ancestral Honor Garments

5000.description: No one has more respect for their Ceremoniarchy and its functionaries than the High Elves: dignity and a high self-regard are the watchwords of an Altmeri Reeve. This outfit represents the Summerset administrator in all his glory!
5000.name: Reeve's Formal Apparel

5001.description: Even if you're not a kinlord, every High Elf is a noble at heart, and wants something in his wardrobe suitable for attendance at Alinor's Royal Palace. This majestic Elven ensemble is just the thing!
5001.name: Kinlord's Alinor Attire

5002.description: Show your face! Put "Hide Your Helm" into your Hat slot to cosmetically remove your helmet, hat, or hood.
5002.name: Hide Your Helm

5004.description: When a Psijic monk uses scrying, or magical farseeing, in spellcasting parlance a "Magicka Zephyr" emits from the scryer's eyes, enabling perception of distant locations. This lovely adornment is a visual tribute to such farseeing.
5004.name: Magicka Zephyr Lashes

5005.description: The design of these gilded Ear Clasps was inspired by the diagrams of Magicka flow in the Psijic Order's "Book of the Eleven Forces."
5005.name: Magicka Ear Clasps

5006.description: These facial adornments are not only fancy accessories for mortals of all persuasions, they also illustrate the Psijic Order's understanding of the arcane concept known as "transpontine circumpenetration of the limen."
5006.name: Magicka Nasal Rods

5007.description: Though inspired by the iconography of the Psijic Order, the Magicka Medallion is a fine adornment for anyone with a commitment to the arcane arts, whether as an independent spellcaster or a member of the Mages Guild.
5007.name: Magicka Brow Medallion

5008.description: A vicious pack of werewolves, led by the mighty Vykosa, has crushed the wolf hunters of the Silver Dawn and occupied their citadel of Moon Hunter Keep. Now you must retake the keep and defeat the Werewolf Lord and her feral followers!
5008.name: Moon Hunter Keep

5009.description: In the realm of the Hunting Grounds, compete with fierce Hircine worshipers in the March of Sacrifices to win the favor of the Daedric Prince. Victory in the hunt will reward great prizes, but more importantly, there are mortal souls at stake!
5009.name: March of Sacrifices

5010.description: The Court of Bedlam may be a cult of angry and vengeful Daedra worshipers, but there's no denying they have a certain sinister sense of style. Adopt their distinctive look with this ominous costume.
5010.name: Court of Bedlam

5011.description: Aurorans are idealized humanoid Daedra mainly in the service of Meridia, the Lady of Infinite Energies. Their armor usually appears golden in tone, but since they come from the Colored Rooms, they could be of any hue.
5011.name: Auroran Knight

5013.description: Even if your background isn't Imperial, if you admire history's greatest warriors, you'll want to honor Pelinal Whitestrake with this costume from Whitestrake's Mayhem, the celebration that commemorates his deeds.
5013.name: Star-Made Wolfshead

5014.description: You wish to maintain a low profile and yet exude competence, sexy coolness, and undeniable predatory intimidation all at once, yes? Then this one advises investing in a Queen's-Eye Spymaster costume and flipping a coin in the tavern's dark corner.
5014.name: Queen's-Eye Spymaster

5015.description: Show your devotion to the Goddess of Love and Nurture with these Priestess of Mara vestments. Across Tamriel, even cultures that don't regard Mara as a major Divine recognize her as the patroness of marriage, invoked at every mortal wedding.
5015.name: Priestess of Mara

5016.description: Psijic Order magesâand others who have earned the privilegeâmay choose to wear these official Skullcaps. They're stylish in an austere way, and keep flyaway hair out of their conjurations.
5016.name: Psijic Skullcap
5016.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Towers' Fall" in Summerset.

5017.description: This formfitting Sideburn Skullcap is popular with mages who want coverage along their temples, but want to keep their jaws and chins free to display beards or other adornments.
5017.name: Sideburn Skullcap

5018.description: The Muttonchop Skullcap is formfitting mage's headgear that includes cheek pieces that extend down to the curve of the jaw. Distinguished!
5018.name: Muttonchop Skullcap

5019.description: Tamriel's prestigious and popular Arena Gladiators have an intimidating look all their own. This costume Gladiator Helm enables anyone to adopt their distinctive profile.
5019.name: Arena Gladiator Helm
5019.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with an Arena Gladiator's Recognition, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

5020.description: The Eagle: symbol of the Aldmeri Dominion and totem of the High Elves, expressing their soaring ambition to be pre-eminent in whatever they choose to pursue. This tasteful Face Tattoo displays one's allegiance to that ideal.
5020.name: Eagle Plume Face Tattoo

5021.description: The Eagle: symbol of the Aldmeri Dominion and totem of the High Elves, expressing their soaring ambition to be pre-eminent in whatever they choose to pursue. This flurry of eagle feathers displays one's allegiance to that ideal.
5021.name: Eagle Plume Flurry Body Tattoo

5022.description: The noble eagle is the symbol of both royal family of the High Elves and of the Aldmeri Dominion which they lead. Show your loyalty to this Alliance and its leaders with these eagle wing tattoos.
5022.name: Regal Eagle Wing Face Tattoo

5023.description: The noble eagle is the symbol of both royal family of the High Elves and of the Aldmeri Dominion which they lead. Show your loyalty to this Alliance and its leaders with these eagle wing tattoos.
5023.name: Regal Eagle Wing Body Tattoos

5024.description: The Psijic Order has its eye on youâliterally! These tattoos show that Mysticism enables you to see beyond the mundane and into the arcane.
5024.name: Scrying Eye Psijic Face Tattoo

5025.description: The mystic monks of the Psijic Order claim that Magicka flows through mortals in specific physical channels, and they can delineate these channels as tattoos to help mages focus their spellcasting.
5025.name: Mystic Magicka Flow Face Tattoos

5026.description: The Psijic Order has its eye on youâliterally! These tattoos show that Mysticism enables you to see beyond the mundane and into the arcane.
5026.name: Scrying Eye Psijic Body Tattoo

5027.description: The mystic monks of the Psijic Order claim that Magicka flows through mortals in specific physical channels, and they can delineate these channels as tattoos to help mages focus their spellcasting.
5027.name: Mystic Magicka Flow Body Tattoos

5028.description: Many monks of the Psijic Order proudly display their commitment to the Old Ways and the Eleven Forces with arcane facial imprints.
5028.name: Face Imprint of the Psijic Order
5028.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Shattered Staff" in Summerset.

5029.description: Many monks of the Psijic Order proudly display their commitment to the Old Ways and the Eleven Forces with arcane body imprints.
5029.name: Body Imprint of the Psijic Order
5029.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Towers' Remains" in Summerset.

5031.description: When you use this brief Psijic illusory enchantment, you seem to be scrying a globe of the night sky! The appearance of this relic is based on the Order's researches into the entirely UN-celestial Abyssal Pearls.
5031.name: Psijic Celestial Orb

5032.description: Display your mastery of time, or maybe just your contempt for punctuality, by summoning a mystic hourglassâand then shattering it! It's strangely gratifying. In fact, once you start, it's hard to stopâ¦.
5032.name: Psijic Tautology Glass

5033.description: You know those moments when you just wish you could simply disappear? With the High Elven magic of the Sapiarchic Discorporation Lens, you can! â¦.All right, maybe it IS just a temporary illusion, but it's a damned impressive one.
5033.name: Sapiarchic Discorporation Lens

5034.description: The spellcasting monks of the Psijic Order are the acknowledged masters of the art of magical scrying, with distinctive gestures and visual effects. Use of this memento enables one to simulate such farseeing.
5034.name: Psijic Scrying Talisman

5035.description: An enchanted feather from the gryphon Sunnawel, the living symbol of Sunhold. With this item you can, for a few moments, at least, rule the air! Summon a miniature windstorm and blow your troubles away.
5035.name: Gryphon Feather Talisman
5035.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Sunhold Sundered."

5036.description: This Sea Sload body part radiates with mind magic and simulates a Sea Sload mind trap without most of the debilitating effects.
5036.name: Sea Sload Dorsal Fin
5036.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "An Unexpected Betrayal."

5046.description: It's Showtime! No more delaysâwave your hands to tell others it's time to bring it on!
5046.name: Showtime

5047.description: The sages of the Psijic Order employ glowglobes for a variety of purposes, including to provide illumination when studying scrolls and tomes late into the night. How this one wound up in Sunhold is anyone's guess.
5047.name: Psijic Glowglobe
5047.hint: Acquired by finding its seven Runebox Fragments in Sunhold, and combining them.

5049.description: Happy Face: an exaggerated emote from the theatrical House of Reveries on Summerset Isle.
5049.name: Happy Face

5050.description: Sad Face: an exaggerated emote from the theatrical House of Reveries on Summerset Isle.
5050.name: Sad Face

5051.description: Ta-Dah!: an exaggerated emote from the theatrical House of Reveries on Summerset Isle.
5051.name: Ta-Dah!

5056.description: Psijic Exemplar mounts theoretically represent the ideal forms such creatures can assume, at which point they transcend the physical and incarnate the mystical. One look at the noble Horse Exemplar, and you know it's true.
5056.name: Psijic Horse Exemplar

5057.description: When the Ra Gada first came to Hammerfell from lost Yokuda, they brought their mountsâhorses and camelsâwith them. It was these Yokudan camels that the Psijic monks are said to have taken as models for their Psijic Camel Exemplars.
5057.name: Psijic Camel Exemplar

5058.description: To gaze into the eyes of the Wolf Exemplar is to look into the eyes of every wolf back to the Dawn Era, when the tribes of mortals still huddled around their campfires at night, staring at the glowing eyes of the wolves prowling around the perimeters.
5058.name: Psijic Wolf Exemplar

5059.description: Psijic monks crossing the doubtful terrain of Black Marsh or southern Morrowind are more concerned with the practical matter of safe and sure riding than whether they look dignified and impressive. For these purposes, the Guar Exemplar is unequaled.
5059.name: Psijic Guar Exemplar

5060.description: According to Nord legend, bearsâlike the Nords themselvesâoriginated on the frozen continent of Atmora. And some Nords think that's where the Psijic monks went to find the original model of their Psiiic Bear Exemplar. The Psijic mages aren't saying.
5060.name: Psijic Bear Exemplar

5062.description: The Psijic Senche Exemplar is the ultimate physical expression of feline grace and power. Khajiiti say it reminds them of the descriptions of Southpaw, the legendary mount of Rajhin the Purring Liar.
5062.name: Psijic Senche Exemplar

5063.description: When Psijic monks (or their favored allies) call up a Psijic Spectral Steed, they're really summoning the spirit of a Psijic Horse Exemplar, brought back to the world of the living and made tangible by a supreme act of Conjuration.
5063.name: Psijic Spectral Steed

5064.description: This magical mount was created to provide Psijic Monks with a reliable conjured ride when going to and from the courts of rulers in northern Tamriel. Psijics have little use for such a creature on Artaeum, but summon them out of admiration and affection.
5064.name: Phantom Ice Wolf

5065.description: The Psijic monk who created the spell for conjuring the spirit of a Psijic Senche Exemplar back into the world of the living as a tangible Ghost Cat was a Wood Elfâwhich probably explains why it manifests as an Y'frren spirit of the Green.
5065.name: Green-Graht Ghost Cat

5066.description: When one of Meridia's Auroran Knights manifests in Tamriel, and needs a mount, the knight has the ability to instantly summon a Daedric Warhorse from the Colored Rooms. Curiously, if the knight is banished to Oblivion, the mount sometimes stays behind.
5066.name: Auroran Warhorse

5067.description: These magical creatures have a special relationship to Y'ffre the nature god, and seem to draw strength from the very bones of the earth beneath their hooves. It's a privilege for a mortal rider to be borne by such an enchanted beast.
5067.name: Dawnwood Indrik
5067.hint: Obtained by combining four different Dawnwood Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Dawnwood Indrik.

5068.description: The Luminous Indrik seems to radiate the same soft aetherial glow as the stars in the heavens, but steady and nearby rather than flickering and remote. It's reassuring, somehow.
5068.name: Luminous Indrik
5068.hint: Obtained by combining four different Luminous Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Luminous Indrik.

5071.description: An Exemplar mount is a mystical manifestation of its form's ideal concept, It is also extraordinarily sensitive to the emotional valences of its rider. If the rider engages in too much bloodthirsty killing, their Exemplar may become a Bloodshadow Wraith.
5071.name: Bloodshadow Wraith Steed

5072.description: The Badger Bears of southern Blackwood were nearly extinct in the wild when they were saved by the intervention from an unlikely source, an Imperial noble, when Viscount Glorion of Leyawiin rescued the species by breeding them as mounts.
5072.name: Badger Bear

5073.description: The cliffs and escarpments of east central Elsweyr are the home of the nimble and sure-footed senche-cougars, who prowl the rocks hunting goats and marmots. Inevitably, they've been domesticated by their feline cousins the Khajiit.
5073.name: Senche-Cougar
5073.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

5075.description: In the rugged badlands of central Hammerfell, even camels struggle to maneuver across the broken terrain. But wolves can go where even camels cannot, so the roving Redguards of the canyon lands have bred the local Painted Wolves into sure-footed mounts.
5075.name: Painted Wolf

5076.description: The thief-god Rajhin is said to have stolen these enchanted purple steeds from somewhere in Oblivion, but when his worshipers are asked where he got them, they just laugh and say, "Noweyr!"
5076.name: Noweyr Steed

5077.description: This ominous companion, conjured by Psijic magic in the shape of a glowing senche mount, represents for the monks of Artaeum all of the painful choices they regret having made, but which they nonetheless must ride upon into the future.
5077.name: Senche of Scarlet Regret

5078.description: "Sweet young things like to give this one kittens as keepsakes," says Eye of the Queen Razum-dar, "but raising a pet is not consistent with Raz's romantic but itinerant life of intrigue. Perhaps you could give cute Ja'khajiit a good home, yes?"
5078.name: Ja'khajiit Raz

5079.description: In the Clockwork City, mechanical Firepot Spiders can be programmed to follow chefs around like little walking barbecues. Someone has devised a secret method for exporting them from Sotha Sil's hidden worldâbut how? Better get one while you still can.
5079.name: Firepet Spider

5080.description: "Cute little thing, isn't it? 'Course, what I care about is that a Ringtail, properly trained, can get into places no one else can, and carry out small items in their cheek pouches. Lost goods, as it were, or misplaced valuables. Right?" âFenaanaral
5080.name: Alinor Ringtail

5081.description: The Great Daenians are gigantic hounds bred as protectors and companions by the Beldama Wyrd coven. Despite their size and strength, they are surprisingly gentle except when roused to the defense of their masters.
5081.name: Great Daenian Hound

5082.description: The young of most creatures are cute, even adorable. That's â¦ not really true of the Larval Yaghra. If you have one of these following you, you're either telling the world you don't give a Daedric damn what they think, or you're a Sea Sload in disguise.
5082.name: Larval Yaghra

5083.description: Prong-Eared Grimalkins are widely regarded as having supernatural powers thanks to their ability to appear almost instantly when a container of cat food is opened, and to fit themselves into boxes that seem entirely too small for them.
5083.name: Prong-Eared Grimalkin

5084.description: Native to Summerset Isle, the gaudy Coral Mudcrab has elaborate coral growths on its back, as well as a claw that looks comically over-sized, but which is surprisingly functional. Count fingers after petting.
5084.name: Coral Mudcrab

5085.description: For mortals good in heart and soul, being in the presence of a Springtide Indrik induces serenity and makes anger almost impossibleâthough paradoxically it also inspires a righteous determination to fight injustice.
5085.name: Springtide Indrik

5086.description: As savage as Welwas are, history indicates that every pastoral society in Craglorn's long historyâNedes, Yokudans, Goblins, and Orcsâhas domesticated them at some point. They may be ugly, but they sure are loyal.
5086.name: Longhair Welwa

5087.description: No one can look at the glistening plumage of the Shimmering Indrik and doubt its enchanted nature, for it sparkles with Magicka and virtue. Here is a creature untainted by aggression, though it will ably defend itself at need.
5087.name: Shimmering Indrik

5088.description: The giant crimson beetles that scuttle through the gloom of Mephala's Spiral Skein are said to use their pointed probosces to drink the blood of whatever they catch. True or not, it's a fine gruesome story for cultists to tell about their Daedric pets.
5088.name: Skein Shalk

5089.description: It should surprise no one familiar with Mephala, the Webspinner, that spiders are among the most common denizens of the Spiral Skein, the Daedric Prince's Oblivion realm. They're not exactly affectionate pets, but they are fiercely loyal.
5089.name: Skein Spider

5090.description: Knights of the Spider Cult, known as Deathweavers, often disdain the cultists' usual Daedric Spider companions, preferring Skein Scorpions to present a more warlike attitude.
5090.name: Skein Scorpion

5091.description: When Mephala populated the Spiral Skein with "improved" versions of Tamrielic invertebrates, she outdid herself with the Skein Wasp, a giant menacing insect guaranteed to give any mortal the shivers!
5091.name: Skein Wasp

5092.description: When spring comes to the sun-dappled forests of southern Wrothgar, Echatere babies are sometimes born with temporary spotted camouflage that fades as the Echalette matures. It's pretty while it lasts.
5092.name: Fawn Echalette

5093.description: The handsome breed of Masked Bears are native to the Pale Pass region of the Jerall Mountains, which has given rise to the legend that they came in the First Era with the invaders from Akavir who ended up there. Bears from Akavir? Really?
5093.name: Masked Bear Cub

5094.description: This perky but enigmatic equine glows with Magicka through the mystic runes that embellish its possibly-illusory epidermis. Enchanting!
5094.name: Psijic Mascot Pony

5095.description: Are the Psijic Mascot pets real animals with an enchanted appearance, or illusory beast companions created from Magicka? The Psijic monks know which it is, but ask one, and all you get in reply is a smile.
5095.name: Psijic Mascot Wolf Pup

5096.description: The first Guar came to Artaeum when a Psijic advisor to the Tribunal returned from Mournhold with a Pony Guar in the middle of the First Era, and they've been favorites of the Psijics ever since. There's even a glowing Psijic Mascot Guar!
5096.name: Psijic Mascot Guar Calf

5097.description: By tradition, the Psijic Mascot of the order's Ritemaster is always a Bear Cubâbut since there's been only one Ritemaster, Iachesis, for over 3,000 years, the tradition hasn't had much opportunity to change. Fortunately, others can befriend them as well!
5097.name: Psijic Mascot Bear Cub

5098.description: "Some say that Psijic Mascot creatures aren't true animals at all, but illusory constructs created by Psijic monks as portable storage batteries of Magicka," says Sapiarch Soraturil. "What nonsense!"
5098.name: Psijic Mascot Senche Cub

5099.description: "I don't know, something about being followed around by a tame miniature giant elemental amphibian just seems right to me, you know? Expresses my inner newt." âDinuviel Darkwater of Rellenthil
5099.name: Pocket Salamander

5101.description: The thief-god Rajhin is said to have stolen these enchanted purple Ponies from somewhere in Oblivion, but when his worshipers are asked where he got them, they just laugh and say, "Noweyr!"
5101.name: Noweyr Pony

5102.description: This ominous yet playful pet, conjured by Psijic magic in shape of a glowing senche cub, represents an Artaeum monk's regrettable choices that may yet be reversed by proper adherence to the Old Ways.
5102.name: Senche Cub of Scarlet Regret

5105.description: Though eventually it will grow into a massive beast with a vast wingspan, a Fledgling Gryphon is just the right size for a companion creature, and its juvenile antics are hilarious!
5105.name: Fledgling Gryphon

5107.description: By royal decree, the once-forbidden island of the High Elves has been opened, its Crystal Tower drawing travelers to its light. But dark forces from beyond and below are also interested in the mystic location in the Summerset Isle.
5107.name: Summerset

5108.description: It's said that under certain conditions the Maormer, like chameleons, can change the appearance of their skin. Emulate that legendary ability with this blue-scaled Fish Skin.
5108.name: Maormer Fish

5109.description: Z'Maja's powerful magic infuses those it touches with a tinge of shadow. Commemorate your encounter with this darkest darkness by wearing this Shadow Skin.
5109.name: Z'Maja's Shadow
5109.hint: Acquired by completing the "Cloudrest Vanquisher" achievement in Cloudrest.

5111.description: For your service to the Psijic Order, you have been granted the privilege of wearing their Mystic Eye Cuirass, usually permitted only to the Scryers Militant.
5111.name: Mystic Eye Psijic Cuirass
5111.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Crystal Tower" in Summerset.

5114.description: Attuned by the Psijics to the life force that the Wood Elves call "The Green," these Gauntlets are said to help the wearer focus Nature-based magic and Restoration spells.
5114.name: Psijic Warden Gauntlets
5114.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Lost in Translation" in Summerset.

5115.description: Though few Psijic monks specialize in Destruction magic, those who do proudly display their preference for fire spells by wearing these Flame Gauntlets.
5115.name: Psijic Flame Gauntlets

5116.description: Though few Psijic monks specialize in Destruction magic, those who do proudly display their preference for cold and ice spells by wearing these Frost Gauntlets.
5116.name: Psijic Frost Gauntlets

5117.description: Though few Psijic monks specialize in Destruction magic, those who do proudly display their preference for lightning spells by wearing these Shock Gauntlets.
5117.name: Psijic Shock Gauntlets

5118.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Molag Kena style.
5118.name: Molag Kena Sword

5123.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Molag Kena style.
5123.name: Molag Kena Maul

5124.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Molag Kena style.
5124.name: Molag Kena Shield

5125.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Molag Kena style.
5125.name: Molag Kena Bow

5126.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Molag Kena style.
5126.name: Molag Kena Staff

5135.description:
Unlocks the Warden class for use in character creation.

Wardens are defenders of the Green, master storytellers whose nature tales become magical reality. They wield frost spells against enemies and summon animals to aid them.
5135.name: Class: Warden

5139.description: This mask connotes the serene mind and tranquil heart of one whose emotions are subsumed into the dreams of the House of Reveries.
5139.name: Tranquil Reverie Mask

5140.description: This is the mask chosen when an actor of the House of Reveries must represent growth, nature, or an aspect of Y'ffre. Ready to perform your interpretive dance of springtime? Here's the mask you need!
5140.name: Reveries Flowervine Mask

5141.description: The Face Half Veiled represents a character whose motives and intentions are obscure and as yet unknown. Feeling mysterious? Don the Reveries Veiled Mask!
5141.name: Reveries Veiled Mask

5142.description: This otherworldly mask evokes the moment when the Breath of Y'ffre gave the entities of creation their names and shapes, and order merged with chaos to birth the Green.
5142.name: Breath of Y'ffre Mask

5143.description: Enigmatic Mood, the mask of a performer whose character might move in any direction at any moment. Expect the unexpected from one clad in this visage!
5143.name: Enigmatic Mood Mask

5144.description: When the Red Visage appears on stage, the production has veered into tragedy, and the final songs will be of fury and remorse. This isn't the mask you wear for happy endings!
5144.name: Reveries Red Visage Mask

5145.description: Looping floral choruses adorn the Garden Serenade Mask, promising gentle repose and loving acceptance in an environment free of all conflict and intimidation. Soothingâ¦.
5145.name: Garden Serenade Mask

5146.description: This is the very face of the Unreliable Narrator. Those who wear the Quarto Mask show not just uncertainty, but unwillingness to commit to any set conclusion. The Quarto is the mask of the Perchance Acorn, of the Eclipse in the Lunar Lattice. Beware!
5146.name: Reveries Quarto Mask

5147.description: This Skull Face Tattoo with a Verdant leafy design is worn by those who wish to honor the dead through a day of special remembranceâor just want to look coolly intimidating.
5147.name: Verdant Skull Face Tattoo

5156.description: Unlocks all Divine Prosecution outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.
5156.name: Divine Prosecution Outfit Style

5162.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Ilambris style.
5162.name: Ilambris Battle Axe

5163.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Ilambris style.
5163.name: Ilambris Bow

5164.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Ilambris style.
5164.name: Ilambris Shield

5165.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Ilambris style.
5165.name: Ilambris Staff

5166.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Ilambris style.
5166.name: Ilambris Sword

5167.description:
It's only a single room, but the advantage of this inn apartment is its unrivaled location, just steps from the gates of Alinor. That, and the rare prestige of an Alinor address!
Room is too small for Dueling.
5167.name: Golden Gryphon Garret
5167.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion

5168.description: On the heights of Alinor, with easy access to the Royal Palace, this splendid mansion was built as a consulate for the Bosmeri Ambassador of the Camoran Dynasty. With the ambassador now in Elden Root, the townhouse is available for you!
5168.name: Alinor Crest Townhouse
5168.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Summerset Grand Adventurer" Achievement

5169.description: Once a watering stop for the High Elf navy, this great cavernous grotto on the Summerset coast west of Dusk features shipboard compartments, magnificent Aldmeri ruins, weathered wood from several shipwrecks, and a sparkling subterranean waterfall.
5169.name: Colossal Aldmeri Grotto

5172.description: When a cub, the young Atmoran Snow Bear is a lap-clambering cuddle bug, a friendly fuzzball whose demeanor is completely at odds with the fierce reputation of adult Snow Bears. Enjoy them while they're still small!
5172.name: Atmoran Snow Bear Cub

5173.description: These fiercely noble Snow Bears are said to have been brought from the legendary frozen continent of Atmora by mighty Ysgramor himself, who deemed them the only worthy avatars of the ancient Nord Bear totem.
5173.name: Atmoran Snow Bear

5174.description: This Skull Face Tattoo with a Floral design is worn by those who wish to honor the dead through a day of special remembranceâor just want to look coolly intimidating.
5174.name: Floral Skull Face Tattoo

5175.description: This Skull Face Tattoo with a hard-edged Spoked design is worn by those who wish to honor the dead through a day of special remembranceâor just want to look coolly intimidating.
5175.name: Spoked Skull Face Tattoo

5176.description: The hissing and twitching farmer who sells these claims they're just ordinary black roosters. And probably they are. You must have just imagined that this Cockerel's eyes glow after dark. You must have!
5176.name: Daemon Cockerel

5177.description: The Dragon Cult of the ancient Nords is long gone and forgottenâor is it? These Face Markings show the wearer's devotion to the Dovah worship of old.
5177.name: Dragon Wings Face Markings

5178.description: The Dragon Cult of the ancient Nords is long gone and forgottenâor is it? These Body Markings show the wearer's devotion to the Dovah worship of old.
5178.name: Dragon Wings Body Markings

5179.description: Though Dwarven Metal was usually employed in building Spider constructs, for reasons unknown some rare variants were built with a darker Ebon Steel alloy. When found in working order, these automata are prized by collectors.
5179.name: Ebon Steel Dwarven Spider

5180.description: This extremely rare Dwarven Spider model is surmounted with a double golden crescent, interpreted by scholars of the Dwemer as a "Solar Arc," or tribute to the sunâan iconography otherwise completely unknown among the handiworks of the Deep Elves.
5180.name: Solar Arc Dwarven Spider

5181.description: The Sacred Antler Earring is a subtle but elegant tribute to the Great Stag aspect of Lord Hircine, though it's also worn by nature worshipers of other faiths.
5181.name: Sacred Antler Earring

5182.description: Among the hard-bitten warriors of the Undaunted, no feat of dexterity is more admired than the Autumnal Ornamental Gourd Triple-Toss, also known as "Jugglin' Pumpkins." Do you like hearty applause and sincere adulation? Try it!
5182.name: Jugglin' Pumpkins

5183.description: Traditionally, the Witches Festival encourages beggars to ask for alms and children to ask for treats. Er, what's your excuse, hero?
5183.name: Festival Beggar

5184.description: The Witches Festival encourages beggars to ask for alms and children to beg for treats. Now you can oblige them with this kindly behavior. Be generous while you can, for as the witches and haunts remind us, life is short!
5184.name: Festive Treats

5185.description: Convey your utter disdain for that which offends you by hurling a rotten egg at it. And hey: stay classy!
5185.name: Throw Rotten Egg

5186.description: Carefully you examine the traces of your prey's passage. No doubt about it: they went this way!
5186.name: Tracker

5187.description: "It is well to ponder the inevitability of death, for then we must consider how best to use what life we're given, yes?" âChaplain Jorden, Priest of Arkay
5187.name: Skull Ponder

5188.description: Craglorn Companions of Belkarth had no luck at all exporting Fellrunners for the High Rock and Hammerfell pet marketsâuntil they sold a flock of the Teal-Faced variety to Fahara'jad's menagerie in Sentinel. Suddenly they were all the rage!
5188.name: Teal-Faced Fellrunner

5189.description: Wear the Outfit of the Fire Drakes, those deadly draconic firebrands of the no-holds-barred Battlegrounds!
5189.name: Fire Drakes Outfit

5190.description: The werewolf hunters of the Silver Dawn rely on the courage and keen noses of these great High Rock hounds to help them track Tamriel's lycanthropes to their lairs.
5190.name: Silver Daenian Werewolf Tracker

5191.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Grothdarr style.
5191.name: Grothdarr Mace

5192.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Grothdarr style.
5192.name: Grothdarr Staff

5193.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Grothdarr style.
5193.name: Grothdarr Maul

5194.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Grothdarr style.
5194.name: Grothdarr Bow

5195.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Grothdarr style.
5195.name: Grothdarr Shield

5196.description: The Gryphons that nest on the highest pinnacles of Eton Nir, the tallest mountain on Summerset, have a distinctive bluish tint to their plumage. Some sapiarchs call this sky-blue camouflage, but the Priests of Auri-El see in it a touch of the Divine.
5196.name: Azure Fledgling Gryphon

5197.description: This Modest Flatbrim Mourning Hat, handsome in its subdued way, is for those who feel it would be unseemly to wear ostentatious headgear during days of remembrance for the dead.
5197.name: Modest Mourning Hat

5198.description: This Flatbrim Mourning Hat strikes a balance, sporting restrained decorations that honor the remembrance of the dead without attracting too much attention to the wearer.
5198.name: Deluxe Mourning Hat

5199.description: This Plumed Flatbrim Mourning Hat is for those who feel that, while it's important to honor the deceased on the days of remembrance for the dead, that doesn't mean the living have to look dull and dowdy.
5199.name: Plumed Mourning Hat

5200.description: Of Lord Hircine's five famous aspects, the best known is undoubtedly his appearance as the Great Stag, with an impressive span of antlers jutting from his brows. Now you can pay tribute to the Great Stag with these cosmetic Brow Antlers.
5200.name: Great Stag Brow Antlers

5201.description: "You may meet the Mighty Bear, who is invoked as Hrokkibeg. He embodies the Totem of Claw and Fang, and comes seeking solitude, peace from labors, and renewal of the Burning Spirit Within. Beware, for if you rouse him you will be torn asunder."
5201.name: Hrokkibeg's Claw Face Marks

5202.description: "You may meet the Mighty Bear, who is invoked as Hrokkibeg. He embodies the Totem of Claw and Fang, and comes seeking solitude, peace from labors, and renewal of the Burning Spirit Within. Beware, for if you rouse him you will be torn asunder."
5202.name: Hrokkibeg's Claw Body Marks

5203.description: When you wear the thorn and briar tattoo of the Hunting Grounds, you may be pursuer or prey, hunter or hunted, but either way you display your devotion to Lord Hircine, Master of the Great Hunt.
5203.name: Hunting Grounds Face Tattoo

5204.description: When you wear the thorn and briar tattoo of the Hunting Grounds, you may be pursuer or prey, hunter or hunted, but either way you display your devotion to Lord Hircine, Master of the Great Hunt.
5204.name: Hunting Grounds Body Tattoo

5205.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Iceheart style.
5205.name: Iceheart Sword

5206.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Iceheart style.
5206.name: Iceheart Staff

5207.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Iceheart style.
5207.name: Iceheart Greatsword

5208.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Iceheart style.
5208.name: Iceheart Bow

5209.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Iceheart style.
5209.name: Iceheart Shield

5210.description: Given a nice, ripe Witches Festival pumpkin, you could carve it, cook it, or do any number of creative things with it. But who are we kidding? You know what you want. Smash that gourd!
5210.name: Gourd-Gallows Stump

5211.description: Showing off your adventurer's deft dexterity with a deadly blade, you swiftly carve a Witches Festival pumpkin into a hollowjack lantern. Impressive!
5211.name: Rind-Renewing Pumpkin

5212.description: When you go looking for spirits of the restless dead with the Witches Festival Ghost Lantern, you don't find themâthey find you!
5212.name: Ghost Lantern

5213.description: Lord of the Nightmare Pack, this night-black Wolf mount has burning paws and flames hissing from its face and tail; can anyone doubt that its origin must be Mehrunes Dagon's plane of the Deadlands?
5213.name: Packlord Nightmare Wolf

5214.description: "Be scaredâbe very scared!" say this pup's big fiery eyes. "Please?" But no matter how much it tries to frighten like a grown-up Nightmare Wolf, this flaming fuzzball is still completely adorable.
5214.name: Nightmare Wolf Pup

5215.description: "Look sharp while you hammer out that dagger!" says Orc-tailor Borzighu. "Our Forge-Wife's Frock, spun from non-flammable gray scathecraw fibers, protects you from cinders, soot, hot embers, and even spatters of molten metal. Hot!"
5215.name: Forge-Wife's Impervious Frock

5216.description: "Malacath's Vengeance Day is coming up soon, and you'll want to look your best for it!" says Borzighu of Orsinium. "Being Orcs, naturally we think about revenge every day, but Vengeance Day is still our favorite!"
5216.name: Vengeance Day Dress

5217.description: "As the Wise Woman of your clan, or the Hunt-Wife on ceremonial days, you must project both grace and authority," says designer Borzighu the Tidy. "Count on my gilt-broidered vestment to provide that, and more!"
5217.name: Orc Wise Woman's Vestment

5218.description: Sometimes the tiresome constraints of civilized behavior just â¦ become â¦ too confining! Must stretch, must hunch over, must snarl and snap. Must be â¦ a Beast!
5218.name: Beast
5218.hint: Awarded for completing the "March of Sacrifices Challenger" Achievement.

5219.description: Summerset's Salamanders are amphibians that, when threatened, defend themselves with an impressive array of elemental powers. The bright orange Lava Line on this breed is an indicator of its reliance on natural Flame magic.
5219.name: Lava Line Salamander

5220.description: Wear the Outfit of the Pit Daemons, those infernal dirty fighters of the no-holds-barred Battlegrounds!
5220.name: Pit Daemon Outfit

5221.description: Wear the Outfit of the Storm Lords, those triumphant tempest terrors of the no-holds-barred Battlegrounds!
5221.name: Storm Lord Outfit

5222.description: If you're looking for a warm and fuzzy companion animal to cuddle with, don't start with the Crested Reef Viper. But if what you want is an intimidating reptilian monster that says "Don't mess with me, city boy," this is the ophidian follower for you.
5222.name: Crested Reef Viper

5223.description: Even as cubs, the litter-mates of the noble Riverhold senche-lion prides exhibit the breed's hallmark attributes of courage and loyalty, bravely defending their masters against encroaching beetles and butterflies!
5223.name: Noble Riverhold Senche-Lion Cub

5224.description: The pastoral tribes of northern Anequina need reliable mounts upon which to follow their herds of livestock, and none are more dependable than the prides of senche-lions bred near Riverhold, feline steeds so brave and loyal they're called "Noble."
5224.name: Noble Riverhold Senche-Lion
5224.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

5225.description: Most inhabitants of Skyrim hate and loathe necromancy, but those Nords who do stoop to raising the dead tend to go all in, wallowing in death and its symbols. It was no doubt such Nord necromancers who bred the skull-faced Death Mask Sabre Cats as mounts.
5225.name: Death Mask Sabre Cat

5226.description: It's no surprise that in the Alik'r Desert, where blooming flowers are rare and prized, that Shorn Camels tattooed with Floral designs are well loved and popular. Covering them with flower designs is even said to make them less ornery!
5226.name: Floral Tattoo Shorn Camel

5227.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Troll King style.
5227.name: Troll King Axe

5228.description: An Outfit look for Staves in the Troll King style.
5228.name: Troll King Staff

5229.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Troll King style.
5229.name: Troll King Battle Axe

5230.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Troll King style.
5230.name: Troll King Bow

5231.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Troll King style.
5231.name: Troll King Shield

5232.description: Are you "under the wing" of a Daedric Prince? You may want to display your affiliation with these winged Daedric Twilight Face Tattoos. Soar above other mortals and swoop down upon your prey!
5232.name: Twilight Wings Face Tattoo

5233.description: Are you "under the wing" of a Daedric Prince? You may want to display your affiliation with these winged Daedric Twilight Body Tattoos. Soar above other mortals and swoop down upon your prey!
5233.name: Twilight Wings Body Tattoo

5234.description: Like most adventurers, you're probably worried that no one will remember you when you're gone. Create your own momentary memorial with the Murkmire Grave-Stake! Because you deserve it, hero.
5234.name: Murkmire Grave-Stake
5234.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Cursed Skull."

5235.description: Werewolves are loathed and hunted all across Tamriel, but the region with the strongest tradition of werewolf hunting is High Rock, where the Order of the Silver Dawn was founded specifically to eradicate the canine lycanthropes.
5235.name: Werewolf Hunter Hat
5235.hint: Acquired by entering either Moon Hunter Keep or March of Sacrifices for the first time.

5236.description: Werewolf hunting is a dirty and largely thankless business, but when a Silver Dawn member mounts their resplendent Argent Charger, they feel like the hero they really are. Sure, it's showy, but as a defender of society against the vicious, you deserve it.
5236.name: Silver Dawn Argent Charger

5237.description: Hircine the Hunter appears in his Uricanbeg aspect as the Great Stag, and is honored by his worshipers with the display of this distinctive face tattoo.
5237.name: Uricanbeg the Stag Face Tattoo

5238.description: Hircine the Hunter appears in his Uricanbeg aspect as the Great Stag, and is honored by his worshipers with the display of this distinctive body tattoo.
5238.name: Uricanbeg the Stag Body Tattoo

5239.description: Those who've run afoul of the Followers of the Manbeast, Lord Hircine, may bear the crimson scars of their encounter for the rest of their lives. Badge of honor? Symbol of devotion? Trophy of a battle well-fought? That's for you to judge.
5239.name: Werewolf Claw Face Scars

5240.description: Those who've run afoul of the Followers of the Manbeast, Lord Hircine, may bear the crimson scars of their encounter for the rest of their lives. Badge of honor? Symbol of devotion? Trophy of a battle well-fought? That's for you to judge.
5240.name: Werewolf Claw Body Scars

5241.description: As a murderous beast who lurks in the darkness, to become the color of shadows is only natural. As natural as the blood of the innocents that drips from your claws.
5241.name: Sable Man-Beast
5241.hint: Awarded for completing the "Moon Hunter Keep Challenger" Achievement.

5242.description: When your rage and bloodlust cannot be contained in your usual meager mortal form, then it is time to become â¦ the Werewolf Behemoth.
5242.name: Werewolf Behemoth Sigil
5242.hint: Awarded for completing the "The Great Indrik Hunt" Achievement.

5243.description: For many, the Wolfsbane Ear Posy is just a simple adornmentâbut for members of the Order of the Silver Dawn, it serves to identify those who are secret members or sympathizers of that society of Werewolf hunters.
5243.name: Wolfsbane Ear Posy

5244.description: For most people, giant spiders are just loathsome monsters to be destroyed by fire and steel, but Mephala Cultists know that they're highly intelligent (for, you know, arthropods) and surprisingly trainable. The Goldenbacks are by far the friendliest.
5244.name: Goldenback Spider Lackey

5245.description: Every Witches Festival, the haunted legend of a hidden Rivenspire hollow once more comes to lifeâif you can call it thatâand horse riders across Tamriel are cursed to gallop headless through the night on dark and frantic steeds.
5245.name: Hollowjack Rider Horse
5245.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5246.description: Even in the wastes of the Alik'r, far from Rivenspire, when the sun sets on a moonless Witches Festival night riders may find themselves headless, galloping across the darkling dunes on shadowy camels and clutching glimmering Hollowjacks.
5246.name: Hollowjack Rider Camel
5246.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5247.description:
Night winds whisper through the Hollow
And the darknight wolf-pack prowls
Then your wolf-mount turns to follow
And you ride headless as it howls
5247.name: Hollowjack Rider Wolf
5247.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5248.description: The legend of Jaque o' the Hollow has spread even to the misty realms of eastern Tamriel where the Guar roam the woods and marshes, and during the dark nights of the Witches Festival reptile-riders may also find themselves haunted and headless!
5248.name: Hollowjack Rider Guar
5248.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5249.description: When the moons rise over the Witches Festival, Jaque o' the Hollow haunts the mounts of mortals, cursing their riders to gallop headless through the night. Even the doughty bear mounts of the Nords are susceptible.
5249.name: Hollowjack Rider Bear
5249.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5250.description: Jaque o' the Hollow haunts Rivenspire during dark Witches Festival nights, and even those who ride senche-tiger mounts may find themselves padding headless through the moonless dark while waving a glowing gourd.
5250.name: Hollowjack Rider Senche
5250.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5251.description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just horses imbued with a haunting illusory appearanceâbut some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.
5251.name: Hollowjack Wraith-Lantern Steed
5251.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5252.description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just  senche-panthers imbued with a haunting illusory appearanceâbut some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.
5252.name: Hollowjack Flame-Skull Senche
5252.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5253.description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just riding wolves imbued with a haunting illusory appearanceâbut some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.
5253.name: Hollowjack Daedra-Skull Wolf
5253.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5458.description: Trophy taken from Z'Maja in honor of an Undaunted victory in Cloudrest.
5458.name: Trophy: Z'Maja

5459.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Cloudrest.
5459.name: Bust: Z'Maja

5460.description: This fan allows its bearer to steal another's face; though at the cost of slowly losing themselves.
5460.name: Fan of False-Face
5460.hint: Acquired by completing the "Relics of Summerset" achievement.

5461.description: The underground entrance way leads through a portal to an expansive forested glade in Hircine's Oblivion realm of The Hunting Grounds. Those "blessed" with lycanthropy can maintain werewolf form indefinitely in this otherworldly wilderness.
5461.name: Hunter's Glade

5462.description: When Artaeum was "removed" from Tamriel, a few neighboring isles went with it, including the site of the Grand Psijic Villa, a monumental estate with magnificent views of the south coast of the main island.
5462.name: Grand Psijic Villa

5463.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Shadowrend style.
5463.name: Shadowrend Greatsword

5464.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Shadowrend style.
5464.name: Shadowrend Bow

5465.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Shadowrend style.
5465.name: Shadowrend Shield

5466.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Shadowrend style.
5466.name: Shadowrend Staff

5467.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Shadowrend style.
5467.name: Shadowrend Axe

5470.description: It's said that when Meridia's Aurorans need mounts in Tamriel they conjure these shining Warhorses out of pure light. Perhaps so, but they're certainly solid enough to support a heavily armed warrior at the charge!
5470.name: Auroran Zenith Warhorse

5471.description: Like their mistress, the Daedric Prince Meridia, Aurorans have magical control over color and hue, so when they need a mount in Tamriel after dark it's no surprise that they conjure Warhorses that are as dark as night itself.
5471.name: Auroran Twilight Warhorse

5472.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Skyforge Smith Hammer style.
5472.name: Skyforge Smith Hammer
5472.hint: Acquired by completing the "Master Craftsman" achievement.

5473.description: After millennia buried under the ice, the lost Vault of Mhuvnak is once again within the reach of the people of Tamriel. Join the treasure hunter, Tharayya, on a daring expedition into the ancient Dwemer Frostvault and reveal the secrets buried there!
5473.name: Frostvault

5474.description: Centuries ago, the Empire made an ill-fated foray into the ruins an ancient Ayleid city. Follow in their footsteps with the treasure hunter, Tharayya, to discover what they sought and why they disappeared in the Depths of Malatar.
5474.name: Depths of Malatar

5539.description: This headstrong crystal skull ignored your decision to give it away and elected to stay with you instead. It could tell you all about the sublime mysteries of creation, but would much rather rant, joke, and complain.
5539.name: Augur of the Obscure
5539.hint: Acquired by completing the "Psijic Sage" achievement.

5545.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Vaults of Madness.
5545.name: Grothdarr Mask
5545.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Grothdarr Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5546.description: Purchased from Glirion the Redbeard at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Glirion's Mystery Coffer.
5546.name: Grothdarr Shoulder
5546.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Grothdarr Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5547.description: While it's unclear whether this little netch understands the nuances behind the Witches Festival's many traditions, its joyous tootling is reason enough to let it join in the celebrations.
5547.name: Witches Festival Ghost Netch

5548.description: Less common than the usual variety, the Pale-Plume Gryphons are found only along the seacoast cliffs near the Tower of Dusk in southeast Summerset. Their Fledglings make engaging pets that can be trained to follow their masters even into danger.
5548.name: Pale-Plume Fledgling Gryphon

5549.description: It's believed by some of the Sapiarchs of the High Elves that an Onyx Indrik comes about when a Nascent Indrik is exposed to certain berries imbued with geological Earthbones essences.
5549.name: Onyx Indrik
5549.hint: Obtained by combining four different Onyx Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Onyx Indrik.

5550.description: Some find it strange that the Pure-Snow Indrik should exist in Summerset, where winter never comes, but as the Sapiarch of Elemental Arcana points out, "Frost magic works everywhere."
5550.name: Pure-Snow Indrik
5550.hint: Obtained by combining four different Pure-Snow Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Pure-Snow Indrik.

5551.description: Calamity and mischance seem to follow in the hoofprints of this dark chargerâbut not for its rider! Gallop into battle on the back of this Soot Stallion and curse your opponents with all the ill luck of Black Fredas!
5551.name: Black Fredas Soot Stallion

5552.description: When the dro-m'Athra ride from the Dark Behind the World, they go mounted on these dread steeds: the Rahd-m'Athra! Are they spirits from the Dark Moons, or tangible creatures of evil?
5552.name: Rahd-m'Athra

5553.description: "Almost every stablemaster of the Marsh has fine, scaly lizard mounts available for purchase in various forms, all familiar to dryskins but specifically adapted to deep swamp conditions. So convenient, our lizard-steeds, so scaly and personable!" âUkaspa
5553.name: Wolf-Lizard Steed

5554.description: "More than once I have been asked, 'Ukaspa, why are your lizard-steeds shaped like mounts from other parts of Tamriel? Why aren't your so-very-handsome mounts shaped like, well, lizards?' These are good questions!" âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5554.name: Senche-Lizard Steed

5555.description: "Some dryskins ask, 'Since a Guar is already a swamp reptile mount, why create Lizard-Steeds shaped like Guar? Isn't that somewhat redundant?' These dryskins are unusually perceptive!" âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5555.name: Guar-Lizard Steed

5556.description: "Maybe the Camel-Lizard was created so we heroic Argonian adventurers could travel in arid climes like Anequinaâor maybe it was so heroic Khajiiti adventurers could have something to ride in Black Marsh. I don't know, I just want one." âHeem-Jas
5556.name: Camel-Lizard Steed

5557.description: "So, it's a Bear. Only it's a Lizard. And you can ride it? Shor's bones! That's all I need to know. I'll take it!" âCelebrated Nord Envoy Rigurt the Brash
5557.name: Bear-Lizard Steed

5558.description: "Sometimes Argonians want to travel a long way for a long time, and how do people do that? On mounts! And so useful lizards become Lizard Steeds of proven shapes, and then Argonians can ride, tall in the saddle and proud!" âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5558.name: Horse-Lizard Steed

5559.description: A Frost Mage of Clan Direnni spent her entire life perfecting a spell to permanently summon a Frost Atronach in the shape of a Sabre Cat. (Why? Who knows? Balfiera Island is a strange place.)
5559.name: Sabre Cat Frost Atronach

5560.description: Argonian heavy troops are informally known as Shellbacksâso inevitably, their heavy cavalry mounts are called Shellback Warhorses. They are among the strongest breeds known.
5560.name: Shellback Warhorse

5561.description: "These Glowgill Guar mounts come from a coastal tribe over near Archon. Handsome, are they not? I've been told they can breathe underwater through those gills, though personally, I have never tested this." âUkaspa, Stablemaster of Lilmoth
5561.name: Glowgill Guar

5562.description: There is some debate among naturalists as to whether the Ice Nixad is a separate breed that is mainly seen in the winter because it hibernates during the warm months, or whether it's just a winter phase of ordinary Nixads that sometimes stays year-round.
5562.name: Ice Nixad

5563.description: Though Argonians do relish the elastic flesh of the Black Marsh Swamp Jellies, the whimsical names they give them refer more to their appearance than to their flavor.
5563.name: Cantaloupe Swamp Jelly

5564.description: Though the Argonians claim that they name each breed of Black Marsh Swamp Jelly for its hue rather than its taste, there's no denying that the Mint Jelly does have a gratifyingly refreshing flavor.
5564.name: Mint Swamp Jelly

5565.description: The Plum Swamp Jelly is the rarest of the so-called "Flavor" Jellies, and seeing one is considered by many Argonians to be a sign of good fortune. It's not at all unusual for an Argonian to wear a Plum Jelly's feeler as a "Good Luck Tentacle."
5565.name: Plum Swamp Jelly

5585.name: Nibenese Noble's Shawled Robe

5589.description: The Arena Gladiators of Tamriel's pit-fighting circuit wear armor that exemplifies the sport's ancient tradition of a fighter's protection balanced with the crowd appeal of risk. Why else would one wear heavy armor with significant gaps in it?
5589.name: Arena Gladiator
5589.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with an Arena Gladiator's Exultation, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

5590.description: As a reminder that death awaits even the mightiest, at the Witches Festival heroes and adventurers are invited to humble themselves with juvenile games like bobbing for gorapples. Open wide!
5590.name: Apple-Bobbing Cauldron

5591.description: Cheerful face daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful green algae dye.

5600.description: The Witches Festival, which celebrates horror and death, also has a regrettable tradition of wanton vandalism associated with it, especially among Tamriel's callow youth. The so-called "Hollowjack Netch" appears to be a victim of this practice.
5600.name: Hollowjack Netch

5601.description: On the highest pinnacles of Eton Nir, where the snow never melts, live the pale Snowcap Gryphons. Perfectly camouflaged for a life in the clouds, for most of the First Era they were considered to be a myth.
5601.name: Snowcap Fledgling Gryphon

5602.description: Trophy taken from Vykosa the Ascendant in honor of an Undaunted victory in Moon Hunter Keep.

5617.name: Dead-Water Blood Face Tattoos

5618.description: When the fierce Dead-Water tribe goes to a formal declaration of conflict, the warriors daub themselves with red dye that resembles smears of blood.

5619.description: Is this just a dark fowl, mere poultry of sinister visageâor does it hail from realms beyond Nirn, mayhap from the Deadlands of Mehrunes Dagon or the Ashpit of Malacath? Dare you ask yourself the dread question: Which came first?
5619.name: Daemon Chicken

5620.description: A hardy domestic chicken found all along Skyrim's White River, said to have been originally bred in the old town of Riverwood. Owners grow extremely attached to them, and become outraged if they're harmed.
5620.name: Riverwood White Hen

5639.name: Sagacious Psijic Senche

5640.description: Though the Psijics are not a combat order, the monks do concede a need for protection when venturing beyond Artaeum, and when their fighting escorts need to be mounted, they conjure up these impressive warhorses for them.
5640.name: Psijic Escort Charger

5642.description: As a sign of the blessing of Mara, Goddess of Fertility, in spring certain breeds of Tamriel's hens lay eggs with shells in a variety of colors.
5642.name: Mara's Spring Chicken

5652.description: Hardy and good-natured, the faithful Skyrim Paint Pony wants to be near its master regardless of the weather, leaning into the wind even in a tundra blizzard.
5652.name: Scruffy Skyrim Paint Pony

5656.description: Though obviously related to the netches of northeast Tamriel, the swamp jellies of southern Black Marsh also have a disquieting resemblance to aquatic jellyfish. Natural philosophers have no adequate explanation for this.
5656.name: Swamp Jelly
5656.hint: Acquired by finding its seven Runebox Fragments in Cyrodilic Collections Daily Contract Recompense containers and combining them.

5657.description: This little critter's bright, beautiful colors are actually a warning to predators that it's a potent mouthful of poison. Fortunately for Tamriel's humanoid mortals, its venom affects them as no more than a mild hallucinogen.
5657.name: Kaleidotropic Dragon Frog

5658.description: "The Butterscotch Dragon Frog presumably got its name from the Argonian practice of naming creatures after flavors, whether those things taste like that or not. This one has no intention of finding out whether it does." âM'aiq the Liar
5658.name: Butterscotch Dragon Frog

5659.description: All the large Salamanders of southern Tamriel have elemental powers, but some specialize in particular forces; the Flame Skin breed, for example, almost ripples with fire.
5659.name: Flame Skin Salamander

5660.description: The large, lumbering Salamanders of southern Tamriel are known for defending themselves with various elemental burstsâall but one, the Toxin Skin variety, which relies on venom instead. Not even the Sapiarchs of the Crystal Tower can account for it.
5660.name: Toxin Skin Salamander

5661.description: The lumbering great Salamanders of southern Tamriel all defend themselves with bursts of elemental power, but the Shock Skin variety specializes in electrical discharges. Fortunately, they can be trained not to zap their masters!
5661.name: Shock Skin Salamander

5662.description: "Cats with odd-colored eyes see into the depths of those around them. Those with white fur? They see into time itself." âZamarak
5662.name: Prong-Eared Odd-Eyed Cat

5696.description: Learned from the Welkynar crafting style, acquired by combining Welkynar Bindings from the weekly quest for Cloudrest and ten Welkynar Bindings collected from defeating the final boss in Cloudrest.
5696.name: Welkynar Dagger

5697.description: "It is hard to start a campfire in the damps of the deep marsh, yes? Not when you have a Scorching Horse-Lizard! With one of these as your mount, you will never again have to eat cold eel stew!" âUkaspa, Stablemaster of Lilmoth
5697.name: Scorching Horse-Lizard

5698.description: "The Dwarven Spider Mounts from the Infernium Forge are unusual and distinctive, indicating to this Dwemer scholar that they all come from the hand of a single Deep Elf artisan." âGuylaine Marilie
5698.name: Infernium Dwarven Spider

5699.description: "The Dwarven Spiderlings from the Infernium Forge are unusual and distinctive, indicating to this Dwemer scholar that they all come from the hand of a single Deep Elf artisan." âGuylaine Marilie
5699.name: Infernium Dwarven Spiderling

5700.description: Non-Wood Elves might think it strange that Bosmeri Pod-Singers, who magically persuade Valenwood trees to grow into houses, wear clothes entirely made of animal leather and quills, but such is the mandate of the Green Pact.
5700.name: Deepwoods Pod-Singer Tunic

5701.description: "Durable, flexible, mudproof, and stylish," says the latest missive from designer Jaxa the Hermit delivered by his mute daughter. "What more could a Saxhleel want from a Crocskin Overkilt? Glowing torchbug buttons? Actually, that's not a bad ideaâ¦."
5701.name: Ranger's Crocskin Overkilt

5702.description: The thousands of small shiny particles that decorate the Treethane's Mosaic Jerkin may appear at first glance to be of turquoise or other precious stones, but they are actually the iridescent carapaces of deep forest beetles.
5702.name: Treethane's Mosaic Jerkin

5703.description: For the Argonian tribes that follow the custom, the Bonding Rite is a significant ceremony that requires an appropriately gaudy attire to mark its importance.
5703.name: Bonding Rite Vestment

5704.description: The clans of Anequina in Northern Elsweyr are largely nomadic, but they nonetheless have hereditary aristocracies that express their wealth and power through the splendor of their clothing.
5704.name: Noble Clan-Chief

5705.description: "This Chilling Senche-Lizard is quite rare; it comes from very deep in the swamp, from a tribe said to be dedicated to Frost spells as a means of living longer by living slower. Their Hist tree even drips with icicles (whatever they are)!" âUkaspa
5705.name: Chilling Senche-Lizard

5706.description: "Nothing says 'Back off!' like riding into town on a mount so seething with poison that it glows in the dark. When one comes from a place as bizarre as Black Marsh, one really has to go over the top to be impressive." âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5706.name: Venomous Wolf-Lizard

5707.description: When Imperials of Akaviri descent settled in and around Rimmen toward the end of the Potentate, something about these local Ringtailed Wolves found favor with them, and they domesticated and bred them into distinctive mounts.
5707.name: Rimmen Ringtailed Wolf

5708.description: Largest of all the furstocks, or "breeds" of Khajiit, the Senche-raht is fully intelligent, and in combat often serves simultaneously as warrior and mount.
5708.name: Senche-Raht

5709.description: "As the Sub-Sapiarch of Domestic Livestock, I was assigned by Larnatille to breed an appropriate mount for our sages to ride upon when working in the field. I proudly present my result: the loyal and majestic senche-serval!" âCorderil of Sunhold
5709.name: Sapiarchic Senche-Serval
5709.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

5710.description: As an incarnate nature spirit, an Indrik first appears in its comparatively drab Nascent form before somehow differentiating into one of their more splendid variations.
5710.name: Nascent Indrik

5711.description: Those doing darker deeds, such as practicing the art of Necromancy, might wish to have their attire reflect their interests. Dealing with the control and animation of the spirits and bodies of the deceased can take its toll on an average garment.
5711.name: Grim Harvester

5712.description: This smaller breed of haj mota lurks in the brackish estuaries of Black Marsh's southern coast, camouflaged by the gray color of the murky tidewater. When hand-raised from hatching, they make surprisingly pleasant pets.
5712.name: Slateback Haj Mota

5713.description: A haj mota is an ambush predator, waiting patiently in concealment until its prey should come into attack range. The Verdigris breed tends to hide in algae-covered pools where its color acts as camouflage.
5713.name: Verdigris Haj Mota
5713.hint: Acquired by traveling to Lilmoth in Murkmire for the first time.

5714.description: Though the adult Bear-Lizards can be quite intimidating, even fearsome, the roly-poly lizard cubs are disarmingly cute. (For reptiles, that is.)
5714.name: Bear-Lizard Cub

5715.description: When young Argonian egg-siblings tell their creche-parents they want a pony, this is what they mean. And now that you've seen it, don't you want one, too?
5715.name: Pony-Lizard

5716.description: True, it does hiss rather than meow, and has shiny scales rather than soft fur, but otherwise the Senche-Lizard Cub is just as adorable as any other kitten.
5716.name: Senche-Lizard Cub

5717.description: The Wolf-Lizard Pup is simply adorable when it tries to howl, just hisses instead, and looks ever so confused.
5717.name: Wolf-Lizard Pup

5718.description: Though you know it's just going to grow up and become big, dumb, scaly livestock, how can you resist those lizard-calf eyes?
5718.name: Guar-Lizard Calf

5719.description: Most Echalettes are docile and fawn-like, but not the Badger Ruff breed, which are strangely fierce and irritable. They're so ornery they've been known to chase away inquisitive Sabre Cats.
5719.name: Badger Ruff Echalette

5720.description: The migratory Monarch Butterfly is a common sight across all of southern Tamriel, and it's seen in the northern provinces during summer. The Monarch is said to represent the souls of the present, in contrast to the Ancestor Moth that represents the past.
5720.name: Monarch Butterfly

5721.description: "Ha ha! Fooled you, didn't it? Looks just like a Baby Dragon, doesn't it? Well, there are no such things, and you should know better. It's just an Illusion Imp with a rather Peryite look to it. Baby Dragon, really!" âAbnur Tharn
5721.name: Green Dragon Imp

5722.description: "The Jerboas, you say? Ah, yes, the little jumping skeevers with the so-big ears. There are many in the Ashen Scar, and if you catch one when it's small, it makes for a pleasant, fuzzy friend. I had one when I was a kitten!" âShuzirri of Riverhold
5722.name: Ashen Scar Jerboa

5723.description: The legend among the underworld explorers of the Undaunted is that these little incendiary sprites are responsible for lighting all the candles, torches, and lanterns found burning underground, flying ahead of adventurers to ignite them in the dark.
5723.name: Brimstone Nixad

5724.description: "Kaoc! That luridly patterned Scale Skin style worn by the Bright-Throats is far too gaudy. Could a serious person appear in public like that? I think not." âJaxsik-Orrn of the Dead-Water tribe
5724.name: Bright-Throat Scale

5725.description: "The Crystalfrost skin is a cosmetic Alteration spell that gives a mortal the appearance of a Frost Atronach. Why would a mortal want to look like a Frost Atronach? Don't ask me, I don't even like putting on makeup." âGabrielle Benele, Mages Guild
5725.name: Crystalfrost
5725.hint: Acquired by completing the "Newly Charitable" achievement.

5726.description: "Not to be overly critical, but in my opinion the shadowy Scale Skin of the Dead-Waters is entirely too austere. Though it is, I admit, simple and elegant." âXukas
5726.name: Dead-Water Scale

5727.description: Most Argonians live above ground, where the sun can shine on the leaves of their Hists, but some, strange and reclusive, live in subterranean caverns. Over time their scales grow as pale as marsh mist.
5727.name: Marshmist Palescale
5727.hint: Acquired by completing the "Blackrose Prison Conqueror" achievement in Blackrose Prison.

5728.description: The Dead-Water Tribe of Naga Argonians are a spiky lot to begin with, and when they want to look tough, they just pile on more spikes. This trick works for just about anyone, really.
5728.name: Dead-Water Tooth-and-Tusk Tiara

5729.description: It's said that a warrior of the Dead-Water tribe saw the impressive sideburns on a Breton general and decided it was a look that could be improved upon with Jaw-Fins. Wise decision.
5729.name: Dead-Water Jaw-Fin Fringe

5730.description: For the Argonian tribes that follow the custom, the Bonding Rite is a significant ceremony that requires an appropriately gaudy headdress to mark its importance.
5730.name: Bonding Rite Headdress

5731.description: Invoke these Tablets of Archaic Lore and they glow with the wisdom of ancient knowledge!
5731.name: Archaic Lore Tablets

5732.description: When invoked, this creates a brief, ephemeral image of the Remnant of Argon.
5732.name: Dream Amulet of Argon
5732.hint: Acquired by completing the "Hero of Murkmire" achievement in the Murkmire DLC game pack.

5733.description: Kick a sports ball like an Argonian!
5733.name: Kick Ball

5734.description: Of the many instruments used by the Argonians of Murkmire, the drum is the simplest and most common.
5734.name: Mire Drum

5735.description: This memento enables one to play the bizarre Argonian vossa-satl, or Frog-Pipes. Party in the swamp!
5735.name: Vossa-Satl

5736.description: The user enters a brief posture evocative of an Argonian communing with their tribe's Hist tree.
5736.name: Commune with Hist

5738.description: Displays a typical Black Marsh greeting gesture between tribal Argonians.
5738.name: Argonian Greeting

5739.description: A dexterous display of deck division and distribution!
5739.name: Cardsharp
5739.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Tournament Begins" in High Isle.

5740.description: Put your mastery of the Argonian teeba on full display with this stylish dribble.
5740.name: Teeba Dribble

5741.description: Warm up for a rousing game of teeba-enoo, a popular Argonian pastime.
5741.name: Teeba Warm-Up

5742.description: Show that you are prepared for a teeba kick-off with this ready stance.
5742.name: Teeba Ready Position

5743.description: Perform the greeting of the Hist to those you meet.
5743.name: Hist Greeting

5744.description: Acknowledge others in the traditional battle-oriented manner of the Dead-Water tribe.
5744.name: Dead-Water Greeting

5745.description: Express your hope for understanding among all beings by using the Bright Throat tribe's greeting.
5745.name: Bright Throat Greeting

5746.description: This unusual emote displays an aggressive "Gladiator" gesture that varies depending upon what kind of weapon the user has equipped. All indicate a warrior who's ready for action!
5746.name: Gladiator Taunt
5746.hint: Acquired by combining 30 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with an Arena Gladiator's Mockery, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

5749.description: Contemplate the Lunar Lattice like a true Khajiit, thinking deep feline thoughts and totally not taking a cat nap.
5749.name: Cat Contemplation

5750.description: Nothing is more important to a self-respecting Khajiit than proper grooming! Clean those ears and whiskers.
5750.name: Feline Hygiene

5751.description: No merchant beckons a customer with more charm and enthusiasm than a Baandari Pedlar!
5751.name: Pedlar Beckoning

5752.description: This emote requests a festive and seasonal public display of affection. Use with care!
5752.name: Mistletoe

5753.description: A cheeky request for a rude public display of affection!
5753.name: Mistletoe Posterior

5754.description: Ring in New Life with this festive bell-ringing emote!
5754.name: Festive Bell Ring

5755.description: Travel to Murkmire, the southernmost region of mysterious Black Marsh, and venture into the deep swamps to learn some of the most hidden secrets of the Argonians!
5755.name: Murkmire

5756.description: Get small to go large: this miniature Snow Globe Home is tiny on the outside but expansive on the inside, proving shrunken real estate is a big bargain! And to make the interior cozier, the exterior features an eternally-festive gentle snowfall. Magical!
5756.name: Enchanted Snow Globe Home

5757.description: Stay moist in an underwater Xanmeer Manor with its own submerged picture windows! Gaze into the depths of a lush Murkmire lake from the sunken interior of this capacious Argonian edifice, where comfort mixes casually with the bizarre. Xuth!
5757.name: Lakemire Xanmeer Manor

5763.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Arx Corinium.
5763.name: Sellistrix Mask
5763.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Sellistrix Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5764.description: Purchased from Glirion the Redbeard at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Glirion's Mystery Coffer.
5764.name: Sellistrix's Shoulder
5764.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Sellistrix Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5765.description: The rare and colorful Shock Nixad looks rather like a tiny, winged Storm Atronach, though without the whirling electric rocks. They make loyal companionsâthough they may also make your hair stand on end!
5765.name: Blue Shock Nixad
