5830.description: An outfit both pretty and practical for working the common room of the local tavern.
5830.name: Tavern Maid

5843.description: The word goes forth! Abnur Tharn, battlemage and former Imperial advisor, requires able-bodied allies to defend the cat-folk of Elsweyr against a rage of Dragons. Only the most brave need apply. Find Tharn in Riverhold, in Northern Elsweyr.
5843.name: Elsweyr

5846.description: The Hot Pepper Bantam Guar breed is native to the "spice island" of Esroniet, the source of much of Tamriel's nutmeg, cloves, mace, and hot peppers. And the Pepper Guar has a spicy little personality to go with its name!
5846.name: Hot Pepper Bantam Guar

5847.description: "The recesses of our nightmares contain horrors that we often cannot look at. Yet we must, lest these pockets of terror fester and grow. To light your path, I present this bantam guar. Please do not squeal." â Overheard in a dark alley
5847.name: Eerie Violet Bantam Guar

5848.description: When asked about the rumor that the Hot-Blooded Bantam Guar had been bred as a vampiric sub-species by the disgraced mage Darvasen before he was exiled from Shad Astula, Arch-Mage Valeyn replied, "What nonsense! They just like to eat tomatoes. Trust me."
5848.name: Hot-Blooded Bantam Guar

5849.description: Start with a dollop of wiggly cuteness, add a dash of the Coldharbour glow, and you get a bantam guar that causes "oohs!" and "ahhhs!" wherever you go, plus helps you avoid stubbing your toe at night when you leave your bed. Genius!
5849.name: Coldharbour Bantam Guar

5850.description: "A fur-less, cold-blooded reptile with icy blue eyes that comes from the frozen, far-north, and in-all-likelihood legendary continent of Atmora? Bah. I refuse to believe it." âPhrastus of Elinhir
5850.name: Atmoran Bantam Guar

5851.description: It may look cute, but this volcanic little pest comes from Mehrunes Dagon's Oblivion plane of the Deadlands: it's got lava in its blood and fire in its eyes, so keep it away from the curtains.
5851.name: Deadlands Bantam Guar

5852.description: A donkey might not be the most glamorous pack animal, but it's certainly the hardiest and most sure-footed, toting heavy loads through desert, mountains, and tundra without complaint â¦ though it will give you a dirty look, and might nip if you turn away!
5852.name: Explorer's Pack Donkey
5852.hint: |cffffffPurchasing this pet increases your inventory capacity by 5 slots on all characters account wide.|r

5853.description: According to Nord legend, in its native land of Atmora this Chub Loon is much larger, as tall as two warriors and with a squawk that starts avalanches. It took mighty Ysgramor a day and a night to wrestle one down from Shivering Glacier. What, you doubt?
5853.name: Atmoran Chub Loon

5854.description: Stolid, careful, sturdy, and long-suffering, the Treasure Hunter's Horse is resigned to a life of being ridden into crumbling ruins by a reckless master who's searching for wealth but often finds only danger.
5854.name: Treasure Hunter's Horse

5855.description: North of Windhelm in Skyrim, where the snow on the heights never melts, the Nords' great Wolfhounds have lighter and fluffier fur coats. In addition to barking, they even howl a bit like the wolves they pursue.
5855.name: Winterhold Wolfhound

5856.description: One might think that being frozen in a glacier for several thousand years would damage a delicate mechanism like a Dwarven Spider, but in the case of the Icebound units it seems instead to have preserved them in perfect working order.
5856.name: Icebound Dwarven Spider
5856.hint: Awarded for completing the "Frostvault Conqueror" Achievement.

5857.description: "The forces of Nocturnal's attempted invasion of the Colored Rooms were inadvertently accompanied by some Evergloam Daedrats, which afterward were rounded up, Lustrated for purification, and then banished to Nirn." âSapiarch Galaadil
5857.name: Lustrated Daedrat

5858.description: According to the notebooks of Corvus Direnni, the frost senche-panther may actually be a form of atronach summoned from a plane known as the Fourth Sinus of Takubar. Why it remains in Tamriel where it willingly submits to the orders of mortals is unknown.
5858.name: Dragonscale Frost Senche

5859.description: "I have been fortunate enough to have personally glimpsed a Solar Horse on an Anequine morning, and I say with conviction that it must be a creature of Magrus, the Cat's Eye, and no other." âMoon-Bishop Hunal
5859.name: Dragonscale Solar Horse

5861.description: "Our Lady of the Infinite Energies, Strict but Fair Arbiter of Inner Luminance, grant unto thy most devoted worshiper a sign of thy radiant favor, mayhap a loveable, glowing Sabre Cat cub." âSayings of Valasha
5861.name: Meridian Sabre Cub

5862.description: Tired of pets that follow you everywhere? Fed up with feeding them? Step up to Pebble Pal, the pet that's a â¦ rock.
5862.name: Pebble Pal
5862.hint: |cff0000This pet cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5863.description: Pining for a perfect pet? Perhaps you're a person who'd prefer a pleasantly playful piglet, pearly-white, pretty, and partial to paladins and protectors!
5863.name: Pink Pearl Pig

5864.description: The Dwarven Theodolite was a sort of automated measuring device designed to explore and survey subterranean areas; this version is notable for its distinctive red "eye."
5864.name: Carnelian Theodolite

5865.description: "I would speculate that the Storm Wolf is the result of an experiment by a powerful Destruction mage in which a wild canine was subjected to prolonged exposure to a Meip Glyph of Shock." âGabrielle Benele, Wizard
5865.name: Dragonscale Storm Wolf

5866.description: The rare Sweetroll Grizzly Bears prowl the golden forests of the Rift on the northern slopes of the Jerall Mountains. They're big strong cuddly hug machinesâexcept when they're angry.
5866.name: Sweetroll Grizzly

5867.description: Deep in the shadows of the Tenmar Forest, hidden by its camouflaged coat and stealthy stalking, the Senche-Tiger is a nearly invisible jungle predator. Even as a mount, it retains something of the air of mystery it wears in the wild.
5867.name: Tenmar Senche-Tiger

5868.description: Though in coloration the Glenumbra Border Wolf resembles certain Breton dog breeds, this sturdy and stoic mount is no dog, and will carry a High Rock courier for leagues through dark night and heavy weather.
5868.name: Glenumbra Border Wolf

5869.description: "Some accounts of Meridia's plane of the Colored Rooms describe a menagerie of light-imbued spectral beasts elevated from Nirn and 'purified' by the Lady's holy light." âSayings of Valasha
5869.name: Meridian Sabre Cat

5870.description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Horses are popular in the Daggerfall Covenant.
5870.name: Novelty Stick Horse
5870.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5871.description: Shorn Camels are desert mounts with elaborate Tattoos on their hide where once there were wiry bristles. The "Verdant," with its repeating floral designs, may be the most beautiful of them all.
5871.name: Verdant Tattoo Shorn Camel

5872.description: Frankly, compared to war horses, bear mounts, and even saddle guars, it's hard for Camels to look magnificentâuntil you dress them in Dragonscale Bard. Then look out!
5872.name: Dragonscale Barded Camel

5873.description: "This one doesn't sell many Guars here at the Riverhold Stables because Khajiit are folk who value their natural dignity and prefer not to ride so silly a beast. But a Guar in Dragonscale Bard is a thing of beauty!" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5873.name: Dragonscale Barded Guar

5874.description: "Our distant cousins, the senche-mounts, look so majestic in Dragonscale Bard, like creatures who've just stepped out of an ancient wall-frieze in Dune. Perhaps these pesky Dragons have a use after all, yes?" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5874.name: Dragonscale Barded Senche

5875.description: "I had always thought the Helkarn Wolf to be Elsweyr's finest Wolf mount, but that was before I saw a cavalry Wolf in Dragonscale Bard. Could a mount look any more martial?" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5875.name: Dragonscale Barded Wolf

5876.description: Dragonscale bard is just about the heaviest armor one can put on a mount, but bears bred as mounts are so strong they scarcely seem to notice it.
5876.name: Dragonscale Barded Bear

5877.description: "Dragons are a pain in the tailbones, yes? But their scales make such superb steed armor! The Dragonscale Barded War-Horse may be the sharpest mount this one has ever seen!" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5877.name: Dragonscale Barded War-Horse

5878.description: The Daggerfall Dapple is a hardy horse breed that comes from the Farwatch region of Glenumbra between Daggerfall and Camlorn. Known for its endurance, it's a favorite of long-distance riders.
5878.name: Daggerfall Dapple Horse

5879.description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Guars are popular in the Aldmeri Dominion.
5879.name: Novelty Stick Guar
5879.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5880.description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Dragons are popular in the Ebonheart Pact.
5880.name: Novelty Stick Dragon
5880.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5881.description: Some scholars study the ancient history of Tamriel from libraries and archives, but the more active investigators do their studies in the field, exploring ancient ruins that are often both dirty and deadly dangerous.
5881.name: Ancient Sites Explorer

5882.description: You might think the profession of Fisher is one that's simple, slow, or easy. You'd change your mind fast the first time you hauled in a net full of slaughterfish!
5882.name: Fisherfolk Work Wear

5884.description: As a Treasure Hunter, forever poking around in shadowy nooks and crannies for loose gems, lost journals, and hidden levers, what could be more important to you than your trusty ever-burning torch? Never again be lost in the dark without it!
5884.name: Treasure Hunter

5885.description: Whoop it up to celebrate whatever Tamrielic festival is going on or just make a nuisance of yourself in the tavern common room with this Festive Noise Maker!
5885.name: Festive Noise Maker
5885.hint: Obtained by consuming Festive Noise Maker Parts, which can occasionally be found in Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes.

5886.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's like a sweetroll mountain, a festival for your taste buds!
5886.name: Jubilee Cake 2019
5886.hint: Obtained by completing the 2019 Anniversary event.

5887.description: What's this? A tiny cask? How intriguing! What can it possibly contain? Maybe if I shake it near my ear I can hearâOh!
5887.name: Jester's Festival Joke Popper
5887.hint: Obtained by consuming Joke Popper Parts, which can occasionally be found in Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes.

5888.description: Invoking this crystal prism briefly exalts the user with the luminous feeling of being possessed by the Lady of Infinite Energies.
5888.name: Meridian Possession Prism

5889.description: This enchanted Ribbon briefly unfurls a Prismatic Banner over the head of its user.
5889.name: Prismatic Banner Ribbon

5890.description: This miniature Psijic Projector briefly displays the glowing illusion of a Gold Dragon hovering over the hand of its user.
5890.name: Gold Dragon Hand Projector

5891.description: Imitate an obnoxious mute comedian who imitates pulling on a nonexistent rope to imitate an invisible game of Tug of War!
5891.name: Pantomime Tug-of-War

5892.description: Sometimes the only way to have a decent conversation and get a straight answer is to talk to your own hand. Right?
5892.name: Chatty Hand Puppet

5893.description: (Silent scream.) "Let me out! I'm trapped behind an invisible wall! Help! No, reallyâinvisible walls! Get me out of here! Isn't this convincing? Just look!"
5893.name: Wall Pantomime

5895.description: There's a bitter wind blowing in off the Sea of Ghostsâbetter warm your hands!
5895.name: Warm Hands

5896.description: There are various fairy-tale reasons for kissing a frog. Argonians prefer to taste them, to savor what they call "amphibian brandy."
5896.name: Kiss the Frog

5897.description: These geometrical face markings emphasize the lost Dwemer's obsession with numerical precision, and make their wearer look as tough as a Dwarven mechanism.
5897.name: Dwarven Geometry Face Markings

5898.description: These repeating geometrical body markings emphasize the lost Dwemer's obsession with numerical precision, and make their wearer look as tough as a Dwarven mechanism.
5898.name: Dwarven Geometry Body Markings

5899.description: Tattoos that replicate the distinctive iconography of Alftand, the only known Dwarven site built partially inside an active, moving glacier.
5899.name: Alftand Glacial Face Tattoos

5900.description: Tattoos that replicate the distinctive iconography of Alftand, the only known Dwarven site built partially inside an active, moving glacier.
5900.name: Alftand Glacial Body Tattoos

5901.description: An impressive set of face markings inspired by that giant mechanical guardian of Dwemer ruins, the Dwarven Centurion!
5901.name: Dwarven Centurion Face Tattoos

5903.description: An impressive set of body markings inspired by that giant mechanical guardian of Dwemer ruins, the Dwarven Centurion!
5903.name: Dwarven Centurion Body Tattoos

5904.description: "The Light of Meridia bursts into your chest and then seems to come alive, coiling and burning throughout your body and head, illuminating you from within." âThe Sayings of Valasha
5904.name: Meridian Radiance Face Tattoos

5905.description: "The Light of Meridia bursts into your chest and then seems to come alive, coiling and burning throughout your body and head, illuminating you from within." âThe Sayings of Valasha
5905.name: Meridian Radiance Body Tattoos

5906.description: Celebrate the brightest light of all the Lady's Infinite Energies with these glowing Meridian Sunburst Tattoos.
5906.name: Meridian Sunburst Face Tattoos

5907.description: Celebrate the brightest light of all the Lady's Infinite Energies with these glowing Meridian Sunburst Tattoos.
5907.name: Meridian Sunburst Body Tattoos

5908.description: Before battle, warriors consecrated to Meridia often paint their faces with these energetic "War Burst" markings.
5908.name: Meridian War Burst Face Markings

5909.description: Before battle, warriors consecrated to Meridia often paint their bodies with these energetic "War Burst" markings.
5909.name: Meridian War Burst Body Markings

5910.description: In recent years, irritating voiceless street performers with painted faces have begun appearing in all the plazas and market squares of Tamriel, begging for coin while pretending to be trapped in invisible boxes. Are you obnoxious enough for Mime Time?
5910.name: Obnoxious Mute Face Paint
5910.hint: Awarded for completing the "Dessert Domination" Achievement.

5911.description: A replica of the First Era royal crown of one of the last Ayleid kingdoms in Cyrodiil.
5911.name: Ayleid Royal Crown
5911.hint: Acquired by entering either the Depths of Malatar or Frostvault dungeons for the first time.

5912.description: This intimidating facial jewelry, a favorite with adherents of the Daedric Prince Boethiah, conveys the idea that its wearer seethes with barely contained fury that might erupt at any provocation.
5912.name: "Chained Wrath" Piercings

5913.description: On Vvardenfell, home to so many Dwarven ruins, treasure hunters scavenge the ancient sites for whatever they find that might be useful. Some Dark Elves in Balmora have built a cottage industry out of making jewelry from the parts of old Dwemer mechanisms.
5913.name: Dwarven Sprocket Earrings

5914.description: "Those who betray their oaths to the Lady of Infinite Energies will be purged of their corruption, lustrated, and purified so they can endure to fulfill their vows. Forever." âSayings of Valasha
5914.name: Meridian Purified
5914.hint: Acquired by completing the "Depths of Malatar Conqueror" achievement.

5915.description: Certain Goblin tribes instill fierce recklessness in their warriors by encouraging them to think of themselves as already dead, chalking their forms before battle with what their adversaries refer to as Ghost Goblin War Paint.
5915.name: Ghost Goblin Face War Paint

5916.description: "I found the shipwreck locked in ice. The crew were all frozen and frostbitten, and I thought they were dead â¦ until they rose, frost-crusted and icy, and picked up their weapons." âAelfrydda of Dawnstar
5916.name: Arctic Rime Skin

5918.description: Wear the haughty golden laurels of the Nibenese aristocracy with this Coronet and look down your noble nose at lesser mortals!
5918.name: Nibenese Laurel Coronet

5924.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Spindleclutch II.
5924.name: Bloodspawn Mask
5924.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Bloodspawn Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5925.description: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Maj's Mystery Coffer.
5925.name: Bloodspawn Shoulder
5925.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Bloodspawn Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5926.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Spindleclutch I.
5926.name: Swarm Mother Mask
5926.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Swarm Mother Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5927.description: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Maj's Mystery Coffer.
5927.name: Swarm Mother Shoulder
5927.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Swarm Mother Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

5930.description: This meticulous reproduction of the ancient Argonian calendar may not have the storied history of the original, but is a masterpiece of stonework in its own right.
5930.name: Replica of the Xinchei-Konu
5930.hint: Awarded for bringing all twelve tablets of the Xinchei-Konu to Jekka-Wass Vozei at the Xinchei-Konu Monument northeast of Lilmoth.

6003.name: Voriplasm Battle Axe

6007.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Voriplasm style.
6007.name: Voriplasm Bow

6010.name: Voriplasm Staff

6011.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Voriplasm style.
6011.name: Voriplasm Sword

6013.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Blackrose Prison.
6013.name: Bust: Drakeeh the Unchained
6013.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Blackrose Prison.

6014.description: Trophy taken from Drakeeh the Unchained in honor of an Undaunted victory in Blackrose Prison.
6014.name: Trophy: Drakeeh the Unchained

6018.description: The Coffee Scorpion gets its name from the way they like their kaveh in Rihad: strong, dark, and sweet. (Well, I guess two out of three isn't bad.)
6018.name: Rihad Coffee Scorpion

6019.description: Certain Goblin tribes instill fierce recklessness in their warriors by encouraging them to think of themselves as already dead, chalking their forms before battle with what their adversaries refer to as Ghost Goblin War Paint.
6019.name: Ghost Goblin Body War Paint

6032.description: The uncanny Gloam Wolf hails from the Oblivion plane of the Daedric Prince Nocturnal. Sometimes, the Night Mistress will reward a loyal Tamrielic worshiper with a Gloam Wolf Mount sent permanently to Nirn.
6032.name: Gloam Wolf

6033.description: The many multicolored eggs of Tamriel are valuable for their differing alchemical properties, and this makes the Egg Hunter's job a profitable one, especially in the spring.
6033.name: Egg Hunter's Horse

6034.description: Hailing from Nocturnal's Oblivion realm of Evergloam, the Gloam Wolf Cub seems to oscillate like an optical illusion between adorable and sinister.
6034.name: Gloam Wolf Cub

6035.description: According to Nibenese legend, a house where its owner was murdered will be haunted by the shade of their cat, sent from beyond by Lord Hollowjack to torment the killer with eternal shame and guilt.
6035.name: Ghostly Housecat

6036.description: Is this ghostly Elk an antlered mount from the spirit world, or is it a sending from Lord Hircine's Oblivion plane of the Hunting Grounds? It seems solid enough, and doesn't disappear in broad daylight, so it must be more than just a haunt!
6036.name: Eerie Elk of Dread

6037.description: Unlike most Gryphons, which catch live prey, the Vulture Gryphons subsist primarily on carrion. But they're still majestic, and their young Fledglings still make adorable pets!
6037.name: Fledgling Vulture Gryphon

6038.description: "To those who do not live in the desert heat, it seems strange that we wear long sleeves and trousers," says Sar'aq of Sentinel, "but really, nothing is more practical than a long, billowing pair of salvar breeches."
6038.name: Sentinel Vest and Salvar

6039.description: "In Hammerfell, our Crown nobility prefer clothing simple and traditional in cut, but rich and varied in material," says designer Sar'aq of Sentinel. "This ensemble is appropriate for both receiving noble guests and visiting others."
6039.name: Magnifica's Sundas Wear

6040.description: A clan of vampires have captured a Dragon at Moongrave Fane and plan to drain its blood to gain its power. You must venture deep within the jungle temple to stop these vampires and the lost Dragonguard that leads them.
6040.name: Moongrave Fane

6041.description: The corruption of the Dragon, Maarselok, creeps out from his lair, threatening all Grahtwood. Help the forces of Elden Root defend the Green and end the Azure Blight with an unlikely ally: the forest spirit, Selene.
6041.name: Lair of Maarselok

6043.description: Unlocks all Dragon Bone outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.
6043.name: Dragon Bone Outfit Style

6044.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Darkshade Caverns II.
6044.name: Engine Guardian Mask
6044.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Engine Guardian Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6045.description: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Maj's Mystery Coffer.
6045.name: Engine Guardian Shoulder
6045.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Engine Guardian Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6046.description: Use this enchanted gemstone to cast a brief illusion of a flight of Dragons.
6046.name: Dragon Flight Illusion Gem
6046.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Halls of Colossus."

6047.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Engine Guardian style.
6047.name: Engine Guardian Dagger

6048.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Engine Guardian style.
6048.name: Engine Guardian Staff

6053.name: Statuette: Azura, Moon and Star

6054.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Hircine, the Huntsman.
6054.name: Statuette: Hircine, the Huntsman

6055.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, Lord of Brutality.
6055.name: Statuette: Molag Bal, the Brutal

6056.description: A miniature statue of the living god Lord Vivec, Warrior-Poet.
6056.name: Statuette: Vivec, Warrior-Poet

6057.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile, holding aloft his Masque.
6057.name: Statuette: Clavicus Vile, Masque

6058.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Sheogorath, the Mad God.
6058.name: Statuette: Sheogorath, the Mad

6059.description: "A 'Baby Dragon,' you say? No such thing. What you have there is a clever Illusion Imp that's found a way to get free handouts and a warm place to sleep. Young folk these days: so gullible." âDivayth Fyr
6059.name: Blue Dragon Imp

6060.description: Trophy taken from King Narilmor in honor of an Undaunted victory in Depths of Malatar.
6060.name: Trophy: King Narilmor
6060.hint: Awarded for completing Depths of Malatar.

6061.name: Bust: King Narilmor
6061.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Depths of Malatar.

6064.description: Arena Lions are trained to absolute obedience, whether as sturdy and savage Craglorn companions or as pit-fighting beasts taught to drag out a kill for the entertainment of an audience.
6064.name: Elinhir Arena Lion
6064.hint: Acquired by combining 40 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with an Arena Gladiator's Roar, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

6139.description: This side entrance to Frostvault leads down to a deep and spacious side grotto that was cut off from the main caverns long ago, though power still flows into it through conduits from the central source. Careful, those platforms have no handrails!
6139.name: Frostvault Chasm

6140.description: Pit Fighting promoter Crottus "Thumbs-Down" Lycus built this private arena atop the haunted ruins of Molavar because the land was cheap, and what could go wrong? He vanished mysteriously some time ago, and now his unique Arena Home is back on the market.
6140.name: Elinhir Private Arena

6146.description: Part of the Prophet's style, obtained from Anniversary Jubilee Gift Boxes.
6146.name: Prophet's Staff

6181.description: With the Baandari Pedlar Camel as your mount, you can go farther between water breaks, plus enjoy the sight of camel spit distressing those unlucky enough to be in range.
6181.name: Baandari Pedlar Camel

6182.description: The well-traveled Baandari Pedlars lend their style to this horse's tack, creating a look any lover of rich hues would die for. Today it can be yoursâwith no need to die!
6182.name: Baandari Pedlar Steed

6183.description: The Baandari Pedlars find the keen sense of smell that their wolf mounts possess to be a useful source of extra profit. They sometimes offer their services as trackers, but only if other profit is not at hand!
6183.name: Baandari Pedlar Brindle Wolf

6184.description: For years, the Baandari Pedlars have traveled hither and yon, requiring them to train and equip mounts for both comfort and utility. Now you too can ride a colorful guar mount that has that Baandari style!
6184.name: Baandari Pedlar Guar

6185.description: Prone to rumbles and purrs, the Baandari Pedlar Senche-Lion serves as both a mount and a source of warmth on cold evenings around the campfire. Just watch out for that rasping tongue.
6185.name: Baandari Pedlar Senche-Lion

6186.description: The colors exhibited by the Cerulean Scorpion make it a creature sought after by artists and by those who prefer their companions to have a bit of a sting to them.
6186.name: Cerulean Scorpion

6187.description: In their travels, the Baandari Pedlars have shown off their pack ponies to the delight of children everywhere. Recently they began selling them, and now children put even more pressure on parents to acquire them.
6187.name: Pedlar Pack Pony

6188.description: Even the pups receive the full Baandari Pedlar tack treatment! These wolf cubs are often seen chasing each other around those seeking wares from the Pedlars, sometimes tripping up customers until they're trained to know better.
6188.name: Pedlar Pack Wolf Cub

6189.description: The Baandari Pedlars first used these repurposed mechanized spiders to help retrieve things that got lost in crevices and the like. For the right price, they may sell you one.
6189.name: Pedlar Pack Spider

6190.description: To prepare their Senche-Lion mounts, the Baandari Pedlars train them with full gear as cubs. Despite the tack, these cubs pounce and play as kittens do.
6190.name: Pedlar Pack Senche-Lion Cub

6191.description: Need some happiness in your day? The Alabaster Jerboa is your answer. Its hopping and air-dancing acrobatics can bring a smile to even the grumpiest Dark Elf.
6191.name: Alabaster Jerboa

6192.description: Before ice-fire senche-lions become mounts, they start as adorable cubs. But be careful! These cute creatures still require careful handling due to their mix of cold and flame.
6192.name: Sunspire Ice-Fire Senche-Cub

6193.description: A traditional gift to successful Dragon Hunters, this pup exhibits the same courage that these hunters must have, and also reminds them of the lives they're protecting with their ongoing work.
6193.name: Elder Dragon Hunter Wolf Pup

6194.description: Originally bred to find and kill rats on the docks of the Iliac Bay, the Breton Terrier has found a place in the hearts and minds of many Tamrielics due to its joyful and wriggly behavior.
6194.name: Breton Terrier

6195.description: "While carrying out an assignment from Larnatille in my role as Sub-Sapiarch of Domestic Livestock, I created a mount both loyal and majestic. Though the kitten stage is â¦ a bit trying." âCorderil of Sunhold
6195.name: Senche-Serval Kitten

6196.description: The discovery of this "lynx" created waves in noble circles when certain of their number realized they could have a feline around without succumbing to fur-based allergies. Now you see them everywhere.
6196.name: Sphynx Lynx

6197.description: Do the Guar Stomp! Rahrr! Wave your tiny hands! Grahrr! Stomp your reptile feet! GUAR!
6197.name: Guar Stomp
6197.hint: Acquired by finding its seven Runebox Fragments in Northern Elsweyr Defense Force Cache containers and combining them.

6198.description: Originally bred for a reclusive family in Rivenspire, the Indigo Senche-Panther possesses a distinctive black fur that has a purple sheen. Rumors claim that when left to its own devices, it stalks werewolves for amusement.
6198.name: Indigo Senche-Panther

6199.description: Bred for speed and battle, the White Spotted Courser holds a special place in the hearts of war historians due to their prominence as cavalry mounts in the Battle of Dragon Wall.
6199.name: White Spotted Courser

6200.description: When summoned, this warrior mount of the deathless Anka-Ra mystically amalgamates, drawing sand and strength from the distant Alik'r.
6200.name: Anka-Ra Sandcamel

6201.description: Not only is this vamidium crafted from an Ebony and Ebon Steel alloy, but it also has the form of a Dwarven Spider, making it a must-have for those who prefer dark clothes and darker lives.
6201.name: Ebony Dwarven Spider

6202.description: A combination of feline agility with the power of a sandstorm makes this mount both a favored and feared battle companion of the eternally loyal Anka-Ra warriors.
6202.name: Anka-Ra Senche-Lion

6203.description: Ready to rule the arena? With the Arena Gladiator Horse as your steed, you'll do so in flashy style. Each one has received special training from former gladiatorial champions that makes it a practical and dashing choice.
6203.name: Arena Gladiator Horse

6204.description: The long-lost Dwemer never spread as far as Elsweyr, but the Baandari Pedlars go everywhere, and will adapt even ancient technology to their uses.
6204.name: Baandari Dwarven Spider

6205.description: Ride like the Bringer of Disease and Pestilence that you want to be! This mount features a saddle with the Peryite cult symbol upon it, giving those who spot you a chance to fear their imminent and loathsome doom.
6205.name: Steed of the Afflicted

6206.description: Born in flame, this senche-lion's temperament matches its fiery appearance. Those who earn its respect, however, gain a mount that can blaze a path through the darkest shadows.
6206.name: Blazeborn Senche-Lion

6207.description: Dragon Hunters, take heed! This mount has received elite training that enables it to fearlessly stand fast even in Dragon breath. Some claim that the final, secret test of these mounts is what imbues their eyes with a blue glow.
6207.name: Skyterror Dragonslayer Horse

6208.description: With Dragons on the loose in Elsweyr, a modern cadre of Dragon Hunters have sprung up to hunt them down. Their mounts are sturdy and fearless.
6208.name: Elder Dragon Hunter Horse

6257.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Nightflame style.
6257.name: Nightflame Mace

6258.description: "If an innkeeper dresses like a soiled bar rag, imagine the state of the linens. You want to run a respectable establishment? Dress the part!"âMedresi Grulathil, Tailor
6258.name: Innkeeper

6259.description: Featuring a moon motif, this cheek chain is a popular ornament among the Baandari Pedlars and those who adopt their vivid style.
6259.name: Baandari Cheek Chain

6260.description: The Baandari Pedlars, like all traders, love the  gleam of precious metals. This stylish circlet allows them, and now you, to express this affection in a flashy manner.
6260.name: Baandari Luck Circlet

6261.description: Those wishing for extra camouflage within Tenmar need only replicate the coloration of the Tenmar leopards upon their faces.
6261.name: Tenmar Leopard Face Marks

6262.description: The leopards of Tenmar blend into their surroundings so well that those seeking to emulate them mark their bodies similarly to these creatures.
6262.name: Tenmar Leopard Body Marks

6263.description: "The act of venerating Alkosh with ritualized facial art is an ancient Pride of Alkosh practice. In Elsweyr, we brought it back only recently." âMo'khu, Moon Priest
6263.name: Pride of Alkosh Face Marks

6264.description: "Once a ritual of the Pride of Alkosh, the marking ceremony places ornate designs upon an adherent's body, signifying reverence to the First Cat."âMo'khu, Moon Priest
6264.name: Pride of Alkosh Body Marks

6265.description: The followers of Peryite express their reverence through many means, including face stains that hint at their pestilent inner selves.
6265.name: Plague Dragon Face Stains

6266.description: Seeking to show your devotion to Peryite? These Dragon-shaped stains do just that! They're best paired with a cough or other visible illness.
6266.name: Plague Dragon Body Stains

6267.description: "All will see your fierceness plainly as it is now writ upon your face in Dragonsmoke."âArtist-Adept Aimira
6267.name: Dragonsmoke Face Markings

6268.description: "With these markings, it is as if you take the power of the Dragon within you, and let the smoke of its flames conceal you. Whether this is true is now up to you, yes?"âArtist-Adept Aimira
6268.name: Dragonsmoke Body Markings

6269.description: Before body artists place Draco Aerius facial markings on someone, they wash the face with a concoction called "Dragon's Blood."
6269.name: Draco Aerius Face Markings

6270.description: A key component of the Draco Aerius markings is ground Dragon scale, which body artists use in the ink.
6270.name: Draco Aerius Body Markings

6271.description: Presented to Dragon Hunters after they have helped slay their first Dragon, this crescent is crafted from the slain Dragon's bones by the Huntmaster.
6271.name: Elder Dragon Hunter Coronal

6272.description: The melding of ice and fire might seem out of reach for the average person, but you're not the average person, are you? Show your mastery of Sunspire's Ice-Fire by exhibiting it on your body.
6272.name: Sunspire Ice-Fire
6272.hint: Acquired by completing the "Sunspire Conqueror" achievement in Veteran Sunspire.

6273.description: Join the ranks of Peryite's plague-ridden adherents and enjoy all they have to offer, including a diseased appearance!
6273.name: Peryite's Afflicted

6274.description: Learned from the Coldsnap Goblin crafting style, acquired by adventuring in Frostvault after a certain date.
6274.name: Coldsnap Goblin Battle Axe

6275.description: Learned from the Coldsnap Goblin crafting style, acquired by adventuring in Frostvault after a certain date.
6275.name: Coldsnap Goblin Maul

6283.name: Coldsnap Goblin Sword

6285.description: Alter your two-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Sinweaver Elder Scrolls Artifact, an ancient Elven sword possibly Ayleid in origin, though it's endowed with powers often associated with Daedric weapons.
6285.name: Sinweaver

6286.description: Alter your staff's Outfit style with a replica of the Spear of Bitter Mercy Elder Scrolls Artifact, a mighty weapon from Oblivion usually associated with the Daedric Prince Hircine.
6286.name: Spear of Bitter Mercy

6287.description: Alter your one-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Firstblade Elder Scrolls Artifact, a strange sword the Skaal of Solstheim say belonged to a renegade Dragon Priest named Miraak far in the distant past.
6287.name: Firstblade

6290.description: Show off your love of baking by donning this practical yet stylish baker's outfit.
6290.name: Baker

6291.description: Merchants need to look presentable, and those who travel require protection from the elements. With this outfit, you can travel through Tamriel and beyond knowing that you have met both requirements!
6291.name: Traveling Merchant

6292.description: When collaborating with rats, heavy and concealing clothes are a must. This outfit, which includes full facial coverage, grants you an inscrutable yet formidable appearance.
6292.name: Peryite Skeevemaster
6292.hint: Acquired by finding and using ten Plague-Drenched Fabrics from the Orcrest City Public Dungeon.

6293.description: "I found an illustration for this garb in a founder's journal and made it for our second Proving Festival. I'm pleased with the result!"âMagnate Feina-Darak
6293.name: Hakoshae Festival Attire

6294.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Malacath, the Orc-Father.
6294.name: Statuette: Malacath, Orc-Father

6353.description: Alter your two-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Volendrung Elder Scrolls Artifact, a paradoxical weapon forever torn between its Dwarven origins and Malacath's Daedric influence.
6353.name: Volendrung

6354.description: Alter your two-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Chrysamere Elder Scrolls Artifact, a sword also known as the Paladin's Blade.
6354.name: Chrysamere

6355.description: Alter your bow's Outfit style with a replica of the Bow of Shadows Elder Scrolls Artifact, a weapon created by the Daedric Prince Nocturnal.
6355.name: Bow of Shadows

6357.description: Alter your one-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Mehrunes' Razor Elder Scrolls Artifact, a weapon forged by the Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon.
6357.name: Mehrunes' Razor

6358.description: Alter your shield's Outfit style with a replica of the Fearstruck Elder Scrolls Artifact, a shield crafted by the Daedric Prince Boethiah. Reportedly destroyed by a wyrm, this shield and its memory live on in the imagination and reproductions.
6358.name: Fearstruck

6360.description: Perform rich music with a traditional Khajiiti instrument! Favored among string players in Rimmen, the esraj is played with a bow.
6360.name: Play Esraj

6362.description: Master the flow of energy in this kata from the Khajiiti order of Vrin-Thak.
6362.name: Goutfang Kata

6363.description: The Khajiiti order of Ziz Kurah often practice this kata to find balance within themselves. Now you can do the same.
6363.name: Whispering Claw Kata

6364.description: Wield a sword in this kata practiced by adepts in the Khajiiti order of Rawlith Khaj.
6364.name: Desert Rain Kata

6365.description: Display your alliance's banner with pride and honor!
6365.name: Daggerfall Covenant Banner

6367.description: Show the strength of your emotions by destroying this hapless urn! Beware the consequences â¦.
6367.name: Brittle Burial Urn
6367.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Relatively Speaking" in Elsweyr.

6368.description: "The Peryite cultists have anâ¦interesting world view. For instance, some will carry around that bottle andâno, don't open that!"âDar'ava
6368.name: Winnowing Plague Decoction
6368.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Unhealthy Preoccupation" in Elsweyr.

6369.description: Let images of Jone and Jode orbit you as you take up a position of prayer.
6369.name: Bright Moons

6371.description: Express your emotions with a rolling pin, the best baking implement for angry rants!
6371.name: Rolling Pin

6372.description: Need a touch of salt? Sprinkle away! Need more? Why not keep sprinkling?
6372.name: Salty

6373.description: Slice, dice, and chop your ingredients with style.
6373.name: Slice Food

6374.description: Sweep your hands into a gesture revering the moons, Jone and Jode, with this Khajiiti greeting.
6374.name: Bright Moons Greeting

6375.description:
Unlocks the Necromancer class for use in character creation.

Masters of death, Necromancers can call upon corpses to serve as undead thralls and weave ghastly spells to both harm and heal.
6375.name: Class: Necromancer
6375.hint: |ce60000WARNING: Using certain Necromancer abilities in town is a criminal act. Citizens and guards will react accordingly.|r

6376.description:
This Alfiq banker stands ready to fulfill your personal banking needsâexcept in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which make her nervous.

When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.
6376.name: Ezabi the Banker

6378.description:
This Alfiq merchant buys your non-stolen wares as often as you need him toâbut not in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which Fezez avoids due to "considerations of extreme danger."

When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.
6378.name: Fezez the Merchant

6380.description:
Those seeking a respite from the heat and bustle of Rimmen's crowded streets can find it in this cozy suite. Easy access to Rimmen's amenitiesâboth legal and illicitâmake this the perfect abode for adventurers on the go.
Room is too small for Dueling.
6380.name: Sugar Bowl Suite
6380.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion

6381.description: The reason behind the creation of this tabby was simple: Cats kill rodents. Mummified and mobile cats will kill rodents indefinitely. Thus this bandage-bound pet was â¦ born?
6381.name: Grisly Mummy Tabby
6381.hint: Acquired by finding and using ten Mummified Alfiq Parts from the Rimmen Necropolis Public Dungeon.

6382.description: "Sometimes pups hear the call. To defend against claws. To rend wings. When they show up, we train them."âJavinda, Dragonslayer
6382.name: Skyterror Dragonslayer Pup

6384.description: Dancers among the Baandari Pedlars wear this tassel-laden veil that chimes and jingles with every move. Now it can be yours for a song â¦ or a dance!
6384.name: Baandari Luck Veil

6385.description: Crafted from Dragon bone, this piercing indicates that the Dragon Hunter wearing it has slain at least one Dragon.
6385.name: Elder Dragon Hunter Piercing

6388.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Imperial City Prison.
6388.name: Lord Warden Mask
6388.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Lord Warden Dusk Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6389.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag's Mystery Coffer.
6389.name: Lord Warden Shoulder
6389.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Lord Warden Dusk Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6390.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Lord Warden style.
6390.name: Lord Warden Greatsword

6391.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Lord Warden style.
6391.name: Lord Warden Bow

6392.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Lord Warden style.
6392.name: Lord Warden Shield

6393.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Lord Warden style.
6393.name: Lord Warden Staff

6394.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Lord Warden style.
6394.name: Lord Warden's Axe

6395.description: Blue pigment enhances the Dragon horns of this facial tattoo, creating a dramatic visual impact.
6395.name: Elder Dragon Face Marks

6396.description: With its blue flair, this Dragon tattoo is a favorite among those who crave to feel the strength of this creature running through their blood.
6396.name: Elder Dragon Body Marks

6398.description: "Though accounts vary as to Sheogorath's appearance, several claim he wears a multihued turban. Would that I could verify this."âExcerpted from Mistress Valaste's journal, circa 2E 579
6398.name: Madgod's Turban
6398.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Lunacy of Two Moons" in Elsweyr.

6399.description: Few adeptoriums can match the hallowed majesty of Jode's Embrace. Rumor has it that the temple's worthiest occupants can peer into the sacred realm of Jode itself. Just keep an eye out for Dragons overhead!
6399.name: Jode's Embrace

6400.description: The Khajiit of Elsweyr built this awesome temple as a tribute to the legendary hero, Khunzar-ri. Elsweyr's greatest champions may assume stewardship of the Hall, but only the most patient and cunning will discover all of its secrets!
6400.name: Hall of the Lunar Champion
6400.hint: Awarded for completing the "Two Queens" quest in Elsweyr.

6401.description: "Dark as a starless night, Cult of the New Moon bears move through shadows silently to attack their prey. Never anger one of these." âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6401.name: New Moon Bear

6402.description: "I would ride this steed with great care. Its barding? The stuff of nightmares. Perhaps I intend that pun. Perhaps not."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6402.name: New Moon Horse

6403.description: "The eyes of this guar feel like they're reaching into my soul. As it turns out, that was a warning. It bit my hand soon after."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6403.name: New Moon Guar

6404.description: "Those seeking their way on dark sands should consider the New Moon Camel. Some say it feeds off the night itself. I say maybe so."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6404.name: New Moon Camel

6405.description: "Of all the wolves one could ride through gloom, this one is the best. Of course, if you're not the one riding it, watch out. You might be its prey."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6405.name: New Moon Wolf

6406.description: "Senche steeds are already quiet. This one? It  moves as if it is the avatar of silence."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6406.name: New Moon Senche

6408.description: Express your inner gargoyle with this fierce facial flair. The gargoyle's horns are yours now. Will you use their power to intimidate gravely? Or frivously? Why not both?
6408.name: Gargoyle Facial Flair

6409.description: When you cannot achieve the form of a gargoyle, decorating your body with spectacular gargoyle symbology can be your next best achievement. Exhibit this flair with pride and fierceness!
6409.name: Gargoyle Body Flair

6410.description: Are you the thrall of a vampire? Would you like to show the truth of that to the world? Now you can!
6410.name: Blood-Drained Thrall

6411.description: "Colorful and intimidating. Truly, these markings bring the fire of the warrior-poet to your spirit as well as to your face."âArtist-Adept Aimira
6411.name: Warrior-Poet Skull Tattoo

6412.description: When you're a thrall, it's helpful to ensure that every single vein in your body is visible so that those feeding off you can find the best sources of blood.
6412.name: Thrall's Arterial Map Face Marks

6413.description: Make the lives of those vampires around you easier by helping them see where your veins run. After all, the quicker they're sated, the quicker you can get back to what you were doing before you became dinner.
6413.name: Thrall's Arterial Map Body Marks

6414.description: "Dancing among the Dragons. Wounding. Killing. It's not a job for the faint of heart. Whatever your motivation, and whatever your hunting methods, this facial mark expresses your resolve to destroy those creatures known as Dragons." âArtist-Adept Aimira
6414.name: Dragondancer Facial Markings

6415.description: "Take the strength of those Dragons you've slain with your killing dance into your physical form, melding it with your mind to grow in your purpose. These markings? They represent this purpose." âArtist-Adept Aimira
6415.name: Dragondancer Body Markings

6416.description: Many Dragons have fallen before your might. Many respect your prowess in combat. And with these green-glowing markings, even those unfamiliar with Dragon hunting will suspect your ferocity.
6416.name: Legendary Dragon Face Marks

6417.description: So many Dragons have died at your hands that the smell of Dragon blood has soaked into your very dreams. With great skill, the artist-adept has given you markings that reflect your experience, making them glow with an emerald hue.
6417.name: Legendary Dragon Body Marks

6418.description: As Dragon Hunters grow more experienced, taking on tougher or more numerous foes, they earn their next coronal piece.
6418.name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Coronal

6419.description: In a solemn ritual, the Huntmaster pierces the Dragon Hunter with further Dragon bones, recognizing that the recipient has achieved a new level of skill in killing Dragons.
6419.name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Piercing

6420.description: As they reach the zenith of their prowess, Dragon Hunters gain the final piece of this famed coronal. Let the weight of countless slain Dragons weigh heavy upon your brow!
6420.name: Legendary Dragon Coronal

6421.description: The jagged piercings of a legendary Dragon Hunter memorialize not only your past triumphs, but all the bloody victories yet to come. Dragons beware!
6421.name: Legendary Dragon Piercing

6422.description: The additional markings that Ancient Dragon Hunters receive on their faces cause the entire tattoo to shift to a golden outer glow.
6422.name: Ancient Dragon Face Marks

6423.description: After a tattooed Dragon Hunter has killed enough Dragons, an artist-adept adds to the markings, causing the color of its glow to shift to a golden hue.
6423.name: Ancient Dragon Body Marks

6424.description: "Each of us has deep darkness within us. And we choose what to do with that darkness. You? You need reminding of that. Winged darkness, yes, to give you strength as you fly through shadowed times."âArtist-Adept Aimira
6424.name: Wings of Darkness Face Tattoos

6425.description: "The darkness within you should be acknowledged, yes? With you, I see it as wings taking you through times of Dark Moons into brighter times. Let us get to work so that you can better embrace this journey."âArtist-Adept Aimira
6425.name: Wings of Darkness Body Tattoos

6427.description: "I've been told this tattoo makes my cheekbones stand out. Bah. Who has need of pretty cheekbones? No, this tattoo honors the blood I shed defeating the deadliest foes in Tamriel."âMargretha
6427.name: Death Dealer Facial Markings

6428.description: "Each of these markings represents a victory over a worthy foe. Come, let us see your markings. Or have you not gained any yet, little one? Consider these, perhaps."âMargretha
6428.name: Death Dealer Body Markings

6429.description: "Yeah, so, if you're going to decorate your face, you wanna do it right. This face marking? Balorgh'd say it's right."âYarzurgakh
6429.name: Trophy of Balorgh Facial Tattoo

6430.description: "Do nothing halfway. That's what Balorgh would say. So, yeah, if you're gonna mark your victories in ink? I say go for the full-body treatment. So would Balorgh."âYarzurgakh
6430.name: Trophy of Balorgh Body Tattoo

6431.description: "Those of us who relish the thought of having warm Dragon blood wash over us as we perform our killing dance? We are called Dragondancers. And we have earned this trinket on our face by shedding that blood."âKlatinja, Dragondancer
6431.name: Dragondancer's Cheek Cord

6432.description: "This bit of metal on my forehead is more than just flashy jewelry. It represents the act of rending scale and wing in an act of sublime mercyâof killing a Dragon."âKlatinja, Dragondancer
6432.name: Dragondancer's Circlet

6434.description: "Do not ask me how this creature came to be. Or not be. It just is. But, perhaps do not kill chickens in already-haunted places."âGeem-Sai, Butcher
6434.name: Spectral Chicken

6435.description: "Gah! Netches! Mine kept getting stuck behind closed doors. So my friend and I made this ghostly netch. Yours for a song, five-claw! Not at all necromantic. Promise!"âLanjo, merchant
6435.name: Haunting Netch

6436.description: "A daedrat I killed ended up following me home â¦ as a ghost. Now I use it to keep my relatives from staying with me."âTheldyn Faden, Explorer
6436.name: Ghostly Daedrat

6437.description: Though mystery shrouds this mount's origin, it currently serves as the preferred steed of several known Vampires. Ride these mounts with pride (and no small measure of caution).
6437.name: Sanguivorian Howler

6438.description: The role of a siegemaster requires valor, quick thinking, and a supreme command of tactics. This helm is often worn by such leaders.
6438.name: Siegemaster Close Helm
6438.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Recognition, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.

6439.description: Add this cute bat to your menagerie. Not only does it eat pesky bugs, but it'll keep you company on your adventures!
6439.name: Long-Winged Bat

6440.description: Riders of these senche-panthers often find their welcomes worn out while in town, but their journeys across wilderness can be strangely trouble-free.
6440.name: Plagueborn Senche-Panther

6441.description: This steed's blue markings glow, indicating its exposure to the energies of the Planemeld. Its glimmering eyes possess a frightening intelligence that seems unnatural for a horse.
6441.name: Planemeld Courser

6442.description: As the Dragon threat spreads, the need for veteran Dragon Hunters increases. These gold-barded horses can help you reach your prey quickly.
6442.name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Horse

6443.description: "Occasionally one grows tired of the crush of humanity. To that end, I bought this Death Hound. Now I cannot enter most taverns, but I also don't have people crowding my space."âTheldyn Faden, Explorer
6443.name: Death Hound

6444.description: This imp, after being caged by Vampires, freed itself and can now join you in your journeys. Easily spooked, it often changes into a Vampiric Dragon form, hoping to seem fiercer than it is.
6444.name: Vampiric Dragon Imp

6445.description: Cult of the New Moon pups haven't quite grown out of their youthful exuberance, which make them fun travel companions. They often stalk shadows, seeking to destroy them.
6445.name: New Moon Wolf Pup

6446.description: Though this cub wears the signature barding of the Cult of the New Moon, it acts just like a kitten. Which is to say, you might need to train it to avoid rubbing its head and scratchy barding against your cheek.
6446.name: New Moon Senche Cub

6447.description: A handful of daring merchants stole some pack animals from the Cult of the New Moon, and they claim these ponies are as nimble as goats to the point of even climbing trees. Apple orchard farmers beware!
6447.name: New Moon Pony

6448.description: The Cult of the New Moon keeps a number of different creatures around, including guars. Due to a peculiarity in its breeding, this guar tries to sing along whenever it hears someone singing. Only dogs can hear it do so, however.
6448.name: New Moon Guar Calf

6449.description: This cub from the Cult of the New Moon will happily trundle along behind you as long as you keep it well-fed.
6449.name: New Moon Bear Cub

6450.description: Young durzogs acquired from the Coldsnap Goblin tribe are temperamental and require a firm hand. After you've established firm boundaries with this creature, though, its loyalty is boundless.
6450.name: Coldsnap Durzog Pup

6451.description: "Some keep so-called Pocket Watchers as pets, playing off the name of those Pocket Mammoths seen in Wrothgar. Even at their smaller size? Still not the wisest move. Small Daedra are still Daedra, after all, and thus beyond our ken. "âWarlock Aldaale
6451.name: Pocket Watcher

6452.description: Complete with wrappings and a creepy mask, the Grisly Banekin Mummy will accompany you on all your journeys, causing boundless horror among all who see it!
6452.name: Grisly Banekin Mummy

6453.description: "This pup has lived through a Dragon attack, proving itself in front of all the Dragonslayers present. Its steadfastness should help keep you alive."âJavinda, Dragonslayer
6453.name: Dread-Aurelian Dragonslayer Wolf

6454.description: "The Mind-Shriven Scamp is an unusual specimen. Generally you find them among other mind-shriven creatures, but some addled folk have started including them in their entourage. Peculiar, at best."âWarlock Aldaale
6454.name: Mind-Shriven Scamp

6455.description: Equipped with a hat, this black cat makes its way in the world at your side, leaving little fiery pawprints behind as it goes.
6455.name: Witch's Infernal Familiar

6456.description: This wolf senses the impending arrival of Dragons, making it an excellent pet for veteran Dragon Hunters.
6456.name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Wolf

6458.description: "Ah, yes, the Undaunted. That they have decided to train Scamps to wear a pack is, shall we say, a prodigious undertaking. I look forward to seeing how much gear goes missing."âWarlock Aldaale
6458.name: Undaunted Porter Scamp
6458.hint: Acquired by completing the "Moongrave Fane Conqueror" Achievement

6459.description: A young blacksmith raised a foundling wolf decades ago, thus training the first of the Oak-Ember Forge Wolves as a steed. With its unusual fur pattern, you're sure to make an impression on those around you.
6459.name: Oak-Ember Forge Wolf

6460.description: In honor of a fallen Warden, a Wayrest blacksmith continues to breed and sell these bears as mounts today. If you happen to notice a Warden watching you as you ride this steed, consider thanking her. She may be the fallen Warden's shade!
6460.name: Graysmoke Forge Bear

6461.description: Originally bred by a family of Breton blacksmiths, the Coalsmoke Forge Horse's strength allows them to work for long hours. Just make sure you provide them with a salt lickâthey love them.
6461.name: Coalsmoke Forge Horse

6462.description: "You might think Mind-Shriven Wolves are fragile beasts, but their environment has instilled within them a hidden strength. "âWarlock Aldaale
6462.name: Mind-Shriven Wolf

6463.description: Make an entrance with this mummified mount! With its ancient wrappings and hallowed barding, this ghastly horse adds the perfect touch of eeriness to any spooky procession or gathering.
6463.name: Grisly Horse Mummy

6464.description: Known as steeds of the Dremora, Kynbound Senche-Panthers have found their way into service as mounts for those who have some ties to the Dremora. Perhaps that's you?
6464.name: Kynbound Senche-Panther

6465.description: Like the holds and keeps that prevent enemies from vanquishing them, this warhorse is fortified to prevent foes from taking it down quickly. Join forces with this prodigious mount to besiege opposing forces and take over their holdings!
6465.name: Siegemaster's Warhorse

6466.description: Those skilled enough to overcome Sunspire can earn a special variant of the Sunspire Ice-Fire Senche-Lion. With golden armor and gear, this mount shines, reflecting your own adventuring glory.
6466.name: Sunspire Champion Senche-Lion
6466.hint: Acquired by completing the "Sunspire Dragonbreak" Achievement.

6483.description: Alter your two-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Sword of Jyggalag Elder Scrolls Artifact, the claymore created by the absent Prince of Order.
6483.name: Sword of Jyggalag

6484.description: Alter your two-handed axe's Outfit style with a replica of the Rueful Axe Elder Scrolls Artifact, a weapon created by the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile.
6484.name: Rueful Axe

6485.description: Alter your staff's Outfit style with a replica of the Sanguine's Rose Elder Scrolls Artifact, a charming weapon from Oblivion usually associated with the Daedric Prince Sanguine.
6485.name: Sanguine's Rose

6486.description: Alter your staff's Outfit style with a replica of the Skull of Corruption Elder Scrolls Artifact, a relic of Vaermina best known for bringing out dark reflections of its victims.
6486.name: Skull of Corruption

6487.description: "Our best artisans crafted this jeweled laurel based on my research of past Proving Festivals. It is our hope that by wearing these laurels, we can become closer to our honored ancestors."âMagnate Feina-Darak
6487.name: Hakoshae Festival Laurel

6489.description: Feanirr witnessed the demise of her proud adeptorium, not to war, but to a sickness faster and stealthier than all but her. Since then, she lives only in the moment, knowing that at any moment something deadlier than her could catch her by the tail.
6489.name: Whispering-Claw Senche-Raht

6490.description: A scholar studying Mnemoli the Blue Star as well as a Whispering Claw warrior, this Senche-raht serves Queen Khamira with both brain and brawn. He volunteered to travel with you, lending you speed and steady companionship.
6490.name: Queen's Claw Senche-Raht

6491.description: After spending many years in a Vrin-Thak adeptorium, this powerful Senche-raht decided it was time to work with someone who regularly goes toward danger. She prefers to learn by watching, however.
6491.name: Goutfang Senche-Raht

6492.description: This gentle giant embodies kindness and loyalty, and her loving spirit will run alongside you forever.
6492.name: Belle

6493.description: Display your alliance's banner with pride and honor!
6493.name: Aldmeri Dominion Banner

6494.description: Display your alliance's banner with pride and honor!
6494.name: Ebonheart Pact Banner

6497.name: Pristine Moon Crescent

6508.name: Dread-Aurelian Charger
