6609.description: Place on the Jonelight Altar in the Hall of the Lunar Champion to awaken the lunar reflector.
6609.name: Behold the Lunar Champion
6609.hint: Awarded for completing the "Two Queens" quest in Elsweyr.

6610.description: Trophy taken from Nahviintaas in honor of an Undaunted victory in Sunspire.
6610.name: Trophy: Nahviintaas

6611.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Sunspire.
6611.name: Bust: Nahviintaas

6612.description: Set yourself apart from common tavern strummers and strut into your shows like a brightly plumed cockerel, fully prepared to captivate the senses with a brilliant display of song and dance. In this flashy regalia, all eyes and ears will be on you alone!
6612.name: Singing Skald

6613.description: Place on the Altar of Betrayal in the Hall of the Lunar Champion to unlock an overlook of the Halls of Colossus.
6613.name: Behold Khunzar-ri's Betrayal
6613.hint: Awarded for completing the "The Heir of Anequina" quest in Elsweyr.

6616.description: Though many associate darkness with evil, those looking at the Ebon-Glow Indrik come to understand that darkness is simply the absence of lightâneither good nor bad in itself. A soothing thought that calms fears, much like this magical indrik does.
6616.name: Ebon-Glow Indrik

6617.description: Some claim that this indrik comes into being when the first rays of the sun hit pristine snow. Whether that's true or not, it can help you make an impression as you wander the streets of Alinor or venture beyond that.
6617.name: Frost-Light Indrik

6618.description: Those who have watched this particular imp's mimicry wonder how it survived seeing the Dragon that inspired its antics. Regardless, awe others by making this imp your companion.
6618.name: Regal Dragon Imp
6618.hint: Acquired by completing the "The Dragon's Wrath" Achievement.

6619.description: Though they originally hail from Senchal, these mousers have recently started showing up in other locales. Having one at your side not only exhibits your charity toward street cats, but also helps ensure you sleep free of pesky mice!
6619.name: Silver-Gray Mouser Cat

6620.description: Covered in golden fur and possessing a sharp sense of smell, this mutt becomes loyal to any who feed it and treat it with kindness. Are you the benefactor who will take this dog away from its life scrounging on the docks of Senchal?
6620.name: Senchal Harbor-Mutt

6622.description: Nimble and fleet, this fawn sticks to your side like you're its mother. Cute? Oh yes. Those eyes! That nose! Those spots!
6622.name: Fawn

6623.description: This pup isn't one for simple games of fetch, but it will follow you loyally through your adventures. That and its ability to chill your water simply by curling around it? Practical and cute, in its own frosty way.
6623.name: Frost Atronach Wolf Pup

6624.description: Some would choose to pass on a senche cub that has sharp edges and no fur. But not you! In fact, you can look forward to its cooling nudges for attention while trudging through deserts.
6624.name: Frost Atronach Senche Cub

6625.description: Are ponies too adorable for you? Fear not! This pony takes adorable, freezes it, and adds a hefty helping of "don't even think about petting my nose." A welcome companion to those who hate the heat, as well!
6625.name: Frost Atronach Pony

6626.description: A frost atronach in kagouti calf form, this companion embodies the essence of Vvardenfell's wilds in an icy way, making it an interesting choice for heroes seeking to stop threats in that region. Native Dark Elves might look askance at you, however.
6626.name: Frost Atronach Kagouti Calf

6628.description: "As the fiercest of the Dragonslayer wolves, this one's eyes glow a steady green, and it remains by her owner's side even against the most majestic of Dragons."âJavinda, Dragonslayer
6628.name: Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Wolf

6629.description: With this loyal dog at your side, you have a companion who can help you make it through even the most treacherous of avalanches in Pale Pass and other mountainous areas â¦ even if it has to pull you out from under a pile of fallen snow and detritus.
6629.name: Anthorbred Avalanche Dog

6630.description: You needn't know Conjuration magic to have an atronach companionâClan Direnni mages have gifted bear cubs of that provenance to those they deem worthy. They can be oddly heart-warming despite their frosty form.
6630.name: Frost Atronach Bear Cub

6631.description: This wolf's experiences with Dragons surpasses that of many Dragon Hunters. And it has chosen to be at your side! An excellent match, indeed.
6631.name: Legendary Dragon Wolf

6632.description: You've done it! You have the Chaos Ball! Time to rub your superior play in the opposition's faces!
6632.name: Chaos Ball Victory Dance
6632.hint: Acquired by spending Alliance Points at Battleground Supplies Merchants.

6633.description: Riding high on your latest triumph, you slam the Chaos Ball into the ground. Good idea? Maybe not. But it was fun to watch.
6633.name: Chaos Ball Boom
6633.hint: Acquired by spending Alliance Points at Battleground Supplies Merchants.

6634.description: Ooh, ouch, too hot to handle! Quick, pass along the Chaos Ball before it burns your hands!
6634.name: Scorching Chaos Ball
6634.hint: Acquired by spending Alliance Points at Battleground Supplies Merchants.

6635.description: Dragon Hunters like you deserve only the best beverage in the best container. Drink out of the horn of a Dragonâpotentially one that you yourself have slain!
6635.name: Drink From Horn

6636.description: Khajiiti merchants insist that this "Dragon call" can summon the beasts as surely as a duck-call summons waterfowl. While its effect on Dragons remains a matter of debate, everyone agrees that its clatter reliably attracts irritated friends and neighbors.
6636.name: Dragon Call

6637.description: Dragon Hunters often polish a trophy from their past battles to help them focus before the next battle. This Dragon trophy is yours to focus upon. Perhaps polish it a little? It's got a speck right â¦ there. No, no. There.
6637.name: Polish Dragon Trophy

6638.description: The skulls of your enemies make fine containers for your favorite beverage. Here's to you, skulldrinker. Here's to you.
6638.name: Drink From Skull

6639.description: Bats are cute, yes? And you want one hanging from your finger, of course. Only monsters don't want to let bats hang from their fingers. You're not a monster, are you?
6639.name: Summon Bat

6640.description: The world can be an awful, terrible, no-good place filled with undead. Ward them all off with Arkay's help. (Caution: Does not actually ward off undead.)
6640.name: Arkay's Warding Gesture

6641.description: Crafted with great care, this Dragonhorn replica celebrates your past triumph with Sai Sahan against Vahlokzin. Simply blow, and a wave emanates from it. It does not, however, affect Dragons.
6641.name: Dragonhorn Curio
6641.hint: Awarded for completing the quest "The Horn of Ja'darri."

6642.description: That sickening blue glow you picked up while adventuring in the Lair of Maarselok? Yeah, it's all over you. Just remember what Selene taught you, and you'll be rid of it in seconds!
6642.name: Corruption of Maarselok
6642.hint: Awarded for completing the "Lair of Maarselok Conqueror" Achievement.

6643.description: Be the life of your party with this cute little skeleton marionette! It dances! It prances! It hangs from strings, ready for you to make it move! (Creepy skeleton voice not included.)
6643.name: Skeletal Marionette

6644.description: Shimmer with a variety of hues, taking on the colors of the famed opals of Yokuda, with this skin. Perfect for star-strewn celebrations in Sentinel and beyond.
6644.name: Opalescent Epidermis

6646.description: Fierce, unnatural storms swirl around the frozen island of Icereach, sinking ships and lashing the coasts of Skyrim. Fight your way through a frigid ruin and put an end to the unholy ritual at the eye of the storm!
6646.name: Icereach

6647.description: A group of Nordic graverobbers slaughtered their way into a long-hidden burial ground, intent on stealing ancient remains. Help the sentinel, Shelaria, on her quest for revenge and oust these nefarious plunderers.
6647.name: Unhallowed Grave

6648.description: A hat says much about the person wearing it, so pick yours carefully. For instance, this particular one speaks volumes about how much you love the Witches Festival. (Don't we all?)
6648.name: Witch's Infernal Hat
6648.hint: Awarded for completing the "Wicked Writ Apprentice" Achievement.

6649.description: The ice within which you contain your emotions is strong, but your rage is stronger. Express your fury with these cracked ice facial markings.
6649.name: Frigid Impact Face Marking

6650.description: When pushed, your white-hot rage breaks free of the icy cage you set around it, smashing your foes. Warn others of your wrathful inclinations with these markings.
6650.name: Frigid Impact Body Marking

6651.description: The call of a lawless life sings in your head each evening. Maybe you'll help someone who's struggling. Maybe you'll steal an arrogant mer's coin purse. Whatever the case, your chosen path is reflected by your choice of facial tattoo.
6651.name: Senchal Brigand Face Tattoo

6652.description: To survive in Senchal, you've learned how to make the most of a bad situation. These bold markings prove that you have what it takes to shake your fist in the face of adversity and deprivation.
6652.name: Senchal Brigand Body Tattoo

6653.description: You stand strong in the darkness, listening to its wishes. You are a Nocturnal Outlaw, and none should ever doubt your abilities. Remind them with this striking facial tattoo.
6653.name: Nocturnal Outlaw Face Tattoo

6654.description: The shadows are your friend, providing you with shelter â¦ and opportunity. As a Nocturnal Outlaw, you deserve a body tattoo that expresses your true nature.
6654.name: Nocturnal Outlaw Body Tattoo

6655.description: The Cult of the New Moon demands much, and you've given it â¦ and then some. Show off your affiliation with this stylized flame facial tattoo.
6655.name: New Moon Cultist Face Tattoo

6656.description: You've found what you're looking for in the Cult of the New Moon. And you want everyone to know whose side you're on. Let the flame symbology of this eye-catching tattoo show them.
6656.name: New Moon Cultist Body Tattoo

6657.description: "Within you is the spirit of the First Cat's Pride. Let us bring that golden fire to the surface so that others may gaze upon your spirit directly, then react with awe."âArtist-Adept Aimira
6657.name: First Cat's Pride Tattoo

6658.description: "Your body knows much it doesn't tell. With artistry, we can call forth the First Cat's Pride so that you may guide others in Alkosh's path. They will see the golden fire on your body and follow."âArtist-Adept Aimira
6658.name: First Cat's Pride Tattoo

6659.description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.
6659.name: Dawnwood Berries of Bloom

6660.description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.
6660.name: Dawnwood Berries of Budding

6661.description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.
6661.name: Dawnwood Berries of Growth

6662.description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.
6662.name: Dawnwood Berries of Ripeness

6663.description:
Ready to adventure in places filled with hideous monsters, traps, and other surprises? Dress appropriately with the Dungeon Explorer costume!

|cffffffEquipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.|r
6663.name: Dungeon Explorer

6664.description: "After the last time someone tried to hug me at a Dark Anchor, I designed this attire. It's particularly effective at staving off such shows of â¦ excessive and nonconsensual exuberance."âPelynwe the Untouchable
6664.name: Harboursworn Occultist

6665.description: An experienced siegemaster might wish to observe any unusual defenses by surveying them firsthand. This gear provides protection while doing so.
6665.name: Siegemaster's Uniform
6665.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Recommendation, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.

6666.description: Flowers! For your head! Flaunt your colorful style with this hat, and bring floral joy to everyone around you.
6666.name: Floral Skull Fascinator

6667.description: Let your grace and style shine with this glistening tiara. Perfect for Evening Star galas, royal balls, and days when you just want to sparkle.
6667.name: Snowcrystal Tiara

6668.description: Had your eye on the prize a bit too much, eh? Well, cover up that wound with this stylish patch.
6668.name: Prize-Hunter's Patch

6669.description: Howling winds and piercing cold may give some heroes pause, but not you! Show off your icy determination with your frost-covered face.
6669.name: Frosty Features

6670.description: Applying this shimmery azure glow to your face tells everyone that you are a princess and are worthy of all the good things in life. What are those good things? Up to you, of course, because you're a princess!
6670.name: Winter Princess Glamour

6671.description: Do you revel in cataclysmic forces? Is vindication best reflected in ruining all who thwart you? Perhaps you revere the destructive Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon. Whatever the case, this ruddy-hued skin reflects your true nature.
6671.name: Deadlands Brand

6672.description: Few can withstand the scorching heat and relentless desolation of the Deadlands. Those unlucky few who find themselves trapped there may encounter one of these scuttling horrorsâa hideous reminder of their grim and eternal fate.
6672.name: Mudcrab of Eternal Doom

6673.description: The epitome of Dragonslaying mounts, this steed has not only braved dangers that would make lesser heroes cringe but serves as a worthy mount for one of your stature and experience. The fact that it has green glowing eyes makes it even more noteworthy.
6673.name: Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Horse

6674.description: Only the Wasseek-haleel would breed such a colorful and sweet-natured horse-lizard. Ideal for those times when you're wandering through Murkmire, looking for trouble to quash.
6674.name: Wasseek Horse-Lizard

6675.description: By forcing their steeds to consume the Blood of Coldharbour, the traitorous soldiers of Legion Zero created a war horse unlike any other. Adorned with fearsome barding and their sullen red colors, this is truly a mount to be feared.
6675.name: Legion Zero Destrier

6676.description: In times past, honored visitors and brave heroes joined Windhelm's annual ceremonial ride on the festively decorated steeds of the Winterbloom Warmblood herd. Now that they're more freely available, perhaps you can recapture the spirit of this tradition.
6676.name: Winterbloom Warmblood

6677.description: The corrupting presence of Dark Aeon can twist the local wildlife, such as this wolf, into crystalline creatures. Green tendrils accompany you as you race on its back, providing you both with an otherworldly presence.
6677.name: Dark Aeon Wolf

6678.description: This molten mount radiates heat and reeks of brimstone. Some Dark Elves swear that it emerged from the heart of Red Mountain itself, but they speak of this only in whispers. Those who seek such a blasphemous steed will find none better!
6678.name: Volcanic Senche-Panther

6679.description: The result of a boastful Khajiiti mage's bizarre transmutation ritual, the Dark Opaline Steed shimmers with blues and purples, and waves of colorful light trail behind it. Course through any environment while looking stylish and almost ephemeral!
6679.name: Dark Opaline Steed

6680.description: This kagouti-shaped frost atronach might just be the last thing an unfortunate apprentice warlock crafted before becoming its first victim. Perhaps you can tame this mount? If not, best have extra healing potions on hand for the inevitable bites.
6680.name: Frost Atronach Kagouti

6681.description: Two mages crafted this mount, then had a deadly falling out over whether to share their research. Now you can ride it into the frozen peaks of Skyrim with no problems â¦ or enjoy its coolness in the blistering heat of the Alik'r.
6681.name: Frost Atronach Wolf

6682.description: Most sorcerers scoff at the idea of imbuing the lumbering frost atronach with feline grace, but when summoned correctly, this frigid senche more than matches its warm-blooded peers in quiet and cunning. Perfect for a hero of your stature!
6682.name: Frost Atronach Senche

6683.description: All the strength of a standard frost atronach, with all the nobility and grace of the equine form! Create a spectacle by riding into your favorite town on this mighty steed.
6683.name: Frost Atronach Horse

6684.description: Few mages possess the power to press a frost atronach into serviceâbut twisting its form into that of a Dwarven spider? That takes a rare gift. And with the sun glinting off it as you ride it, you'll cut quite an imposing figure!
6684.name: Frost Atronach Dwarven Spider

6685.description: Orcish spellwrights rarely call for boons from Daedric realms beyond Malacath's Ashpit. Even so, the lure of a raging bear wrought from rock-hard ice is difficult to pass up.
6685.name: Frost Atronach Bear

6686.description: Many masters of the art of necromancy find this horse suits their taste exceedingly well, especially since it possesses no fear of the undead that often surround necromancers. It calls to you, does it not?
6686.name: Khaj Necromancer's Steed

6687.description: Taken from the crime-ridden back streets of Senchal and raised by scavengers, this mount lost an eye while defending its rider from pursuing guards. Now wearing a patch, the Howler is an ideal mount for doers of deadly deeds.
6687.name: Scorched Alley Howler

6688.description: Hunters riding these valiant steeds are often the first on the scene of a Dragon attack. With its ornate, jade-accented barding, and its fierce loyalty to its rider, this steed is a must-have for any veteran Dragon Hunter.
6688.name: Legendary Dragon Horse

6689.description: "A mage from Lilmoth found a way to, ahem, 'tame' these green slimes. Yes, it will follow you around, leaving a disgusting trail of slime, but it's hardly docile. My apprentice's so-called 'pet' woke me by trying to engulf my face."âAleri Andalor
6689.name: Voriplasm

6690.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Ruins of Mazzatun.
6690.name: Mighty Chudan Mask
6690.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Mighty Chudan Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6691.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag's Mystery Coffer.
6691.name: Mighty Chudan Shoulder
6691.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Mighty Chudan Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6692.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Cradle of Shadows.
6692.name: Velidreth Mask
6692.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Velidreth Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6693.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag's Mystery Coffer.
6693.name: Velidreth Shoulder
6693.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Velidreth Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6694.description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.
6694.name: Luminous Berries of Bloom

6695.description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.
6695.name: Luminous Berries of Budding

6696.description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.
6696.name: Luminous Berries of Growth

6697.description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.
6697.name: Luminous Berries of Ripeness

6698.name: Onyx Berries of Bloom

6700.description: One of four Legendary Onyx Berries.
6700.name: Onyx Berries of Growth

6701.name: Onyx Berries of Ripeness

6702.name: Pure-Snow Berries of Bloom

6703.name: Pure-Snow Berries of Budding

6704.description: One of four Legendary Pure-Snow Berries.
6704.name: Pure-Snow Berries of Growth

6705.description: One of four Legendary Pure-Snow Berries.
6705.name: Pure-Snow Berries of Ripeness

6706.description: The first of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.
6706.name: Emerald Indrik Feather

6707.description: The second of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.
6707.name: Gilded Indrik Feather

6708.description: The third of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.
6708.name: Onyx Indrik Feather

6709.description: The fourth of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.
6709.name: Opaline Indrik Feather

6719.description:
"Oh, yes! I've seen legionaries stand their ground against a battle-bonded Khajiit pair. Never seen one survive the experience, but you've got to respect anyone who faces a Senche-raht and their chosen battlemate."
âNallangaer, Vinedusk Ranger
6719.name: Senche-Raht Statue, Battle-Bound

6720.description: Khajiit claim these torchbugs are the light of Jode given form, which allows them to dance amid the moon-sugar cane and bless the crops. Now you can have one flitting about you! After all, having Jode's blessing is never a bad thing, right?
6720.name: Crimson Torchbug

6721.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Blackheart Haven.
6721.name: Pirate Skeleton Mask
6721.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Pirate Skeleton Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6722.description: Purchased from Glirion the Redbeard at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Glirion's Mystery Coffer.
6722.name: Pirate Skeleton Shoulder
6722.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Pirate Skeleton Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6723.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Pirate Skeleton style.
6723.name: Pirate Skeleton Maul

6724.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Pirate Skeleton style.
6724.name: Pirate Skeleton Bow

6725.name: Pirate Skeleton Shield

6726.name: Pirate Skeleton Staff

6727.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Pirate Skeleton style.
6727.name: Pirate Skeleton Sword

6728.name: Battleground Runner Jack

6729.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Battleground Runner style.
6729.name: Battleground Runner Helmet

6730.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Battleground Runner style.
6730.name: Battleground Runner Guards

6731.name: Battleground Runner Arm Cops

6732.name: Battleground Runner Boots

6733.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Battleground Runner style.
6733.name: Battleground Runner Bracers

6737.description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.
6737.name: Apple-Bobbing Fresh Gorapples
6737.hint: Acquired from the Witches Grab Bag during the Witches Festival.

6738.name: Apple-Bobbing Cold Iron Cauldron
6738.hint: Acquired from the Witches Grab Bag during the Witches Festival.

6744.name: Chokethorn Mask

6751.description: Dotted with Elsweyr architectural features, this meadow provides plenty of building space in a peaceful and natural setting. Nearby streams gleam in the light of the sun and moons, enhancing this idyllic getaway.
6751.name: Moon-Sugar Meadow

6752.description: With its pillars of skulls, stained glass, and ghostly portals, this abode can accommodate even the most tormented soul. Take advantage of its open layout to set up large-scale rituals, and use its vaults and lofty balconies for vile experiments.
6752.name: Wraithhome

6753.description: Acquired by following the Eastmarch Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6753.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Battle Axe

6754.description: Acquired by following the Bangkorai Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6754.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Maul

6755.description: Acquired by following the Malabal Tor Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6755.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Greatsword

6756.description: Acquired by following the Stonefalls Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6756.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Axe

6757.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Bow

6758.description: Acquired by following the Daggerfall Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6758.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Dagger

6759.description: Acquired by following the Rivenspire Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6759.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Mace

6760.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Shield

6761.description: Acquired by following the Auridon Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6761.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Staff

6762.description: Acquired by following the Alik'r Glenmoril Wyrd Treasure Map.
6762.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Sword

6774.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Dread-Aurelian style.
6774.name: Dread-Aurelian Pauldrons
6774.hint: Acquired by completing the "Scalebreaker Delver" achievement.

6775.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Fungal Grotto II.
6775.name: Spawn of Mephala Mask
6775.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Spawn of Mephala Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6776.description: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Maj's Mystery Coffer.

6776.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Spawn of Mephala Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

6777.name: Spawn of Mephala Maul

6919.name: Behold Khunzar-ri's Guile
6919.hint: Awarded for earning the "Scalebreaker Scout" achievement by completing Moongrave Fane and Lair of Maarselok.

6920.description: To the heroes of Tamriel! Sai Sahan, blademaster and former captain of the Dragonguard, requires adventurers strong in heart to help fight back against the rage of Dragons that have invaded Elsweyr. Find Sai Sahan in Senchal, in Southern Elsweyr.
6920.name: Dragonhold

6922.description: Perform "Ragnar the Red" on a lute. Thrill your audience with your skilled string rendition of this piece!
6922.name: Play Ragnar the Red

6923.description: Look for your missing sweetroll. Where did it go? This is important to know!
6923.name: Missing Sweetroll

6924.description: Express all the angst and agony of taking an arrow to the knee!
6924.name: Arrow to the Knee

6925.description: Go beyond building a snowman. Build a snow Cadwell with this memento!
6925.name: Snow Cadwell

6926.description: Sometimes you just need to chill out. This blizzard-creating memento can help with that!
6926.name: Blizzard Globe

6927.description: You've braved dangerous waters and seedy back-alleys. Now, on land or sea, your telltale swagger marks you as someone who's comfortable in all manner of deadly environments!
6927.name: Swashbuckler

6928.description: A miniature statue of Auri-El and Xarxes, based on the statues in the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene.
6928.name: Statuette: Auri-El and Xarxes

6929.description: Originally bred by Tenmar Khajiit, these wily strays made their way to Senchal and now roam several port cities. Captains love having them on board ships to sniff out and kill vermin, plus help keep the crew warm on cold nights at sea.
6929.name: Sable Tenmar Stray

6930.description: "Some say that dogs of this breed don't have a mean bone in their bodies, but if you set them up to guard horses or other creatures, you'll see one fierce guardian. Also great at rounding up livestock."âPiet
6930.name: Merle Paddock Hound

6931.description: Vampirism and sunlight just don't mix. Hide from the oppressive light of Magnus with this memento.
6931.name: Orb of Magnus

6932.description:
Ready for a snowball fight? To use this collectible, add it to your quick slot and then pick a target.

|cff0000Note: Hitting a guard with a snowball will count as a Petty Crime. |r
6932.name: Everlasting Snowball

6933.description: What a wonderfully decorated stake you've recovered from Murkmire! But, oh dear, you do realize you took that from a grave? Perhaps you should return it. Now. Before the grave's inhabitant seeks you out. Or is it too lateâ¦.
6933.name: Wooden Grave-Stake

6942.description: Rare indriks don't die but instead live on as haunting apparitions. Though they walk between two worlds, these ghostly steeds serve their chosen companions well as mounts. Some Summerset High Elves claim this is a true sign of a rider's worthiness.
6942.name: Spectral Indrik
6942.hint: Obtained by combining four different Spectral Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Spectral Indrik.

6950.description: Though some scholars in Alinor have hypotheses about why an indrik would linger after death, none have as yet proven them. Perhaps these indriks have simply picked someone worthy to follow for all time?

6966.description: You may not be a Dragon, but this mask reverberates with the fierceness and majesty of the king of these mighty creatures.
6966.name: Mask of Alkosh
6966.hint: Earned from completing the "Return of the Dragonguard" Achievement.

6967.description: Dragons have ascended! And now you can show off your affiliation with them. After all, they are the most powerful creatures in Tamriel and deserve the reverence you give freely.
6967.name: New Moon Dragon Cult Garb

6968.description: Looking for an outfit that displays your alliance with the Dragonguard but leaves room to wiggle? This costume is made for you! Approved (and worn) by Za'ji himself.
6968.name: Za'ji's Dragonguard Uniform
6968.hint: Earned by completing the quest "Uneasy Alliances" in Southern Elsweyr.

6969.description: Instill dread in those who dare confront you with this Dragon priest mask! Scholars note it once belonged to a cult that claimed to walk within the dreams of Dragons, learning as much as they could from their masters.
6969.name: Dread-Etched Dragon Priest Mask

6970.description: Braving fiery foes? This mask is made for you. With its dark metal and limber leather, you can wear this knowing that only the most foolish or intrepid would dare try to stare you down.
6970.name: Scorched Dragon Priest Mask

6971.description: Those who gaze upon you will despair when you wear this mask. Crafted from only the purest of gleaming metal, it once adorned a cultist who assassinated every single person who impugned Dragons while in her presence.
6971.name: Terrorgleam Dragon Priest Mask

6972.description: "Clearly the Dwarves liked to travel in pairs now and again, so they built this two-seated animunculi for that purpose. My partner and I adore using it on market day!"âDelyna Ulvel
6972.name: Duo-Dynamo Dwarven Spider

7076.description: An iniquitous blend of magic created this unhallowed mount. From its baleful glow to the corrupt lanterns that drift about it, this steed serves liches, necromancers, and other wicked beings with undying loyalty.
7076.name: Cursebound Lichsteed

7077.description: This creature is dominated by the oppressive energies of Coldharbour, bound to its master by a vile pledge to Molag Bal. Though it lacks the ability to act without command, the simmering rage bottled inside the beast grows with every passing day.
7077.name: Cursebound Sabre Cat Prowler

7078.description: Zarnor, seeking to quench his insatiable curiosity, took part in experimental rituals that twisted and marked him. Though he still seeks to satiate his ceaseless desire for knowledge, he does so to free himself from servitude to loathsome masters.
7078.name: Cursebound Senche-Raht Darkfang

7079.description: "A fellow named Rigurt requested a 'fortuitudinous' bear mount that 'shines up the face' of a friend. My glowing Gloomspore Bears, with their mora tapinella infusion, barrel through enemies to get a rider to safety. 'Fortuitudinous' galore."âMage Naleldi
7079.name: Gloomspore Bear

7080.description: "A scholar sought a mount that would assume her burdens, so I gave her a Gloomspore Camel. Using scaly pholiota in its creation makes it less likely to complain at any weight it bears, plus gives it a bounce to its step."âMage Naleldil
7080.name: Gloomspore Camel

7081.description: "A Dunmer mage came by, shaking with rage, and tersely asked for my toughest mount. Though my Gloomspore Guars are a bit nippy, probably due to the extra bleeding crown I used to make them, they have thick fungal hide."âMage Naleldil
7081.name: Gloomspore Guar

7082.description: "Using giant lichen while creating Gloomspore Horses caused unexpected results. Dauntingly beautiful, these mounts often twitch with nervous caution. So you'll never have to worry about an ambush. Just hold on tight!"âMage Naleldil
7082.name: Gloomspore Horse

7083.description: "When developing my Gloomspore Senche, I utilized thunder fungiâa remarkable mushroom that erupts into spores with a deafening boom! I thought it only fitting to mix one roar with another." â Mage Naleldil
7083.name: Gloomspore Senche

7084.description: "Using hypha facia while creating my Gloomspore Wolves made for some eerie fungal mountsâperfect for anyone who wants to keep others at a distance. Their howls make my own skin prickle."âMage Naleldil
7084.name: Gloomspore Wolf

7097.description: When mixed into tattoo ink, the insectoid eyes of the chaurus lend the substance a sting that makes gaining Chittering Chaurus facial markings an especially painful process. Yet the pain is part of the experience, or so both artists and recipients claim.
7097.name: Chittering Chaurus Face Markings

7098.description: Adventurers seeking poisons often hunt chaurusesâenormous insects known for their venomous bite. Nord inkwrights add it to the ink for the markings known as the Chittering Chaurus, which they claim provides bearers with the tenacity of these insects.
7098.name: Chittering Chaurus Body Markings

7099.description: "Look, I'll tell it to you straight: Don't mess with Gloomlurkers. They spent too much time in ruins and put some ritual markings on their faces after killing what they fear most. You poke them and they become your greatest fear."âGloor the Glowerer
7099.name: Gloomlurker Face Markings

7100.description: "Some ruin explorers calling themselves Gloomlurkers mark themselves with chalky-white line patterns after killing the creature that terrifies them most. You want these markings? Go find a beast worth slaying."âGloor the Glowerer
7100.name: Gloomlurker Body Markings

7101.description: The symbol of the Icereach coven reminds people not to cross you and yours. If they do, well, the consequences are theirs to suffer.
7101.name: Frigid Ritual Face Markings

7102.description: The power of the Icereach coven flows through your veins, and their symbols decorate your skin, marking you as one of them. You have become one with the coven, and all should fear your prowess.
7102.name: Frigid Ritual Body Markings

7103.description: "People act like what we do is amoral, but you retrieve a trinket from their long-dead grandpa, and they're all smiles. Just don't forget to mark yourself as one of us before you start work, or we might mistake you for draugr!"âPaurges Aline
7103.name: Grave Plunderer Facepaint

7104.description: "Exploring tombs is not for the faint of heart. Sometimes you run into something that's best left alone. That's when you get help from others like us. So, paint yourself up like me, and you'll know who your friends are."âPaurges Aline
7104.name: Grave Plunderer Bodypaint

7105.description: Though the arcane markings on this gray pocket mammoth indicate its status as a sacrificial offering, these creatures often end up trundling along after soft-hearted souls like yourself.
7105.name: Sacrificial Pocket Mammoth

7106.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Pellitine Outlaw style.
7106.name: Pellitine Outlaw Greatsword

7107.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Pellitine Outlaw style.
7107.name: Pellitine Outlaw Bow

7108.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Pellitine Outlaw style.
7108.name: Pellitine Outlaw Staff

7109.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Pellitine Outlaw style.
7109.name: Pellitine Outlaw Dagger

7110.description: Bred for their wicked intelligence, the Emberthroat Durzog might just outwit the Netch Gouger Goblins that raised them. Only those with nimbler minds keep their loyaltyâand that might just be you!
7110.name: Emberthroat Durzog

7111.description: Teeth. Lots of sharp teeth. Jutting from gums pulled back in a mirthless, rictus grin. Eager to devour anyone in its path. Yet if you're brave enough to ride it, those frightful teeth will eagerly snap at your foes.
7111.name: Cursebound Wolf

7217.description: Enterprising siegemasters need to move quickly when working to overthrow a fortification. Whether you plan to conquer Castle Alessia, take over Fort Warden, or overwhelm Chalman Keep, the Holdbreaker Horse is a valuable addition to your stable!
7217.name: Holdbreaker Warhorse

7218.description: By some miracle or simple chance, Lucky Cat Landing weathered the fires that ravaged Southern Elsweyr completely unsinged! Its spacious terrace frames a gorgeous view, and its proximity to Senchal makes it convenient for those who enjoy city living.
7218.name: Lucky Cat Landing

7219.description: When the winter air grows quiet and heavy just before snowfall, woodsmoke touched by Magicka swirls into the form of an Icebreath Indrik. Summerset scholars believe these mounts allow those with insight and wisdom to understand their deepest wish.
7219.name: Icebreath Indrik
7219.hint: Obtained by combining four different Icebreath Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Icebreath Indrik.

7220.description: The Laughing Lion has taken a liking to you! Place this ancient sarcophagus in your home and his carefree wisdom will always be close to hand.
7220.name: Khunzar-ri's Rest
7220.hint: Awarded for completing the "A Hero's Song" achievement in Southern Elsweyr.

7221.description: After arriving on Firemoth Island, the slavers found and trained a flame-hued variant of the nix-ox steed. Its vibrant colors belie its fiery temperament, making it a suitable match for those seeking to ride into the midst of combat.
7221.name: Firemoth Nix-Ox

7224.description: Decaying corpses? Rusty traps? You're bound to find worse in the tombs around here. Best make sure you have gear that can keep your shovel and other tools safe while you beat a hasty retreat from draugr, ghosts, and other nasty threats."âPaurges Aline
7224.name: Graverobber

7225.description: The artists of Black Heights honor their lives through their paintings on the Wall of Life. Now, to commemorate their practices, you can paint a tree in mid-air.
7225.name: Wall of Life Brush
7225.hint: Earned by completing the quest "Chiaroscuro Crossroads" in Southern Elsweyr.

7226.description: Originally built by the Potentate Versidue-Shaie as a retreat from Senchal, this manor contains roomy spaces in which to entertain guests. A terraced area features a flooded aeonstone crater as well as luminescent flora transplanted from Moonlit Cove.
7226.name: Potentate's Retreat

7228.description: "During one of their infrequent moots, vampires of Iliac Bay honored their leaders with this haunting crownlet. Once adorned, they fed until only fellow vampires remained within screaming distance of the gathering."âNalana, Advisor to House Tamrith
7228.name: High Vampiric Headdress

7229.description: Before the Kairian coven split and lost members to the Icereach, its seedswoman grew a coronal each year to crown their leader. After wearing it for a year and a day, this leader gifted it to a dark champion, recognizing a kindred and twisted soul.
7229.name: Crone's Wicker Coronal

7231.description: Most adventurers who drink corrupted Hist sap die in frothing agony. But for a precious few, the ritual bestows dubious "gifts," such as polished green scales and veins that glow like precious amber.
7231.name: Mireheart Scale

7232.description: "Whether afflicted by the Rivenspire blood-curse or some other vile vampiric corruption, the result is the same: Victims transform into ravenous monsters. These creatures know nothing but rage and hunger. Appalling."âNalana, Advisor to House Tamrith
7232.name: Bloodfiend

7233.description: A life in Namira's service often brings bleak and horrifying side-effects. Praise Namira, the Lady of Decay and the Great Darkness! With eyes awash in pitch black ichor, you shall see her will fulfilled.
7233.name: Namira's Bile

7234.description: The legendary might of the Sea Giants is the envy of any warrior. A superstitious few choose to dye their skin like stormy skies and paint themselves with silver markings in hopes of channeling that power.
7234.name: Seaborn Silver
7234.hint: Acquired by completing the "Kyne's Aegis Conqueror" achievement in the Kyne's Aegis trial.

7235.description: "Afraid of spidersâor worseâlanding on your head while you're scouting out a tomb? Wear a hood. Even better, wear this hood, which has a lens you can use to examine any treasures you find."âPaurges Aline
7235.name: Graverobber's Appraising Hood

7236.description: "Used to be that hacking up crypt-dust was just part of the trade. But times have changed, eh? Take a look at this hood and mask. Won't keep the stink of a rotting skeever out of your nose, but it'll help you breathe a little easier."âPaurges Aline
7236.name: Graverobber's Mask

7269.description: "The cold blue glowing eyes and markings of the Slate-Skinned Daedrat stem from their diet: corpses touched by Molag Bal. Those brave enough to research or even thwart the Lord of Brutality often study these creatures for insight."âPhrastus of Elinhir
7269.name: Slate-Skinned Daedrat

7270.description: Freed at last from her terrible captivity, and rightfully wedded to Jester King Jorunn, the Sovereign Sow can trundle along at your side to share in your adventures. Who would not want a companion of such royal blood and stately countenance?
7270.name: Sovereign Sow
7270.hint: Acquired by finding and combining all seven Sovereign Sow collectible fragments found in Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes during the Jester's Festival.

7271.description: After news of the Seventh Legion's presence near Hallin's Stand spread, several Evermore citizens moved quickly to protect some at-risk fauna, among them a breed of easily domesticated jackals. Now one of these fierce companions can roam at your side.
7271.name: Hallin's Jackal

7272.description: "Witches refused to share the grisly secrets of the Wickerfright summoning ritual â¦ until now. Upon appearing, its wooden countenance twists into an eerie smileâa frightful expression, indeed!"âWarlock Aldaale
7272.name: Wickerfright Banekin

7273.description: "No better companion exists than my devoted Gloomspore Guar Calf. I used spores known for their calming properties to modify the guar's temperament. Regrettably, it makes the creature gassy, but unmatched loyalty is worth opening windows."âMage Naleldil
7273.name: Gloomspore Guar Calf

7274.description: "Integrating research left behind by Ahzidal the Enchanter, I crafted a bear cub from spores acquired from a well-traveled merchant. This creature bumbles around a bit more than its animal counterpart, but it glows! Perfection!"âMage Naleldil
7274.name: Gloomspore Bear Cub

7275.description: "To the surprise of none but the most hard-hearted, I made a tumbling ball of fungal-fur in the form of a senche cub. How could I not? And shame on any who pass this adorable bundle of spores without smiling."âMage Naleldil
7275.name: Gloomspore Senche Cub

7276.description: "Challenged by a colleague, I created a pony-fungus creature. The first few stood as still as statues, so I added manic morels from Dementia. That livened things up considerably. If you adopt one, I suggest keeping it out of your parlor."âMage Naleldil
7276.name: Gloomspore Pony

7277.description: "I designed some adorable wolf pups, adding oxblood fungus spores to see if that instills fierce guardianship in them. It workedâthey now guard my feet from things like boots and stockings. Consider garbing yourself out of their sight!"âMage Naleldil
7277.name: Gloomspore Wolf Pup

7278.description: The sound of wind gusting through dusklit, ice-laden trees heralds a Rimedust Indrik's birth. These indriks emanate a sense of deep calm wherever they go.
7278.name: Rimedusk Indrik

7279.description: Dark Elves of House Hlaalu, knowing that Vvardenfell isn't the only place with deadly flora, fauna, and folk, bred a nix-hound that can thrive in different environments. Even with its gorgeous blue-purple shading, it still possesses a menacing air.
7279.name: Coldspring Nix-Hound

7280.description: While studying arcane husbandry, Mage Naleldil discovered a long-forgotten Ayleid ritual capable of granting luminescent qualities to common salamanders. Now, due to an unexpected population explosion, she gives them to those who impress her.
7280.name: Ice-Glow Salamander

7281.description: The night before Waking Day, Iliac Bay Bretons share stories about the Terrible Torchbug of Molag Bal. While the story varies, all agree on one thing: those followed by a cobalt-hued torchbug possess a savagery in battle that haunts any who survive.
7281.name: Blue Torchbug

7282.description: Madness follows the Purple Torchbug, or so some claim. Others believe that those who once held Sheogorath's attention attract these insects. Either way, perhaps Sheogorath's dubious blessing touched them.
7282.name: Purple Torchbug

7283.description: Some believe that gaining Meridia's favor is like gripping a double-edged blade tightly with bare hands. Yet, if you perform an action she likes, she may gift you with a White Torchbugâperhaps the least worrisome of her favors!
7283.name: White Torchbug

7284.description: Some followers of Stendarr claim that those who see a Pink Torchbug must perform great acts of charity and mercy by sunset the following day. If they please Stendarr, the pleasant little creature might follow them for a time.
7284.name: Pink Torchbug

7286.description: Long ago, the secretive Pyre Watch bred local jackals into mounts, allowing them to move swiftly as they patrolled their cursed caverns. Now this nimble and fleet pale steed can be yours!
7286.name: Pyre Watch Jackal

7287.description: A bloodied Daedric dagger used by a spurned lover. The tears of a victim tormented by Molag Bal. When used in a wicked Icereach coven ritual, they help shape a wicker mount that is worthy of bearing everyone's worst nightmare: you.
7287.name: Icereach Wicker-Steed

7288.description: "Ahzidal made the shadowcap's azure glow the centerpiece of this unsettling feline mount. Prized by spelunkers, this luminescent mount can light up the darkest caverns without making a sound. "âHalund Greycloak
7288.name: Shadowcap Cave-Senche

7289.description: "One of Ahzidal's experiments involved creating an ideal wolf mount for dangerous forests and caverns. This Fungiflare Wolf has a vicious temperament by design and natureâfungiflare mushrooms are lethal."âHalund Greycloak
7289.name: Fungiflare Wolf

7290.description: "Seeking to meld fire with fungi, Ahzidal created the first Embermould Warhorse. Formed from char morels often used in stews, this mount can light a rider's way on the darkest winter nights."âHalund Greycloak
7290.name: Embermould Warhorse

7291.description: Ride a stick mount that symbolizes your fiery dreams of all-consuming doom. Complete with flaming mane, tail, and eyes, this thrice-cursed novelty horse makes your stick-riding experience one for the books â¦ of burning horror!
7291.name: Nightmare Stick Horse
7291.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

7360.description: The unusual properties of the crystal known as aeonstone continue to confound alchemists and arcane researchers. This particular formation resonates with nearby inactive deposits, causing them to emit a soft glow.
7360.name: Aeonstone Formation
7360.hint: Awarded for completing the "Fall of the Dark Aeon" achievement in Southern Elsweyr.

7361.description: "Say what you want about Za'ji, but he has style. His uniform gets more elaborate every time I see him. You can always tell when he's visited a city since there's usually more than one person wearing something inspired by him."âPuurri, Dragonguard
7361.name: Za'ji's Sailing Apparel

7362.description: If you love chipping away at rock until you reveal raw gemstone, garb yourself appropriately. Crafted from sturdy materials, this costume features pockets, pouches, and gear that allow you to better find and remove natural riches.
7362.name: Gem Prospector

7363.description: Why depend on others to tell you the worth of your finds? Set yourself up with these spectacles, and you can determine the value of gems you discover yourself!
7363.name: Gemcutter's Spectacles

7365.description: "For our skills to flourish, we lend our magic to ice and spite. Each frost-tainted conjuration and ritual we conduct grants us strength and germinates the wicked seed of power within us."âGohlla
7365.name: Visage of Gohlla

7366.description: "Delve deep within to find your darkest fear and use your might to destroy it. Only then will you be truly free, my dear."âBani
7366.name: Visage of Bani

7391.name: Wickerman Mishap
7391.hint: Earned by completing the "Harrowstorm Explorer" achievement.

7392.description: Show off your skill at cryomancy by crafting a flower from ice.
7392.name: Iceblossom Summoning

7393.description: The power of lightning crackles between your fingers. Impressive!
7393.name: Tame Lightning

7394.description: Bones await your call when you use this trinket.
7394.name: Bone Digger's Trinket

7395.description: When invoked, you can use these prayer-beads to form a circle of glowing mushrooms around you.
7395.name: Fungimancer's Prayer-Beads

7396.description: Join the ranks of the brutal Draugrkin graverobbers with these Bloodrune facial markings. These skilled plunderers paint their faces in a ritual that imbues their markings with a metallic sheen, allowing them to easily recognize one another in dark places.
7396.name: Bloodrune Face Markings
7396.hint: Earned by completing the "Knock Knock" achievement.

7397.description: The Bloodrune-marked Draugrkin graverobbers pride themselves on surviving and thriving in the deadliest tombs. Those who best them in combat have a chance to gain their distinctive red markings.
7397.name: Bloodrune Body Markings
7397.hint: Earned by completing the "Unhallowed Grave Conqueror" achievement.

7398.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Balorgh style.
7398.name: Balorgh Greatsword

7399.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Balorgh style.
7399.name: Balorgh Bow

7400.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Balorgh style.
7400.name: Balorgh Shield

7401.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Balorgh style.
7401.name: Balorgh Staff

7402.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Balorgh style.
7402.name: Balorgh Dagger

7404.description: The Icereach Coven hoarded countless magical items on their cursed isleâthese chains for instance. What happens when you invoke their power? Let's see â¦
7404.name: Chains of the Ice Witch
7404.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Coven Conundrum."

7424.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Tempest Island.
7424.name: Stormfist Mask
7424.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Stormfist Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7425.description: Purchased from Glirion the Redbeard at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Glirion the Redbeard's Mystery Coffer.
7425.name: Stormfist Shoulder
7425.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Stormfist Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7426.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran March of Sacrifices.
7426.name: Balorgh Mask
7426.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Balorgh Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7427.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag Chief-bane's Mystery Coffer.
7427.name: Balorgh Shoulder
7427.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Balorgh Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7430.description: Deep within the halls of Blackreach, a mad alchemist feverishly perfects his devious creations. Enter the Stone Garden, uncover the dark laboratory's secrets, and put a stop to the heinous experiments at its heart.
7430.name: Stone Garden

7431.description: After years of isolation, the mysterious Lady Thorn now amasses a dread army within the walls of her ancient castle. Gather your allies, storm the fortress gate, and stop the Thorn Legion before it marches on Western Skyrim.
7431.name: Castle Thorn

7464.description: "When a Bright Moons Lunar Moth follows you, the blessings of Jone and Jode flutter close behind."âMoon-Priest Tedaza
7464.name: Bright Moons Lunar Moth

7466.description: To the heroes of Tamriel! Jorunn the Skald-King has dispatched agents to Western Skyrim to investigate and deal with a threat not only to Skyrim, but to all of Tamriel. Find the Skald-King's agent in Solitude, the capital city of Haafingar Hold.
7466.name: Greymoor

7467.description: Born when a sunset's light tickles Magicka-imbued bird feathers, the Crimson Indrik possesses a flowing gait. Scholars observe that the indrik's magical nature promotes self-reflection.
7467.name: Crimson Indrik
7467.hint: Obtained by combining four different Crimson Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Crimson Indrik.

7468.description: Summerset scholars state this indrik, which comes into being at the base of the oldest tree in the forest, possesses an air of profound agelessness. Those riding these magical creatures find that weighty matters ease away.
7468.name: Mossheart Indrik
7468.hint: Obtained by combining four different Mossheart Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Mossheart Indrik.

7500.name: Icereach Coven Dagger

7501.description: Once these death hounds served crypt wardens exclusively, stalking the gloomy barrows of Skyrim in search of prey. Now, thanks to an ingenious mage from Solitude, these mounts can serve you, lending you their menacing air.
7501.name: Crypt Warden Death Hound

7502.description: Some Alinor scholars claim these indriks form when Magicka mingles with the petals of early-blooming roses. Others note that the roses' thorns need to have drawn blood first. Regardless, this creature inspires creativity in any it follows.
7502.name: Rosethorn Indrik

7503.description: As trees awaken in the spring, the first light of dawn sparks the formation of a Sapling Indrik from Magicka-touched acorns. Boundless hope fills those they choose to follow.
7503.name: Sapling Indrik

7504.description: A miniature statue of Sithis, patron of the Dark Brotherhood.
7504.name: Statuette: Sithis, Dread Lord

7505.description: A miniature version of the enigmatic mermaid statue found in Anvil.
7505.name: Statuette: Mermaid of Anvil

7506.description: A miniature statue of Auri-El, chief deity of the Aldmeri pantheon, with an eagle.
7506.name: Statuette: Auri-El, Aldmer King

7507.description: When you're done wading into battle on behalf of your hold, celebrate your glorious victories in the jarl's mead hall! This rugged but stylish raiment is typically reserved for northern nobilityâjust more proof of your heroic stature!
7507.name: Jarl Finery

7508.description: Crafted from horker leather and metal reworked from weapons, this circlet marks your lofty status among the Nords.
7508.name: Jarl Crown

7511.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Icereach.
7511.name: Mother Ciannait Mask
7511.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Mother Ciannait Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7512.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag's Mystery Coffer.
7512.name: Mother Ciannait Shoulder
7512.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Mother Ciannait Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7513.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Unhallowed Grave.
7513.name: Kjalnar's Nightmare Mask
7513.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Kjalnar's Nightmare Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7514.description: Purchased from Urgarlag Chief-bane at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Urgarlag's Mystery Coffer.
7514.name: Kjalnar's Nightmare Shoulder
7514.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Kjalnar's Nightmare Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

7515.description: Bears afflicted by a necromancer's curse become baneful, easily enraged beasts. Loyal only to their masters, these transformed ursines show no fear in the face of danger, making them excellent battlefield companions.
7515.name: Cursebound Bear

7516.description: The roar of a sabre cat bridled by a deathless curse shreds a soul to pieces, or so say those at the Bards College in Solitude. Yet that doesn't deter ambitious necromancers from trying to tame these frightening creatures.
7516.name: Cursebound Sabre Cat

7517.description: Glorious and deadly. Majestic and haunting. This well-armored steed serves its master faithfully, though its nightmarish appearance once inspired rumors of a ghoulish nature in the area around Cragwallow.
7517.name: Cursebound Horse

7518.description: This fell monstrosity inspired Maestro Efnort of the Bards College to write the poem "The Red-Eyed Terror of Zthenganaz." In truth, this steed most often chooses intimidation and flight tactics over direct confrontation.
7518.name: Cursebound Kagouti

7519.description: The dramatic black and white coloration of this lithe mount makes for striking entrances. Watch out, though! Karthstalkers show affection by trying to groom your face.
7519.name: Karthstalker Sabre Cat

7520.description: Originally tamed and bred as mounts by the ancient Grimfang Reach clan, these riding bears became popular among Nords who captured them in raids. Despite their inherent docility, these bears anger swiftly when threatened.
7520.name: Druadach Mountain Bear

7521.description: Battlemages within the perfidious Legion Zero conjure these powerful warhorses out of thin air using forbidden Daedric magic. The sight of this otherworldly charger inspires both fear and awe on the battlelines.
7521.name: Legion Zero Charger

7522.description: When seen at night, this elk emanates a faint glow, rivaling the unusual color shifts in the northern skies of Skyrim or the glowing fungus of Blackreach's vast caves. Stunning!
7522.name: Pineblossom Vale Elk

7523.description: This elk's blue luminescence stems from its origins, claim Mages Guild scholars: they coalesce from a beam of pure light, blessed by Azura, that falls upon a drift of snow. Or perhaps, as others state, its diet of blue entolomas causes the azure glow.
7523.name: Snowdrift Vale Elk

7524.description: Some claim a ghost possesses this proud steed, providing it with a haunting glow. Others point to its chosen diet: glowing flora and fungi. Regardless, riders feel as if they're gliding on air.
7524.name: Hailcinder Vale Elk

7525.description: In an annual Windhelm competition, contestants must ride their potential prizes up a mountain then down at top speedsâbareback and without falling off. Most rams toss riders into the air on purpose, validating the claim that the ram chooses its rider.
7525.name: Yorgrim River Ram
7525.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

7526.description: "Pure white, these bats, making them hard to see in wintry conditions. But give one a bit of banana, and it'll stick close to you for a while. With a constant diet of bananas and other fruits? You are its boon companion."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7526.name: Snow Throat Fruit Bat

7527.description: "Normally you don't see these black bats because they prefer caves and other areas avoided by people. However, if trained, these fellows consider you a member of their colony and hate to leave your side."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7527.name: Shadowswift Bat

7528.description: "People blessed by these brown bat companions experience very few issues with insects. They love hiding in your pack during the day, and they'll keep you bug-free while you sleep at night."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7528.name: Brown Steeple Bat

7529.description: "Sometimes called Friends of the Caravan, these black-and-white bats migrate among cacti stands in arid regions. Trackers follow their guano to find hydrating, safe cacti when in need. Easily trained to be a companion."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7529.name: Dappled Cactus Bat

7530.description: "So colorful! And common around orchards, farms, and other places with cultivated fruit and flowers. A priceless companion for foragers and travelers since they can lead you to food."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7530.name: Duskfire Nectar Bat

7531.description: Legends claim that Dibella sent one of these joyful gryphon fledglings to the Bards College during the bards' opening performance, marking it as being the first creature inside the building.
7531.name: Skald-Muse Fledgling Gryphon

7532.description: Decades ago, Nords whispered stories of a reclusive dark-furred lynx that ate spirits barred from Sovngarde. Imagine the Nords' surprise when they found these lynxes domesticated as tent guards during a raid on Reach natives.
7532.name: Twilight Striped Lynx

7533.description: Known for both their stubbornness and their ability to climb on structures at the worst possible times, the Whiterun Mottled Goat picks a favorite person and tries to follow them. Affectionate? Only if you find gentle headbutts to be so.
7533.name: Whiterun Mottled Goat

7534.description: "Though I lost many trained frostbite spiders to those who took them for an aggressive infestation of Solitude, I moved outside town and now give them away. They are trained, venomous, and ready to follow you in your travels!"âHlokela of Solitude
7534.name: Frostbite Spider

7535.description: Enterprising merchants seek out and capture these delightful little creatures, calling them either "bunnies" or, if the buyer prefers accuracy or a certain level of decorum, Pale Pass Mountain Hares. So cute!
7535.name: Pale Pass Mountain Hare

7536.description: "These fastidious cats bring the blessing of Tu'whacca and hold a place of honor within their chosen homes. Further, they often start sleeping with any who near death, and thus we venerate them as guides to the Far Shores."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7536.name: Tu'whacca's Sphynx Cat

7571.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Lyris's Icereach Battle Axe style.
7571.name: Lyris's Icereach Battle Axe

7572.description: Upon their one-year anniversary of service guarding the border of the Reach, members of the Karthwatch garrison have an informal tradition of getting a knotwork band tattooed across their foreheads to signify that they held the line.
7572.name: Karthwatch Guardian Face Tattoo

7573.description: The Nords of Karthwatch's garrison are the first line of defense against incursions from the Reach. Many emblazon their bodies with the knotwork tower of their heraldry as a symbol of their bravery and a mark of pride.
7573.name: Karthwatch Guardian Body Tattoo

7574.description: The Huntsman selects prey for his games carefully, for weakness makes for poor sport, but few are wily and tenacious enough to survive the honor. Those who do carry these umbral markings along with their scars.
7574.name: Umbral Snarl Face Markings

7575.description: You, the prey, survived one of Hircine's hunts untouched by all who sought to kill you, earning Hircine's respectâand his brand in the form of these umbral markings. Stand proud, for you outwitted the best hunters in Tamriel.
7575.name: Umbral Snarl Body Markings

7576.description: "Nords are known for leading short, but vigorous lives driven by passion. Those with Giant sacrificial markings on their faces? The fire of life burns brightest in those with looming shadows cast over them."âFadile Senoril
7576.name: Forsaken Sacrifice Face Markings

7577.description: "Nord peace offerings to Giants bear markings similar to those the hulking folk wear, as a sign that they are free to take. The practice of tattooing exiles in this manner is still common among remote communities."âFadile Senoril
7577.name: Forsaken Sacrifice Body Markings

7578.description: "Paint Dibella's beauty in gentle strokes upon your cheek so that all will know your muse and feel her touch when you caress the hearts of your audience."âArtist-Adept Aimira
7578.name: Bards College Skald Face Marks

7579.description: "A Skald is more than a musician. A song more than sound. Let this ink dance around your form and write the music of your soul upon the canvas of your skin. All who look upon you will hear the tempo of your heart."âArtist-Adept Aimira
7579.name: Bards College Skald Body Marks

7582.description: Display the banner of Solitude. By the wolf!
7582.name: Solitude Banner

7583.description: Brandish the banner of Karthwatch. Long stand the Tower!
7583.name: Karthwatch Banner

7584.description: Flourish the banner of Morthal. For Hjaalmarch!
7584.name: Morthal Banner

7585.description: This emote allows you to fully express just how â¦ ahem â¦ sad you find somethingâno words needed!
7585.name: Play Tiny Violin

7586.description: Join in on the exuberant folk dance of Falkreath!
7586.name: Falkreath Frolic

7587.description: "Huh. Wait. No. Maybe this way? No? Who drew this so-called map?"âevery adventurer ever
7587.name: Ponder Poorly Drawn Map

7588.description: An obvious request for a vampiric blessing.
7588.name: Bite Me

7589.description: Not all reliquaries contain sacred remains or serve as memorials for departed family members. Some harbor evils that were meant to be forgottenâbury them once and for all!
7589.name: Accursed Gray Reliquary

7590.description: Is that a new sun? A falling star? No! It's an exhibition of your psijic power. Glorious!
7590.name: Psijic Cosmic Starburst

7592.description: Delightfully frame your face using a jaunty chapeau straight from Wayrest! Enhanced by a feather plucked from one of Elsweyr's terror birds, this hat is as inspiring a performance as the artist wearing it.
7592.name: Wayrest Canto Chapeau

7593.description: Entertain your audiences with flair and verve by donning this flamboyant cap. With its playful plumage and wide brim, this hat promises to command the eyes of the audience while shading yours during sunny spectacles.
7593.name: Spirited Soubrette Round Cap

7595.description: Many among the Reach clans believe they can draw power from the trophies of their hunts. Conjure the blessings of the Horned Huntsman with this sacred headdress fashioned from the deadly beasts of the Reach.
7595.name: Reach-Mage Ceremonial Skullcap
7595.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with a Reach Mage's Ferocity, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

7596.description: Lighten the darkest places with your own handheld sun!
7596.name: Miniature Dwarven Sun
7596.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Tones of the Deep" in Western Skyrim.

7597.description: Study this stone tablet that calls upon the might of the Warrior Goddess and Mother of Nords, Kyne.
7597.name: Kyne's Tablet of Storms
7597.hint: Acquired from completing the quest "The Fading Fire" in Western Skyrim.

7598.description: Enter crashing waves to take part in an ancient ceremony known only to the clever women of Skyrim. Runes bind your blood to the tides, and your skin mirrors the sea's restless waters. To what end? Only time will tell.
7598.name: Runic Seabrume

7599.description: "Be it icy gales or vengeful souls that drag ye into the Sea of Ghosts, your fate will be the same. To join the reef of frozen dead in the frigid depths. Locked in ice as dark as that abyss for all eternity."âFrig the Stormrider
7599.name: Frosthaunt Glister

7600.description: Thunderous waterfalls, an imposing smithy, and a magnificent view of the Great Bay make this brisk coastal village the perfect refuge for adventurers seeking a rugged Orcish lifestyle. |cFFFFFFIncludes a built-in blacksmithing station.|r
7600.name: Forgemaster Falls

7601.description: With its mix of Redguard architecture, both old and new, Thieves' Oasis features a stunning waterfall, ancient statues, and housing fit for a princeâwhether that prince is a scholarly antiquarian or roguish thief.
7601.name: Thieves' Oasis

7609.description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.
7609.name: Sovereign Fodder
7609.hint: Acquired from Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes.

7610.description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.
7610.name: Sovereign Sash
7610.hint: Acquired from Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes.

7611.name: Sovereign Tiara

7616.name: Broom

7617.description: "A Bucket helm? Nope, sorryâwho would wear such a thing? It's far too silly and undignified. Be off. â¦Ha ha ha, fooled you! That sounds splendid! Where can I get one?" âSir Cadwell of Codswallop
7617.name: Bucket

7619.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Savor its darkly rich flavorâdecadence for your taste buds!
7619.name: Jubilee Cake 2020
7619.hint: Obtained by completing the 2020 Anniversary event.

7620.description: Rule over the night with deadly elegance in this sleek ensemble of figure-hugging apparel. The long coat clings as close as your own shadow, and every layer flows as freely as arterial spray from your prey. Just take care not to get blood on your ascot.
7620.name: Vampire Noble

7622.description: Whether you're climbing the snowiest peaks in Skyrim or slogging through the soggiest lowlands, these insulated leathers will protect you and your mapmaking supplies from Tamriel's harshest environments.
7622.name: Master Field Cartographer
7622.hint:
Acquired by collecting and combining all of the Cartographer Fragments found in the Nchuthnkarst public dungeon in Western Skyrim.

|cffffffEquipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.|r

7623.description: Make a splash at your next scholarly symposium in these decorous, tasseled robes commissioned exclusively for members of the distinguished Antiquarian's Circle.
7623.name: Antiquarian Robes
7623.hint: Acquired by completing the "Master of the Eye" Antiquities achievement.

7624.description: Show that you can tame the most treacherous waters and unruly whiskers, fur, or spines with the frozen spray of the northern seas. Any sailor who marvels at your frosty braids and scrimshaw adornments will know you're worth your salt.
7624.name: Old Salt's Chin-Trinket

7625.description: The wind-swept waves of the Sea of Ghosts is no place for bare heads, fanciful hats, or a loose shaggy mane. Keep your locks bound as tightly as your sails with these ropy braids and horker-tusk charms and you'll have no fear of the harshest gales.
7625.name: Seafarer's Crowning Trim

7634.description: Trophy taken from the Icereach Coven in honor of an Undaunted victory in Icereach.
7634.name: Trophy: Mother Ciannait

7635.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Icereach.
7635.name: Bust: Mother Ciannait

7636.description: Trophy taken from Kjalnar Tombskald in honor of an Undaunted victory in Unhallowed Grave.
7636.name: Trophy: Tzirzhalir

7637.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Unhallowed Grave.
7637.name: Bust: Tzirzhalir
7637.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Unhallowed Grave.

7638.description: After hunting some of the most threatening prey within Hircine's graspâperhaps even under the Blood Moonâthat Daedric prince's scarlet sign of approval now scores your face. Any who would become your quarry would do well to think twice.
7638.name: Hircine's Hunt Face Markings

7639.description: Hunters, when taking part in any of Hircine's challenges, must be brutal and cunning. After coming back victorious from one such contest, you now wear crimson markings in honor of the blood you spilled for the Huntsman.
7639.name: Hircine's Hunt Body Markings

7691.description: Established to create an impregnable border between Skyrim and the Reach, Karthald Hold maintains a war footing year-round, and its jarl stands at the ready to leap to the defense of Skyrim in this regal mix of satin and steel.
7691.name: Karthwatch Jarl Finery

7692.description: Let skalds wear silks! The stalwart rulers of Morthal require sturdier materials. These rustic, oiled leathers are lined with the down of waterfowl, providing warmth and comfort befitting royalty even in the damp, cold wetlands of Hjaalmarch.
7692.name: Morthal Jarl Finery

7735.description: Tested in battle after battle, the Karthwatch Spangenhelm proved itself as indomitable as Karthald's tower redoubt. With this helmet, you have nothing to fear from the beasts of the Reach whether they walk on four legs or two.
7735.name: Karthwatch Spangenhelm

7736.description: Supple mammoth leather forms the basis of this commanding circlet, which convincingly imitates that worn by the Jarl of Morthal. The metal focal point integrates Morthal's heraldry, adding a hint of flair to this handsome bandâand to any who don it!
7736.name: Morthal Jarl Circlet

7737.description: Elegantly deadly, this gold head adornment captures the graceful menace of vampiric prowess. Each exquisite blade on the razorguard receives the blessing of the Blood Matron, granting itâand its wearerâprestige among even the most ancient vampires.
7737.name: Blood Scion Razorguard

7738.description: Though this adorable fawn's kin shimmer with hues different than its own, the first color ever seen was the pearly white glow on this one. Give it enough care and you can help it overcome its shyness, allowing it to cavort at your side.
7738.name: Vale Fawn

7739.description: "The red glow of a Nightrose stems from its time of birth," a spelunker claims. "If the sky above is red, so is the fawn." While some scoff at this, all agree on one thing: Nightroses have a sixth sense for danger, nudging awake any chosen family.
7739.name: Nightrose Vale Fawn

7740.description: Its amber-gold glimmer creates a warmth that one stablemaster states, "Can get you through chilly nights under the Skyrim stars." All it takes to keep one of these vale fawns at your side is a lick of honey now and again.
7740.name: Ambersheen Vale Fawn

7741.description: For a time, scholars thought only one type of vale fawn existed. Now, knowing better, some wonder why the variation? The fawns care not. But, ones with a green shimmer love to race. Choose one as a companion, and it might even race you!
7741.name: Emerald Vale Fawn

7742.description: One scholar studying vale fawns notes that the purple-hued Orchidfall fawnânamed after a now-lost flora-filled cavern in Skyrimâenjoys eating flowers. "Give it a flower, and it's your friend for life!" Do you have your flower in hand?
7742.name: Orchidfall Vale Fawn

7743.description:
Become one with death, allowing it to flow from within you and change your very appearance.

|cff0000This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality|r
7743.name: Accursed Death

7786.description: Once known as the toughest Baandari thief in the Stitches, Abahayda ran afoul of a terrible curse in the Ashen Scar. She seeks a companion who will help restore her former life and vigor. Is that you?
7786.name: Cursebound Senche-Raht

7787.description: Solitude's silver wolf dominates this replica of the crown worn by High King Svargrim, making it perfect for those who wish to look both regal and fierce. Legends claim the crimson elements represent the blood shed in defense of hearth and kin.
7787.name: Wolfcrown of Solitude
7787.hint: Acquired by completing the "Daughter of the Wolf" quest in Western Skyrim.

7788.description: "It's said that when a worthy Nord seeks a glorious end, Sovngarde will send them a fleet steed to spirit them to their final battle, but pay no mind to skalds who sing of a horse of many legs."âClever Woman Moritra
7788.name: Valiant Sovngarde Charger

7789.description: "The clawthanes of Sovngarde often stand watch over the Whalebone Bridge, but some choose to join forces with a courageous soul in Skyrim or beyond. Noble wolves, these are, and clever."âClever Woman Moritra
7789.name: Sovngarde Clawthane Wolf

7790.description: "Lithe sabre cats are prized among Sovngarde's heroes, particularly those called valorfangs, who died while defending their riders. They stand ready at the Hall of Valor, waiting to convey a hero to a warrior in need of aid."âClever Woman Moritra
7790.name: Sovngarde Valorfang Sabre Cat

7791.description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.
7791.name: Icebreath Berries of Bloom

7792.description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.
7792.name: Icebreath Berries of Budding

7793.description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.

7794.description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.

7795.description: "During times of great need, Sovngarde releases some of its heroes back into the world, and legendary beasts to serve them. The stoutheart bear is one such creature. A fearless companion to carry true warriors to battle."âClever Woman Moritra
7795.name: Sovngarde Stoutheart Bear

7796.description: "Guar who fall in battle earn a place in Sovngarde. Some later walk among us, serving as faithful and courageous mounts to those who dedicate themselves to brave acts. They leap quickly into action when called."âClever Woman Moritra
7796.name: Valorous Sovngarde Guar Strider

7797.description: "Camels do indeed thrive within Sovngarde. When called to join battle in Tamriel, these resplendent creatures eagerly race forward to meet their valorous riders. Do not believe the claims that they spit mead, though."âClever Woman Moritra
7797.name: Resplendent Sovngarde Camel
