8000.description: Feel left out? Alienated? Alone? Adopt the form of a Shadowsilk Goblin, and you might* find that sense of belonging you crave among these creatures! Fleas not included, but easily attainable. *Might is no guarantee. They may try to eat you instead.
8000.name: Shadowsilk Goblin
8000.hint: |cff0000This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality.|r

8001.description: Set with a rare aquamarine worn smooth by tides, this imposing metal browplate features waves reminiscent of rough waters. Some claim a spirit from the Sea of Ghosts haunts the gem, imbuing it with a faint chill.
8001.name: Seastone Browplate

8003.description: Used as daily wear, this garb includes durable, if elaborately embellished, breeches and a weatherproofed backpack to keep your discoveries dry and free of the dirt you so painstakingly brushed away.
8003.name: Antiquarian Field Garb
8003.hint:
Acquired by completing the "Master Antiquarian" Antiquities achievement.

|cffffffEquipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.|r

8004.description: Alter your shield's Outfit style with a replica of the Karthwatch Sigil Shield.
8004.name: Karthwatch Sigil Shield
8004.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Vampire Scholar" in Western Skyrim.

8005.description: Alter your one-handed weapon's Outfit style with a replica of the Wolf of Solitude Sword.
8005.name: Wolf of Solitude Replica Sword
8005.hint: Complete the quest "Greymoor Rising" in Western Skyrim.

8006.description:
Allows you to Scry for Antiquities. 

When used within a Dig Site, indicates the direction to the nearest possible Antiquity location.
8006.name: Antiquarian's Eye
8006.hint: Obtained by completing the quest "The Antiquarian Circle" in Western Skyrim.

8008.description: Set up a crackling fire and start warming up with fellow |cffffffgroup members|r using this handy Campfire Kit.
8008.name: Campfire Kit

8009.description:
Whether visiting the Bards College, seeking an audience at the Blue Palace, or looking to imbibe the best Nord mead around, take advantage of convenient living in the midst of Solitude with this room inside the Lonely Troll.
Room is too small for Dueling.
8009.name: Snowmelt Suite
8009.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion

8010.description: Many lived within Solitude's coveted Proudspire Manor over the years, but its last owner vanished, leaving its spacious living quarters emptyâand available. Shelter yourself from the cold within this multi-room landmark in the heart of Solitude.
8010.name: Proudspire Manor
8010.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Skyrim Grand Adventurer" Achievement

8011.description: Towering architecture, views to die (or kill) for, and a secret passage number among the many features of this striking Blackreach edifice, which stands within easy reach of Greymoor Keep.
8011.name: Bastion Sanguinaris

8013.description: An outlaw with a talent for magic but a thirst for alcohol, Sereyne wants a cozy place to drink her troubles away. Perhaps you can provide? After adding Sereyne to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8013.name: Sereyne

8016.description: "Imbued with the spirits of those turned away from Sovngarde, this dark courser emanates tendrils and spines of those lost souls. Dare you walk with it along its path of shadows and regret, taking on some of its burden?"âClever Woman Moritra
8016.name: Lambent Shadowmane Courser

8017.description: "Duskstalkers hunt and gather tormented battlefield ghosts, providing these lost souls a safe haven until they willingly leave. They can be seen as wisps, whose colorful auras emanate around both the sabre cat and its rider."âClever Woman Moritra
8017.name: Auric Sabre Cat Duskstalker

8018.description: The dark pigments used in this variant of a classic Dwemer marking adds a funerealâor even sinisterâtone to already impressive body art.
8018.name: Ebon Dwemer Body Markings
8018.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in [TBD].

8019.description: Vivid blue swirls, dots, and slashes make up these markings, which hearken back to Ysgramor and his Companions. Now you can decorate your own body with these striking symbols of Ysgramor's favor.
8019.name: Ysgramor's Chosen Body Markings
8019.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Western Skyrim.

8020.description: Some studying Dwarven lore argue that the ebon pigments in this facial marking were present in the golden variant, but that the wearer's actions made the marking change from gold to black. Others claim this is a fanciful story.
8020.name: Ebon Dwemer Face Marking
8020.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in [TBD].

8021.description: Add vibrancy to your presence with the blue markings that once graced those who battled at Ysgramor's side.
8021.name: Ysgramor's Chosen Face Marking
8021.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Western Skyrim.

8022.description: With its lustrous gems and geometric patterns, this antique crown features the distinctive style of the Dwarves. Adorn yourself with both history and mystery by wearing this crown to the next Antiquarian's Circle gathering!
8022.name: Dwemer Crown
8022.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Western Skyrim.

8023.description: Two scowling Dragons hewn in the Atmoran style grant the wearer of this coronet an imposing air of historical and visceral authority.
8023.name: Companion's Coronet
8023.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Western Skyrim.

8024.description: "Those who give up hope, dying from heartbreak or other such ailments of the spirit, find a kind companion in this wolf. Until they gain peace, these beings sheathe both wolf and rider in colorful mists and jagged spikes."âClever Woman Moritra
8024.name: Silver Nimbus Wolf

8025.description: To those living in Hew's Bane, seeing a spotted senche-serval is an omen of good luck. Some, hoping to gain a constant supply of good fortune, captured and trained several cubs. Now they serve as mountsâgood luck indeed to those so blessed with one!
8025.name: Khefrem Senche-Serval

8026.description: With barding featuring Whiterun's heraldry, this indomitable horse remains sure-footed in the snowy mountains of Skyrim and beyond. Majestic!
8026.name: Whiterun Mountain Charger

8027.description: This wolf of light was born out of fierce devotion, and it tirelessly seeks a rider whose soul burns brightly for Meridia, the Lady of Infinite Energies. Will it be drawn to your inner light?
8027.name: Auroran Penumbra Wolf

8028.description: The magic of the Icereach Coven shapes these striped durzogs in the womb, and handlers train the pups to the saddle. To transfer loyalty to a new rider, that rider should sleep with the saddle for a few days before attempting to mount the durzog.
8028.name: Frostborn Durzog Mangler
8028.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

8029.description: Sparks fly with this dwarven spider! Light up your life by taking this automaton for a lively jaunt around town. It'll follow over any terrain, happily zapping away!
8029.name: Energetic Dwarven Shock-Spider
8029.hint: Acquired by earning the "Stonethorn Explorer" achievement.

8030.description: Dramatic coloration marks this gryphon as one originally bred by Khajiit in Elsweyr. Due to some "incidents," the unfortunate breeders sold their stock, making them available to fine folk such as you!
8030.name: Firepoint Fledgling Gryphon

8031.description: Some may find the fiery cuteness of this horned cub unbearable, but you can handle it! Just watch out for those adorable little pawsâthey're hot as coals.
8031.name: Nightmare Firestalker Cub

8032.description: "This devious little creature will drop the ambient temperature considerably when summoned. And mind your fingersâthe little monster likes nothing better than to freeze them, break them off, and pop them into its mouth!"âDivayth Fyr
8032.name: Frostshriek Imp

8033.description: Originally from the Tenmar Jungle, these green moths spread via caravans and carry the scent of fresh spring rains with every flap of their wings.
8033.name: Springlight Moth

8034.description: Though adorable, even as cubs these sabre cats seek out trolls in the White River region, hoping to nip at their flesh and bring them down by sheer force of numbers. Luckily for you, you're not a troll! Also, we mentioned they're adorable, yes?
8034.name: Graywinter Sabre Cat Cub

8035.description: "Potential. Bear cubs from Sovngarde sense it and follow those who have itâall the way back to Sovngarde. While here, they make for sometimes silly companions."âClever Woman Moritra
8035.name: Sovngarde Bear Cub

8036.description: "You may laugh at the idea of a pony guar from Sovngarde, but they exist. In fact, one showed up around here, but it chose to follow a worthy traveler. Or perhaps one freer with cuddles than I am."âClever Woman Moritra
8036.name: Sovngarde Pony Guar

8037.description: "Noble ponies trot forth from Sovngarde, seeking those who have made oaths, knowingly or not. Curiosity prompts them to follow an oathmaker to see how they fulfill their promise. If one follows you, give it an apple. They love them."âClever Woman Moritra
8037.name: Sovngarde Pony

8038.description: "Sabre cat cubs from Sovngarde might play with string, but it's not visiting us for such trifles. Instead, they serve as the eyes and ears of Sovngarde, allowing them watch our worldâwhile sometimes getting tangled in yarn."âClever Woman Moritra
8038.name: Sovngarde Sabre Cat Cub

8039.description: "Wolf cubs from the Hall of Valor tumble into our world, ready to help catalogue knowledge for their masters. They particularly love to howl along to skalds and bards, but they'll join up with anyone who travels widely. "âClever Woman Moritra
8039.name: Sovngarde Wolf Pup

8040.description: "My notes indicate these vibrantly hued watchers once inhabited the ruins of Zaintiraris until an unfortunate explorer set them free. Given their color and origin, I suspect Sheogorath holds some sway over them. Also unfortunate."âWarlock Aldaale
8040.name: Amaranthine Pocket Watcher

8041.description: Born with a snarl, these striped durzogs tend to bite the hand that feeds themâbut only gently after they get to know you.
8041.name: Snowsnarl Durzog

8042.description: Spelunk in luxury! This mining gear is practically a home away from home when you're excavating precious underground resourcesâif you like living in your clothes!
8042.name: Subterrane Excavator
8042.hint: |cffffffEquipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.|r

8043.description: Known for striking quickly and quietly from stealth, Timbercrow wanderers serve as scouts and assassins for their clan. They prefer to keep their garb simple and light to remain unfettered by the chains of civilization.
8043.name: Timbercrow Wanderer
8043.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Distinction, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.

8044.description: There is no better bait for a trap than temptation and no better lure than seduction. This suggestive ensemble will enhance your allure and disarm your prey until it is far, far too late.
8044.name: Dark Passions Regalia

8045.description: These earrings feature gemstones bathed in the ichor of heretic vampires, set into an insignia cast from the silver instruments used in their executions. Only members of the Gray Host's upper echelon wear them.
8045.name: Greymoor Ruby Earrings

8046.description: After years of working with lenses and hues, one of Telenger's former students discovered a way to make red lenses that did not fade over time. This monocle features such a pristine carmine lens.
8046.name: Carmine Monocle

8047.description: "Some claim a cursed jeweler crafted this circlet, transferring the affliction to his final creation. Now, only vampires may wear it without succumbing to insatiable bloodlust."âNalana, Advisor to House Tamrith
8047.name: Dark Passions Circlet

8048.description: "Dragons call the lands of Skyrim 'Keizaal,' and thus we shall name this coronet, which only the worthiest of a Dragon warrior-priest's servants may don."âAzhidal
8048.name: Keizaal Coronet

8049.description: You remain untamed and unruly, as does your crowning glory: your hair. Even better? You're not afraid to show it.
8049.name: Misanthropic Lycanthrope

8050.description: This mask only hints at your blood-drenched desires. Revel in your passions and feed with no restraint.
8050.name: Mask of Bloody Passions

8051.description: With your oath of loyalty to the Gray Host newly given and your mask of office firmly in place, nothing can stop you from working to gain freedom from slavery to a vile master.
8051.name: Pentarch Vassal's Oathmask

8052.description: To attend masked revels in Skyrim and beyond, some vampires wear these masks to hide their natures from their prey. The knotwork design also helps other vampires identify their fellow hunters.
8052.name: Mask of Entangled Paths

8053.description: Who needs goggles when you're as skilled as you are at alchemical experiments? Huh. Maybe we spoke too soon â¦.
8053.name: Maddening Mishap Face Markings

8054.description: A rite of passage among Morthal's guard involves surviving a night out in the marshes in the buff. Those who return bear this mark of their bravery. The rest bear only the weight of the crushing mire.
8054.name: Morthal Champion Face Markings

8055.description: Some call these markings the fangs of Solitude because those who bear them tend to go for the throat with reckless abandon. Fierce!
8055.name: Wolf of Solitude Face Markings

8056.description: "The road to Sovngarde requires bravery. Courage. Perseverance. And much death, including yours. Wear the symbol of this path upon your faceâto warn others that you stand your ground in even the most desperate plights."âGerda Swift-Sword
8056.name: Path of Valor Face Markings

8057.description: "Windracers, sworn to protect Whiterun, learn their way around town without relying on vision. After they survive their first night battle, they gain facial markings to note their skill and courage."âGerda Swift-Sword
8057.name: Whiterun Windracer Face Markings

8058.description: Explosive results might sound like a good thing, but when they're literally explosive and weren't meant to be, well, that's gonna leave a mark. Maybe two.
8058.name: Maddening Mishap Body Markings

8059.description: Featuring the Morthal triskelion, these ornate markings grace only the bodies of those who have heroically protected Morthal and its citizens.
8059.name: Morthal Champion Body Markings

8060.description: Your ancestors have called Solitude home since only lonely wolves howled at its cliffs. Wear these markings with pride among your brethren, and let your enemies hear the wolves' howls as they die.
8060.name: Wolf of Solitude Body Markings

8061.description: "You follow in the footsteps of valiant heroes, swearing to prove your bravery so that you may one day enter Sovngarde. Now carry these markings alongside your axe to embody your oath."âGerda Swift-Sword
8061.name: Path of Valor Body Markings

8062.description: "We call those who sprint to the defense of Whiterun 'Windracers.' Each wears tattoos that symbolize unity of purpose and fleetness of foot."âGerda Swift-Sword
8062.name: Whiterun Windracer Body Markings

8063.description: Those who anger Kyne must meet her fury. Transform yourself into a living embodiment of her wrath with this skin.
8063.name: Kyne's Fury

8064.description: Colorful. Vibrant. Toxic. Those who take part in the sacred Argonian Xoleel Ceremony are transformed into a deadly sacrifice to Leviathans that threaten the Deepmire Hist.
8064.name: Xoleel Scale

8065.description: "Despite the secrecy surrounding Lady Thorn, a vampire, recent rumors suggest her castle teems with activity and ghastly new thralls. Disturbing, if true. I await further details."âNalana, Advisor to House Tamrith
8065.name: Reanimated Vampiric Thrall
8065.hint: Acquired by earning the "Castle Thorn Conqueror" achievement.

8066.description: Pour out a libation to those fallen heroes who walked your path with youâor who came before you.
8066.name: Memorial Toast

8067.description: Whether you're indicating your need for extreme personal space or simply making your displeasure known, hissing is a versatile and expressive tool.
8067.name: Hiss

8068.description: Amaze and perhaps even hypnotize onlookers with your skills at spinning fire. A perfect complement to knife juggling, fire breathing, and other festival activities!
8068.name: Fire Spinning

8069.description: Ready to fend off pesky scarecrows without the slightest provocation â¦ or not?
8069.name: Scarecrow Pose

8070.description: Need to slake a deep thirst? Partake of your favorite beverage the Lonely Troll way by quaffing a boot full of it!
8070.name: Boozy Boot

8071.description: Summon a smallâhopefully harmlessâharrowstorm using this very early version of the Icereach Coven's netherroot brew.
8071.name: Nascent Netherroot Brew

8072.description: You're pretty sure that these potions won't explode when tossed about, but a little uncertainty adds to the excitement, right?
8072.name: Mostly Stable Juggling Potions
8072.hint: Acquired by earning the "Stone Garden Conqueror" achievement.

8073.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Antiquarian's Pickaxe style.
8073.name: Antiquarian's Pickaxe
8073.hint: Acquired by completing the "Master of the Spade" achievement.

8075.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Nocturnal, the Night Mistress.
8075.name: Statuette: Nocturnal, Gloamqueen

8076.description: A miniature statue of the divine warrior Trinimac, holding aloft a sword.
8076.name: Statuette: Trinimac, Paragon

8077.description: A miniature statue of the Night Mother, worshiped by the Dark Brotherhood.
8077.name: Statuette: Revered Night Mother

8079.description: Peer into your future with these augury bones! Give them a toss and read the portents that await.
8079.name: Throwing Bones

8080.description: Ready your instruments! It's time to show off your vast musical talents with stunning performances of the lute, flute, and drums!
8080.name: Minstrel

8081.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Chitinous style.
8081.name: Chitinous Jack

8082.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Chitinous style.
8082.name: Chitinous Helmet

8083.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Chitinous style.
8083.name: Chitinous Guards

8084.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Chitinous style.
8084.name: Chitinous Arm Cops

8085.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Chitinous style.
8085.name: Chitinous Boots

8086.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Chitinous style.
8086.name: Chitinous Bracers

8087.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Chitinous style.
8087.name: Chitinous Belt

8088.description: "Placing the Potentate wolves in High Rock in 2E 4 seems off to me, but I find no texts disputing Mirannah of Gwylim's notes. 'Caused a panic in Shornhelm'âwell, these wolves with their horned barding look menacing. Perhaps."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8088.name: Akaviri Potentate Wolf

8089.description: "Mirannah of Gwylim writes 'the Potentate sabre cat mounted regiment combed Skyrim for Reman loyalists in 2E 7'âpotentially accurate. But I think she meant 'killed Solitude's wolves using magical roars' to be local myth."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8089.name: Akaviri Potentate Sabre Cat

8090.description: "Label your fact from fiction, Mirannah! 'The barding on Potentate horses shimmers due to a geas of loyalty Versidue-Shaie instilled in the materials.' No. It's simply magic. But 2E 5 for their first use? Feasible."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8090.name: Akaviri Potentate Charger

8091.description: "While I find the idea of 'Dark Elf assassins chasing Reman's loyalists in Morrowind on luminous Potentate guar steeds' to be laughably absurd, Mirannah's date of 2E 27 seems accurate for the first use of these ferocious mounts."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8091.name: Akaviri Potentate Guar

8092.description: "The Potentate bought several herds of camels in 2E 25 for delivery to Versidue-Shaie, Mirannah of Gwylim states. 'Reman desert pursuit' and 'enchanted barding like bear' are also true. Chased by glowing camelsâwhat a sight!"âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8092.name: Akaviri Potentate Camel

8093.description: Keldora left her adventuring life behind to fulfill her dream of overseeing and organizing a connoisseur's mead collection, though she possesses expertise in all forms of alcohol. After adding Keldora to your home, you can set her on a path.
8093.name: Keldora

8096.description: Gellena left the Icereach Coven to see firsthand what they loathed about other culturesâand to consider what scores she needs to settle. After adding Gellena to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8096.name: Sister Gellenna

8097.description: Told to go "find yourself" by a Tribunal superior, Deras traveled enough to find all but himself. Now he seeks a quiet meditation spot. After adding Deras to your home, you can set him on a path.
8097.name: Acolyte Deras Arelas

8098.description: "Mirannah of Gwylim notes that the first Imperial bear cavalry came into use in 2E 23. Scrawled next to this: '10th Legion steed?' and 'Leyawiin bear parade.' I can verify the date, but the latter two must be fiction notes."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8098.name: Akaviri Potentate Bear

8099.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8099.name: Chitinous Battle Axe

8100.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Chitinous style.
8100.name: Chitinous Bow

8101.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Chitinous style.
8101.name: Chitinous Shield

8102.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Chitinous style.
8102.name: Chitinous Staff

8103.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8103.name: Chitinous Axe

8104.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8104.name: Chitinous Maul

8105.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8105.name: Chitinous Greatsword

8106.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8106.name: Chitinous Dagger

8107.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8107.name: Chitinous Mace

8108.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Chitinous style.
8108.name: Chitinous Sword

8109.description: A golden Dwarven face dominates the wearer's back, lending its compelling aspect to their overall presence.
8109.name: Dwemer Body Markings
8109.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Western Skyrim.

8110.description: Scholars speculate that the design of this facial marking indicates both leadership and inherent power. Whether the wearer already possessed these traits or wanted them is still up for debate.
8110.name: Dwemer Face Markings
8110.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Western Skyrim.

8115.description: Dance with the courteous grace of the High Elves!
8115.name: Alinor Allemande
8115.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Summerset.

8116.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8116.name: Snowhawk Mage Jerkin

8117.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8117.name: Snowhawk Mage Hat

8118.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8118.name: Snowhawk Mage Breeches

8119.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8119.name: Snowhawk Mage Epaulets

8120.description: An Outfit look for footwear in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8120.name: Snowhawk Mage Shoes

8121.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8121.name: Snowhawk Mage Gloves

8122.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8122.name: Snowhawk Mage Sash

8123.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Snowhawk Mage style.
8123.name: Snowhawk Mage Robe

8124.description: "The instability inherent in the structure of some morpholiths makes them unsuitable for use as sigil stones, yet that doesn't stop certain Daedric Princes from trying. Imagine the surprise when said portals don't work."âWarlock Aldaale
8124.name: Unstable Morpholith

8125.description: Treasure rests beneath the oily waters in Clockwork City for those with the guts to plumb deeply into its viscous lubricants. Your valiant effort to dredge up valuable scrap gives your skin a slippery, many-hued sheen.
8125.name: Slag Town Diver

8126.description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.
8126.name: Mossheart Berries of Bloom

8127.description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.
8127.name: Mossheart Berries of Budding

8128.description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.
8128.name: Mossheart Berries of Growth

8129.description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.
8129.name: Mossheart Berries of Ripeness

8131.description: A man of few words, Jorn stood guard over Solitude's bank until a recent illness laid him low. Now, his position filled by another, he needs workâperhaps a guard position in your home! After adding Jorn to your home, you can set him on a path.
8131.name: Solitude Guard Jorn

8132.description: Phedre loves history. A lot. Give her a place to study, and her gratitude nears "eternal"âas does her wish to share what she learns. After adding Phedre to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8132.name: Historian Phedre

8133.description: Ride like the wind on this fleet and sure-footed horse! A favorite of stablemasters, Whiterun Windsteeds possess steady temperaments and gentle gaits, making them the perfect first mount for any rider.
8133.name: Whiterun Windsteed

8134.description: Delicate in both form and color, this pink-hued butterfly flits around Elsweyr, Skyrim, Rivenspireâand around you! Tailor Medresi Grulathil looked to her own butterfly companion for inspiration while crafting ceremonial garb honoring Mara in Solitude.
8134.name: Mara's Blush Butterfly

8135.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8135.name: Cartographer's Mask
8135.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8136.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8136.name: Cartographer's Coat
8136.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8137.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8137.name: Cartographer's Leggings
8137.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8138.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8138.name: Cartographer's Gloves
8138.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8139.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8139.name: Cartographer's Boots
8139.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8140.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8140.name: Cartographer's Belt
8140.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8141.description: Part of a set of items that make up the Master Field Cartographer Costume.
8141.name: Cartographer's Backpack
8141.hint: Acquired rarely while adventuring within the Nchuthnkarst Public Dungeon.

8142.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Maw of the Infernal style.
8142.name: Maw of the Infernal Maul

8143.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Maw of the Infernal style.
8143.name: Maw of the Infernal Bow

8144.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Maw of the Infernal style.
8144.name: Maw of the Infernal Shield

8145.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Maw of the Infernal style.
8145.name: Maw of the Infernal Staff

8146.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Maw of the Infernal style.
8146.name: Maw of the Infernal Sword

8147.description: Obtained rarely by completing the dungeon Veteran Banished Cells II.
8147.name: Maw of the Infernal Mask
8147.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Maw of the Infernal Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

8148.description: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath at an Undaunted Enclave. Obtained rarely by opening Maj's Mystery Coffer.
8148.name: Maw of the Infernal's Shoulder
8148.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Maw of the Infernal Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

8151.description: Trophy taken from Lord Falgravn in honor of an Undaunted victory in Kyne's Aegis.
8151.name: Trophy: Lord Falgravn

8152.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Kyne's Aegis.
8152.name: Bust: Lord Falgravn
8152.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Kyne's Aegis.

8153.description: While many crustaceans struggle to remove clinging barnacles, the Barnacle-Back Coral Crabs appreciate the company. Some naturalists believe the crabs welcome their guests' sharpened shells as an added protective layer. But maybe they're just gregarious!
8153.name: Barnacle-Back Coral Crab

8154.description: "The amber glow of this Gill Guar marks its origin as Gideon. Gideon Glowgill Guar is a mouthful, yeah? That's why it's an Ambergill instead. Watching a herd of these race out from Gideon? Impressive, just like their riders!"âUkaspa of Lilmoth
8154.name: Ambergill Guar

8155.description: With the chaos and mischance of Black Fredas on your side, you're sure to cause quite a stir when you pass through townânone wish to catch the eye of your Ashen Sabre Cat lest they fall under its curse!
8155.name: Black Fredas Ashen Sabre Cat

8156.description: None can say the Blazeborn Wolf lacks a bold appearance, formed from flames as it is. Even bolder, though, is its temperament, making it a perfect companion for racing through icy wastes to confront foes you deem worthy of your courage!
8156.name: Blazeborn Wolf

8157.description: None dare stare Riften's native ram in the eyesâit sees threats in many things, and only its owner can meet its gaze without needing to brace for an immediate headbutt. In short, would-be Riften Coalhorn Ram thieves are frequently airborne.
8157.name: Riften Coalhorn Ram

8158.description: Trained with special care, a chaurus egg hunter's horse requires an even temper, a smooth gait, and the ability to navigate through dark passages with equanimity. This steadfast mount will break fewâif anyâof your prized eggs!
8158.name: Chaurus Egg Chaser's Horse

8159.description: As stablehands across Tamriel can attest, the ravager comes by its name honestly, destroying anything that moves between it and its master. Scholars speculate that the blue Hist of Dead-Water Village brought forth this green-hided breed.
8159.name: Nagahide Welwa Ravager

8160.description: "Yes, 2E 30 seems right for the first Cloudracer steed, but Mirannah of Gwylim's notes about them being spectral fall into fiction. While their creation is a mystery, I suspect magic is involved."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8160.name: Potentate Cloudracer Courser

8161.description: "Having ridden this ephemeral senche, I see why Mirannah insists they are spirits. Her origin date of 2E 29 doesn't match another's 2E 35âeither could be true. Regardless, its roar calls forth magic, making it a memorable ride!"âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8161.name: Potentate Halcyon Senche

8183.name: Eccentric Experimenter Gloves

8184.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Eccentric Experimenter style.
8184.name: Eccentric Experimenter Belt

8185.description: "The inky black form of this steed, first seen in 2E 42 according to Mirannah of Gwylim, reminds me of a Potentate stealth rite used to track down Reman loyalists. I feel a frisson of dread when I ponder my recent ride on one."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8185.name: Potentate Aphotic Wolf

8186.description: With its sharp teeth, scary spines, and enormous horn, this fabricant follower not only shows that you mean business as you go about your day, but also indicates an appreciation for the complex and refined machines of Sotha Sil.
8186.name: Microtized Verminous Fabricant

8187.description: Frequently seen sniffing items and creatures alike, these Murkmire guar glow a soft amber. Those with close ties to the swamp claim they feel it feeding the guar's light, but some scholars believe the luminescence is simply an alchemical reaction.
8187.name: Tawny Lambent Guar

8188.description: "Talking with the trainers of the wolf riders that Versidue-Shaie established in 2E 4 allowed me to see the armored pups at play. I adored how they bonelessly stretched on the ground. Hard to believe they grow to be so fierce!"âMirannah of Gwylim
8188.name: Akaviri Potentate Wolf Cub

8189.description: "Before heading to Skyrim in 2E 7, the Potentate had to train sabre cat cubs to the saddle. Watching these cubs pounce while wearing their training barding all these many years later almost made me lose my composure and squeal."âMirannah of Gwylim
8189.name: Akaviri Potentate Sabre Cat Cub

8190.description: "In 2E 5, companies using the new enchanted barding designed by Versidue-Shaie's battlemages received their orders: hunt and kill Reman loyalists. Though initially only horses, ponies and more earned the special barding and training."âMirannah of Gwylim
8190.name: Akaviri Potentate Pony

8191.description: "The Potentate first mounted up on guar steeds in 2E 27 under the Red Mountain's shadow, but they trained guar calves to the saddle just outside Mournhold. One barded calf demanded nose-pats from me when I visitedâI couldn't resist."âMirannah of Gwylim
8191.name: Akaviri Potentate Guar Calf

8192.description: "The cubs trained into steeds by the Potentate in 2E 23 proved so successful that this practice continues today. Seeing one melted my heartâthat tail tassel! In their training barding, they walk through Leyawiin's streets each week."âMirannah of Gwylim
8192.name: Akaviri Potentate Bear Cub

8193.description: Bred to withstand the winters in the Druadach Mountains, these dogs are favored among the Timberclaw Reach clan. They show deep tenderness to their clan or family members while protecting their territory with ferocity.
8193.name: Druadach Mountain Dog

8194.description: Quiet, tree-shaded lakes attract these blue-purple moths. Legends claim they glide on starlight and rest upon the Moons' reflections in the water. If one follows you away, good luck is said to bless your path.
8194.name: Dusklight Lunar Moth

8195.description: This fastidious little jerboa originated from Orcrest, but recent events saw them scurry away or go into deep hiding among the nooks and crannies of that ill-fated city. With coaxing, one of these delightful little creatures might venture forth with you!
8195.name: Orcrest Jerboa

8196.description: Who would not want such a cute Breton Terrier trailing behind them, garbed in the red and black of the Ebonheart Pact? Perfidious fools from other alliances, that's who! Blood for the Pact!
8196.name: Pact Breton Terrier

8197.description: So many wiggles in this Breton Terrier! And wearing the Aldmeri Dominion colors of yellow and silver? Such a good dog! The best dog! For the Queen!
8197.name: Dominion Breton Terrier

8198.description: The blue and silver of the Daggerfall Covenant decorate this adorable Breton Terrier, who wants to sniff all the sniffs while you go to war in Cyrodiil. For King and Covenant!
8198.name: Covenant Breton Terrier

8199.description: When raised from the egg, these small chaurus learn commands extraordinarily well. Some folk insist that carrying the egg near your heart helps the chitterling form an attachment to you, making it less likely to wander off and become a menace to others.
8199.name: Teacup Chaurus Chitterling

8200.description: Silver hide and dark gray stripes mark these domesticated boars, which once ran wild around Karthwasten. Their stomachs run on a tight schedule, making them perfect for those who lose track of time. Nothing like waking up to boar snuffles in your ear!
8200.name: Karthwasten Silver Boar

8201.description: "I'm not sure why my apprentice insists on making pets of gooey creatures, but here we are, looking at a smaller void rot. So far, it seems the sleeping potion keeps it tractable. So far. Those black tendrils concern me, however."âAleri Andalor
8201.name: Somnolent Void Rot
8201.hint: Acquired by earning the "Peered into the Abyss" achievement in the Reach.

8202.description: "After my fox mask did well in Sentinel, I traveled to Windhelm and crafted some in their style. My timing was perfect! It was Fishing Day, and some drunken Nords wanted to fish while wearing my masks. I, of course, joined them."âNandim
8202.name: Windhelm Fox Mask

8203.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Potentate Smiling Viper style.
8203.name: Potentate Smiling Viper Helm

8204.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Potentate Scaled Dragon style.
8204.name: Potentate Scaled Dragon Helm

8205.description: Using the blood of an amberglow guar, tattoo artists of Murkmire set alight your skin with distinctive luminescent yellow markings. Once done, they state, the blessing of the land keeps the markings lit.
8205.name: Lambent Guar Body Markings

8206.description: The symbols of tree spirits and more decorate those chosen as protectors by the Glenmoril Wyrd. Some claim that spriggans contribute sap to the ink, forming a tighter bond between nature and the one being marked.
8206.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Body Markings

8207.description: The Riften Ratway contains many a ne'er-do-well, but that doesn't trouble you because you've earned a high place among this disreputable bunchâand these tattoos prove it! Though blades cross your chest, none in the Ratway of Riften dare cross you.
8207.name: Riften Rogue Body Markings

8208.description: "When you first joined the College, Shalidor's magic imprinted your body invisibly. As you passed trials, marks began to appear. Now, having mastered your curriculum, your body exhibits them all. Congratulations."âMage Vignarth, College of Winterhold
8208.name: Eye of Shalidor Body Markings

8209.description: Under the light of the moons, after swearing an oath to defend the land, those chosen for the honor receive softly luminous facial markings. Maintain the favor of the land, and the marks continue to glow.
8209.name: Lambent Guar Face Markings

8210.description: Favored among the Markarth Sisters, these blood-red markings signify one who fiercely defends the natural world while walking among the wilds and cities alike.
8210.name: Glenmoril Wyrd Face Markings

8211.description: They say you're bolder than a starving skeever, deadlier than a rutting troll, and quieter than the fallen deadâyou had to be to earn this tattoo from the artist-thieves in the Riften Ratway.
8211.name: Riften Rogue Face Markings

8212.description: "I see Shalidor's eye on your browâyou passed the final test set before you then. Well done! I shall make all the library's resources available to you at this point."âLibrarian Nalinale, College of Winterhold
8212.name: Eye of Shalidor Face Markings

8213.description: "Crafted in Mount Anthor's shadow, this bronze crown rested upon the head of the master of hidden arcane knowledge within Winterhold: Shadow. Some claim it never saw use outside secret meetings, but I doubt this. Crowns proclaim status."âTaleon Mythmaker
8213.name: Anthor's Shadow Crown

8214.description: "Its gold, along with its variant of the College of Winterhold's eye, symbolize leadership over both mundane and arcane mysteries. In short, Dawn mastered both magic and people to uncover secrets, leading Shadow and Shroud."âTaleon Mythmaker
8214.name: Dawn's Eye Crown

8215.description: "Silver may glint in darkness, but the master who wears this crown often blackened its gleam while pursuing worldly agendas in hidden spaces. All that is a romantic way of saying that a spymaster earned this badge of office for Shroud."âTaleon Mythmaker
8215.name: Shrouded Crown

8216.description: Under the ruins of the once-opulent Black Drake Villa, a grand library holds treasures and ancient tomes from across Tamriel. Gather your companions for a race against time to recover a mysterious book before dark forces burn everything to ash.
8216.name: Black Drake Villa

8217.description: A fervent new cult has kidnapped innocent Dark Elves, dragging them to a lair deep within a long-abandoned mine. Join two unusual saviors to penetrate the defenses of the Cauldron and stop the Order of the Waking Flame from completing their deadly ritual.
8217.name: The Cauldron

8218.description: This intimidating horned senche steed wears coal-black barding, making its orange flames stand out in stark contrast. Though none know its origins, the touch of the Deadlands looks to be upon this mount, making it favored by Mehrunes Dagon's adherents.
8218.name: Battlefield Nightmare Senche

8219.description: "As we people of the root know, the Hist provides. With this feathered sep adder, it gives us a creature who provides both loyal companionship, as well as keen eyesight and smell. It senses danger before its companion quite often."âDaixth
8219.name: Jewel-Feathered Sep Adder

8220.description: Some say you should embrace your nightmares. With this darling little bear cub, you can do exactly that! This trundling bundle of adorable terror might have flaming eyes and fiery paws, but it loves hugs.
8220.name: Nightmare Bear Cub

8221.description: Never be without a snowball to throw at â¦ uh, wait. It appears and goes plop onto the ground? Ah, I see! Ahem. Never be without a friendly snowball buddy as you adventure in Tamriel! Guaranteed to show up in even the hottest climates as if by magic.
8221.name: Snowball Buddy
8221.hint: |cff0000This pet cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

8222.description: "A tale says these green frogs grew as large as Dragons, but envied the Dragons their wings. One pact with Peryite later, and they gained their wings but lost their size. So, best not to make pacts with Peryite. Yet they are amusing companions."âDaixth
8222.name: Viridescent Dragon Frog

8223.description: Born from wamasu taken from Shadowfen to the Deadlands, or so their vendors claim, these progeny light up with fire instead of lightning. When confronted, their fiery spines project fire, making them fierce defenders of those they choose to follow.
8223.name: Deadlands Wamasu

8224.description: Your soul once drifted through the boundless Void, and though it found purchase on Nirn, it can't escape the relentless pull of its former home. Signs of its vast emptiness creep over you, hollowing out your mortal shell to eventually leave behind a husk.
8224.name: Void Pathosis
8224.hint: Acquired by completing the "Vateshran Hollows Conqueror" achievement in Vateshran Hollows.

8225.description: Murkmire itself accepts you as its champion, transforming your body to suit the deeper wallows and afford greater camouflage in its murky swamps and marshes. As mud is your mother!
8225.name: Dusky Guarhide

8226.description: After the Soulburst, mysterious slate-skinned figures appeared in the Imperial City to fight Daedra. Each one has the Red Diamond encrusted upon their torso. To this day, none know where they come from or where they go after each fray.
8226.name: Red Diamond Guardian

8228.description: Swirls of flowing dresses, wafts of floral scents, dazzling lights, stirring music, and more set the stage for the Shimmerene Soiree! Toast to the continued success and prominence of this High Elf city-state in perfect praxis with an equally perfect gown.
8228.name: Shimmerene Soiree Gown

8229.description: Everything you need to brave the wilds of the forest and bring back some hard-won lumber is supplied in this robust kit, so hoist your trusty axe and get to chopping wood!
8229.name: Logger
8229.hint: |cffffffEquipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.|r

8321.description: A miniature statue of a Nord warrior with his wolf companion.
8321.name: Statuette: Wolf and Warrior

8322.description: A miniature statue of Morwha, the Yokudan goddess of fertility and love.
8322.name: Statuette: Morwha, Desire's Root

8323.description: This Frozen Coast location features a Dwarven passage that leads past two deep alcoves and out to a frozen lake set amid the natural beauty of Skyrim. Hidden away beyond the lake, an ice cave awaits those seeking further respite from the world.
8323.name: Stillwaters Retreat

8377.description: Son of Jorunn the Skald-King, Prince Irnskar often feels as if he lives in his father's shadow. Hoping for a respite, he came to visit you. After adding Prince Irnskar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
8377.name: Prince Irnskar

8378.description: Adusa-daro lives by a code of honor, vigilance, and restraintâthe latter being of particular concern for a vampire. Will you invite her in? After adding Adusa-daro to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8378.name: Adusa-daro

8379.description: "Want a distraction? If you need to head overland to your mark, take your partner with you on a shiny Dwarven spider, make a showy arrival to draw eyes away from your third, and then get to business. Never fails â¦ someone. Not me."âDahnadreel
8379.name: Duo-Dynamo Burnished Spider

8380.description: The mage that crafted the illusion produced by this replica reliquary meant for it to demonstrate the proper use of the real thing.
8380.name: Reliquary of Dark Designs
8380.hint: Acquired by completing the "The Gray Council" quest in Rivenspire.

8381.description: Each time you look in the mirror, these markings seem to stare back with the judgment of your secret, inner demons. Did they just blink?
8381.name: Horror Within Face Markings

8382.description: Hide the truth of yourself no longer! Stain your body as darkly as your soul for all the world to see, and tremble.
8382.name: Horror Within Body Markings

8383.description: The Undaunted, Hroltar, may frown upon modern convenience, but this Reach native is quick to make himself at home in your abode. After adding Hroltar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
8383.name: Hroltar the Boaster

8388.description: A dark army marches across Skyrim! Count Verandis Ravenwatch seeks allies in the wild land of the Reach to uncover the true intent of the Gray Host. Find Verandis near Markarth, the primary city in the untamed Reach.
8388.name: Markarth

8455.description: "During the long journey from Nenalata to High Rock, beloved mounts became saviors. A song, nearly forgotten, details how a bear named Sunnawend saved Ayleids from a watery grave as they sought to cross a rain-swollen river."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8455.name: Nenalata Ayleid Bear

8456.description: "King Dynar insisted their camels leave Nenalata as well, setting them to carrying the gravely ill and fatigued among the evacuees. Their fortitude shone brightest with Silatam, who was the last camel standing each rest period."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8456.name: Nenalata Ayleid Camel

8457.description: "While resting during their evacuation from Nenalata, guar mounts would voluntarily form a circle around the young and infirm, protecting them from danger. Their leader, Mafrelatta, set her calves amid them to share warmth."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8457.name: Nenalata Ayleid Guar

8458.description: "The Nenalata horses bore the brunt of the cargo work whether trained for battle or not. To allow them to rest, their riders would often walk alongside them for a time. Oiobaun, though, carried his rider the entire way."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8458.name: Nenalata Ayleid Horse

8459.description: "Hunters among the Nenalata Ayleids teamed up with senche mounts daily to track and kill game to help feed the evacuees. King Dynar joined them, riding Ceydarre; he fed her from his own rations."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8459.name: Nenalata Ayleid Senche

8460.description: "Those riding the Nenalata wolves during the evacuation to High Rock served as scouts, moving ahead of the group. Many wrote of Nenagai, who seemed almost prescient in finding hidden dangers and indicating them to his rider."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8460.name: Nenalata Ayleid Wolf

8507.description: Some speak of Reach clans that keep these little bundles of fluff as companionsâand hunt down any who harm them. Regardless of veracity, these creatures love to be cuddled, often sleeping in the crook of their companion's necks.
8507.name: Karthspire Coney

8508.description: "Pregnant mares imbued by a welkynd stone in a lengthy ritual may bear these steeds, my sources say. Additionally, as the Nenalata evacuated, they took with them glowing barding that bolstered these steeds' tirelessness."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8508.name: Welkynd-Born Courser

8509.description: "This steed's glow comes not only from its Culanda-enhanced barding but also from an interaction between it and the animal. Culanda is in its bloodâstate various Nenalata Ayleid writingsâgiving this senche envious grace."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8509.name: Culanda-Born Senche

8510.description: "The eerie glow of those born from Varla-touched wolves, as the Nenalata called them, intensifies when a rider uses Varla-embellished barding. Such wolves possess a sure-footedness that lends them stealth despite their glow."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8510.name: Varla-Born Wolf

8512.description: "Need a mount that won't eat you out of house and home? For two? Well, this argent Dwarven spider mount can manage both! And don't worry about it losing its shineâit'll gleam until the end of times."âDevbarth the Stablemaster
8512.name: Duo-Dynamo Argent Spider

8513.description: The blazing orange of its hide hints at both the origin and temperament of this guar mount. Though born from and shaped in the fiery Deadlands, you hold the power to temper it into a fierce but loyal mount.
8513.name: Deadlands Guar

8514.description: First tamed by the Ahemmusa Ashland tribe, this lighter nix-ox steed only recently gained use by those outside the tribe. In fact, some riders who journeyed through Skyrim's winter noted that this nix-ox loves jumping around in snow.
8514.name: Chyle Seamed Nix-Ox Steed

8515.description: More docile than other rams, this mount provides a steady seat even among the most challenging of mountain terrain. In fact, some Windhelm natives claim they'd not ride any other steed through mountain passes during the winter months.
8515.name: Windhelm Cliff Ram

8516.description: After the Scorch of Senchal and nearby areas, several prides of senche-lions moved into the area. Enterprising and desperate Khajiit trained some of these fearless creatures to saddle, hoping to bolster their forces against deadly Dragons.
8516.name: Pellitine Scorch Senche-Lion

8517.description: This grieving steed of the Silver Dawn lost its riderâand its purpose. Now, it seeks a new companion. As long as you ride in search of worthy foes, this proud warhorse will heed your call.
8517.name: Dawn's Avenger Destrier

8518.description: "At the Battle of Falinesti, several herds of Wood Elf totem elk vanishedâsome say to Khajiit scoundrels. Later, Falinesti Faithful regained them, gifting them to devout riders. What constitutes a devout rider? Ask them."âFlaccus Terentius
8518.name: Falinesti's Faithful Totem Elk

8519.description: Followers of Meridia who assist Aurorans can gain enough favor to earn one of their wolf steeds. Trained for war, these wolves stay the course even in siege situations, making them excellent mounts for all manner of dangerous situations.
8519.name: Auroran Zenith Warwolf

8520.description: "During the Nenalata evacuation, barded wolf pups fought off a berserking bear until a warrior could take it down. These same pups helped keep their Ayleids warm when resting. Fierce but loving little creatures."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8520.name: Nenalata Ayleid Wolf Pup

8521.description: The Dunewalkers once roamed deserts beyond Elsweyr, seeking knowledge amid the sands of other lands. Mighila seeks to return to that tradition, hoping to bring back information on how to definitively vanquish the Dragons. Will you assist her?
8521.name: Dunewalker Senche-Raht

8522.description: Years of winning racing competitions finally bored Hazazkheran, so he ran messages for the queen for a time. Alas, even that grew predictable. Now he wants to poke his whiskers into all the hidden corners of the worldâperhaps with you.
8522.name: Spotted Duneracer Senche-Raht
8522.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

8523.description: "Dremnaken are fearsome creatures with crushing footpads and jagged teeth that promise only pain. Anyone who can strap armor onto one's back and ride it into battle should be doubly feared. That's only logical." Nororlie, Alinor Daedrology Society
8523.name: Dremnaken Wrathsteed

8525.description: After giants claimed the White Fall area as their own, these dark-ombre rams migrated into Skyrim, where Nords trained them to saddle. Although they frequently butt heads, literally, while being broken in, you'll not find a more loyal mount.
8525.name: White Fall Hinterland Ram

8526.description: Some scholars say the eerie blue markings on this nix-ox result from strange energies that once emanated from Mzuleft. Locals claim that no such energies exist these days and immediately speak of the steed's endurance and adaptability.
8526.name: Dagon Fel Nix-Ox Steed

8527.description: That flash of orange and red before a bull kagouti attacks can cause anyone's heart to skipâunless you're riding this intimidating mount into battle! Embrace this creature's ferocity, but be prepared for its adorable cooing when you scratch its nose.
8527.name: Bull Kagouti Charger

8528.description: Bred for war by the Netch Gouger Goblins, these vicious war durzogs require a firm hand or even magical coercion to stop when they have prey within their jaws. Their primitive precocity makes them good choices for those who frequently confront agile foes.
8528.name: Emberthroat Warzog

8529.description: The Winterborn clan claims that winter's frost rimes this wolf's heart and a blizzard's raging winds bellow from its howl. They also state only those with cold hate in their veins can endure riding these creatures.
8529.name: Winterborn Wild Hunt Wolf

8530.description: Bloodroot senches revel in the gore of their rider's battle fury, making them excellent steeds for those who love bloodlust as much as the Dreadhorn clan does. Will you embrace this partnership of slaughter?
8530.name: Bloodroot Wild Hunt Senche

8531.description: Though the Dragon Maarselok's blue-limned scourge illuminates this conjured steed, never fear! The magic that summoned it contains the blight, keeping the Green safeâbut given its penchant for biting, tip the stablemaster extra for its keep.
8531.name: Azure Blight Wild Hunt Steed

8532.description: Though shy, this orange and black creature fiercely defends its den, which builders of Fort Linchal noted in their records. They tamed those they displaced during construction, then took them home to the Imperial City, to the delight of many a noble.
8532.name: Linchal Titian Fox

8533.description: Some Wood Elf spinners claim Y'ffre granted these bunnies as part of the Green Pact, scholars contest that Second Empire Imperials brought them when establishing Woodhearth and, well, nature took its course. These hoppy hares make great fuzzy friends!
8533.name: Woodhearth Brown Rabbit

8534.description: "Everyone told me not to explore Bal Ur. Yeah, Daedric, blah blah whatever. What's worse? Striders there go for the head in droves. Gorgeous colors, though, all red and black, so I trapped and started training them. Won't crack your crown now!"âSkorg
8534.name: Bal Ur Cliff Strider

8535.description: The fiery red of this daedrat's fur indicates its origin: the Oblivion plane called the Deadlands. How it got here and why it's following you are both questions you'd best find the answers to, and soon.
8535.name: Deadlands Daedrat

8536.description: Striking scarlet hues mark this ancestor lizard, which some claim are the ancestors of the Bright-Throats. While this hospitality-minded tribe remains silent on this claim, these lizards are known to comfort the pain of others by nuzzling them.
8536.name: Lilmoth Ancestor Lizard

8537.description: This boar's regal bearing and attire indicate a level of breeding that would not allow for "cute" or "comical" behavior. Nothing could be further from the truth! He digs for his own truffles, plus rumors indicate he loves batter-based treats.
8537.name: Regal Razorback

8538.description: Resourceful scavengers and the bane of all street chefs, rathounds are a favorite among beggars. Survivors from Orcrest say the Rathounds and their uncanny ability to sense danger led a canine exodus from the city before it fell to the Knahaten Flu.
8538.name: Orcrest Rathound

8539.description: Originally from General Thibaut's hunting pack, these dogs later gained a reputation as fierce defenders of Greenhill's livestock and grain. If you're looking to keep rats out of your bags plus gain a loyal companion to hug, this handsome dog is for you.
8539.name: Greenhill Farmdog

8540.description: Both the fleecy white sheep and their doughty shepherds enjoy the clear water of Cloud Spring in High Rock. Though dangers abound, the sheep avoid the worst of it, making the rumors of their ability to sense and avoid peril seem plausible.
8540.name: Cloud Spring White Sheep

8541.description: Though one Reach clan claims their ancestors bring them messages via these snowy bunnies, the creatures seem mundane enough. That said, it couldn't hurt to have someone's extremely cute and cuddly ancestor helping you, right?
8541.name: Powderwhite Coney

8542.description: Those traversing the Niben River can see these fellrunners racing along the banks, avoiding dangers while seeking safe water. Enterprising merchants capture and sell them to buyers captivated by their teal-feathered, avian beauty.
8542.name: Niben River Fellrunner

8543.description: The Nords absolutely loathe these particular nixads since they interfere with their beesâand thus mead production. In an effort to help, Solitude's Mages Guild trained them to take instruction, making them into companions. Need a drinking buddy?
8543.name: Nectarthief Nixad

8544.description: "The unusual decorative touches on this clockwork creature show off the skill of its creator, which must be Sotha Sil himself. To what purpose? Well, I plan to keep one by my side to see if that ever becomes clear."âJournal fragment found on a skeleton
8544.name: Blue Cloisonne Clockwork Shalk

8545.description: The superstitious Nords of Solitude seek out wool originating from the black sheep of Bleakrock, claiming its dark color fends off evil intent. True or not, these darling sheep love to curl up next to their keepers and help them fall asleep.
8545.name: Bleakrock Black Sheep

8546.description: Legends claim the Red Mountain's first eruption not only gave brown sheep their current hue, but also imbued them with the fortitude to thrive despite hardship. Knowing their sheep remain placid while in danger, many Dark Elves believe these tales.
8546.name: Ascadian Umber Sheep

8547.description: Long ago, some of the striped fawns of Clearspring Tarn felt a call to migrate elsewhere, and they eventually found protection and a home with the Falinesti Wood Elves. Though you can spot them in many areas, they retain their original name.
8547.name: Clearspring Striped Fawn

8548.description: Those oathbound to Arana wear their stark white and carmine red facial tattoos with pride fueled by inner rage. Even the fiercest clans of the Reach think twice before confronting those displaying these marks.
8548.name: Reach Rebel Face Markings
8548.hint: Acquired by earning the Crow-Eye Savior achievement.

8549.description: Accents of red and white mark the bodies of those who have taken an oath to defend the Reach while under Arana's command. Her own hand traces the symbols while her witchery changes the skin's hue.
8549.name: Reach Rebel Body Markings
8549.hint: Acquired by earning the Protector of Markarth achievement.

8551.description: Some adventurers call animunculi like these nuisances since they get under foot easily. Some who prefer constructed companions recommend the Dwarven Scarab over any other type, stating that not only are they pleasing to the eye but also neat as a pin.
8551.name: Dwarven Scarab
8551.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in the Reach.

8652.description: Before working arcane miracles on Eyevea and the College of Winterhold, the great mage Shalidor experimented with pocket realms of Oblivion. One domain, his Shrouded Realm, features Nord-style towers on arboreal terrain that floats in a wondrous sky.
8652.name: Shalidor's Shrouded Realm

8653.description: Play the qanun with a virtuosity that could make homesick Khajiit weep for Elsweyr.
8653.name: Play Qanun

8654.description: Toast your marshmallows and eat the ooey-gooey result. Tasty!
8654.name: Marshmallow Toasty Treat

8655.description: Sometimes you just need to let all the rage out. All of it.
8655.name: Rage of the Reach
8655.hint: Acquired by combining 30 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Commendation, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.

8656.description: After gathering candleflies, Breton families set them out to light their annual summer reunion dinner. Once they savor a last bite of dessert, they release the flies back into the evening sky, causing a cloud of gently bobbing lights to drift away.
8656.name: Temporary Candlefly Lantern

8657.description: The lubricant used in clockwork maintenance is particularly well known for its immediate efficacyâand its difficulty to clean up.
8657.name: Phial of Clockwork Lubricant

8658.description: Ready to summon a cliff strider? Thetys Ramarys, breeder extraordinaire, created a kit you can use to attract them. Just toss the bait quickly if you want to keep your fingers.
8658.name: Thetys Ramarys's Bait Kit

8659.description: A call to arms! The Chamber of Legates in Leyawiin needs help to investigate a threat against former Imperial councilors and the activities of a Mehrunes Dagon cult. Seek the leader of the Ivory Brigade in Leyawiin, the capital of Blackwood.
8659.name: Blackwood

8661.description: "Simply looking upon the vertices formed by durable curves and lines makes me feel easy with my thoughts. Perhaps, to Dwarves, wearing this helm helped provide greater insight into whatever puzzle confounded them."âMathinn Palard, University of Gwylim
8661.name: Arkthzand Insight Vertex Shroud
8661.hint: Acquired as an antiquity, found in the Reach.

8662.description: "Though the helm's central focal point seems odd, perhaps it protected a Dwarf from magic meant to affect the mind. Wearing it makes my thoughts feel muffled. Oh, to be a Dwarf and know for sure this helm's purpose."âMathinn Palard, University of Gwylim
8662.name: Arkthzand Anfractuosity Shroud
8662.hint: Acquired by completing the "Welcome to The Reach" achievement in the Reach.

8663.description: "Many feel as if they've already worn this helm once settling it on their head for the first time. Given this and its use of aetherium, we hypothesize that the stone augments some form of Dwarven augury magic."âMathinn Palard, University of Gwylim
8663.name: Arkthzand Flanged Auspice Shroud

8823.description: Taming even a young terror bird requires patience, full-coverage armor, and even more patience. The result, however, can put pause to any seeking to cast you in the role of victim. Plus these fledglings cuddle so nicely while making cute sleeping noises!
8823.name: Fledgling Terror Bird

8824.description: Reach legends claim the witch Naenra Waerr wore a headdress like this while creating the Umbra Sword. To honor her, Reach witches who pass the final test of wisdom and power set to them by a clan elder gain the privilege to craft one of their own.
8824.name: Witchwise Headdress
8824.hint: Acquired by completing the "Witness to Prophecy" achievement in the Reach.

8829.description: "Veya's a practical child. While others her age favor short hair or intricate braids, she merely tucks her hair behind her ears and gets on with the task at hand. She'll excel at whatever she wants."âVilyn Hlas, tutor employed by Councilor Eris
8829.name: Draping Locks

8831.description: Most books share all sorts of knowledge with their readers. Some, however, don't have "sharing" in their index. They do have fire though. Lots of fire.
8831.name: Temperamental Grimoire

8832.description: Exhibit your mastery over proffering powerful potables in clean containers!
8832.name: Barkeep

8833.description: Kneel and offer up your arms to one worthy of your trust. This gesture varies depending upon what kind of weapon the user has equipped.
8833.name: Offer Weapon

8834.description: A remembrance of your times traversing void portals, this void shard still creates interesting visual effects even if it can't help you move through breaches in reality.
8834.name: Void Shard
8834.hint: Acquired by completing the "A Feast of Souls" quest in the Reach.

8835.description: "I named these senches Nighthaunts because, I suspect, the cult of Vaermina curiosities I was studying during their creation affected their appearance and intensified their glow. Not their nature. Grim-looking they are, yes, but not evil."âMage Naleldil
8835.name: Nighthaunt Gloomspore Senche

8836.description: "Whisper the words in your heart and call for an unworthy person's death. Or, if you possess the right skills, fulfill upon the sacrament on behalf of the Night Mother. I am the latterâas my robes proclaim. Care to know more?"âNight Mother Evangelist
8836.name: Night Mother's Evangelist

8837.description: Celebrate Aiden Direnni's victory against the Alessian Army on the Day of Release. Glenumbra's most ebullient celebrants don this festive garb, and you can too! Spend a memorable day dancing, drinking, and toasting alongside them!
8837.name: Day of Release Roisterer

8838.description: "A self-described Saliache artist-warrior described how she wore this stunning tiara to shapeshifting exhibitions to assist in transformations. While I can't garner the same results, it catches the light and draws eyes at gatherings."âSavre Longleat
8838.name: Saliache Aetherial Tiara

8839.description: The lone surviving member of a now-forgotten Reach clan woke up after a night spent at a shrine to Mehrunes Dagon with this thorny crown upon her brow and a grim purpose. Those who follow her earn a similar adornment after trials best not spoken aloud.
8839.name: Dagon's Thorns

8840.description: Enchanted to fare well in foul play, the faux cherry blossoms in this anadem frame your facial features with the fragrance of flowersâa foolproof flourish for your Jester's Festival frivolities!
8840.name: Cherry Blossom Anadem

8841.description: An ancient, Nenalata Ayleid ritual shaped your form into that of their beloved Varla stones. The shimmering hues and stony striations that make up your new "star" form can bedazzle even the most jaded of observers.
8841.name: Varla-Born

8842.description: The nothingness inside youâthat boundless emptinessâwants out. It craves to swallow all that is not you and make it nothing. It won't fill the void inside you, but letting it consume gives your hollowed body a moment's release from its gnawing.
8842.name: Hollow Void Husk

8843.description: Fancy Cold-Flame Atronachs, do you? Their frozen blue flames? That rock-hard physique? Well, now you can make those elements your own! Perfect for when you need to give someone the cold shoulder.
8843.name: Cold-Flame Epidermis

8844.description: You'd give anything to Mehrunes Dagon. Offerings of destruction. Of blood. Even your life. Already, you've earned the crimson-fire brand of his viscerents after feeding your epidermis to him bit by bit. Your devotion is bared to all. Glory to Dagon!
8844.name: Dagon's Viscerent
8844.hint: Acquired by earning "The Cauldron Conqueror" achievement.

8845.description: What do you really know about the mysterious Dremora Lyranth aside from her affiliation with Coldharbour's Foolkiller clan? Listen and maybe learn. After adding Lyranth to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8845.name: Lyranth

8846.description: A chef of many soups, but perhaps only one at a time, the Argonian Makes-Many-Soups seeks to add her culinary creativity to your abode. After adding Makes-Many-Soups to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8846.name: Makes-Many-Soups

8847.description: Javinus Tirnendo left the Order of the Waking Flame, a cult dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon. Now he seeks refuge from his former allies. Will you help? After adding Javinus to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
8847.name: Javinus Tirnendo

8848.description: The prankster prances, filled with glee, as she plays tricks on all you see. With purple markings on her face, she'll bow to you with careless grace. Pray join her in her fancies free, and live life with frivolity!
8848.name: Prankster Purple Face Paint

8849.description: The raconteur tells stories bright to help you shine through darkest night. His voice will change from friend to foe, and back again to vanquish woe. Please join him in his quest for light by taking on the red and white.
8849.name: Raconteur Red Face Paint

8850.description: Also called netchimen, netch handlers domesticate and care for the floating fauna, rearing them for food, labor, and even as pets. Recently, handlers in West Gash adopted this hat as a badge of pride and to show their love for all their betties and bulls.
8850.name: Netch Handler Cap

8851.description: Ingratiating yourself with the Blackfeather Court is a rare honor for a wingless cur! Display your respect for the corvid court with this flatteringly featheredâand seductively shinyâbilled mask!
8851.name: Courtly Crow Mask

8852.description: A cadre of Ayleid scholars and explorers loved their studies of the Saliache Elves so much that they tattooed their bodies with "the door to greater knowledge." To join their ranks is an honor preserved for the best Ayleid lorekeepers of the time.
8852.name: Saliache Scholar Body Markings

8853.description: One does not need a background in Ayleid history to identify the origins of these facial markings, but only those with a vast knowledge of the Saliache Elves will truly appreciate the meaning of their design.
8853.name: Saliache Scholar Face Markings

8854.description: The brilliant hue of the Ayleid life-tree glows upon those who sought knowledge from the Ayleidsâand somehow gained the favor of one of their spirits. While its glow may not light your way in Ayleid ruins, it might win the favor of any lingering ghosts.
8854.name: Blessed Life-Tree Body Markings

8855.description: The mysteries surrounding the ancient ruins of Ayleid civilization are many. How you returned from your last Ayleid endeavor with the markings of the blessed life-tree on your face remains one of them.
8855.name: Blessed Life-Tree Face Markings
