8872.name: Bust: Maebroogha
8872.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Vateshran Hollows.

8873.description: Trophy taken from Maebroogha in honor of an Undaunted victory in Vateshran Hollows.
8873.name: Trophy: Maebroogha

8874.description: The magic-wielding knights of Zenithar's Crucible prize these molten steeds above all elseâeven their arms and armor! To this day, no force has weathered the charge of an Iron destrier.
8874.name: Iron Atronach Horse

8875.description: Aer, the Conjurer Magnificent, summoned the first of these Iron Bears in 1E 2150. According to her notes, the lumbering, ursine frame matches the atronach's temperament perfectly, making the calling-ritual far easier.
8875.name: Iron Atronach Bear

8876.description: Famous Redguard conjurer, Rozaba af-Nizhadal, often referred to Iron Atronach Camels as "glass-treaders." Adventurers in Hammerfell still find glass tracks from where the atronach's scorching feet seared the sand!
8876.name: Iron Atronach Camel

8877.description: On a drunken dare, the mage Tarvyn Othren summoned the first known Iron Atronach Guar, which immediately killed his companions. Grieving, the mage sought redemption, riding only that guar as a reminder of his mistake.
8877.name: Iron Atronach Guar

8878.description: Stories tell of how Maalanrie Direnni, though restrained by bandits, somehow walked through dreams and called the first Iron Atronach Senche. Upon arrival, it destroyed her cage and freed her so she could kill her captors and flee upon its molten back.
8878.name: Iron Atronach Senche

8879.description: Of all the Iron Atronach's diverse forms, the wolf comes hardest. Atronachs resent the wolves' pack reliance and yearn for a shape befitting their solitary nature. Mages who bend these molten goliaths into a lupine form are among the strongest in Tamriel.
8879.name: Iron Atronach Wolf

8880.description: "Burning ash and feathers dark, sharpened claws and rageâthese hew close to the Razor Prince, or so explains a sage. Yet ere chaos warped this beast, Direnni crafted well. The Deadlands taints it with fell heat, impossible to quell."âQilik the Skaafin
8880.name: Dagonic Quasigriff

8883.description:
This relic's tie to Sentinel Aksalaz allows you to summon forth his visage in a display of frosty power.

When used within Black Drake Villa, all party members gain the Icy Vision effect, which reveals hidden treasures within Black Drake Villa.
8883.name: Relic of the Sentinel
8883.hint: Obtained by defeating Sentinel Aksalaz in combat and looting it from one of his treasure chests.

8884.description: A miniature statue of a Nord skald with hawk and horn.
8884.name: Statuette: Child of the Sky

8885.description: A miniature statue of Boethra and feline companion, a banisher of the demon Orkha.
8885.name: Statuette: Boethra, Orkha-Bane

8886.description: A miniature statue of Kinlord Nemfarion, founder of Corgrad on Summerset Isle.
8886.name: Statuette: Kinlord Nemfarion

8887.description: In the ceaseless wars of Oblivion, there will always be scoundrels. After rooking marks of goods and foes of lives, this rugged, Dremora-style coat lets you slink away, sounding no louder than a whisper.
8887.name: Dremora Deceiver Duster

8888.description: "Still tasting victory after overcoming our challenges, new blood? Eager to dance among those you can now call equals? Garb yourself in this fine accession gown. It hides blood well."âArchblood Delyna
8888.name: Thrafey Debutante Gown
8888.hint: Created by combining 50 Scaly Cloth Scraps from the Silent Halls in Blackwood.

8889.description: Only you know what lies beneath your enshrouding bandages. Whether hero or horror, your presence imparts an unforgettable chilling dread.
8889.name: Grisly Mummy Wrap

8890.description: Gear up in Wood Elf style! Fashioned after the garb of Eveli Sharp-Arrow, this outfit's supple leather provides protection while still allowing for astounding trick shots and dizzying acrobatics!
8890.name: Eveli's Adventuring Leathers

8891.description: After Sai Sahan freed Leyawiin from its Longhouse occupation, Leyawiin honored those who aided him with a special medallion. Each year since, the city awards these Nibenese-style head ornaments to its bravest defenders.
8891.name: Stallion-Liege Brow Medallion

8892.description: Popular among the more zealous smiths of Blackwood, the anvil facial tattoo makes one's commitment to labor and commerce clear to everyoneâespecially Zenithar, the Provider of our Ease.
8892.name: Fortune's Anvil Face Markings

8893.description: The Sul-Xan designed their markings to emulate the elaborate stonework of the xanmeer pyramids. Painting lines on their cheeks and chins before battle ensures that they will remain steadfast and resolute, no matter the danger or the cost.
8893.name: Sul-Xan Prophet Face Markings

8894.description: The bands and arches of this distinctive pattern accentuate a face's brow and cheekbones, making a sneer or a battle cry all the more distinctive.
8894.name: Triptych Motion Face Markings

8895.description: Thorns and angles, ancient Nibenese symbols of grace and precision, often appear in shrines and votives to Saint Kaladas. Wearing them on the face shows true dedication to one's craft.
8895.name: Saint Kaladas Face Markings

8896.description: "To worship Dagon is to enact his will in the world. When the victims of our great work crawl from the ashes and gaze upon your face, they will see only the face of Lord Dagon." â Fenrold, Priest of Dagon
8896.name: Dagon's Aspirant Face Markings

8897.description: Those who prove their loyalty to the Prince of Destruction, Mehrunes Dagon, are allowed the great honor of displaying his distinctive red markings on their body.
8897.name: Dagon's Aspirant Body Markings

8898.description: The Sul-Xan are renowned for their prowess in battle and their devotion to their cause. The prophet's red markings are worn only by those who are sworn to ensure the future of the tribe.
8898.name: Sul-Xan Prophet Body Markings

8899.description: Looping to accentuate the muscles of the body, the flowing lines of this Triptych Motion marking are believed to add power and might to the bearer. This has yet to be proven, but by looking at the dark ink, who can say whether or not it is true.
8899.name: Triptych Motion Body Markings

8900.description: Those who adore Saint Kaladas the Architect often display their devotion with this budding script that grows from the ground up to bloom across their shoulders.
8900.name: Saint Kaladas Body Markings

8901.description: "Zenithar demands only one thing, my friend: effort. When the sweat pours from your brow and your muscles turn to jelly, these markings will remind you of your oath to the Divines." âSeverio Helenus, Priest of Zenithar
8901.name: Fortune's Anvil Body Markings

8902.description: Sul-Xan tattooists often fall into a bloody reverie when applying face paint to their warrior kin. Acidic dyes make their frenzied artistry dangerous for the eyes, but those who lose their sight in throes of chaos are doubly blessed!
8902.name: Sul-Xan Raider Face Markings
8902.hint: Acquired by earning the Xanmeer's Protector achievement in the Rockgrove trial.

8903.description: The Sul-Xan raider oathtaking ceremony includes tracing a marsh-green pattern upon hide and scale. The dye's acidic scent hints at the level of burning pain involved in this exaltation of chaos.
8903.name: Sul-Xan Raider Body Markings
8903.hint: Acquired by earning the Rockgrove Conqueror achievement in the Rockgrove trial.

8904.description: "Those who swear loyalty to Mehrunes Dagon and receive his blessing are forever changed. The flensing of the skin to receive the sacred crimson ink, though painful, purifies the recipient for what's to come."âDisastrix Zansora
8904.name: Deadlands Excoriated

8905.description: "Hist-Tsoko are the elder Hists. Rarely, they mark one to carry out a sacred task, and we know to provide aid to them. Sometimes we give words. Sometimes goods. Sometimes distance."âAttributed to Sap-Speaker Kuzei
8905.name: Hist-Tsoko

8906.description: "A hint of playfulness. A touch of joy. An aura of mystery. These mix under Jode's light and take the form of a masked fox who seeks out these traits in their next rider. Or so the priests say. But maybe they've had too much moon-sugar."âSulema
8906.name: Ja'zennji Siir Fox
8906.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

8907.description: "True, these golden wolves hail from Solstheim, but bred by Snow Elves? Ha! Mead hall fish tales. What matters is they heed the call to battle. Snow, ice, trolls, avalanches â¦ they'll face it all with a snarl!"âAelirma of Solitude
8907.name: Solstheim Lunar Wolf

8908.description: Befriend your fellow woodland creatures as you dance under the forest's boughs, swaying gracefully in the guise of a sylvan-born spriggan, and unleash nature's fury on those who intrude upon the Green.
8908.name: Sylvan Spriggan

8909.description: Those who wrap themselves in Mephala's web and help spin her secretive plots sometimes develop the keen night-eyes of her spiderkith. Ideal for navigating the complex strands of the Spiral Skein, but easily blinded by the light.
8909.name: Spiderkith Eyes

8994.description:
This Blackfeather Court banker wants your shinies â¦ to keep them safe for you, of course! The chaos of Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds are murder on his plumage, so he won't visit you there.

When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.
8994.name: Baron Jangleplume, the Banker

8995.description:
This Blackfeather Court merchant can relieve you of shiny, non-illicit burdens. She avoids Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, describing them as "unprofitable" and "full of fat-legged giants."

When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.
8995.name: Peddler of Prizes, the Merchant

9003.description: You own it. Now show it. That throne is yours!
9003.name: Own the Throne

9004.description: Spread the holiness of the Day of Lights wherever you venture with your own magical light. Whether those around you dance or pray, they'll thank you for wishing their farming and fishing efforts well.
9004.name: Day of Lights Spectacle

9005.description: Explore your artistic side with this sturdy easel and canvas. Whether you're interested in painting dramatic landscapes or prefer to depict nature, these items should serve you well.
9005.name: Painter's Easel and Canvas

9006.description: What's in this delightfully bedecked box? It's a surprise, of course. Crank it open and find out!
9006.name: Playful Prankster's Surprise Box

9007.description: Every adventurer needs a tool that works against Daedric wards! Just hold this amulet up, invoke the magic, perhaps shield your eyes, and voila! The ward is â¦ not unwarded? Well, it's showy at least!
9007.name: Daedric Unwarding Amulet
9007.hint: Acquired by completing "The Emperor's Secret" quest.

9008.description: A hidden fire burns within this gem. With a quick invocation, you can draw it out to create the illusion of charging salamanders in a stunning display of magic.
9008.name: Illusory Salamander Stone
9008.hint: Acquired by earning the "Black Drake Villa Conqueror" achievement.

9009.description: Scholars disagree on whether these iron atronach steeds took on the aeonstone hues during the summoning ritual intentionally or after by mistake. Motives aside, riders magically summon these mounts, creating an impressively explosive visual impact.
9009.name: Viridian Iron Steed

9010.description: Born from the same wretched forges as Dark Anchors, these ebony-alloy senche atronachs manifest in a burst of soul-searing light when called. Though onlookers may feel as if they'll never be warm again, some riders claim they feel nothing while mounted.
9010.name: Black Forge Iron Senche

9011.description: A meteoric boom presages the arrival of this summoned atronach wolf, making it a natural for those who prefer to live with flairâand flare! A sunset's ruby radiance lends its hue to this steed's magical glow. Glory in its intense incandescence.
9011.name: Sunflare Iron Wolf

9012.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Relish its luscious flavorâtantalizing to your taste buds!
9012.name: Jubilee Cake 2021
9012.hint: Obtained by completing the 2021 Anniversary event.

9013.description: The recently abandoned Sheogorath shrine that locals call Assalkushalit features a statue to the Mad God within its stony hall. Whether you revere this Daedric Prince or want a home nestled in Red Mountain, this portal-ridden sanctuary can be yours!
9013.name: Kushalit Sanctuary

9014.description: Ancient pillars along the Abecean Sea mark the site of once-soaring Ayleid architecture. Though none know the original purpose of these structures, some claim that soaking in the retreat's indoor crystal pool heals the spirit.
9014.name: Varlaisvea Ayleid Ruins

9061.name: Regal Regalia Dagger

9062.description: Through an Argonian ritual imbued by the Razor Prince's chaos, this former welwa mount seethes with both fury and destruction in conflagration-touched form. Only the strong-willed can control this beast. Perhaps that's you?
9062.name: Sul-Xan Fleshripper
9062.hint: Complete the "Xalvakka's Bane" achievement in the Rockgrove trial.

9063.description: Though some claim these horses are bred purely for show, the Grand Nibenese Stallion serves as more than just a good luck charm in Leyawiin. They possess a keen intelligence and even temperamentâmaintaining their composure, even on crowded streets.
9063.name: Grand Nibenese Stallion

9064.description: "Though Iron Orcs ate nearly all these gentle camels, the puissant Elinhir mages took them in, allowing them to flourish. With their flowing gaits and downy fur, the sweet-scented creatures became the mages' steed of choice."âGarold Farfly
9064.name: Dappled Elinhir Camel

9065.description: This steed's sunny disposition matches its vibrant multihued coat, making it an excellent horse for a new riderâor one who regularly ventures into treacherous situations. Herds often race the Gold Coast waves, manes flowing freely and tails high.
9065.name: Sungold Bay Thoroughbred

9066.description: "The stars do not always stay in the sky in Craglorn. They wander, leaping over rocks, and occasionally eat everything you planted in your garden. Those tusking goats can take their shimmering hides somewhere else!"âUbri, Belkarth Horticulturalist
9066.name: Celestial Ram

9067.description: Once considered a delicacy by Maormer, these iridescent mudcrabs regard every creature a threat, even other mudcrabs. With proper handling, it probably won't snap at your nose. Probably.
9067.name: Wasten Coraldale Mudcrab

9068.description: While Alik'r natives count this sleeping boar's twitches to foretell of coming sandstorms, others enjoy its penchant to bob along to a drum's beat or squeal until it gains a taste of burgundy wine. Clearly, a boar that favors festivities! Like you, maybe?
9068.name: Goldspine Boar

9069.description: Ask an Iliac Bay native what they'd miss most about their home and the answer might be the sight of tree-climbing spotted goats. Fortunately for these goat-lovers, the creatures now bleat their way from the bay to climb all manner of trees in new homes.
9069.name: Iliac Spotted Goat

9070.description: Ready for action? Like Khamira herself, this kitten certainly is! With a roll and a hiss, Ja'khajiit Khamira enters your life, ready to face danger at your side.
9070.name: Ja'khajiit Khamira

9071.description: Because these ponies love flowersâto the point of nudging and nickering at any picking themâNibenese folk started stabling them amid gardens as guardians. Their gentle grace in such a colorful setting make them superb companions for beauty lovers.
9071.name: Nibenese Pony

9072.description: These cerulean-toned haj mota hatchlings learn to fend for themselves amid ice caves, frozen wastes, and crevasses early on. If you tame one, not only do you have a future terror loyal to you, but you also gain its keen survival instinct in frosty lands.
9072.name: Scutecicle Haj Mota

9073.description: Syliril the trapper caught a sabre cat from the Vale and presented it to Emperor Durcorach in 2E 531. Not to be outdone, Durcorach's beastmaster created a more resplendent cat. He was fed to the hunting dogs when the color washed out of the cat's fur.
9073.name: Vale Sabre Cat

9074.description: The Argonian who named this multihued jelly claims inspiration from the mineral, though some note she was calling it a "watermelon jelly" first. Oddly enough, some find its flavor resembles that of the fruit.
9074.name: Tourmaline Swamp Jelly

9075.description: With pincers resembling Dagon's spires and a ferocious multibarbed stinger, these Deadlands natives see most creatures as prey. If you let a softshell baby ride your shoulders until it molts, however, you might just have a friend for life. Might.
9075.name: Deadlands Scorpion

9076.description: Visiting the Stitches requires a certain amount of fortitude and bravado. Living there, as do these cavies, involves hiding and good timing, as well. Gain a cavy's hard-won trust, and you gain a furry friend seeking neck-snuggles for life.
9076.name: Stitchfur Cavy

9077.description: A unique Outfit look for headgear in the Bog Blight Funerary style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.
9077.name: Bog Blight Funerary Mask

9079.description: Watching mighty trees fall to this ram's practice leaps and headbutts led to its eventual domestication by the Nords around its home peak. Bring that power, as well as its love of scaling treacherous heights, into your stable!
9079.name: Eldersblood Peak Ram

9080.description: Like the vines choking the Bloodroot Forge, your boughs share Hircine's thirst for prey. Bathe your roots in the blood of the fallen and feel it course through the crimson arteries of the predator that you are.
9080.name: Bloodroot Spriggan

9081.description: The quiet desolation of snow-laden forests instills a sense of undisturbed peace. Take on the aspect of stoic winter spriggans that preserve this unmolested tranquility.
9081.name: Winterborn Spriggan

9082.description: The otherworldly blue glow of the Azure Blight radiates from the cracks in your illusory bark, screaming "danger" to anything that lays eyes on you. Though your corrupted appearance is a false one, the menace becomes you.
9082.name: Azure Blight Spriggan

9083.description: "Blackwood has some odd creatures. Take the bog dog. Sure, it lives in bogs, but it's no dog. That said, tame it and train it, and it'll follow you anywhere. Just make sure the local guards know it's yours."âGrelaith of White Stallion Inn
9083.name: Bog Dog
9083.hint: Acquired by completing the "Lost in the Wilds" achievement in Blackwood.

9084.description: "As you feel the crown's weight, let the clang of steel, the scent of ash, and the taste of blood fill your mind. Now stand, Razor-pledged. Let your ambition guide you along Dagon's path."âDisastrix Zansora
9084.name: Malign Ambitions Crown
9084.hint: Earned by completing the "A Hidden Vault" quest in Blackwood.

9085.description: A component required for the Deadlands Firewalker personality.
9085.name: Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew

9086.description: A component required for the Deadlands Firewalker personality.
9086.name: Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew

9087.description: A component required for the Deadlands Firewalker personality.
9087.name: Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew

9088.description: The long-suffering Stibbons, Lady Laurent's servant, needs a break. He chose to seek you out, desperate for the peace your home provides. After adding Stibbons to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9088.name: Stibbons

9089.description: Erilthel's quest to become Lady Twilight, Tamriel's greatest thief, brought her to your door until her teacher, Seeks-the-Dark, finds her again. After adding Erilthel to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9089.name: Erilthel

9090.description: The blacksmith, Narboth, dedicated her life to her art after fulfilling an oath to Malacath. Now she seeks a worthy patron. After adding Narboth to your home, you can set her on a path.
9090.name: Narboth

9235.description:
These black-and-gold barded destriers carry their riders with distinction as they sweep across Cyrodiil, serving as but one symbol of goals and experiences their dauntless combatants share. 

|cFFFFFFRiding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r
9235.name: Bonds of Battle Destrier

9236.description:
The envy of treasure-seekers throughout Tamriel, this sure-footed steed serves as both a sturdy companion and an enduring reminder of what fellowship and camaraderie can achieve.

|cFFFFFFRiding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r
9236.name: Guild's Pride Charger

9237.description: Breezes tease your feathered crest when you venture forth wearing this helm. Styled after the piece worn by Keshu the Black Fin, this Argonian-crafted headwear exhibits your dedication to this leader's optimistic vision for her people.
9237.name: Helm of the Black Fin
9237.hint: Obtained by completing the "Weapons of Destruction" quest in Blackwood.

9238.description: "If the creature following behind me truly is a ghost, then this is the gentlest haunting I have ever seen. The crustation only skitters at my feet and occasionally clacks its claws at unwelcome houseguests."âBensharaz, Spirit Hunter
9238.name: Spectral Mudcrab

9239.description: Not content to simply summon iron atronachs, some mages weave powerful illusions to assume the shape of these molten behemoths! Harden your heart and embrace the iron!
9239.name: Iron Atronach
9239.hint: |cffffffEquipping this polymorph will hide your shield when stowed.|r

9240.description: In the wild, Topaz Terror Birds cloak themselves in wind-blown sand to ambush unsuspecting prey. This little fledgling is keen to practice the technique, so be sure to warn your companions before a sandstorm hits. No one wants to lose a toe!
9240.name: Topaz Fledgling Terror Bird

9241.description: Whether you're running errands or consulting with a scholar, you should look wizardly and impressive while doing so. With these fashionable robes, you'll always look the part in the eyes of your colleagues.
9241.name: Wizard About Town

9242.description: Celestial guardians themselves could not take issue with these robes. The gemstones reference the Warrior and Thief, while the elegant draping of fabric pays homage to the Mage. Wear this ensemble and you'll be sure to wow courtiers and scholars alike.
9242.name: Celestial Robes

9243.description: "Which lowland does this ornery creature call home? Why, all of them! Think I'm exaggerating? Believe what you want, but know that unless trained while young, they'll charge you in a heartbeat. Best have them on your side."âMiet, Breeder
9243.name: Lowland Bristleback

9244.description: These feral pigs prowl through the boreal forests of Bleakrock Isle. They grudgingly adapt to domestication, and take pleasure in plowing through deep snow, mud, or grasslands alongside their owners.
9244.name: Snowbarrow Boar

9245.description: Stalwart and true, Bastian Hallix personifies the best traits of High Rock nobility. But in a world of greed and broken vows, can a righteous man persevere? Call this companion to your side and prove that Tamriel still needs virtuous guardians.
9245.name: Bastian Hallix
9245.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Competition and Contracts."

9246.description: A product of wizardry and selective breeding, these chimeric steeds descend from Summerset gryphons. According to creator Irastimil Direnni, their wingless frame kept upkeep costs low, while maintaining superiority over the upstart Bretons' clumsy steeds.
9246.name: Quasigriff

9247.description: A miniature statue of Syrabane, an Aldmeri god-ancestor of magic.
9247.name: Statuette: Syrabane, the Warlock

9248.description: A miniature statue of Kynareth, Divine patron of sailors and travelers.
9248.name: Statuette: Kynareth, Air Goddess

9249.description: "This lithe feline possesses the quiet madness of a clever assassin, making it a harmonious steed for those methodically ending the lives of others. Even betterâmine sometimes brings gifts of mangled Mer. Perhaps you'll be so lucky?"âMother Regrets
9249.name: Grinning Terror Senche

9250.description: "I can't pick a favorite from the Grinning Terrors, but this ominous horse kissed by madness appeals to me on a visceral level. Perhaps because they enjoy spreading the viscera of unwelcome riders about with their hooves."âMother Regrets
9250.name: Grinning Terror Steed

9251.description: "You need more than colorful barding to harness one of these bearsâa splash of blood freed by Neb-Crescen and a teardrop from a watcher's eye might bind one to your cause. Might. Otherwise, stand clear. You won't survive their hugs."âMother Regrets
9251.name: Grinning Terror Bear

9252.description: "Croon to this guar, describing recent murder sprees, and you might win a place at this guar's side. Or capture its attention by emulating loud bodily functions. Either delights this creature."âMother Regrets
9252.name: Grinning Terror Guar

9253.description: "This wolf might seem a playful Jester's Festival creatureâa performer's beast ready to entertain. But no. Its sharp wit and sharper teeth care not for another's amusement, favoring its own. Only its rider is safe from its joy-nips."âMother Regrets
9253.name: Grinning Terror Wolf

9254.description: According to the Ash'abah, if you receive one of these fierce sep adders as a gift and you both survive for a year with each other, you have passed the first trial necessary to trade in poisons. Bonus? You keep the jewel-toned creatureâif you live.
9254.name: Sapphire Sep Adder

9255.description: Nearly driven to extinction a century ago by Nibenese, who used their brilliant ruby wing dust as rouge, these moths made a comeback in a different area: Valenwood. Friendly to a fault, they are now favored companions among alchemists.
9255.name: Carmine Wood Moth

9256.description: Farmers in Southern Cyrodiil carry an antidote to Spotted Plow Spiders since it is not uncommon to accidentally rake through a nest and be bitten by thousands of tiny hatchlings. Despite the dangers and if raised correctly, the spiders make good pets.
9256.name: Spotted Plow Spider

9257.description: A staple of Morthal wardens, these imposing bears trundle near the outskirts of town, serving as extra guards when not in use as steeds or resting. Those who seek to one day become valiant defenders of their town often sneak away to feed them extra treats.
9257.name: Sunback Bear

9274.name: Maarselok Shoulder
9274.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Maarselok Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

9275.description: Said to have been bred by Coral-Splitter Goblins to hunt for fresh fish, these aqua-blue and coral-striped durzogs spread to the shores of Topal Bay decades ago. To this day, they still love to dive into the surf and snag aquatic bounty!
9275.name: Topal Durzog

9276.description: With dappled skin perfectly matched to the white rock and marshy wetlands east of Bthanual, these Kagouti favor stealth and ambushes over brute force attacks. Ride one of these creatures and you'll be sure to turn heads in Mournhold.
9276.name: Chalkhide Kagouti

9277.description: The Knights of the Silver Rose spent years finding the best felines to rid their fortress of pests and annoyances. Generations later, and these senche-servals can clear out banekin infestations in a single day.
9277.name: Silver Rose Senche-Serval

9278.description: Woe to any who ride this fiery steed without its consent! Sanctified by ashes from the funeral pyres of venerated witches, this wicker steed blazes a path across Tamriel and beyond, reminding any mortals who see it of their own short lifespans.
9278.name: Bonfire Wicker-Steed

9353.description: The inquisitive adventurer, Mirri Elendis, might just unravel the deepest secrets of the Dark Elves â¦ provided she can fend off her family's latest blunders. Call this companion to your side and uncover Tamriel's greatest mysteries together!
9353.name: Mirri Elendis
9353.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Shattered and Scattered."

9356.description: Let the games begin! With this portable trebuchet, you can wage a yard war and toast to your victories over the ensuing feast.
9356.name: Wargame Trebuchet
9356.hint: Acquired by completing the "Siege Specialist" achievement by participating in the Alliance War.

9357.description: Pull out your wand, blow some bubbles, and watch them drift in the air.
9357.name: Blow Bubbles

9358.description: Nothing says spicy like a sprinkle of fire salts!
9358.name: Fire Salts

9359.description: Clear up those sinuses with a nice bowl of zesty soup. Taste the heat!
9359.name: Spicy Soup

9360.description: Take some time away from adventuring to crochet using your favorite yarn.
9360.name: Crochet

9361.description: Burn your way through town and country, literally, with these alchemical augments to your footwear! The flames last only for a few moments, so you can reassure any who feel you've become a fire hazard.
9361.name: Inferno Cleats

9362.description: Made too many decisions today already? Pull out your trusty Impartial Decision Coin, give it a flip, and see what comes of itâno further rumination required!
9362.name: Impartial Decision Coin

9363.description: Using its focus item, summon one of Divine Zenithar's many symbols: a golden anvil. Perfect for when you're sharing tales of triumphs gained through honest toil.
9363.name: Full-Scale Golden Anvil Replica
9363.hint: Acquired by completing "The Golden Anvil" quest in Blackwood.

9364.description: Never again suffer the indignities of a weed-filled garden! This potent phial contains a defoliating decoction that hastily rids you of any and all corrupting creepers.
9364.name: Wilting Weed Killer Phial
9364.hint: Earned by completing the "Harrada Harvest" quest in Blackwood.

9365.description: Lyranth the Dremora summons those willing to defend Nirn against the gates of Oblivion. The followers of Mehrunes Dagon threaten to unleash a storm of destruction upon the mortal realm. Meet Lyranth in the mysterious Daedric plane known only as Fargrave.
9365.name: The Deadlands

9366.description: After performing bloody rites of devotion, Dagon's most zealous cultists earn the right to shed their mortal form. Hours of ritual scourging shears their skin, revealing a coat of crimson scales beneath. Are you willing to endure this metamorphosis?
9366.name: Scourger's Scales

9368.description: "Celestial senches prowl over jagged rocks on surprisingly soft paws for creatures made of Spellscar-like stone. Yes, the Steed constellation is a horse, but how the Warrior didn't ride a starry senche into battle is beyond me."âMadadi, Celestial Scholar
9368.name: Starchaser Senche

9370.description: "The glow emanating from this celestial horse soothes and energizes me at the same time. Odd, given its origins in Spellscar. Sitting astride this mystical mount can make even the most wretched pauper feel like a master mage."âMadadi, Celestial Scholar
9370.name: Nebulous Star-Born Steed

9374.description: For centuries, the honorable Knights of the Silver Rose prosecuted crusades against the servants of Oblivion. Now, they wield their Daedric plunder almost indiscriminately. Invade Red Petal Bastion and uncover the truth behind the once noble order's fall.
9374.name: Red Petal Bastion

9375.description: The Empire kept its darkest secrets hidden in the depths of Black Marsh, far from prying eyesâthe Dread Cellar, a torture chamber meant to hold those the Empire wanted to vanish. Explore this forgotten abattoir and learn its secrets, old and new.
9375.name: The Dread Cellar

9376.description: By Azura, by Azura, by Azura! Destined to be a Grand Champion with more admirers than you know what to do with? Maybe you're just hoping your hero will notice you. This bold hairstyle is just what you need to get your adventures started!
9376.name: The Adoring Stand

9377.description: The Cropsford Hen is a beloved staple of many Cyrodilic farmsteads since just one hen will staunchly protect the entire coop against foxes. Children in Cropsford say the hens herd them into the coop whenever a hawk is circling.
9377.name: Cropsford Hen

9378.description: "My Wick and I have built many nests, felled sickened trees, and cleaned the roots of our Hist. Dryskins think shalks of her color are lucky, but Wick dirties her pinchers in rotting bark for our fortune."âVunsu, Arborealist
9378.name: Mzark Jade-Cap Shroom Shalk

9379.description: Wardens of Morthal ride large, hulking Sunback Bears into battle. While the full-sized bears tend to scare villagers, cubs are more easily accepted. Plus, the cubs' tiny ears can get the staunchest of merchants to lower their prices.
9379.name: Sunback Bear Cub

9382.description: "The Mind-Shriven usually have no concept of the self, but this feline appears to be as content with its nature as always. It seems that Molag Bal himself cannot enslave a cat."âWarlock Aldaale
9382.name: Mind-Shriven Cat

9383.description: This hound's attire may suggest that it was once a fun-loving companion; there is nothing playful about it now. This resurrected creature is not for the faint of heart, but it will show loyalty in not setting you ablaze with its fiery muzzle.
9383.name: Infernal Trickster Death Hound

9384.description: "There is madness in all of us, and senches don't commit to anything half-heartedly. I came across one such mad senche and still bear the scars of its wild attacks. To take one on an adventure, you'd have to be mad as Sheogorath himself!"âVi Aspblade
9384.name: Dark Delirium Senche

9385.description: The shadowy shapes of inky goats lead revelers through the streets to Sanguine's latest celebration. Often, the animals are fitted with the symbols of the party: sweet drinks and heady rose perfumes. Take a ram like this into your care at your own peril.
9385.name: Ram of Dark Delights

9386.description: "Clockwork fabricants possess keen intelligence, but their characters remain blank slates. Rumor has it that the Astronomer can import a dissected beast's memories directly into a fabricant's animo core, making for an enlightened mount."âUleni Silarys
9386.name: Mnemoflare Kagouti Fabricant

9387.description: Originally found in the arid canyons of Northern Elsweyr, these striped beauties rarely submit to training, making cats that do extremely desirable. Just make sure to have plenty of toys on hand or you'll find your leather boots gnawed to pieces.
9387.name: Dunecoat Senche-Serval

9388.description: A crackle of lightning accompanies this hatchling wherever it goes, providing a foreshadowing of what it will become in its adulthood. Before that point, though, it makes an excellent if imposing adventuring buddy!
9388.name: Wamasu Hatchling

9389.description: Few Reach witches make the effort to invest eldritch magic into unborn pups, train them to draw attention without fear, and decorate them with eerie skeletal bone markings. All it takes is one look to either fear this canine or love it beyond reason.
9389.name: Witch-Tamed Bear-Dog

9390.description: Known for their prowess at sweeping an area clean of shalks, these armored kittens possess a keen sense of group tactics at an early age. So, not only do you gain an affectionate furball as a friend, but you also have fewer pests distracting you.
9390.name: Ironclad Senche-Serval Kitten

9392.description:
Every year, hundreds of Zenithar's worshipers journey to Leyawiin, desperate for a glimpse of St. Kaladas's architectural marvel: The Great Chapel of Zenithar. This suite offers a welcome respite from the road's perils. 
Room is too small for dueling.
9392.name: Pilgrim's Rest
9392.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion

9393.description: Scholars debate over when this particular helm design first came into use on Annihilarch's Summit, but all agree on one thing: its imposing horns lead to many a nightmare for those who face its wearer in battle.
9393.name: Ironclad Sarcoshroud
9393.hint: Acquired as an antiquity, found in the Deadlands.

9394.description: "The Bosmer have no qualms about stamping the 'opulence of life and growth' on their cheeks; it is a way to pay homage to their beloved Green. I say they're uncouth to wear such markings. We are flesh, not leaf."âFormer Scholar Andania of Alinor
9394.name: Viridian Valor Face Markings

9395.description: The Green has the power to mold its own future; this body marking is suited for anyone who actively seeks the same. With elegant leaves and tenacious vines running up and down each limb, it is hard not to be inspired to strive for independence.
9395.name: Viridian Valor Body Markings

9399.description: Woven carefully from shadow wisps of Nocturnal's realm, these noble indriks shy from the light of day until trained by a patient rider to tolerate it. Forever after, they move under Magnus's fierce glow as if to defy it.
9399.name: Evergloam Indrik

9400.description: These wolves were among the first creatures to storm Evermore when the Reachmen's attack broke through the city's walls. Each wolf's unique markings display their lineage with some incorporating designs from Durcorach's beloved howler herself.
9400.name: Black Drake Howler

9401.description: Contrary to popular belief, this cute-yet-terrifying Evergloam creature does not eat shadows to grow larger. But they definitely do win at games that involve hiding in murky placesâa gift from Nocturnal herself, perhaps?
9401.name: Gloam Gryphon Fledgling

9402.description: "When Durorach allied with the Tagh Droiloch coven in 2E 527, the witches added asp oil to the soot paint the Blake Drake used. Warriors fell into a battle frenzy whenever they applied the soot mixture."âHolwin, Scholar of Reach Studies in Haafingar
9402.name: The Black Drake's Face Warpaint

9403.description: Made by applying a thick layer of soot and ash to the body and then carving away the paint with the fingers, this warpaint embraces the volatile nature of battle. Durcorach reportedly saw the pattern in the flickering flame of his hearth.
9403.name: The Black Drake's Body Warpaint

9404.description: Combining Daedric elegance with the protection of the wearer's eyes and identity, this mask makes you as mysterious as Oblivion itself.
9404.name: Grave Elegance Mask
9404.hint: Awarded by earning the "Lyranth's Liaison" achievement.

9405.description: "Let the power of the stars wash over you, my friend. Your skin will take on an astral gleam. On hazy nights when constellations grow dim, the Star-Gazers may turn their eyes to you instead!"âOverheard in Belkarth
9405.name: Astral Sheen

9407.description: Those seeking a taste of river life without all the flooding can find everything they need in this cozy bridge home. With both the Outlaws Refuge and Leyawiin Castle just a brief walk away, it's the perfect spot for nobles and lowlifes alike.
9407.name: Water's Edge
9407.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Blackwood Grand Adventurer" Achievement

9408.description: A popular song in Camlorn tells of a white Breton Terrier who wiggles himself into a pile of ashes.  Different singers offer rhyming suggestions on how to clean the terrier, but by the time the chorus is reached the terrier never gets the stain out.
9408.name: Sooty Breton Terrier

9409.description: "Though I agree these pyrelings are fiery and intimidating, I can't believe they acted like ticks on Dragons, as one scholar who shall remain nameless stated in my presence. No, instead I think they are variants native to the Deadlands."âVi Aspblade
9409.name: Scorion Pyreling
9409.hint: Awarded by earning the "Waking Flame Explorer" achievement.

9410.description: There are too many realms to live out your life in just one. With excitement humming in your veins and a pack stuffed with scrawled Daedric maps on your back, step through every portal in your path and let adventure sweep you away.
9410.name: Oblivion Explorer Garb
9410.hint:
|cffffffEquipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.|r

Acquired by completing quest "The Durance Vile."

9411.description: Originally created by a now-forgotten Breton whose search for knowledge of obscure magic led him into the Deadlands, this innovative headgear is a must-have for any wandering the unforgiving wilds of Oblivion.
9411.name: Oblivion Explorer's Headwrap
9411.hint: Awarded by earning the "Welcome to the Deadlands" achievement.

9412.description: The embattled clergy of the Quenching Grail established Pantherfang Chapel in the First Era as a bastion of faith. Part cathedral, part citadel, this edifice still stands as an immortal reminder of Aedric strength. Allows use of the Pledge of Mara.
9412.name: Pantherfang Chapel

9413.description: For many mortals, marking the forehead with a tattoo or war paint is a reminder to fight with deadly intention. Daedra are very different, so it should be no surprise that Xivilai with forehead markings favor savagely headbutting their enemies.
9413.name: Xivilai Rubyfire Linework Visage

9414.description: "I proudly displayed my rubyfire brand while I single-handedly decimated a Dremora regiment at Bellow's Valley. If I see any Xivilai who have fled the field of battle showing their rubyfire marks, I will remove their flesh in strips!"âXalwif
9414.name: Xivilai Rubyfire Linework Brand

9415.description: "I have yet to gather the courage to ask the Xivilai about the markings upon his face. There appear to be dual blades over his eye. Perhaps to aid in seeing through his enemies' feints?"âLady Finalore, kidnapped noble from the Court of Alinor
9415.name: Xivilai Cruelean Linework Visage

9416.description: Mortals see enough familiar shapes in this Xivilai marking to make their hair stand on end. With spiders crawling across their calves and the viper's fangs dripping down their chest, anyone who proudly displays these symbols is an individual to avoid.
9416.name: Xivilai Cruelean Linework Brand

9417.description: Xivilai value independence and prowess over all else. What better way to show individual prowess than a smear of gold to add strength to a jawline and accentuate the murderous glint in an eye?
9417.name: Xivilai Vilegilt Linework Visage

9418.description: Xivilai, unlike the regimented Dremora, have no patience for hierarchies. But, with its gold hue and filigree-like detailing, it's difficult not to think that anyone who bears this pattern isn't royalty of some kind.
9418.name: Xivilai Vilegilt Linework Brand

9419.description: Inspired by their devotion to Xivilai warriors, Gleamwoe cultists in Shadowfen trickle pigment carefully down their cheek and add more dripping lines with every high-ranking noble they kill.
9419.name: Xivilai Gleamwoe Linework Visage

9420.description: The Gleamwoe cultists believe that spreading a salve made of minerals and torchbug innards over their bodies will strengthen their resolve, making them more like Xivilai. Cult leaders gleefully sacrifice initiates who form the intricate lines incorrectly.
9420.name: Xivilai Gleamwoe Linework Brand

9421.description: Said to borrow the marking from Xivilai in the service of Molag Bal, members of the Icy Harvester cult adorn their faces with paint that looks like dripping bruises to show that they embrace the sting of pain.
9421.name: Xivilai Weltwine Linework Visage

9422.description: "Fear not the lash, the spider's bite, the pain of life, nor the chill of death. Mark your form with the symbols of all you fear and, in possessing them, overcome your mortal foolishness."âMilo Silain, Reaper of Molag Bal
9422.name: Xivilai Weltwine Linework Brand

9423.description: As the first roses of the season bloom, Sanguine's followers gather in candlelit gardens to caress each other's faces with inkâtracing a rose-shaped path of pain and pleasure along both brows and cheeks.
9423.name: Thorns of Ecstasy Face Marks

9424.description: The Lord of Revelry's faithful often decorate each other with sacred, floral-based inks. The result? Beautifully rendered roses that bristle with thorns. This alluring design serves as a reminder of Sanguine's great gifts: both bliss and agony.
9424.name: Thorns of Ecstasy Body Marks

9425.description: Hermaeus Mora watches through eyes that are dedicated to him. Those devoted to knowledge add to the Library of Apocrypha by dedicating their eyes to the Daedric Prince and painting on more to give him multiple perspectives on their adventures.
9425.name: Abyssal Embrace Face Markings
9425.hint: Awarded by earning the "Ascending Tide Explorer" achievement.

9426.description: "Hermaeus Mora does not ask much, but those with the unending thirst for knowledge and secrets often wrap their bodies in his tentacles as a sign that they are pledged to Apocrypha."âScholar Aia Laenius, Lillandril
9426.name: Abyssal Embrace Body Markings
9426.hint: Awarded by earning the "Shipwright's Regret Conqueror" achievement.

9427.description: The Crimson Trickster hides his face with painted smiles and eerie grace. Two-thirds red and one-third white, this comic face is quite a sight! If mischief is what brings you glee, this paint will suit your revelry!
9427.name: Crimson Trickster Face Paint

9428.description: Not all is glee and merriment as we live through our years. Wear purple and white upon your face to symbolize our tears.
9428.name: Mirthless Mirror Face Paint

9429.description: Popularized by the legends of the Argonian tribes of Black Marsh that tell of heroes with trees on their cheeks, this face marking shows that you heed the Hist's wisdom. Join the ranks of famed heroes and carry Blackwood with you on all your adventures.
9429.name: Shadows of Blackwood Face Marks
9429.hint: Acquired from the Gates of Oblivion Grab Bag.

9430.description: "Rivers may flow in one direction, but paths can be traveled in two. When dedicating space on your body to something as encompassing as the Blackwood forest, be prepared for the forest itself to judge your worth."âRoot Herald Iokish
9430.name: Shadows of Blackwood Body Marks

9431.description: A favorite of veterinarians and beast masters across Tamriel, these netches are prized for their clear gelatinous outer membranes that allow students to view its organs from a distance.
9431.name: Pellucid Swamp Jelly
9431.hint: Acquired from the Gates of Oblivion Grab Bag.

9432.description: Need to get a word in edgewise? Or want to show off? Become the center of attention by creating an illusory daedroth that briefly mimics your own gestures. None dare ignore this fiery, clawed, and toothy illusion!
9432.name: Daedroth Illusion Gem

9433.description: "Legion Zero is coming with their glowing blue eyes to force that odious sludge down my throat. I can hear them. My only hope is that the transformation is not too painful."âScrap from the journal of Tatius Nerva
9433.name: Coldharbour Corruption Eyes

9434.description: The forest god Y'ffre's blessings manifest in many different ways. Feel your own connection grow as flowers sprout from the vines weaving underneath your verdant skin.
9434.name: Grace of the Green

9435.description: Success in Conjuration requires tremendous willpower and fierce, unshakable focus. Mages who delve deeply into the art of summoning often develop otherworldly features. These violet eyes are a testament to your dedication to the arcane.
9435.name: Conjurer's Eyes

9436.description: Not content to simply bear Akatosh's symbol, some of the Dragon God's most ardent worshipers use magic to adorn their skin with golden scales. Display your devotion to the greatest of the Divines with this resplendent skin!
9436.name: Scales of Akatosh

9437.description: "After much knowledge-seeking, I learned to summon an illusion of a small, fiery Dragon to follow me. While it's not the same as the real thing, that endears me to it more. Who wants a real Dragon around, after all?"âNinaleon Sightbinder the First
9437.name: Soulfire Dragon Illusion

9438.description: The honor of being born under the Serpent is a mixed blessing that heralds life's harshest distresses as well as its sweetest celebrations. Embrace being a charge of the Serpent and hold on to all that comes to you in a crushing embrace.
9438.name: Scales of the Celestial Serpent

9439.description: This Dremnaken may be the runt of its pack, but it is still prepared to follow its leader into danger. It uses its armor to show other Dremnaken that it is every bit as fierce as they are, despite its diminutive size.
9439.name: Dremnaken Runt
9439.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Hope Springs Eternal."

9440.description: Diligent and steadfast heroes like Bastian Hallix still need time to unwind. His chivalrous charm is sure to brighten up any room. After adding Bastian to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9440.name: Bastian Hallix

9441.description: The intrepid explorer, Mirri Elendis, needs a break from her irksome family. With thrilling tales and a sailor's mouth, she's sure to impress! After adding Mirri to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9441.name: Mirri Elendis

9442.description: Granted to the winner of the 2020 Tamriel Together Sweepstakes. After adding Larry, Duke of the Dance to your home, you can set him on a path.
9442.name: Larry, Duke of the Dance

9444.description: "Let lesser vampires scuttle about in the shadows. A true child of Lamae Bal knows the value of light and fashion. Wear this circlet, and you'll attract the gaze of every aristocrat at the ballâeasy prey, eager for domination."âArchblood Delyna
9444.name: Thrafey Debutante Circlet

9445.description: "Long ago, during the annual Ket Keptu hunt, Tula the Skullcleaver and their bear Falk rose above the others in the amount of prey they killed for the shared larder. In celebration, Falk received these markings of Hircine's favor."âFori, Keptu Scholar
9445.name: Keptu Bear

9446.description: Several theories circulate on the nature of the torchnix's light. Some scholars suggest the luminescence is a mating display, while others argue that it's a form of communication. Children in Ahemmusa tell each other the glow is bad food in the nix's gut.
9446.name: Summer's Herald Torchnix

9447.description: Draw attention away from your handsâand perhaps your mischiefâwith this impressive ornament. Though once worn only by Dremora as a sign of status, these flashy diadems now grace the heads of cunning thieves and bold Daedra-slayers alike.
9447.name: Dremora Deceiver's Diadem

9448.description: The cockerels of Alcaire Castle uphold their noble duty and make as much noise during daybreak as possible. Their screeching continues well into the morning, waking any lucky enough to miss out on their earliest morning calls.
9448.name: Alcaire Blue Cockeral

9449.description: Creating a perfect diversion any time it walks behind you, a Rustbite Ringtail's adorably wide eyes never fail to draw a crowd of enamored onlookers. What you do with a crowd of happily distracted townsfolk is your business.
9449.name: Rustbite Ringtail

9450.description: "Now, surely the presence of this creature is enough to dissuade those pompous academics from believing magic created the first Vvardvark. Who would create a creature so listless that moss grows on it?"âAtmore, Vvardenfell Zoological Field Commission
9450.name: Mossy Vvardvark

9451.description: Known for its brilliant yellow hues, this moth flits through the deciduous fall forests of Cyrodiil almost unseen. Each year, some fly beyond the Heartland's borders in all directions, as if trying to escape the war-torn province.
9451.name: Mustardseed Moth

9452.description: Originally, young Keptu bear cubs received fresh markings once each season to gain Hircine's favor. Some seeking to keep the tradition alive continue to mark cubs until these creatures bond to a hunting companion, then share the marking ritual with them.
9452.name: Keptu Bear Cub

9453.description: Only the fiercest and most skilled warrior-smiths of the Ket Keptu earned the right to bear these two-toned face tattoos. Do you craft your own weapons and wield them in battle? If so, wear these marks proudly.
9453.name: Ket Keptu Face Marks

9454.description: Originally solid colors, the markings some Ket Keptu wore to signify their status as warrior-smiths later gained a gradient of hues. Scholars claim this occurred as these pre-Alessians furthered their knowledge of ore refinement and tattoo inks.
9454.name: Ket Keptu Body Marks

9455.description: The gems of this coronal glitter even when the night is dark and the winter drags on. The headpiece serves as a reminder that hope sleeps beneath the snow, ready to flourish for anyone with the strength to wait for the thaw.
9455.name: Hopesbud Coronal

9456.description: "Sheogorath tortured butterflies. Did you know that? If one wants to rest on my head, then so be it. As far as I'm concerned it could use a break. Besides, I think my new friend is rather fetching, don't you?"âDuchess Carmyne, Hegathe Palace
9456.name: Monarch Hairpin

9457.description:
Gifted to Bastian when he was still a boy, this medallion depicts the logician's triangle in polished bronze. The edges have grown dull, the result of frequent use as a worry talisman.

Permanently grants the passive "Bastian's Insight" to the bearer.
9457.name: Bastian's Julianos Medallion

9458.description:
Hewn from basalt, this idol merges all three Good Daedra into single grotesque effigy. While some might consider such an object hideous, Mirri regards it as one of her greatest finds.

Permanently grants the passive "Mirri's Expertise" to the bearer.
9458.name: Ancient Anticipations Idol
9458.hint: Acquired by completing the "Treasured Comrade" achievement.

9459.description: "The hues on these reefborn steedsâwondrous, yes? Instead of flowing manes on these so-called equines, colorful coral grew. Just don't try to feed them apples. They prefer to feed on algal blooms."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9459.name: Reefborn Charger

9460.description: "Those who love wolves may find this breed boosts their prestige in some Abecean coastal areas, especially among the druid folk. While you need stern discipline to train this one to saddle, you gain a lifelong adventuring partner."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9460.name: Reefborn Wolf

9461.description: "Mages Guild scholars think someone creates these types of senches. With what magic, I don't know. Maybe some sea-loving druid? Regardless, they're as fierce as you'd expect for a senche mount."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9461.name: Reefborn Senche-Lion

9462.description: Foolhardy warriors travel into the charred Deadlands forests to face off against the ursine horrors that reside there. Lucky adventurers return to their homelands alive, but forever haunted by the sound of red-hot claws digging into ashen dirt.
9462.name: Nightmare Bear

9463.description: "If you visit Abecean islands, you need to be ready to handle reefborn creatures. The bears, for example, do bear things. Mostly. But watch them near saltwaterâthey'll roll in it whether you're on them or not."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9463.name: Reefborn Bear

9464.description: "You'll find few wild guars wandering Abecean shores, but these coral beasts dance in the shallows nonetheless. Wherever they came from, they still exhibit the tamed guars' playful disposition."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9464.name: Reefborn Guar

9465.description: Trophy taken from Xalvakka in honor of an Undaunted victory in Rockgrove.
9465.name: Trophy: Xalvakka

9466.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Rockgrove.
9466.name: Bust: Xalvakka

9467.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Maniacal Jester style.
9467.name: Maniacal Jester Maul

9468.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Maniacal Jester style.
9468.name: Maniacal Jester Bow

9469.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Maniacal Jester style.
9469.name: Maniacal Jester Shield

9470.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Maniacal Jester style.
9470.name: Maniacal Jester Staff

9471.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Maniacal Jester style.
9471.name: Maniacal Jester Dagger

9472.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9472.name: Crimson Oath Cuirass

9473.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9473.name: Crimson Oath Helm

9474.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9474.name: Crimson Oath Pauldrons

9475.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9475.name: Crimson Oath Greaves

9476.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9476.name: Crimson Oath Girdle

9477.name: Crimson Oath Gauntlets

9478.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9478.name: Crimson Oath Sabatons

9479.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9479.name: Crimson Oath Jack

9480.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9480.name: Crimson Oath Helmet

9481.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9481.name: Crimson Oath Guards

9482.name: Crimson Oath Belt

9483.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9483.name: Crimson Oath Arm Cops

9484.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9484.name: Crimson Oath Boots

9485.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9485.name: Crimson Oath Bracers

9486.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9486.name: Crimson Oath Jerkin

9487.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9487.name: Crimson Oath Hat

9488.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9488.name: Crimson Oath Breeches

9489.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9489.name: Crimson Oath Epaulets

9490.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9490.name: Crimson Oath Sash

9491.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9491.name: Crimson Oath Shoes

9492.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9492.name: Crimson Oath Gloves

9493.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9493.name: Crimson Oath Robe

9494.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9494.name: Crimson Oath Battle Axe

9495.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9495.name: Crimson Oath Maul

9496.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9496.name: Crimson Oath Greatsword

9497.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9497.name: Crimson Oath Axe

9498.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9498.name: Crimson Oath Bow

9499.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9499.name: Crimson Oath Mace

9500.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9500.name: Crimson Oath Shield

9501.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9501.name: Crimson Oath Staff

9502.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9502.name: Crimson Oath Sword

9503.description: Learned from the Crimson Oath crafting style, acquired by completing the Dread Cellar Dungeon.
9503.name: Crimson Oath Dagger

9505.description: "I wrapped my body in the kelp and coral of a sea-bound Nereid and frolicked in the tidepools as I did in childhood. All should enjoy the freedom of Nereid attire as I have."âOceanographic Society Director, Vaerwyeana
9505.name: Nereid's Seafoam Raiment

9506.description: Born of waves and foam, saltwater Nereids clothe themselves in whatever materials lay scattered about the sea floor. They're masters at turning coral, pearls, and kelp into stunning headdresses that anyone would be honored to wear.
9506.name: Nereid's Seafoam Coiffure

9507.description: "Some claim these elk originate from necromantic rituals involving restless spirits. Perhaps, I say. Regardless, these fawns make for delightful companions, though they'll sometimes stare at nothing for hours."âPhrastus of Elinhir
9507.name: Palefrost Elk Fawn

9508.description: The Abecean Sea is fraught with dangers, but your mastery of all things nautical and the feel of your scallop-topped leather boots adds a swagger to your step. Dressed like this, even the fiercest pirates will know better than to challenge you at port.
9508.name: Abecean Privateer's Apparel

9509.description: Dance in joyful waters and cavort in turbulent tributaries while flaunting the brilliant blues of the Riversiren Nereid. While you may not choose to live in the waters of Tamriel's rivers, you'll certainly make a vibrant splash wherever you go.
9509.name: Rainsiren Nereid

9510.description: Moonlight glints off glittering snowflakes during a ritual to imbue a white elk with the intelligence of a ghost captured from the frigid seas near Jehannaâor so claims High Rock lore. True or not, this steed understands more than most expect.
9510.name: Palefrost Elk Mount

9511.description: Granted to the winner of the 2020 Tamriel Together Sweepstakes.
9511.name: Statue of Gloria

9512.description: All Star-Born horses are children of the Steed. Impatient and in a rush, these creatures are difficult to tame. Any time spent earning their trust is always recovered the second they're allowed to canter down an open road.
9512.name: Star-Born Guardian Horse

9513.description: "Don't let this bear's mesmerizing stars fool you into thinking it's a harmless bit of magical transport. Recall the sway of the Constellations, and understand that this creature embodies that power."âWheezing Wilren
9513.name: Star-Born Guardian Bear

9514.description: Legends in Fulstrom say that a star-studded guar brought the bastard child of King Vrage to their village one snowy night. No one heard or saw the pair arrive, until a child cried out for warmth. The guar disappeared before dawn.
9514.name: Star-Born Guardian Guar

9515.description: Senches are opinionated creatures, but ones imbued with the confidence of the stars are infinitely more judgmental than their Nirn-born counterparts. Riding one of these across Tamriel is a clear sign that even the stars heed your power.
9515.name: Star-Born Guardian Senche

9516.description: "There's something out there, stalking me through the dark underbrush. My eyes deceive me and see only stars moving across a starless sky. They growl and bare their pointed teeth. Vaermina take pity."âHavaldar the Crazed
9516.name: Star-Born Guardian Wolf

9517.description: A painting of Leyawiin, the Nibenese city standing at the mouth of the Niben River and known for its majestic chapel honoring Zenithar.
9517.name: Painting: Leyawiin Awaits

9518.description: Any who seek to find loopholes in the Stricture of Fargrave know better than to do so when they see these Grasp-favored facial designs nearby. You may not be of the Grasp, but giving shady Daedra pause while in the Bazaar? Worth the marks!
9518.name: Fargrave Soullattice Face Marks
9518.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Against All Hope."

9519.description: Those who uphold the dictates of Fargrave's Stricture often adorn their bodies with this indigo latticework design. Now that they're available to those outside the Grasp, perhaps you, too, are interested in helping Fargrave maintain Daedric neutrality?
9519.name: Fargrave Soullattice Body Marks
9519.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Against All Hope."

9521.description: Jakarn is rugged, practical, and dashing. Dressing like him ensures that you never look like you're trying too hard. His well-tailored clothes always fetch the eyes of tavern beauties and never chafe when riding a stallion into the sunset.
9521.name: Jakarn's Ensemble

9522.description: This mask and cloth cap combination became popular with pirates and invaders alike for its ability to hide the wearer's features without sacrificing their threatening appearance.
9522.name: Savvy Scoundrel's Mask

9523.description: A perfect replica of the Adytum Gate from the Zenithar Abbey.
9523.name: Replica Zenithar Adytum Gate
9523.hint: Created by combining 50 Inscribed Shards from the Zenithar Abbey in Blackwood.

9524.description: Exquisitely designed, this warm-hued tapestry of Blackwood serves as both an art piece and a practical guide to the region.
9524.name: Blackwood Tapestry
9524.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Blackwood.

9525.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Baron Zaudrus style.
9525.name: Baron Zaudrus Maul

9526.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Baron Zaudrus style.
9526.name: Baron Zaudrus Bow

9527.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Baron Zaudrus style.
9527.name: Baron Zaudrus Shield

9528.name: Baron Zaudrus Staff

9529.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Baron Zaudrus style.
9529.name: Baron Zaudrus Dagger

9530.description: With a flick of your wrist, show the world and fellow |cffffffgroup members|r that you are an initiate of a witch's coven, creating bonfire flames that dance in hues of purple and green.
9530.name: Witch's Bonfire Dust

9531.description: The delicious energy of Daedric artifacts tantalizes, looking for ways to corrupt more deeply. The first taste tickles the senses, creating cravings for more at any costâand inevitably leaves its chaotic stamp on the faces of those who feast.
9531.name: Shattered Chivalry Face Tattoo
9531.hint: Awarded by earning the "Arcane Analyst" achievement.

9532.description: The whispers of Oblivion slither through the halls of Red Petal Bastionâdrawing its guardians ever deeper into the Daedra's embrace. These once-noble warriors forsook their oaths to pursue dark artifactsâbut remain forever marked by their choice.
9532.name: Shattered Chivalry Body Tattoo
9532.hint: Awarded by earning the "Red Petal Bastion Conqueror" achievement.

9565.description: "When Sir Byric's flames razed the ground outside our walls and the Reachfolk hurled stones at our walls. I stood tall at my post, knowing that our smallest knights padded the ramparts alongside me."âSir Hughes, Alcaire Castle
9565.name: Knights of the Flame Pup

9566.description: A miniature statue of Sai Sahan, the liberator of Leyawiin.
9566.name: Statuette: Sai Sahan, Deliverer

9567.description: A miniature statue of Zenithar, holding an anvil.
9567.name: Statuette: Zenithar, God of Toil

9568.description: The Khajiit called M'aiq the Liar travels widely, speaking foolishlyâor wisely, depending on whom you ask. Host him before deciding, yes? After adding M'aiq to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9568.name: M'aiq the Liar

9569.description: Is your home bedecked in shiny treasures? Did you leave carrion out in the sun? Regardless, Blackfeather Court's most nettlesome squire noticed! After adding Squire Caw to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9569.name: Squire Caw

9570.description: Trained in the Battlespire, Lucilla Caprenia made a decision that altered her future. As she ponders her next steps, invite her into your abode! After adding Lucilla to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9570.name: Lucilla Caprenia

9571.description: A painting of the Havocrel named Baron Zaudrus, defeating those who oppose him.
9571.name: Painting: Baron Zaudrus Triumphs

9572.description: Though still feared by those traveling to and from Amenos, the ornaug packs native to local waters can serve as loyal steeds if tamed and trained. Or so say the prisoners dreaming of freedom on that prison isle.
9572.name: Amenos Ornaug

9573.description: As swift as the waves at high tide, this steed's gallop is unmatched. With its glowing mane and shining tail, night riding on this Surfglow Courser is the most sublime experiences known to equestrians.
9573.name: Surfglow Courser

9574.description: "Like Spriggans roam the glades on land, so does this creature prowl around the tidepools. Its gnarled wooden bones sprout with aquatic life. If it sees me, I'm sure it'll tear my throat out."âScrap from the lost journal of Teldh
9574.name: Cat O' War Senche Lion

9575.description: "Do these coral spiders simply mimic Dwarven spiders or did coral grow over a discarded animunculus? I haven't pried one open to find outâthey really don't like that, so don't even try."âWheezing Wilren
9575.name: Coral Crawler Dwarven Spider

9576.description: Ride in style with a close friend or partner on this sturdy Skyrim-bred draft horse! With its pillion saddle crafted from genuine horker leather, this horse possesses strength to take two riders without breaking a sweat.
9576.name: Grand Pillion Draft Horse

9577.description: The cat's eyes seem to speak, saying, "Jolly good to see you! We appear to have a small blight of rodents. Dreadful crawling things. Scuttling everywhere. Hmm, skittering blights. I knew a good joke about that. What? Oh, yes. Lovely day for a hunt!"
9577.name: Catwell

9578.description: "The mythic texts of discredited scholars are right, the Great Dark Ram lives! Hircine appears in this form only during Rain's Hand in the Great Forest. Soon, there will be the trials of virility. I hope my strength endures."âLost Journal of Bekelva
9578.name: Great Dark Ram

9579.description: With a design that harkens back to Nerevar's Moon and Star ring, these earrings are worn by the leaders of Ashlander tribes. They believe the iconic symbol wards off the words of false incarnates and keeps them from successfully corrupting the tribe.
9579.name: Moon-and-Star Earrings

9580.description: Ask not who has two thumbs upâit's you.
9580.name: Two Thumbs Up

9581.description: These jerks are really asking for it! When you're ready to settle an argument the old-fashioned way, express it with this aggressive emote.
9581.name: Fight Me

9582.description: Sublime doesn't even begin to describe the perfection you just experienced. No, for that only a gesture will doâthis gesture!
9582.name: Chef Kiss

9583.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Prior Thierric style.
9583.name: Prior Thierric Greatsword

9588.name: Prior Thierric Mask
9588.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Prior Thierric Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

9589.name: Prior Thierric Shoulder
9589.hint: This Style is obtainable only while the Prior Thierric Arms Pack is available, as they are inviolably bound to one another.

9590.description: Create a rattling bone colossus illusion that momentarily matches your own movements, and cow any who dare oppose you!
9590.name: Bone Colossus Illusion Gem

9591.description: While concentrating on this stone, pain breaks you into slivers of individualized torment. Seconds later, you reform. Impressive? Definitely. But dare you repeat the excruciating experience?
9591.name: Agonymium Stone
9591.hint: Awarded by earning the "The Dread Cellar Conqueror" achievement.

9631.name: Trophy: Prior Thierric Sarazen
9631.hint: Awarded for completing Red Petal Bastion.

9632.description: Trophy taken from the Magma Incarnate in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Dread Cellar.
9632.name: Trophy: Magma Incarnate
9632.hint: Awarded for completing The Dread Cellar.

9633.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Red Petal Bastion.
9633.name: Bust: Prior Thierric Sarazen
9633.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Red Petal Bastion.

9634.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Dread Cellar.
9634.name: Bust: Magma Incarnate
9634.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran The Dread Cellar.

9635.description: Alchemists in Cey-Tarn Keep fashion mount armor out of specially treated Culanda stones. No alchemist will say exactly what properties the resulting meadowglass has, but scouts riding meadowglass armored wolves have yet to be captured.
9635.name: Meadowglass Wolf

9636.description: Tainted by proximity to active harrowstorms, these bears have become hexed abominationsâperfect for warriors with cold blood and dark intentions.
9636.name: Harrowstorm Bear

9637.description: Happiest when climbing their native Valus Mountains, these sure-footed mounts grudgingly accept both saddle and reins for as long as their rider allows them to keep movingâor provides them with prodigious amounts of mountain flower treats.
9637.name: Clawhorn Mountain Goat

9638.description: "Grant your skin the vibrant hues of Culanda with this luminescent golden enchantment! That's what they promised, these Summerset High Elves, and they deliveredâmagnificently! People's eyes light up when I enter the room!"âTarquinius Truptor, Esquire
9638.name: Culanda-Born Skin

9639.description: No one knows how these beasts found their way into Blackreach, but it didn't take long for them to heed the Dark Heart's call. Drenched in the void's corruption, this mount will chill your enemies to the bone.
9639.name: Voideater Durzog

9640.description: These small Daedric worms may follow visitors around the Deadlands or Apocrypha to appease their curiosity. Some continue to tag along after their chosen mortal on Nirn!
9640.name: Skitteris

9641.description: Oh yeah, you're totally done with this. Whatever "this" is.
9641.name: Wash My Hands of This

9642.description: What's going on here? Where am I? Express your total lack of comprehension with this bewildered emote.
9642.name: Befuddled

9643.description: Bred for their lithe frame and large eyes, these senches excel at tracking prey through the dark underbrush of Balfiera. The Direnni Hegemony fell, but their senches prowl on, hunting during the night and sharpening their claws during the day.
9643.name: Balfiera Senche Cub

9644.description: Face the world with a maniacal grin while wearing this fiendish garment. Whether you're capering during Jester's Festival or cavorting amid Daedric foes, none will forget the menacing terror of your presence.
9644.name: Garb of Grinning Horrors

9645.description: Cey-Tarn Keep dog-handlers made armor training wolf pups a priority after older members of the pack gnawed their plate-harnesses to pieces. The practice lives on in this pup who proudly displays his Elven panoply as he trots beside his owner.
9645.name: Meadowglass Wolf Pup

9646.description: Fashionable nobles would never sully their fine court clothes with the dirt of travel. They wear simpleâyet still elegantârobes while riding between castles, and display their wealth in the silver fastenings holding the robes together.
9646.name: Courtly Traveling Attire
9646.hint: Awarded by earning the "Peace in Our Time?" achievement.

9647.description: "I've seen the whole world, but my eyes aren't what they used to be. Thanks to your spectacles, I'll be able to see a bit more of it before I'm forced to settle down."âLetter of thanks written by Lady Arabelle Davaux to Lorb, Glassblower
9647.name: Scholar's Spectacles

9648.description: Maybe you want to comically refuse an offer or bemoan an unlucky result. Or maybe you actually have no dice. Either way, this emote has you covered.
9648.name: No Dice

9649.description: Forged in the fires of the Deadlands, this lava-ringed plateau features a stunning view of Daedric landmarks and a solid foundation on which to build your very own Daedric dwelling. Live dangerously within the realm controlled by Prince Mehrunes Dagon!
9649.name: Doomchar Plateau

9650.description: Liven up Tamriel with your rakish lunacyâand keep people on their toes with your dagger-sharp wit. Plus actual daggers. Or hammers for those dullards who don't get the jest.
9650.name: Maniacal Jester

9651.description: On an oft overlooked little islet among the Summerset Isles, big trouble is brewing. Help the cagey Captain Kaleen lead a daring rescue of one of her former crew from the dissidents of the Ascendant Order and recover what they stole.
9651.name: Coral Aerie

9652.description: Join Captain Za'ji's quest to perfect the Perfect Pounce using the secrets of the finest shipbuilders in Tamrielâprovided they can still be found in the rolling fog, thick overgrowth, and haunted remnants of the Shipwright's Regret.
9652.name: Shipwright's Regret
