12235.description: Some may call Tanlorin a rabble-rouser or rapscallion. They much prefer being called a friend. After adding Tanlorin to your home, you can set them on a path to wander. You can also speak with them. But be warned, they're a bit of a talker.
12235.name: Tanlorin
12235.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Of Crown and Flowers."

12236.description: Though far from his own time, Zerith-var is sure to brighten any living space with his thoughtful observations and warm company. After adding Zerith to your home, you and guests can speak to him. You can also let him wander by setting him on a path.
12236.name: Zerith-var
12236.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Dark Behind the World."

12237.description: These mesmerizing creatures hail from the Daedric realm of Mirrormoor. Unlike some of the other denizens of that realm, Crystaljacks appear to be organic in nature, with shimmering skin that simply mimics the appearance of mirrored surfaces.
12237.name: Crystaljack
12237.hint: Obtained by completing quest "In Memory Of."

12238.description: "Change cannot be denied. Yet some wish to thwart it, finding comfort in stasis. In stagnation. These I seek out in the way of seers so that ku-vastei may deal with them. Once they clear the path, needed change occurs."âClaw Seer Deelith-Xul
12238.name: Claw Seer of Sithis

12239.description: Why am I not out adventuring? Just look down. There's an arrow, right there in my knee. The healer says I need to leave it be. But my adventuring days are behind me. Does that answer your question?
12239.name: Adventure-Ending Arrow

12240.description: Something about this entrancing orb feels â¦ off. Perhaps give it a try for the sake of knowledge? Just be ready for anything!
12240.name: Accursed Recall

12241.description: Why break a sweat by chopping wood yourself when you can have a Dwarven Sphere do it for you?
12241.name: Dwarven Sphere Chop

12242.description: "Well this is just ostentatious. Instead of doing the hard work of mining you want to, what. Summon a meteor to do it for you? Ridiculous!" âTelenger the Artificer
12242.name: Meteor Mining

12243.description: "Never underestimate any foe. And that includes the wilds of Wrothgar. Even the plants put up a fight here, which is why I use my ancestor's sharpest dagger and pray to Malacath with each sweep."âGhaz of Orsinium
12243.name: Malacath's Harvest

12244.description: The people of Riverhold have bred these horses for generations. The result is a line of bright-eyed and faithful steeds, eager to please with their rich chestnut coat. On the road, few horses are steadier or more reliable.
12244.name: Riverhold Chestnut Horse

12245.description: Very few mounts take to battle as readily as a warbear. This one answers only to the strength of its rider. Between its fierce disposition and ursine defenses, it has little to fear from any foes on the battlefield.
12245.name: Dragonclaw Imperial Warbear
12245.hint: Acquired by completing the "Imperial Warbear Seeker" Achievement.

12246.description: "Varkenel did not pull the first vvardvark out of his hat. Why do you let this charlatan keep performing this trick when you know it's historically inaccurate? I agree it's cute, but accuracy matters!"âFrom a letter sent to Captain Aresin of Daggerfall
12246.name: Varkenel's Hat Trick

12247.description: "I thought I was kept busy before I became a mage's apprentice. Now, if I'm not learning something new, I have to practice. Every. Waking. Moment. No idle hands for me!"âHreilund of Shad Astula
12247.name: Apprentice's Idle Magic

12248.description: By necessity, all compositions for these intricate instruments are relatively new. Dwarven musicians are vexingly unavailable for consultation. Still, bards at the college in Solitude find it an exciting challenge. What music can you coax from it?
12248.name: Play Glass Armonica

12249.description: "Upon their brow the marks of heroism are borne. Let these symbols show all the peoples of Nirn that this bearer is a bringer of light and justice, and that no evil shall flourish where they go."âThe Seer's Adoration, translated
12249.name: Face Art of the Five Companions

12250.description: The bravery of the Five Companions lives on in the next generation of heroes. Those eager to embrace the courage of valiants such as Lyris Titanborn and Sai Sahan emblazon legendary deeds upon their bodies.
12250.name: Body Art of the Five Companions

12251.description: All destinies may be changed, as the children of Mirrormoor know all too well. They wear glimmering threads upon their skin, to remind themselves that fate and the future are of one's own making.
12251.name: Threads of Mirrormoor Face Art
12251.hint: Acquired by completing the "Retrieval Specialist" achievement.

12252.description: "The threads of fate live within us all, weaving all reality together in a terrible, beautiful tapestry. It is a gift to be bound within this complex existence. Do not try to fight it."âCipher Ascien
12252.name: Threads of Mirrormoor Body Art
12252.hint: Acquired by completing the "Lucent Citadel Conqueror" achievement.

12253.description: "Be mindful of wandering too long in the Infinite Archive, mortal. Even the most experienced scholar cannot comprehend all the dangers and delights of this place. And I really don't have time to go looking for you."âFiler Eru
12253.name: Veteran of the Infinite Face Art
12253.hint: Acquired by completing the "Veteran of the Infinite" achievement.

12254.description: The Infinite Archive is a trove of hoarded knowledge and untold secrets. Those who can fight off the many dangers may find what they seek, although most explorers leave with more than they bargained for.
12254.name: Veteran of the Infinite Body Art
12254.hint: Acquired by completing the "Archival Veteran" achievement.

12255.description: "My mother wasn't pleased when she saw what I had inked on my scales. She would've preferred a rendition of the Hist or something from the Black Marsh. But I just like roses more."âPaints-with-Mud, Murkmire
12255.name: Rose of Tamriel Face Marks

12256.description: The flora of Tamriel has long been a source of inspiration for artists. Tea lovers and provisioners in particular may appreciate the more subtle qualities of the rose, but the plant's striking appearance has a wide artistic appeal as well.
12256.name: Rose of Tamriel Body Marks

12257.description: "Many strange and wonderous things hail from Mirrormoor. Perhaps this creature walked here along the threads of fate to assist you on your journey."âKeeper Adiir
12257.name: Refulgent Mirrormoor Steed
12257.hint: Acquired by completing the "Knot Worthy" achievement.

12258.description: "To follow the Dawnway requires faith. We are returning to our rootsâto the old magic that the Wild Elves used. You can't expect it to be without its share of weeds. Still, the Green provides."âPriest Nothelas, Vashabar
12258.name: Wildburn Lynx
12258.hint: Acquired by completing the "Savior of West Weald" achievement.

12259.description: "The great expanse between the planes of the Aurbis is endless night, the Outer Darkness of the Void. Some few things, blessedly few things, live in this endless nothingness. And they are strange beyond imagining."âAzandar al-Cybiades
12259.name: Hollowsoul Steed

12260.description: "Why the flowers? Because this one finds them beautiful, that's why. Charging into battle together does not mean we can't enjoy their colors. And a battlefield littered with petals is a sight to behold."âMathi-jo
12260.name: Ardor's Devotion Senche-Raht

12261.description: It is said that when the bloodlust of Hircine's Huntsmen goes unsated for too long, the collective prey drive forms a will and a shape of its own. Once its quarry is scented, the wolf will pursue at all costs, never stopping until it tastes blood.
12261.name: Bloodmoon Wolf

12262.description: Animal husbandry experts from Hammerfell and Wrothgar came together in a unique Covenant collaboration to create a good-natured pack animal with a hearty constitution and a pleasing aesthetic. The soft-coated, lovable brekka is the result.
12262.name: Russet Brekka

12263.description: "It's a strange creature, no doubt about that. I'm not sure if it's a bear that became enchanted too close to the sea, or a magical oceanic construct that just happens to look like a bear. Either way, it's a good swimmer."âMage Adept Erwan Cottret
12263.name: Shoal Bear

12264.description: Not all of Molag Bal's eyes are as vigilant as the Prince would like, it would seem. This one exhibits open curiosity about the world! The blinking certainly is creepy, though.
12264.name: Coldharbour Ocular Observer

12265.description: Though you may not truly be a Minotaur, you can take on challenges in the name of Morihaus and bring further honor to his name.
12265.name: Minotaur

12266.description: "This one has always admired the owls around here. Very wise creatures. Most do not get too close, even when offered treats. Most, but not all. This is Hooty. A very clever name, yes? What else does one call a pet owl?"âTraveling Merchant J'margo
12266.name: Senchal Horned Owl

12267.description: Stand majestically before an audience as the living statue of the Warlock God! Just remember not to fidget. You're a statue now, after all.
12267.name: Syrabane Living Statue

12268.description:
Look at you! So scary when wearing Malacath's helm. Oh, oops. Maybe you weren't meant to wear it for long?

You cannot use this if you have a polymorph equipped.
12268.name: Malacath Helm Haunt
12268.hint: Acquired by completing the "Oathsworn Pit Conqueror" achievement.

12269.description:
Tho'at Replicanum's presence corrupts much of the archive, but corrupted relics can still be useful. 

When used within the Infinite Archive, the Eye summons a maligraphic Watcher who will aid you in the archival wings.
12269.name: Eye of the Infinite
12269.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive.

12270.description: Twinkling candleflies and languorous willow trees set a cozy scene for this retreat nestled near a peaceful pond. Waterfalls and scenic views complete this serene living nook on the edge of Blackwood.
12270.name: Willowpond Haven

12271.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Order of the Lamp style.
12271.name: Order of the Lamp Girdle

12272.description: This is a small house item.
12272.name: Apocryphal Tome

12273.description: When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the profound "Oath of the Keepers" composition.
12273.name: Music Box, Oath of the Keepers

12408.description:
A gauntlet lined with leather tanned from the hides of the unworthy. None shall escape your iron grasp!

A component required for the Master of Schemes personality.
12408.name: Cold Iron Gauntlet

12409.description:
Smiles are a sign of weakness. One true masters of the world cannot afford.

A component required for the Master of Schemes personality.
12409.name: Grim Iron Mask

12410.description:
Which of the innumerable tyrants that Tamriel has known wound up trapped inside this crystal prison? It matters little; their power will be added to your own.

A component required for the Master of Schemes personality.
12410.name: Tyrant's Soul Gem

12411.description: "Are predators menacing your barnyard? Well, the Potion Peddler has an elixir for you! In seconds, my potion can increase the size of your rooster. Then you can watch him chase all those pesky foxes away! "âNotice plastered on a Skingrad wall
12411.name: Potion Peddler

12412.description: Forged by Hermaeus Mora, the Echonir collects remnants of ancient memories and shows them to you. Perhaps a closer examination is in order before the Lord of Secrets reclaims it.
12412.name: Echonir Examination
12412.hint: Acquired by completing the "Bedlam Veil Conqueror" achievement.

12413.description:
Eri has been expertly trained by Nord beast tamers to act as a very good (such a good!) personal banker for you and your groupmates. 

He doesn't venture to Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds. Too much violence, not enough pets.
12413.name: Eri, Barking Banker

12414.description:
Xyn travels the Daedric realms looking for profitable opportunities. They'll happily take your goods (or those of your groupmates) in exchange for common mortal coinage.

Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.
12414.name: Xyn, Planar Purveyor

12416.description: "The metamorphic nature of the voriplasm is a bit of a passion of mine. Nothing in all of Tamriel is as adaptive as this simple-minded gel. My lab sample collection grows daily, showing unbelievable specificity in their adaptations."âGabrielle Benele
12416.name: Vineyard Voriplasm

12417.description: A miniature statue of Auriel, King of the Aldmer. Based on the storied effigy of the same name in the ruins of Garlas Agea along the Gold Coast.
12417.name: Statuette: Auriel of Garlas Agea

12418.description: A miniature statue of Peryite, the Daedric Prince of Pestilence.
12418.name: Statuette: Peryite, Blightlord

12419.description: Located within the Scar in Northern Elsweyr, the Stitches draws the eye of many an artist seeking the challenge of illustrating a more vertically oriented settlement.
12419.name: Painting: The Stitches

12420.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Lucent Citadel.
12420.name: Bust: Orphic Shattered Shard
12420.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Lucent Citadel.

12421.description: Trophy taken from the Orphic Shattered Shard in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Lucent Citadel.
12421.name: Trophy: Orphic Shattered Shard

12422.description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake calls upon his prodigious experience to provide you with a celebratory taste that somehow encapsulates ten years of adventuring in Tamriel and beyond.
12422.name: Jubilee Cake 2024
12422.hint: Obtained by completing the 2024 Anniversary event.

12423.description: Nix-oxen are incredibly adaptable, thriving across Tamriel. This subspecies developed bright markings to attract one another across the heat waves of the desert. Their long legs also allow them to cross the sands easily and stay cool in harsh conditions.
12423.name: Oasis-Strider Nix-Ox

12424.description: The gifting of live animals is sometimes practiced among Mara's faithful as a sign of a couple's commitment to one another. Though bears are rarely used for this purpose, this one is immeasurably affectionate, with soft fur that begs to be petted.
12424.name: Mara's Awe Bear

12425.description: Unassuming at a glance, the closer one looks at a mirrorworm, the more mesmerizing they become. The creature's soft form is protected by glistening reflective scales that also serve to confuse and intimidate would-be predators.
12425.name: Mirrorworm

12426.description: "People say you should be wary of shadows, but what about blinding white snow? When you get disoriented in a blizzard, when you can't tell up from down anymore, that's when the snowclaws will strike! I can feel it."âLast journal entry of Hunter Keedru
12426.name: Snowclaw Senche-Serval

12427.description: Stylized raven art exists in several Tamrielic cultures. Artist-Adept Aimira, who created this tattoo, wanted something minimalist to draw attention to the eyes. "I pulled on the themes I used in the body art. The overall effect is fierce, is it not?"
12427.name: Unkindness of Ravens Face Art
12427.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Siege of Cyrodiil Merits, available by completing District Quests in the Imperial City, with a Siege of Cyrodiil Laureate, available for purchase from Tel Var General Merchants in the Imperial City.

12428.description: As an assassin in the Morag Tong, Ashur takes his work deathly seriously. Invite him to stay and you need never worry about uninvited visitors. After adding Ashur to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
12428.name: Ashur

12429.description: After a Necrom ancestor spirit persuaded her to see more of the world, Miraso decided to accomplish this by taking on jobs in private residences across Tamriel and beyond. Will you take her on? After adding Miraso to your home, you can set her on a path.
12429.name: Necrom Guard Miraso

12430.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Gold Road Dragoon style.
12430.name: Gold Road Dragoon Jack 2

12437.name: Trueflame Sword Replica
12437.hint: Acquired rarely from Fishing during the Anniversary Jubilee.

12438.name: Staff of Worms Replica
12438.hint: Acquired rarely from Dolmens during the Anniversary Jubilee.

12439.name: Sunna'rah Replica

12440.hint: Acquired rarely from World Bosses in Vvardenfell during the Anniversary Jubilee.

12441.description: An Outfit look for staff weapons.
12441.name: Ul'vor Staff Replica
12441.hint: Acquired rarely from Abyssal Geysers during the Anniversary Jubilee.

12444.description: "While it won't cut a path to Mirrormoor, this echo of the sword crafted by Boethiah nonetheless looks impressive. Just watch where you swing it."
12444.name: Echo of the Abolisher
12444.hint: Acquired by completing the "Echo of the Abolisher" achievement.

12445.description: This fragment of the Memory Stone created by Hermaeus Mora may not have the powers of the fully intact version, but it can play with your vision for a time.
12445.name: Echonir Fragment
12445.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Untraveled Road."

12446.description: Is it a celebration if there's no dancing? Why bother answering this question when you can immediately show the world your passionate dance moves on any festive occasion.
12446.name: Celebratory Dance

12447.description: Never again want for a nightlight with this enchanted, flaming larval yaghra at your side. Just beware that while it does keep the darkness at bay, prolonged exposure to its horrible legs and beady little eyes has been known to increase nightmares.
12447.name: Nightflame Larval Yaghra

12448.description: Perhaps the only thing sweeter than this cub are the snuggles it happily bestows on anyone it sees. It's rather addictive, and many who've begun petting the cub find it incredibly difficult to stop. Somehow, it always smells like roses.
12448.name: Mara's Awe Cub

12449.description: "Things that sink in the swamp never truly leave the cold embrace of the muck. Their tormented ends infuse the very land itself, haunting and changing the few living creatures that survive in that wretched place."âSwamp Songs: A History
12449.name: Sepulchral Swamp Jelly

12450.description: Some would argue that bearing the image of Molag Bal for something as trifling as a masquerade is borderline folly, but to the mask-loving revelers of Tamriel, the Prince's iconic silhouette is simply too good to pass up.
12450.name: Molag Bal Masquerade

12451.description: Naturally, the Queen of the High Elves is no stranger to tiaras, but don't mistake this circlet for mere adornment. Forged with precious metals, Ayrenn's circlet is unyielding in its strengthâmuch like the queen herself.
12451.name: Queen Ayrenn's Aldmeri Circlet

12452.description: The glint of gold tempts many. Wear this at your local Carnaval party to draw a greedy gaze.
12452.name: Golden Eye Gaze

12453.description: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, so they say. Although the soothsayers probably didn't mean it to be quite so literal.
12453.name: Fabulous Diamond Eyes

12454.description: "A great cry rose up across all of Nirn at the time of the Soulburst. None who felt it were ever the same, and those who saw it were forever marked by that day."âThe Forlorn Soul, translated
12454.name: Soulburst Face Soulmarkings

12455.description: The Soulburst was not merely a physical event, but a sundering of all the souls on Nirn. Such a catastrophe had never been felt on this plane before. The survivors were often changed, sometimes bearing an outward reminder of their own soul-deep struggle.
12455.name: Soulburst Body Soulmarkings

12456.description: Breezes carry verdant scents from the nearby jungle to caress the sand gardens in this former Desert Wind adeptorium. Though no longer a site of Khajiit practicing a dual-sword technique, this riverside location serves well as a meditative getaway.
12456.name: Zhan Khaj Crest

12457.description: Though adorable at this tender age, Bloodmoon pups still possess the incredible hunting drive of their adult counterparts. However, their hunts often lead to squirrels and insects, and a falling leaf is more than enough to distract them from the scent.
12457.name: Bloodmoon Wolf Pup

12458.description: Having been created through selective breeding and magic, quasigriffs have a penchant for absorbing any excess magicka they're exposed to. This stock was raised within the penumbral realms of Evergloam, as you can see.
12458.name: Reaper's End Quasigriff

12459.description: It's rumored that these little amphibians may be as long-lived as the Ayleids themselves used to be. Found only in Rivenspire near the Erokii Ruins, they are highly prized for their unique coloration and ability to regrow their own missing limbs.
12459.name: Doomcrag Salamander

12460.description: Native to the southeastern region of the Black Marsh, these fellrunners are adept at hunting in the marshy terrain. Though their pecks can be quite swift, they clack their beaks with joy when greeting their owners and favorite people.
12460.name: Oliis Bay Fellrunner

12461.description: After placing this furnishing in your home, a quick prayer to Kynareth causes the weather around you to change. Until you use the vessel again, the skies remain in their current state. Homes without skies are not impacted by this furnishing.
12461.name: Kynareth's Icon of Storm Control

12463.description: "If every soldier in my company could tap into the magic of the Weald, I'd have much less to worry about. Making a hasty retreat isn't a sign of weakness. It's a logistical goldmine." âLieutenant Agrance
12463.name: Gold Road Recall

12464.description: "Anchorites bound to the chains of the master travel by the will of Molag Bal alone." âWorm Adept Ivulen
12464.name: Coldharbour Recall

12465.description: There's more to necromancy than harvesting bodies and playing with bones. Living things such as plants and herbs have a place in the practiceâalthough that doesn't mean necromancers can't gather the materials with their own grim flair.
12465.name: Bone Harvest

12466.description: "The Dwemer of old are known for their clever inventions. Here, they've captured the likeness of a senche through ingenious carving and materials. All these years later, the creature still easily heeds its master's call."âDwarven Constructs: A Guide
12466.name: Cyan Dwarven Senche

12467.description: "Be careful! This beast is meaner than a durzog and hot as a fire atronach. The furnace in its chest gives it incredible power and an appetite to match. I can't remember when last this one was fed. Best not to find out."âKallin, House Ravenwatch
12467.name: Brimstone Death Hound

12468.description: Few birds are as intelligent or vain as the Moorpecker Magpie. Prized by scholars and mages alike for their keen instincts and trainability, the birds can be huffy and prone to temper tantrums when not rewarded with shinies for their work.
12468.name: Moorpecker Magpie

12469.description: "Don't feed the squirrels! Once you do, they never leave you alone. Oh, they look innocent enough now, but when you find one making off with your last sweet roll, you'll be sorry!"âDrisuggan, Markarth
12469.name: Markarth Squirrel

12471.description:
Once a favorite of wine merchants seeking to acquire the area's best vintages, this inn room can serve as a convenient refuge for any hoping to sample Skingrad's best food and drink.
Room is too small for dueling.
12471.name: Rosewine Retreat
12471.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion

12472.description: Merryvine's wines once rivaled those of the nearby Valente Vineyard, but misfortune sent its former owner fleeing. This sun-kissed estate features fertile grapevines, a house suitable for entertaining, and facilities that would please any vintner.
12472.name: Merryvine Estate
12472.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"Gold Road Grand Adventurer" Achievement

12473.description: "Meet my faithful steed, Honor. He's always getting into my foodstuffs. Has the appetite of a mammoth and the cunning of a fox, that one!"âCadwell
12473.name: Golden Honor

12476.description: Bartered in the great merchant stalls of Fargrave, this horse has been trained and tested against everything the Daedric Realms have to offer. It responds to the slightest nudge from its rider, plunging into even the most bizarre battle with no hesitation.
12476.name: Lucent Guardian Horse

12477.description: Specially bred to fight Daedra, this ornaug has a jaw that has been left free of armor. Its powerful bite can cut through even Daedroth hide, and its tough scales are resistant to scrapes and cuts.
12477.name: Lucent Guardian Ornaug

12478.description: Chirhazi has fought more Daedra than most know exist. She's become accustomed to the protective armor necessary for such battles and willingly allows her partner to be her eyes.
12478.name: Lucent Guardian Senche-Raht

12479.description: Traded in the merchant stalls of Fargrave, this beast is far from its native home in the depths of Valenwood. Specially trained to hunt Daedra from every realm, it tracks even the largest Ogrim without fear or uncertainty.
12479.name: Lucent Guardian Wolf

12480.description: Spin an illusion to appear as a scintillating glass Atronach, native of the realm of Mirrormoor. Those razor-sharp edges reflect  how dangerous you truly are.
12480.name: Glass Atronach

12481.description: "Harvest's reaping brings out all sorts of ill-omened beings. I avoid that nonsense by looking like a scarecrow spectre animated by amethyst flames. An illusion, yes, but yours if you can handle the terror you'll inflict."âOthreloth Hlaalo, Illusionist
12481.name: Reaper's End Scarecrow Spectre

12482.description: It's said those who enact the will of Sithis with perfect clarity will one day see the Night Lord himself. What that sight may do to the viewer is never discussed.
12482.name: Eyes of Sithis

12483.description: Khajiit believe the guardian of the winds, Khenarthi, embraces their souls and takes them to Llesw'er once they finish their true path of the moons. Some ease the grief of a loved one's absence by wearing face art symbolizing the wind guardian's embrace.
12483.name: Cycle Behind the Stars Face Art

12484.description: "When death-sorrow claws at your mind, look within. Reflect on the Sands Behind the Stars and know that, once there, true cats reside in splendor until the Next Pounce."âArtist-Adept Aimira
12484.name: Cycle Behind the Stars Body Art

12485.description: When a Tong assassin runs out of room to count their kills on their body, they will elect to record new kills upon their face. Watch for these markings in seedy Vvardenfell alleyways, and run.
12485.name: Morag Tong Writ Count Face Art

12486.description: Notable kills are immortalized by the most zealous Morag Tong as scars across their bodies. Beware a Tong who hides their skin, for they may be hiding the true depth of their prowess.
12486.name: Morag Tong Writ Count Body Art

12487.description: No West Weald harvest festival is complete without seeing these colorful autumnal garlands on joyful celebrants. Some even claim these headdresses bless the wearer with plenty during the upcoming winter.
12487.name: Weald Arbor Headdress

12488.description: Some carve themselves in symbols of the Black Sacrament out of devotion to the Night Mother. Others do so because they came to the Dark Brotherhood after performing their own Black Sacrament. Which are you?
12488.name: Black Sacrament Skincarving

12489.description: "Those who provide the gift of the Night Mother's Kiss to others tend to dress in dark colorsâthe better to blend into shadows. But if you unwrap us, you may find the glorious hues of our guild's stained glass writ upon our skin."âNevusa
12489.name: Woebringer

12490.description: The Night Mother still weeps for her children. It is this sorrow that gives death meaning and drives her assassins into the darkness.
12490.name: Night Mother's Embrace Face Art

12491.description: The Night Mother's countenance is not a warm or comforting thing. Her dark hands reach out from the shadows, born on a nightshade-scented breeze, grasping and searching, until the victim knows the sweet embrace of death.
12491.name: Night Mother's Embrace Body Art

12492.description: Those who work in the shadows need hairstyles as sharp as their blades. With this no-fuss shag cut, you're quickly set for your latest assignation â¦ or assassination.
12492.name: Keen-Edged Shag

12493.description: So beautiful. So deadly. That describes both you and this floral head flair, does it not? Plus you never know when you'll need a bit of alluring poison close at hand.
12493.name: Nightshade Hair Comb

12494.description: "I'd heard about the Ayleid city of Miscarcand, but I thought it to be a bard's fancy made up for songs at the Fertile Respite. Right up until this bit of sparkle came across my counter.  Will wonders never cease."âLouna Maborel
12494.name: Miscarcand Monocle

12495.description: "Of course it's not the real thingâbut it's a very good replica. Master jewelers studied illustrations of the Amulet of Kings to get the shape just right. What I wouldn't give to be able to see the original in person!"âDiocletia of Skingrad
12495.name: Red Diamond Earrings

12496.description: Yeah, that thing you just did? It's going on the list.
12496.name: I Shall Remember This!

12497.description: Applies to Trap Beast, Barbed Trap, and Lightweight Beast Trap. Select in Skills menu.
12497.name: Trap Beast, Dawnlight Orange
12497.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Dragon."

12498.description: Applies to Wall of Elements, Unstable Wall of Elements, and Elemental Blockade. Select in Skills menu.
12498.achievementName: Pen Is Mightier Than the Sword
12498.name: Wall of Elements, Violet Purple
12498.hint: Acquired by completing the "Pen is Mightier than the Sword" achievement.

12499.description: Applies to Magelight, Inner Light, and Radiant Magelight. Select in Skills menu.
12499.name: Magelight, Viridian Green
12499.hint: Acquired by completing the "Gold Road Sword for Hire" achievement.

12501.description: Although arcane investigator Fennorian of House Ravenwatch also happens to be a vampire, he's one of the good ones. Dare you invite him home? After adding Fennorian to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
12501.name: Fennorian

12502.description: A series of defeats in the Three Banners War led veteran Larina to take some leave to recuperate before her next battle in Cyrodiil. Will you give her a place to rest? After adding Larina to your home, you can set her on a path.
12502.name: Imperial Legionary Larina

12503.description: Applies to Vigor, Echoing Vigor, and Resolving Vigor. Select in Skills menu.
12503.name: Vigor, Soothing Blue
12503.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Netch."

12504.description: Applies to Regeneration, Rapid Regeneration, and Radiating Regeneration. Select in Skills menu.
12504.name: Regeneration, Azure Blue
12504.hint: Acquired by completing the "Gold Road Skyshard Hunter" achievement.

12505.description: Applies to Expert Hunter, Evil Hunter, and Camouflaged Hunter. Select in Skills menu.
12505.name: Expert Hunter, Carmine Red
12505.hint: Acquired by completing the "Lucent Citadel Vanquisher" achievement.

12506.description: Applies to Dawnbreaker, Flawless Dawnbreaker, and Dawnbreaker of Smiting. Select in Skills menu.
12506.name: Dawnbreaker, Dusk Purple
12506.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Dawnbreaker" achievement.

12507.description: This vibrant indrik is just the trick to enter the Carnaval festivities in style. Sporting bright plumage and gilded barding, this beast and its rider will be the center of attention, and may even draw the eye of a certain Daedric Prince.
12507.name: Carnaval Indrik

12508.description:
The flesh of Oblivion creatures is often unusually colored, highly toxic, and strangely pungent. The perfect fodder to entice a Daedric steed into your service.

A component required for the Anchorborn Welwa mount.
12508.name: Bizarre Daedric Meat

12509.description:
A lead capable of holding a gnashing Daedric beast without snapping. Strong materials won't help if it decides to turn on you, though.

A component required for the Anchorborn Welwa mount.
12509.name: Fine Ebonsteel Chain

12510.description:
The jaws of a welwa are uniquely equipped to both tear flesh and crush bone. Requires a muzzle strong enough to keep its jaws closed tight, lest it devour its trainer.

A component required for the Anchorborn Welwa mount.
12510.name: Strengthened Welwa Muzzle

12511.description: Applies to Cleave, Carve, and Brawler. Select in Skills menu.
12511.name: Cleave, Cinnabar Red
12511.hint: Acquired by completing the "A Signature with Class" achievement.

12512.description: Applies to War Horn, Aggressive Horn, and Sturdy Horn. Select in Skills menu.
12512.name: War Horn, Amber Orange
12512.hint: Acquired by completing the "Mirrormoor Incursion Disruptor" achievement.

12513.description: Jaguar riders may find themselves thirsting for something other than wine as they stalk Carnaval feasting grounds on these stately and suave mounts. Good thing these felines are silent as the shadows.
12513.name: Carnaval Jaguar

12514.description: The allure of Carnaval is enough to entice even the dourest Dark Elf to celebrate. Done with their characteristic attention to detail, they present the nix-oxen of Vvardenfell in stunning color and gilded saddles, perfect for a night of excess.
12514.name: Carnaval Nix-Ox

12515.description: When kept on a tight leash, welwas can make for a showstopping mount during Carnaval. Riders must be careful not to partake too much in the festivities, or their control of the fearsome beast may slip. What happens next is up to Sanguine.
12515.name: Carnaval Welwa

12516.description: Applies to Grand Healing, Illustrious Healing, and Healing Springs. Select in Skills menu.
12516.name: Grand Healing, Lilac Purple
12516.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Grand Healing" achievement.

12517.description: Even the most well-traveled adventurer should tread with care when entering Fargrave. This haunting welwa has an uncanny sense of direction that allows it to traverse the many planes of Oblivion with ease.
12517.name: Fargrave Walker Welwa

12518.description: Unlocks the Scribing feature for use on characters that have completed the tutorial quest, "The Second Era of Scribing." Access to other features in the system comes from completing Scribing quests on at least one character on your account.
12518.name: Scribing

12519.description: Applies to Low Slash, Deep Slash, and Heroic Slash. Select in Skills menu.
12519.name: Low Slash, Burnt Orange
12519.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Gryphon."

12520.description: Applies to Barrier, Reviving Barrier, and Replenishing Barrier. Select in Skills menu.
12520.name: Barrier, Turquoise Blue
12520.hint: Obtained by completing the final quest in the Scribing quest line.

12521.description: Applies to Blessing of Protection, Blessing of Restoration, and Combat Prayer in the Restoration Staff skill line. Select in the Skills menu.
12521.name: Blessing of Protection, Sky Blue
12521.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Death and Titans."

12522.description: Applies to Entropy, Degeneration, and Structured Entropy. Select in Skills menu.
12522.name: Entropy, Vibrant Yellow
12522.hint: Acquired by completing the "Gifts from the Archmagister" achievement.

12523.description: Applies to Force Shock, Crushing Shock, and Force Pulse. Select in Skills menu.
12523.name: Force Shock, Onyx Black
12523.hint: Acquired by completing the "Ink Accumulator" achievement.

12524.description: Applies to Meteor, Ice Comet, and Shooting Star. Select in Skills menu.

12524.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Meteor" achievement.

12525.description: Applies to Poison Arrow, Venom Arrow, and Poison Injection. Select in Skills menu.
12525.name: Poison Arrow, Crimson Red
12525.hint: Acquired by completing the "Gold Road Pathfinder" achievement.

12526.description: Applies to Reverse Slash, Reverse Slice, and Executioner. Select in Skills menu.
12526.name: Reverse Slash, Ruby Red
12526.hint: Acquired by completing the "Glass Sky Defender" achievement.

12527.description: Applies to Snipe, Lethal Arrow, and Focused Aim. Select in Skills menu.
12527.name: Snipe, Scarlet Red
12527.hint: Acquired by completing the "Antiquarian Chase: Gold Road" achievement.

12528.description: Applies to Soul Trap, Soul Splitting Trap, and Consuming Trap. Select in Skills menu.
12528.name: Soul Trap, Orchid Purple
12528.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Second Era of Scribing."

12529.description: Applies to Weakness to Elements, Elemental Susceptibility, and Elemental Drain. Select in Skills menu.
12529.name: Weakness to Elements, Purple
12529.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Fate of the Forgotten Prince."

12530.description: Applies to Whirlwind, Whirling Blades, and Steel Tornado. Select in Skills menu.
12530.name: Whirlwind, Ochre Orange
12530.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Caught in a Trap."

12531.description: The mystical art of Scribing requires a certain way of viewing the world. Thankfully, you possess the tool and the talent to see things as they truly are.
12531.name: True-Sight Viewing
12531.hint: Obtained by completing the final quest in the Scribing quest line.

12653.description: An Outfit look for hands in the Giantkin style.
12653.name: Giantkin Bracers

12654.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Giantkin style.
12654.name: Giantkin Belt

12655.description: Blossom lovers will delight in this picturesque villa perched on the western coastline of Auridon! With its elegant design, this cozy home awaits any who seek to nurture its blooms to life while enjoying how the light dances on the nearby rippling waters.
12655.name: Seabloom Villa

12656.description: Originally the sanctuary for the Five Companions, this stately structure features five roomsâone for each of the original Companionsâplus a central meeting space. Gorgeous views of West Weald and Cyrodiil complement the majestic serenity of this area.
12656.name: Haven of the Five Companions
12656.hint: Acquired through purchase, promotion, or event.

12657.description: The armor on this gleaming senche isn't just for its own protection. It's a necessary barrier between the rider and the knifelike shards that cover the beast's body. With time, a patient rider can learn where it's safe to touch the beast.
12657.name: Mirrormoor Shard Senche

12658.description: "In pursuit of ever more esoteric materials, I have drawn upon the most curious of realmic threads. Shards of mirror unending, on to the horizon and more. The whole place permeated with the deepest sense of loss." âJournal of the Spidersmith
12658.name: Glass Atronach Dwarven Spider

12659.description: "These majestic birds of prey are capable hunters, sighting their prey from great heights before descending in near silence for the kill. This prowess makes them prized by hunters and nobles alike."âFeathered Fauna, Translated
12659.name: Golden Eagle

12660.description: "She's been my faithful steed through every battle. Never lost her footing even once. There were plenty of close calls, mind you, but whenever I thought we were finished, she'd find some narrow path forward, and here we are."âCaptain Morel
12660.name: 10-Year Lion Guard Steed

12661.description: "Calmer than horses and more dependable than camels, elk are the preferred mount for traversing Tamriel's forests. Their regal bearing gives the rider plenty of visibility, without attracting too much attention."âSteady Hooves: An Elkback Journey
12661.name: Spiritwalker Pillion Elk

12662.description: Double trouble approaches when this pitch-black steed rides into town. With more than enough ill-tidings to go around, this Black Fredas steed is living proof that misery loves company.
12662.name: Black Fredas Pillion Walker

12663.description: "Watch your fingers, now! It looks small, but this little bugger makes up for it with its bite. Come to think of it, that might actually be how it shows affection."âTamer Gudleif
12663.name: Coldharbour Dremnaken Runt

12664.description: White sep adders are rare in the wild since their distinctive coloration doesn't allow for natural camouflage. They are typically found only in captivity, bred for the shine and luster of their scales and their beautiful novelty.
12664.name: Pearl White Sep Adder

12665.description: Mage faithful of Julianos create these unique creatures as a form of devotional art. The wisp represents orderly aesthetics, a sense of balance, and focused energy. It also makes for a beautiful focusing tone while meditating.
12665.name: Stonewisp of Truth and Law

12666.description: "I think Y'ffre has a lesson for us in all his creations. Moths especially. It's easy to overlook them. But they remind us how to be soft. How to move lightly through the world, and how to follow the light."âGundelion of Vashabar
12666.name: Vashabar Petal Moth

12667.description: The wings on these bats are mesmerizing, though difficult to spot during the day. When backlit by the light of Tamriel's moons, they seem to ignite in the sky. The illusion draws insects, a happy feast for the Stainedwing Bat.
12667.name: Stainedwing Bat

12668.description: Though these dragon frogs are striking to look at, not much can be said for their intelligence. When two of them meet face to face, they become mesmerized by their own reflection in the other's body. The resulting standoff can last for hours.
12668.name: Mirrormoor Dragon Frog

12669.description: "One of my seamstresses bought mirrorglass using my funds without permission. Thankfully for her continued existence, she created a gorgeous headdress using them. It keeps hair off your neck while making you look glamorous."âOlarra, Clothier of Fargrave
12669.name: Mirrorglass Crescent Headdress

12670.description: "Oh this look? I think it suits me. It's gotten me into ballrooms, estates, even the odd castle. I'm not one to kiss and tell, but if you stick around we can talk about some kissing I've been involved in."âTanlorin
12670.name: High Elven Instigator

12671.description: "Know the truth and observe the law. Seek wisdom from the wise. And start right here with me."âPilou Mouriou
12671.name: Robes of Truth and Law

12672.description: Unlocks all 7 Skingrad Vedette outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.
12672.name: Skingrad Vedette Outfit Style

12678.description: "When the blood moon rises over Hircine's Hunting Grounds, when true bloodlust has gripped his faithful, when the thrill of the chase is at its peak, it is said the Lord of the Hunt will mark his hunters forevermore."âTales from the Hunt, translated
12678.name: Bloodmoon Eyes

12679.description: "The horns of the Lord of the Hunt are no ordinary antlers. They are not for petty shows of strength or even deterrence. They are true weapons of the hunt, and they have been used to gore and rend as much as any spear."âTales from the Hunt, translated
12679.name: Feral Favor Face Tattoo
12679.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with a Arena Gladiator's Favor, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

12680.description: Hircine favors the bold, it is said. Hunters who wish to gain the Prince's favor have no need for camouflage, preferring instead to proudly tattoo their allegiance across their bodies. On occasion, the blood of their prey is used in place of ink.
12680.name: Feral Favor Body Tattoo
12680.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with a Arena Gladiator's Favor, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

12681.description: Enacting the Black Sacrament is said to leave a mark upon the soul. Some few choose to make that soul mark visible for all to see.
12681.name: Black Sacrament Mass Face Marks

12682.description: "Anoint yourselves in blood, my children. Rejoice in the silence that follows screams. You have earned the succor of the Night Mother. May she see your devotion and be pleased."âBenediction of the Brotherhood
12682.name: Black Sacrament Mass Body Marks

12683.description: "Don't mind old Honeycheeks, here. He's just snuffling around to see if you have anything tasty on you. Don't worry, he's a strict vegetarian! Although he has been known to swallow a bee or two when he gets deep in a honeycomb."âBeniah Bear-friend
12683.name: Dragontail Mountain Bear

12684.description: The one surefire way to tame a Dragontail Mountain Bear is to find one when it's young and tempt it with treats like honey and berries. The bears have a particularly strong sweet tooth and will do anything to satiate their cravings.
12684.name: Dragontail Mountain Bear Cub

12685.description: "You'd be forgiven for mistaking my piles of cogs and springs for wayward scraps from one machine or another. But a trained eye sees them for what they are. Seedlings. Kernels of ideas waiting to be given form and purpose. Why not give it a go?"âHyacinth
12685.name: Clockwork Tinker

12686.description: Show everyone how you deal with affairs of the heart. Pierce with a dagger and dangle from a chain.
12686.name: Heart's Rend Earrings

12687.description: You have bathed in the pool of Dibella's adoration and come out transformed. Flowers of many pastel hues decorate your form, bringing joy and smiles to those who interact with you.
12687.name: Ardor's Devotion

12688.description: Some ruminate on their impending death when gazing upon this elegant headwear. Others see it as a reminder to live their remaining hours as fully as possible. You, of course, consider it to be one of your favorite accessories for a night on the town.
12688.name: Fashionably Deadly Hat

12689.description: "The Black Hand may, at their discretion, choose Dark Brotherhood members to assist in the purification of a sanctuary. These eliminators don distinctive garb and hunt down any who seek to flee the purification."âExcerpt from The Will of Sithis
12689.name: Dark Eliminator's Garb

12690.description: "Some people think these lemurs are psychic, but that's just nonsense. They're just very persuasive. Look at those gigantic eyes! How could you not do whatever it wanted just to get it to stop staring at you?"âIsabelle Onus, Wayrest
12690.name: High Rock Red Lemur

12691.description: "He's just as smart and loyal as any Legion mastiff! And twice as affectionate! Although he has a habit of not actually retrieving his ball if it's under a bush, or in a puddle, or just not easy to see. But that's all right."âLegionary Audania
12691.name: West Weald Retriever

12692.description: "Look, some might call it cheating to play with a ball that follows you around, but it's not like you asked it to! It's perfectly safe. Fine for a regulation game. I think. Might get confusing with two balls on the field, though."âCarrier Clairene
12692.name: Chaosball Cohort

12693.description: Owners of these clever kittens must keep a close eye on them, especially in snowy environments. Their soft steps and white fur allow them to easily disappear in such places. However, most prefer the warmth of their companions to frosty dens.
12693.name: Snowclaw Senche-Serval Kitten

12694.description:
When the Five Companions set about their quest to recover the Amulet of Kings, Emperor Varen ordered the construction of a haven for the search.

A component required for the Haven of the Five Companions house.
12694.name: Varen Aquilarios's Key

12695.description:
Lyris Titanborn insisted on an excess of personal security measures for the Emperor, complete with multiple keys needed to access the haven.

A component required for the Haven of the Five Companions house.
12695.name: Lyris Titanborn's Key

12696.description:
Grand Chancellor Tharn wove elaborate enchantments to mask the haven's location, furthering the protection of the adventuring emperor.

A component required for the Haven of the Five Companions house.
12696.name: Abnur Tharn's Key

12697.description:
Sai Sahan organized a grueling training regimen for all five of the Companions, much to their chagrin.

A component required for the Haven of the Five Companions house.
12697.name: Sai Sahan's Key

12698.description:
Mannimarco secretly forged a master key that would grant total access to everything within the haven.

A component required for the Haven of the Five Companions house.
12698.name: Mannimarco's Master Key

12699.description: In the wake of a great tragedy, the nobles of Albus house devoted themselves to bloody revenge. In this dungeon, you must journey deep into an underground West Weald stronghold with Lucilla Caprenia to put an end to the Albuses' crusade.
12699.name: Exiled Redoubt

12700.description: Smoke rises from the sea outside of Hew's Bane as the forgotten island of Lep Seclusa burns. In this dungeon, help Sister Chana Nirine and Khafdeed reclaim their island from the army of a former emperor and protect Lep Seclusa's treasured Elder Scroll.
12700.name: Lep Seclusa

12702.description: Allows the purchase of Grimoires and Scripts from Chronicler Firandil at the Scholarium, as well as access to the Scholarium's Training Room. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found on enemies.
12702.name: Sigil of the Luminary Indrik
12702.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Indrik."

12703.description: Makes Affix Scripts obtainable from daily World Event rewards, daily Imperial City rewards, and daily Undaunted quest rewards, as well as vendors at the Scholarium and Infinite Archive. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found on harvesting nodes.
12703.name: Sigil of the Luminary Netch
12703.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Netch."

12704.description: Makes Focus Scripts obtainable from daily Delve rewards, PvP Rewards for the Worthy, and daily Mages Guild quest rewards, as well as vendors at the Scholarium and Infinite Archive. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found in heavy sacks.
12704.name: Sigil of the Luminary Gryphon
12704.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Gryphon."

12705.description: Makes Signature Scripts obtainable from daily World Boss rewards, the daily Cyrodiil reward, and daily Fighters Guild quest rewards. Unlocks subsidized Scripts at Mages Guilds across Tamriel. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found in treasure chests.
12705.name: Sigil of the Luminary Dragon
12705.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Wing of the Dragon."

12706.description: Any who possess this tome have, at their fingertips, a comprehensive guide to the art of scribing spells.
12706.name: How to Scribe
12706.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Second Era of Scribing."

12707.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.
12707.name: Delver's Alessia Deck Fragment
12707.hint: Found occasionally after defeating Delve Bosses in West Weald.

12708.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.
12708.name: Slayer's Alessia Deck Fragment
12708.hint: Found occasionally after defeating World Bosses in West Weald.

12709.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.
12709.name: Shattered Alessia Deck Fragment
12709.hint: Found occasionally after defeating Mirrormoor Incursions at Mosaics in West Weald.

12710.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.
12710.name: Hero's Alessia Deck Fragment
12710.hint: Found occasionally after defeating bosses in Public Dungeons in West Weald.

12711.description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck that tells the story of Saint Alessia.
12711.name: Seeker's Alessia Deck Fragment
12711.hint: Complete the quest "The Untraveled Road" in West Weald.

12712.description: The shards on this wildcat's body are dull and safe to touch. The same can't be said for its fangs and claws, which prick like needles. As it grows in size, those shards become razor-sharp glassâa terrifying defense mechanism.
12712.name: Mirrormoor Shard Wildcat

12713.description: This mudcrab is a frisky little crustacean pal who's at home in the water or out of it. Gilded and gussied up as a 10-year tribute.
12713.name: 10-Year Anniversary Mudcrab

12714.description: This pangrit's unassuming colors serve as combat camouflage. They can traverse coastal environments and rocky shorelines nearly unnoticedâa boon to riders looking to avoid attention.
12714.name: Striped War Pangrit

12715.description: "This one holds no love for Colovians, you see. But they did bring one good thing to Arenthia: their horses. Fine steeds, truly. And such fetching colors, no?"âTrader Zetisha
12715.name: Arenthian Skewbald Horse

12716.description: This costume pays a 10-Year tribute to our legendary High Elven hero of the Aldmeri Dominion. Honor this nameless mage by adopting their epic appearance, updated with touches of gold and ivory for the occasion.
12716.name: 10-Year Anniversary Elven Hero

12717.description: This costume pays a 10-Year tribute to our legendary Nord hero of the Ebonheart Pact. Honor this nameless warrior by adopting their ferocious appearance, updated with touches of gold and ivory for the occasion.
12717.name: 10-Year Anniversary Nord Hero

12718.description: This costume pays a 10-Year tribute to our legendary Breton hero of the Daggerfall Covenant. Honor this nameless rogue by adopting their intimidating outfit, updated with touches of gold and ivory for the occasion.
12718.name: 10-Year Anniversary Breton Hero

12719.description: Eldertide druids ready themselves for the chill of winter during their New Life stargazing session with these snug and cozy robes. If you wish to join them in their study of the stars, be sure to prepare with your own set of these festive robes!
12719.name: New Life Winter Storm Robes

12720.description: So many blades, so little time.
12720.name: Blademaster's Conundrum

12721.description: Confidence and a blade will see you through many of life's most challenging moments.
12721.name: Blademaster's Taunt

12722.description: Not all dreams are sweet. Vaermina takes special pleasure in reminding mortals of their deepest fears when they least expect it.
12722.name: Vaermina's Shadow

12723.description: Wonders exist within this particular Varla Stone, or so you've been told. But can you access them? Maybe it just needs a little shakeâwhoa! Is it full of stars? Or merely projecting them?
12723.name: Aether-Traveled Varla Stone

12724.description: Some plunder skulls have treats. But this one seems to have â¦ a spider? And a bat? And even a ghost? Maybe this skull possessedâor is possessed byâonly tricks. Best put it away quickly.
12724.name: Plunder Skull Blunder

12725.description: Celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary by dancing in the golden light of this summoned wisp.
12725.name: 10-Year Anniversary Golden Wisp

12726.description: Shadows often cloak the movements of assassins. Those who learn the methods of these lethal stalkers may discover hidden paths through deeper darkness, allowing them to travel great distances.
12726.name: Recall of the Outer Darkness

12727.description: The Night Mother will forgive a little showing off.
12727.name: Assassin's Chop

12728.description: "The Lady of Infinite Energies lent me a steed to hasten my way to Garlas Malatar. A creature of golden light, gleaming barding, a symphony of blades, and an aura reminiscent of the Colored Room, the charger tested my endurance."âKing Narilmor's Journal
12728.name: Symphony of Dawn Charger

12729.description: This well-dressed monkey is lively and cheerful, even in the grimmest of dungeons. Gilded and gussied up as a 10-Year tribute.
12729.name: 10-Year Anniversary Monkey

12730.description: "Feed the stone with blood and wine. Feel the magic binds entwine. The Prince of Revels loves to take. The Prince of Revels bids you wake."âStone Waking Sacrament of Sanguine, fragment
12730.name: Sanguine Gargoyle

12731.description: Glowing crystals dot the walls of this abandoned Dwarven processing facility perched over fathomless mines in Blackreach. Smiths and others who require steady heat for forging materials can use the active furnace to craft wondrous creations.
12731.name: Kthendral Deep Mines

12732.description: Once the primary museum for collections curated by the University of Gwylim, this stately structure and its grounds provide a perfect setting for the display of art, curios, statuary, and more. Show off favored possessions in a refined locale!
12732.name: Grand Gallery of Tamriel

12734.description: It's no surprise that this unique bear has found a home for itself in the peaceful, rolling hills of Wind Keep. With few natural predators, the beasts are quite docile, and riders appreciate the animal's agreeable nature.
12734.name: Wind Keep Bear

12735.description: "Keep it well-fed and you'll be fine. It's a smart beast, it won't scratch or run off if it knows you'll give it an easy meal. Just watch your rations on the mountains, though. They're practically invisible in the snow."âStablehand Skagurn
12735.name: Frostbreak Tiger-Lynx

12736.description: War and bloodshed have only made this wolf stronger. The creature wears its history proudly, draped in the banners of fallen foes and noble allies alike. Any potential challenger should think twice before approaching the rider of this beast.
12736.name: Three Banners Veteran Wolf

12737.description: "Covered in a thicker coat of fur than most bristlebacks, they are. Just as ornery as the regular ones. If not more so! I hear forsworn wrestle em' for a challenge. Supposed to make them look tough. More like mad!"âMiet, Breeder
12737.name: Karth River Bristleback

12738.description: This bear is fiercely loyal to its rider, and it snaps and growls at anyone else who gets too close. It has a gentle disposition with its bonded rider and often snuffles around in search of treats in their pack.
12738.name: Anniversary Fellowship Bear

12739.description: "My village was pillaged. We were made to live as outcasts. And yet this animal refuses to leave my side for a better life. So I will continue to fight. For them."âMugrog, Covenant Soldier
12739.name: Orsinium Tiger-Lynx

12740.description: "This little bird's stalking me. Ever since I shooed it off from its dip in the fountain by the Manor. It's waddled after me, everywhere! It's even got family by the port. They're plotting something!"âEdre Maric, House Dorell Guard
12740.name: Northpoint Chub Loon

12741.description: Let the power of Molag Bal wash over you. All shall know your might, your power. Don't they know who you are?
12741.name: Anchorite's Carved Bone

12742.description: Tales from the hinterlands say these rare white echalettes were cursed. But these beasts are friendly, kind, and fierce protectors once fed. Perhaps this one's next home is with you?
12742.name: Snowglint Echalette

12743.description: Beware the beaches of Amenos, where these durzogs learned to hide beneath the sand and ambush their prey. Local Dreadsails and other outlaws prize them as mounts for their powerful claws and easy gait on the sand.
12743.name: Skulltooth Coastal Durzog

12744.description: "I couldn't let him go. Not after how he led those goblins away. No one would do that for me. So, if people fear me, let them. This terrier's life is worth more than their approval."âVyctor Aurell, Necromancer
12744.name: Ghostly Breton Terrier

12745.description: "If you want a companion who looks after itself and hides when things get rough, find and train one of these striped nymphlings. These dear hearts love to curl up next to you under blankets while you sleep!"âSaissula, Stablemaster
12745.name: Striped Pangrit Nymphling

12746.description: A reliable companion on the roads of Reaper's March. Especially popular amongst skooma smugglers that require work out of the caves along the River Strid.
12746.name: Arenthian Skewbald Pony

12747.description: One of the many uncharted mysteries off Tamriel's southern coast. This distant relative of the Bog Dog prefers to roll over warm sands and seaweed instead of Blackwood's murky swamps. Like all families, they have their differences.
12747.name: Saltwater Bog Dog

12748.description: Named for the small Auridon town where they were first bred, many needed homes after a Veiled Heritance attack. Some are still looking for a new place (and person) to plant their claws.
12748.name: Silsailen Tortie-Calico Cat

12749.description: "Conservator Vinelore was unimpressed by my fellrunner experiments. Perhaps this pink variant will impress her! It has a most peculiar diet that I think should prove quite interesting!"âOdd Researcher
12749.name: Russafeld Fellrunner

12750.description: "Debassi is enamored by this critter's festive coat! Reds brighter than the blood splats on Black Heights' roads! But Debassi is sure this is not blood. He's seen enough robberies to know!"âDebassi, Traveling Merchant
12750.name: Black Heights Squirrel

12751.description: Before they soar, every gryphon must first learn to ground themselves. It's said that Kynareth sent these fledglings to Nirn to find companions that could help them value both land and sky equally.
12751.name: Kynareth's Fledgling Gryphon

12752.description: Honor Sanguine with enthusiasm and vigor by dancing the night away in this scarlet-adorned outfit.
12752.name: Carnaval Celebrant

12753.description: The vibrant hues and plush feathers of this outfit cause the wearer to practically take flight on the dance floor. They must be careful to remain grounded, or the festivities may sweep them off their feet entirely.
12753.name: Carnaval Feathered Dancing Dress

12754.description: "Walk the streets of Fargrave. Take in the exotic scents of this fabled city. Listen to the mysteries that whisper to you with every breeze. And, when you're ready, let the Celestial Palanquin claim you as one of its own."âTirasie Mirel
12754.name: Fargrave Walker

12755.description: "I find peace and soul's release when casting on the 'moor. With oiled skin, reflections spin, mirror's grace implored. A shimmer here, a glimmer there, my form reflects the light. Forever lost, forever found, mirror's fated knight."âLost in Mirrormoor
12755.name: Mirrormoor Metamorphosis

12756.description: "Oh this? Don't fret, mortal. It may look frightening, but the One Who Knows granted it to me personally. With this eye, the secrets of reality are no longer hidden to me. I see the truth behind the words on the page, and I am grateful."âCipher Lielle
12756.name: Apocrypha Corrupted Eye

12757.description: Some scars lie on the skin, easy to see and understand. Other are subtle, hidden by the trial of time. But some scars lie deeper still, only revealing themselves when the cracks begin to manifest on what was once a perfect mirrored surface.
12757.name: Mirrorweb of Memories Face Art

12758.description: "Even a fractured mind can retain subconscious memories. The echoes of past trauma are written in the fault lines of the soul, and when read correctly, the truth is revealed."âMirror, Myth, and Memory: A Guide
12758.name: Mirrorweb of Memories Body Art

12759.description: "If you see folks with snake markings on their head, chances are they've survived many a fierce battle in Cyrodiil. Poor brave souls. You can tell some are ready to plow fields instead of spill blood."âNaire of Bruma
12759.name: Alliance Viper Pit Face Marking

12760.description: Veterans of the Three Banners War often get tattoos to represent their exploits in Cyrodiil. A new trend sees pit vipers of each faction viciously attacking each otherâsomething many an alliance soldier can relate to.
12760.name: Alliance Viper Pit Body Marking

12761.description: Mere mortals were never meant to remember Mirrormoor. And yet, its power emanates across the Threads of Fate, leaving some marked by this forbidden knowledge.
12761.name: Mirrormoor Memory Face Marking

12762.description: Those who visit Mirrormoor often find themselves changed when they return. By who, or what, they cannot say. Only dim memories remain, like shards of glass scattered upon the ground.
12762.name: Mirrormoor Memory Body Marking

12763.description: Namiira can grant power to those who fall, but at the cost of corruption to the soul and everything someone once was. Some rare few could help a Rajaska back to the light, but the knowledge of this ritual was lost long ago.
12763.name: Rajaska's Snarl Face Tattoos

12764.description: The Bent Dance corrupts all who fall to its ceaseless drumming. The Rajaska are fueled by this corruption, growing as strong as the Ahz-m'Athra that snarls from the Dark Behind the World.
12764.name: Rajaska's Snarl Body Tattoos

12765.description: The shimmering, glistening glow of Mirrormoor is stunning to behold, though few have seen it and remember the experience.
12765.name: Mirrormoor Eyes

12766.description: The pursuit of perfection is brutal when the Sapiarchs are involved. They may look elegant, but these markings are a sign the bearer suffered in the application. Remember thisâand the cost of conformity.
12766.name: Face Soul-Mark of the Sapiarchs

12767.description: When a High Elf's use of magic strays beyond the comfort of the Sapiarchs, drastic measures are taken. These painful, twisting marks are etched into the skin. A measure to restore control, regardless of the cost.
12767.name: Body Soul-Mark of the Sapiarchs

12768.description: Some claim that when the Warrior constellation shines brightly, those born under its sign are assured of victory in battle. Those who seek to win through force of arms often take on the Warrior's mantle during times of great crisis.
12768.name: Warrior Starskin

12769.description: This vibrant mask makes for a colorful addition to your Battlegrounds gear. Whether you're a Fire Drake or a Pit Daemon, wade into battle bearing the colors of your chosen banner!
12769.name: Drakes and Daemons Mask
12769.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Battlemaster Tokens, available by completing Battleground Quests, with a Battlemaster's Power, available for purchase from Battleground Supply Merchants across Tamriel.

12770.description: "Mother found some gorgeous topaz earrings in her jewelry box last night. The note she wrote to accompany them said 'Gift from Fargrave.' Fargrave? And gift from whom? That said, they looked stunning with her new gown."âJournal of Frugo Donze, Clothier
12770.name: Lucent Earrings

12771.description: Don this scintillating mask and add a touch of exquisite mystery to any gathering. Light dances and sparkles as it reflects from the multitude of shards on this meticulously constructed ornament.
12771.name: Mirrormoor Masque

12772.description: The most rewarding kills are the ones you have to work for.
12772.name: Fetcherfly Frustration

12773.description: A miniature statue of Daedric Prince Sanguine, hoisting a tankard during a revelry.
12773.name: Statuette: Sanguine

12774.description: A miniature statue of a Tojay Khajiit, dancing in celebration.
12774.name: Statuette: Dancing Tojay

12775.description: A painting of Oathsworn Pit, where followers of Malacath train in three different forms of combat.
12775.name: Painting: Oathsworn Pit

12776.description: "It is rather elegant, no? This one was practically purring when she perfected the design. It is only by her great generosity that she shares it with the public now."âPazatha the Impeccable
12776.name: Pellitine Anniversary Drape

12777.description: Born and bred in remote reaches of Tamriel, these guar are the bestial stars of any Carnaval parade. Breeders of this variety feed them a rich diet to enhance their vibrant plumage before the festival.
12777.name: Carnaval Feathered Guar

12778.description: "This quasigriff may look fearsome, but she's been touched by Kynareth herself. While astride, you'll never feel the sun's brutal burn, and all wind will be at your back. The skies be blessed."âPriestess Belklina
12778.name: Kynareth's Quasigriff

12781.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons.
12781.name: Nokvroz's Greatsword Replica
12781.hint: Acquired rarely from the Atoll of Immolation during the Anniversary Jubilee.

12783.description: Some Sea Elves are so connected to the ebb and swell of the ocean that the water itself responds to their call. This magical steed was created by a renowned sea witch celebrating their sixth century on the waves.
12783.name: Deepsea Corsair Summoned Steed

12784.description: Don these robes to invoke the gravitas of Guildmaster Vanus Galerion. And without all that tedious studying!
12784.name: Mages Guildmaster Garb

12785.description: "As I looked into the cold, crustacean's eyes, it snapped through my net like sword to skin. It was then that I realized that they were the predator, and I was the prey."âBikkus-Xu, Angler
12785.name: Mind-Shriven Mudcrab
12785.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Justice for the Fallen."

12786.description: What it lacks in flight, it makes up for in fight! One lunge and its prey is paralyzed with poison, which gives it enough time to eat and hop away like a normal frog.
12786.name: Root-Whisper Crested Dart Frog

12787.description: "I love hunting with my dogs, but I can't understand why they try to pull my boots off after each hunt. Maybe it's a quirk of the breed?"âUshataga
12787.name: War Veteran's Hunting Dog

12788.description: Bear the sigils of the ancient past upon your temples. And may the secrets of the Builders one day be revealed to you.
12788.name: Stone-Nest Orator Face Paint

12789.description: Ancient markings upon your skin show your reverence for stone. For Tamriel's roots. For the gift of life itself.
12789.name: Stone-Nest Orator Body Paint

12790.description: The burning passion within shines through your eyes. Feel your worries run down your face like teardrops of sin. That's what Carnaval is really all about.
12790.name: Carnaval Feathered Gaze

12791.description: Every region celebrates Carnaval a little differently. In Blackwood, locals indulge in elaborate face and body painting while festivities rage on. The bright colors are said to draw the gaze of Sanguine himself.
12791.name: Blackwood Carnaval Face Paint

12792.description: Carnaval celebrants from the edge of Valenwood just love the swirling branches and twirling motifsâsiren calls to Sanguine during Carnaval. It's said they create an almost hypnotic effect when the wearer is dancing.
12792.name: Blackwood Carnaval Body Paint

12793.description: It seems you've been impaled. Tragic and hilarious in equal measure.
12793.name: Jester's Deadly Headband

12794.description: Leave your modesty at the cathedral. Sanguine celebrates excess. The flashier, the better.
12794.name: Carnaval Emerald Earrings

12795.description: Some Carnaval participants prefer to add a little mystique to their revels. Beaded veils and masks are sure to catch the eye of a stranger while concealing the wearer's identity from any who might not approve of the night's activities.
12795.name: Carnaval Beaded Veil

12796.description: The vibrant plumage on this Carnaval celebratory headdress stands tall and bright. Throw your all into revelries, feasts, and dances!
12796.name: Carnaval Feathered Headdress

12797.description: Join the celebration with a festive makeover for your crowning glory! Ornate hairpieces add a bit of flash to what's already a stunning look.
12797.name: Carnaval Side Part

12799.description: Before taking her needles and other tailoring tools to Bleakrock Isle, Didrika sold many a jarl a finely crafted dress on the mainland. Some jarls still seek out her exquisitely appointed gowns, such as this one, to this day.
12799.name: Highborn Jarl's Dress

12800.description: "You've heard of the rage of Dragons, yes? If you see one dressed as I am, best not move against them or you will experience that rage firsthand."âMizashuk, Dragon Rage Berserker
12800.name: Dragon Rage Berserker's Garb

12801.description: The life of a relic collector takes a strange turn when they focus on Fargrave. This gear showcases some of the more unusual finds they've uncovered. It also provides full protection just in case any local traders take issue with a bargain.
12801.name: Fargrave Relic Collector

12802.description: "Dwemer design married to the unyielding logic of Julianos. One of my finest creations. The first of this design was personally delivered to my patron in Wayrest, along with a fabulous bottle of wine."âThe personal notes of the Spidersmith
12802.name: Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider

12804.description: War deserters that huddle for warmth around bitter campfires in the Jerall mountains found common cause with these wild tharrikers. The wild magic that created them allows for rapid adaptation to the snowy slopes of their new home.
12804.name: Jerall Deserter's Tharriker

12806.description: Mystically take the shape of an unstoppable Argonian temple guardian! It may not solve all of your problems? But it will at least create new ones.
12806.name: Voskrona Guardian

12807.description: Embrace the dazzling power of Akatosh himself with this fiery polymorph. Golden scale armor and righteous flames will make you appear untouched by time, a hallmark of the gilded Lord of the Dragons.
12807.name: Time's Herald Living Armor

12808.description: "When you bury a dagger to the hilt in more frost draugr than even a skald can count, it gets numbingly cold to the touch and stays that way. Makes them perfect for prying runestones, though you'd best wear gloves."âBrendravald
12808.name: Frost Draugr Runegathering

12809.description: The Nords of Hroldan started using their martial hammers for mining after a bloody skirmish involving miners and Reachfolk. Vowing to never again be caught flat-footed, they perfected this method over time and shared it with Nords throughout Skyrim.
12809.name: Hroldan Hammer Mining
12809.hint: Acquired rarely from harvesting ore. Can also be purchased with Writ Vouchers from Rolis Hlaalu.

12810.description: Alduin's infamous hunger lends a razor-sharp edge to this smoldering polymorph. His shadowy scales will hold your enemies in rapt horror, while you invoke his scorching rage on all who oppose you.
12810.name: World-Eater's Living Armor
