12962.name: Force Shock, Wildburn
12962.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Force Shock" achievement.

12963.description: "Behold the mammoth. Bred among the majestic trees of Malabal Tor. Let its strength endow you with courage and its even-tempered persistence carry you safely. And let its beauty uplift your soul."âOverheard at the Baandari Trading Post
12963.name: Timber Mammoth

12964.description: This is a standard house collectible.
12964.name: Bust: Lord Hollowjack

12965.description: Barbas, Clavicus Vile's faithful companion, loves being a talking dog. Why he wants to stay with you is for him to know and you to never find out. After adding Barbas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
12965.name: Barbas

12966.description: Self-proclaimed expert adventurer and prolific author Narsis Dren needs some time away from his exploits to write his next thrilling book. After adding Narsis to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
12966.name: Narsis Dren

12967.description: This is a standard house collectible.
12967.name: Trophy: Lord Hollowjack

12968.description: "Honestly , it was pleasure just to work with someone outside the House. Please give my warmest regards to Queen Khamira, and I will take her up on her offer of hospitality the next time I'm in Rimmen."âMagister Varkenel
12968.name: Scaleborn Wolf

12969.description: "We've received the scavenged material and the specifications for the product line. This is all very doable, but will likely be somewhat expensive given the properties of draconic fleshweave."âMagister Varkenel
12969.name: Scaleborn Senche-Raht

12970.description: "I think it's a wonderful idea, and the time table is completely workable. You should see your friends in the Dragonguard astride these beasts within the year."âMagister Varkenel
12970.name: Scaleborn Ram

12971.description: "If you're looking for a suggestion for the fourth form, might I suggest something like a bear? I know these mighty beasts are not local to your region but it's proven a popular shape in other work I've done."âMagister Varkenel
12971.name: Scaleborn Bear

12972.description: "Some customs of Solstice's Stone-Nest tribe date back well beyond Duskfall. The magical processes they used to shape flesh as they do stone is lost to the modern villagers, but lives on in ancient designs."âMuzah-Tei, Stone-Nest Scribbles
12972.name: Stone-Nest Landloper

12973.description: These mounts are consecrated when they're only colts, given over in a ceremony to the Storm Goddess. Their riders say you can feel a distant rumble of thunder with every stride.
12973.name: Kyne-Blessed Thundersnow Steed

12974.description: Molag Bal's domain is patrolled by vampiric hounds. Wrapped in the mists of Coldharbour, bones erupting from flesh, it strikes fear into the hearts of others, and sometimes the hearts of their riders as well.
12974.name: Coldharbour Death Hound
12974.hint: Acquired by completing the "Savior of Solstice" achievement.

12975.description: A native of the Nocturnal's domain, Evergloam, these ghost cats are known to escape their bonds and roam Tamriel at will. They choose only the most fortunate (or most unfortunate) to serve as their masters, who need a strong hand at the reins.
12975.name: Gloam Senche

12976.description: This beast's black, scarred hide shows it to be the victor of many battles. Its fierce eyes declare that it has only recently been domesticated. Ride at your own risk.
12976.name: Twilight Kagouti Destroyer

12977.description: The gilded shells of these creatures glow in even the weakest ashfall sunlight. Golden nix-oxen are prized both by merchants seeking to display their prosperity and by worshipers of Akatosh for their beauty.
12977.name: Golden Nix-Ox Steed

12978.description: "As I sat by the fire, I felt two little eyes glaring at me in the darkness. I left some meat at the edge of camp and was shocked when a ghostly senche came out and nibbled on it. Maybe Nocturnal answered my prayer."âRecovered journal of Felisa Moabenar
12978.name: Gloam Senche Cub

12979.description: War mounts created to patrol the far reaches of Coldharbour, these dread beasts have been unleashed on Tamriel. Their hearts are dark with malice, and they live only to witness the destruction of others.
12979.name: Heart's Grief Welwa
12979.hint: Acquired by completing the "Worth the Pain" Achievement.

12980.description: Isolation from the rest of Tamriel for generations has caused the local dovah-fly population to develop bright, unusual colors. They seem to be a warning to predators, although the Solstice dovah-fly itself isn't poisonous.
12980.name: Solstice Flats Dovah-Fly

12981.description: "It may not look like much, but this chicken is lucky, I swear. It's always finding little snacks for me, like apples or an old loaf of bread. It's like it doesn't want me to be hungry. Isn't that nice?"âFarmer Quentyn
12981.name: Navire Chicken

12982.description: Though unruly, Twilight Kagouti Hatchlings can make excellent huntersâif their unfocused energy can ever be harnessed. Many a training session has been unexpectedly ended when a hatchling caught scent of some small animal and disappeared into the bushes.
12982.name: Twilight Kagouti Hatchling

12983.description: An Ashlander tale says that one in every thousand clutches of shalk eggs is specially blessed by the ancestors. The existence of golden shalks seems to support this belief, but no one has ever seen one hatch before.
12983.name: Golden Shalk

12984.description: "I demand a refund on this dragon frog, Nahafa! All it does is scorch my things, bite my fingers, and make rude noises when I have guests. When you said it was a 'honeybutter' variety, I thought it would be sweet!"âOverheard at the Sentinel market
12984.name: Honeybutter Dragon Frog

12985.description: This fashionably ornate braid symbolizes the strength of will required to join the Greybeards in their training.
12985.name: High Hrothgar Braid

12986.description: "Nothing brings peace like a glass of wine and a little dancing! Under the skin, everyone belongs to Sanguine! We just bring that to the surface."âRee-Jaa, Sanguine Disciple
12986.name: Sanguine's Disciple

12987.description: "A splash of gold never hurt anyone. And you've just got to do something to make yourself noticed tonight, darling."âLyra Ignatius, Priestess
12987.name: Carnaval Alluring Eyes

12988.description: A binding mark that signifies a Dawnway follower's resolve in following their Ayleid ancestor heritage.
12988.name: Dawnwood Tender's Skin

12989.description: Mesmerize friends and strangers alike with your ability to manipulate the mirrorball.
12989.name: Mirrorball Trickery

12990.description: As a skilled player of the Mirrormoor glass harp, you know how to bring audiences to tears with your resonant performances.
12990.name: Mirrormoor Glass Harp

12991.description: Forged beneath the hammer blows of master Nord smiths, this living armor provides both speed and warmth. Its overlapping plates move with a supple and tireless grace, fueled by the flames within.
12991.name: Dragonclash Living Armor Senche

12992.description: "All hail Akatosh! Golden one! Most resplendent! Let your flames glow bright within this creation! Let it spread your light and lead all to wisdom. Let Akatosh's power live within this wondrous creature!"âDedication Ceremony
12992.name: Akatosh Living Armor Senche
12992.hint: After acquiring other collectibles from the Akatosh vs. Alduin Crown Crate, you can claim this mount.

12993.description: "All-praise to Ald! World-Eater! First of Dragons! Let there be fire in this creature's belly and rage in its visage! Let its fury be felt by those who oppose us! Let Alduin fuel the power of this beast!"âDedication Ceremony
12993.name: Alduin Living Armor Senche
12993.hint: After acquiring other collectibles from the Akatosh vs. Alduin Crown Crate, you can claim this mount.

12994.description: Brilliant hues mark this vibrant magpie, whose primary habitat lies within the Tenmar Forest. Locals sometimes train them to signal the location of fallen prey for easier retrieval.
12994.name: Tenmar Magpie

12995.description: Many of these hatchlings come from western Murkmire. Raised by the Dead-Water tribe to appear strong and spark fear, some secretly find them cute to keep as pets.
12995.name: Lilmoth Crocodile Hatchling

13055.name: Accelerate, Lilac Purple
13055.hint: Acquired rarely from Psijic Portals. Can also be purchased from Filer Ool in the Infinite Archive.

13056.name: Volley, Winterfall

13057.name: Meteor, Winter's Blast

13058.name: Critical Charge, Winter's Gale

13059.description: Applies to Summon Winged Twilight, Summon Twilight Tormentor, and Summon Twilight Matriarch. Select in Skills menu.
13059.name: Summon Winged Twilight, Warrior

13060.description: Scintillating islands and skeletons of long-forgotten beasts float amid Mirrormoor's luminous skies. Enterprising architects, step through a shattered mirror portal in Fargrave and finesse this osseous mass into a dazzling dimensional home.
13060.name: Shattered Mirror Isle

13061.description: A great dark-furred creature, this beast holds its head high as if a queen among the herd. Other brekkas follow in the wake of this confident leader even in the harshest of climates.
13061.name: Evenfall Brekka

13062.description: Baby brekkas are known to be affectionate, but this one is especially clingy. It's always within arm's reach, never straying farther than its neck can reach. It seems to take comfort in its owner's presence.
13062.name: Evenshade Brekka Calf

13063.description: Fresh from their Daedric forge, Craftmaster Siluruz has the talent to see to the heart of the matter, and thereby reduce items to their components. They avoid Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as mortal conflict bores them in their search for pure creations.
13063.name: Siluruz, Realm Craftsmaster

13066.description: Terilorne is a footloose merchant who seeks to spread the joy and beauty of Dibella in her wake. She will not enter Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as the jarring vibrations of the conflicts there harshes her enjoyment of the world.
13066.name: Terilorne, Dibellan Freetrader

13068.description:
An Outfit look for bows in the Tarnished Red Petal style.

|cffffffStowing this weapon hides it, but some combat effects may still show.|r
13068.name: Tarnished Red Petal Bow

|cffffffStowing this weapon hides it, but some combat effects may still show.|r

An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Tarnished Red Petal style.

|cffffffStowing this weapon hides it, but some combat effects may still show.|r
13076.name: Tarnished Red Petal Dagger

13077.description: "The tinkle of sparkling crystals on this flattering dress I 'acquired' from a Shardborn mage pleases me. The neckline's cut also frames my glorious body art. I almost want to wear this all day. Maybe tomorrow I will."âFalena Rothalor, Undaunted
13077.name: Fatemirror Evening Wear

13078.description: Count Calantius cordially invites a caretaker to maintain and decorate Castle Skingrad as he rides out to support his loyal citizens. This majestic castle stands just outside Skingrad, granting easy access to the city's amenities and nearby vineyards.
13078.name: Castle Skingrad

13079.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Psijic Psion style.
13079.name: Psijic Psion Robe
13079.hint: Acquired by playing Tales of Tribute.

13082.description:
A complete set of runestones etched with sigils of truth and law, as outlined in the scriptures of Julianos.

The first of three components required to create the Stonewisp of Truth and Law.
13082.name: Axiomatic Runestones

13083.description:
A flawlessly inked, illuminated representation of the glyph associated with the god of wisdom and logic.

The second of three components required to create the Stonewisp of Truth and Law.
13083.name: Glyph of Law

13084.description:
The luminous dust left behind by the death of the common wisp, sanctified for use by the priests of Julianos.

The last of three components required to create the Stonewisp of Truth and Law.
13084.name: Powdered Wisp Remains

13085.description:
A smaller version of the shrine associated with Julianos, sometimes carried by the faithful as portable reliquaries.

A component required for the Logical Rune Extraction customized action.
13085.name: Exalted Icon of Logic

13086.description:
While common prisms serve as curiosities, particularly flawless examples can focus light and magicka alike into potent streams of energy.

A component required for the Logical Rune Extraction customized action.
13086.name: Flawless Prism

13087.description:
A tome containing the incantations and somatic diagrams for a unique spell of extraction so that a wizard need not dirty their hands.

A component required for the Logical Rune Extraction customized action.
13087.name: Jhunal's Magnificent Extrication

13089.description: Brilliant battlefield tacticians often became venerated heroes among the Yokudan warriors.
13089.name: Statuette: Yokudan War-Scholar

13090.description: "Some claim to know the provenance of this sleek piece of art, but they know nothing. Especially when it comes to how impressive your home would be with a replica in it!" âZaidrashi, Merchant
13090.name: Statuette: High Elf Mage

13091.description: Shrouded in mystery, the Lucent Citadel gleams in the sand of Fargrave's wastelands.
13091.name: Painting: Lucent Citadel

13092.description: A beautiful remnant of Meridia's power. No Lightless Oubliette required.
13092.name: Remnant of Meridia's Light

13093.description: A vial of Fargrave sand and a touch of magic work together to form this sand model of Lucent Citadel.
13093.name: Sands of the Lucent Citadel

13094.description: "Strands of fate form the tapestry of life, and more. Pluck a few, my child, and shape the moment as you will. What you gather today will garb or nourish you tomorrow."âWitchweaver Koirah
13094.name: Fate Strand Harvest

13095.description: After years of study, several mages faithful to Julianos developed a less labor intensive method to acquire runes. A practical application of wisdom if ever there was one.
13095.name: Logical Rune Extraction

13096.description: An Alliance siege smith recuperating from a bout of fighting in Cyrodiil took on the task to build a better mining pick. When that didn't work out, they went with what they knew.
13096.name: Mini Siege Mining

13097.description: "When the guild asks you to blend teleportation and illusion magic, you don't ask why. You set to work on thaumaturgical manipulation. I'm quite proud of how it turned out, really."âDonovan Renoit
13097.name: Mages Guild Recall

13098.description: Show off your skill and make teeba a spectator sport!
13098.name: Teeba Trick

13099.description: The sun is bright, the sky is clear, and you've nowhere you need to be. Time to relax and enjoy a cold drink on the beach.
13099.name: Beachside Drink

13100.description: Soak up the glorious sunlight on the beach!
13100.name: Beachside Bask

13101.description: "We imbue our skin with the Emperor's Regalia as a declaration of our undying loyalty to Cyrodiil's true emperor, Orpheon! Any that block his path to the throne shall see their own skin stripped and left to rot!"âOrpheon Follower
13101.name: Tactician's Gold Lattice Skin
13101.hint: Acquired by completing the "Fallen Banners Delver" achievement.

13102.description: Your best little froggy friend loves hopping around on you. Why not bring them out for some fun?
13102.name: Frolicking Frog

13103.description: You've perfected the wave used by nobility!
13103.name: Regent's Wave

13104.description: Yes, take a nice look at yourselfâyou are stunning!
13104.name: Self Reflection

13105.description: Chill out for several moments by shaking this exquisite snowglobe.
13105.name: Surprising Snowglobe

13106.description: With the popularity of the vvardvark on the rise, Telvanni magisters are constantly searching for that hit "next look." Just as steadfast as their colorful kin, these beasts make for playful companions as long as they remain mostly indoors.
13106.name: Alabaster Vvardvark

13107.description: "It was a stunning tome. Gorgeously detailed and filled with tales of esoteric Nord mythology. Supple leather binding, gold leaf on the cover â¦ and now it's host for a transliminal parasite!"âCipher Volan
13107.name: Dragonclash Tomeshell

13108.description: "The sound of snapped bones led me back to my trap. A snow owl was eating my kill! So bold, I wasn't even mad. The next day we began our training, and we've been together ever since."âA Mountain Tale by Tharyt the Trapper
13108.name: Windhelm Snow Owl

13109.description: The magisters of House Telvanni are constantly working to perfect their craft and make some coin. This pallid beast is a trendy fashion statement for the next time you turn up at the inn.
13109.name: Ghostwhite Vvardvark

13110.description: "The fury of the druids could not be sated. As sparks fell around me and the forest burned, it appeared from beyond a curtain of smoke. Marked by the destruction. But still loyal."âY'ffelon eruption survivor's tale
13110.name: Leafember Ursauk

13111.description: Fire Drake or Pit Daemon? No one will doubt your commitment to glory on the Battlegrounds when you wear this face paint. May the best team win!
13111.name: Drakes and Daemons Duel Face Art
13111.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Battlemaster Tokens, available by completing Battleground Quests, with a Battlemaster's Duel, available for purchase from Battleground Supply Merchants across Tamriel.

13112.description: Your body is a canvas. Use it to show your devotion to the Battlegrounds!
13112.name: Drakes and Daemons Duel Body Art
13112.hint: Acquired by combining 20 Battlemaster Tokens, available by completing Battleground Quests, with a Battlemaster's Rivalry, available for purchase from Battleground Supply Merchants across Tamriel.

13113.description: "S'razar's mind felt seared by the wisps of flame. And yet they also soothed. It made the blood on his claws taste like wine. A voice allured S'razar. Sangiin called to him!"âS'razar, Carnaval Partygoer
13113.name: Sanguine's Indulgence Face Marks

13114.description: "And as they etched each rose petal on his fur, S'razar felt lighter, more impulsive. Following the Path was an afterthought. What mattered was how much drink he had and the blood he'd spill for more of it."âS'razar, Carnaval Partygoer
13114.name: Sanguine's Indulgence Body Marks

13115.description: Applies to Flame Skull, Venom Skull, and Ricochet Skull. Select in Skills menu.
13115.name: Flame Skull, Onyx and Red

13116.description: These striking wolves are native to Amenos, where their ululating howls echo through the forest. The cubs don't yet have their calls perfected, but that doesn't stop them from trying to make themselves heard.
13116.name: Trappers Peak Wolf Cub

13117.description: You'll not find a more dedicated and loyal mount. They bond closely with their masters, as long as they are properly fed, cared for, and get frequent tummy rubs.
13117.name: Trappers Peak Wolf

13263.description: The great rams of the Daenian birch forests tend to be shy and skittish. Yet, if properly trained, they can be exquisite and powerful mounts.
13263.name: Daenian Great Ram

13265.description: Constructed of refurbished Dwarven parts within a fully reconditioned housing, the Duo-Dynamo is the perfect mount for a comfortable, sharable ride.
13265.name: Duo-Dynamo Guardian Spider

13271.description: Captain Za'ji of the Perfect Pounce sails the seas from Elsweyr to High Isle. Now, though, he hopes to bunk with you while his ship is being refit. After adding Za'ji to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
13271.name: Za'ji

13274.description: It goes without saying that bone Dragons of this size don't naturally exist. The necromancer that crafted this construct must have done so with utmost care. Even at this scale, the Dragon exudes an intimidating energy.
13274.name: Ruinous Bone Dragon

13276.description: A touch of scarlet on the cheeks is enough to let all your enemies know your allegiance is to the Ebonheart Pact. This face paint is worn only by soldiers who wish to unite all of Tamriel under the Pact's banner.
13276.name: Pact Red Face Paint

13277.description: Members of the Ebonheart Pact are no stranger to battle, and these markings are proof of that. Adorned with the Pact's fearsome dragon sigil, this body paint invokes power and ferocity on the battlefield.
13277.name: Pact Red Body Paint

13278.description: It's a great honor to receive this mark of loyalty to the Daggerfall Covenant. This swooping face paint represents the bearer's dedication to their faction, and instills fear in the hearts of their enemies.
13278.name: Covenant Blue Face Paint

13279.description: Only the greatest heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant receive these markings. Adorned with the lion sigil of the Covenant, the bearer's allegiance is unwavering and overtâa sign of true devotion.
13279.name: Covenant Blue Body Paint

13280.description: Though simple, this swirling gold paint reveals the bearer's love of the Queen and their commitment to ensuring the Dominion will emerge victorious in all things.
13280.name: Dominion Gold Face Paint

13281.description: What better way to show your commitment to the shining power of the Aldmeri Dominion than with this gilded body paint? The Dominion's proud eagle soars across your body, as the Dominion will soar across the battlefield.
13281.name: Dominion Gold Body Paint

13282.description: "There is no light without darkness. No fullness without hunger. No life without death. Such are the teachings of the great Dragons."âFire and Ash, by Fjot Tale-keeper
13282.name: Dragonclash Face Marking

13283.description: Some followers of ancient Nord traditions adorn themselves with imagery of a clash between Alduin and Akatosh. They carry it as a reminder that there must be balance in all things and that every story's beginning must come to its inevitable end.
13283.name: Dragonclash Body Marking

13284.description: Let the rhythm of Sanguine's everlasting carnaval possess your mind, body, and spirit!
13284.name: Carnaval Festive Dance

13285.description: Let the festive frenzy within you burst forth!
13285.name: Carnaval Fan Dance

13286.description: The sloths of Solstice have long been favored pets of Sunport residents, especially children. It's not uncommon for teachers to perform "sloth checks" to make sure enterprising students aren't attempting to use their bags to smuggle sloths into lessons.
13286.name: Solstice Sloth
13286.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Gift of Death" in Solstice.

13287.description: Alchemy and fashion combine in these fiercely flaming ombre tresses.
13287.name: Dragonfire Tresses

13288.description: Let the spirit of the Carnaval festival take you away!
13288.name: Featherdance Carnaval Recall

13289.description: Kynmarchers in service to Vaermina clad themselves in nightmares. They call upon this haunting weave to spark the same terror that saturates her most unspeakable dreams.
13289.name: Kindred Kynmarcher Garb

13290.description: Sewn by the faithful at the Benevolence of Mara cathedral in the Imperial City. These finely stitched frocks robe Mara's scholar-priests-in-exile and any new adherents they train to the priesthood.
13290.name: Mara's Disciple Frock

13291.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Huntsman's Warmask style, acquired through digging for Antiquities.
13291.name: Huntsman's Warmask

13292.description: "The first time I saw this skeever at my doorstep, I praised Peryite. Then prostrated myself, as this steed warrants. I'd been called into the world from my cave hideaway. Now we share my Prince's blessings wherever we travel."âPlague Elder Anai No-Nose
13292.name: Plaguewater Swamp Skeever

13293.description: "Servants who earn Vaermina's trust may be gifted this loyal dreadmare. Their first ride from Quagmire takes them on an eldritch path, as the hands of the beast painfully claw out every flaw along the way."âExcerpted from "Paths Through the Mire"
13293.name: Dreadmare of a Thousand Truths

13294.description: When you live to dance, every motion and gesture you make adds to the flowing choreography that is your life.
13294.name: Dancer

13296.description: Those who burn with the soul of the Dragon may be transformed by their own inner fire. Whether that power is used for good or ill is entirely up to them.
13296.name: Blaze of Akatosh

13297.description: "Those who heed the Dragon God of Time find themselves marked by his greatness. His eye sees what is true. To be blessed by him is to know eternity."âPsalm of the Dragon
13297.name: Akatosh Golden Eye

13298.description: Flickering green flames and emerald wings create a striking appearance with this draconic tattoo. Though Kaalgrontiid is undeniably fearsome, those who appreciate the Dragon's power and strength may find the bright markings more alluring than frightening.
13298.name: Timebound Sovereign Face Tattoo

13299.description: Fearsome Kaalgrontiid is frozen forever at the height of his power in this vibrant tattoo. Though terrifying, the awe and artistry of the Dragon's fury can't be denied as it wraps around your arms. Hopefully you'll never face his wrath directly.
13299.name: Timebound Sovereign Body Tattoo

13300.description: At winter solstice, Dragon Cultists gather to award their newest initiates specially crafted stone piercings. Some claim Alduin's blood blessed the nose studs, turning them into rubies the shade of his eyes.
13300.name: Dragon Cult Piercings

13301.description: The World-Eater, the Twilight God, the First Dragonâno matter the name, Alduin casts a long shadow over Nirn. However, many dedicated followers of his cult find wisdom in the darkness, and a certain freedom in his hunger.
13301.name: World-Eater Eyes

13302.description: "What is flame but hunger never sated? What is Alduin, but an appetite with wings? Whether by fire or teeth, he consumes all."âThe Song of Endings
13302.name: World-Eater's Flame

13303.description: "Time heals all. Having the Dragon God of Time perched on your ear gets you healing all the more quickly."âCanor Saccus, Priest of Akatosh
13303.name: Lord of Dragons Ear Cuff

13304.description: Shake these rattlers made from Solstice sea urchins, and you'll have folks dancing to the beat in seconds!
13304.name: Play Solstice Rattlers

13305.description: Victory or loss, a flagon of ale cures all!
13305.name: Tipsy Topple

13306.description: Effortlessly juggle Argonian delicacies, and perhaps even indulge in one while you do?
13306.name: Street Food Juggle

13307.description: "Kyne, follow my arm. Kyne, hear my plea. Kyne, let your thunder roll!"âCommoner's Prayer to Kyne
13307.name: Kyne's Cleave

13308.description: You vanquished the dangers lurking within the Exiled Redoubt, and now you own this haunted mirror souvenir. Does the spirit of Docent Domitius linger within it? Or is this a new poltergeist?
13308.name: Haunted Mirror of Introspection
13308.hint: Acquired by completing the "Exiled Redoubt Conqueror" achievement.

13464.description:
Gold, a color associated with most Divines, symbolizes the value of logic to priests of Julianos.

A component required for the Robes of Truth and Law costume.
13464.name: Golden Fabric

13465.description:
A shimmering blue fabric, glistening in the light as though tiny sapphires were somehow woven into it.

A component required for the Robes of Truth and Law costume.

A minor enchanted item, used to quiet the mind during times where intense concentration and detached logic are required.

A component required for the Robes of Truth and Law costume.
13466.name: Torc of Wisdom

13468.description: "If your horse spares a red-tailed scorpion from being crushed underfoot, the scorpion was sent by the First Serpent to share your camp. To keep it free from vermin."âFrom Grandee Yaghoub's writings
13468.name: Aswala Scorpion

13469.description: Quagmire wasps build nests with nightmares as wasps of Nirn build nests with pulp. Distressing. Yet, you may find having one around useful. Especially when a Daedric Prince seeks to disturb your dreamwalks.
13469.name: Dreamharrow Wasp

13470.description: This adorable ginger cat has more purrs than you can count. He longs to be out and about, whether it's on an adventure or watching you craft potential kitty toys.
13470.name: Anequina Ginger Cat

13471.description: A colorful little friend happy to follow you into even the most disease-ridden dens. Many find the smell off-putting? But this true soul of Peryite goes snout-first into pestilence with a grin.
13471.name: Pestilent Pony Guar

13472.description: "When times are tough and compassion grows thin, Mother Mara graces us with her wolf pups to remind us to be kind. Not nice, mind you. Nice tries to talk away all the bad. Kind recognizes the bad and seeks to end it."âAcolyte Ylaine
13472.name: Mara's Glory Wolf Pup

13473.description: "Of course our skeever mounts start out as pups! That gives us time to train them properly, as Peryite intends. Just try not to cuddle them to death, got it?"âYamighu
13473.name: Swamp Skeever Pup

13474.description: Harvest from nature with the care of the Argonians of Murkmire.

13475.description: "May Azurah bless you. And moon's light shine forth as you work this ore."âAdept Lakjo
13475.name: Lunar Oregathering

13492.description: A miniature statue of a Redguard warrior, often used within royal tombs.
13492.name: Statuette: Redguard Warrior

13493.description: "You may see a swamp. Ruins. Trees. Water. But I see life and endings. Death and beginnings. And most of all change. Learn from the Shadowfen as I do."âJuutenma, Shadowscale
13493.name: Painting: Shadowfen Mirescape

13494.description: Trophy taken from Orpheon the Tactician in honor of an Undaunted victory in Lep Seclusa.
13494.name: Trophy: Orpheon the Tactician

13495.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Lep Seclusa.
13495.name: Bust: Orpheon the Tactician
13495.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Lep Seclusa.

13496.description: Trophy taken from the Squall of Retribution in honor of an Undaunted victory in Exiled Redoubt.
13496.name: Trophy: Squall of Retribution

13497.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Exiled Redoubt.
13497.name: Bust: Squall of Retribution
13497.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Exiled Redoubt.

13498.description: Rimmen gossips speculate this imp takes the shape of a miniature green Dragon in praise to Peryite, who helped the little beasts escape flu-ridden Orcrest.
13498.name: Plaguerot Dragon Imp

13499.description: "This cub represents a strange mix of danger and comfort. I don't think this morpholithic cub can capture souls? But one never knows until one tries."âAfwa's Journal
13499.name: Soul Gem Senche Cub

13500.description: "The colors! So bright. Thank Peryite, it doesn't breathe vile fumes. Well, unless you've fed it fungus. Then it has the foulest breath ever. So. Don't feed it fungus."âYamighu's New-New Journal
13500.name: Pestilent Guar

13501.description: This beast serves its rider without hesitation. Necromancers claim it hums in dark resonance when near soul gems that were created in Coldharbour.
13501.name: Soul Gem Senche

13502.description: "The Weaver of Dreams walks with me when I don this sophisticated dress. What I see, Vaermina sees. And sometimes, those she sees through me will experience her dream creations during their next slumber."âNightdancer Liviana
13502.name: Dreadful Dreams Dress

13503.description: "You're not one of us until you hunt down and skin a skeever for your cap. If you pick up a disease along the way, so much the better."âPeryite's Chosen Two-Toes Cadra
13503.name: Skinned Skeever Cap

13504.description: The inky-black fur of this moose blends into shadows during twilight treks a couple may wish to undertake in secrecy. Since the moose shares no gossip, your secrets remain safe.
13504.name: Grimshadow Pillion Moose

13505.description: "The guardians of the Writhing Wall were shaped, warped, and even twisted by the power of the souls contained within. We should care for the beasts and folk touched by the wall. What other choice do right-thinking folk have? "âCaptain Meggrid
13505.name: Wormwrithe Bear-Lizard

13506.description: An odd creature first seen near the Writhing Wall, this hatchling exhibits a necromantic contamination that sets it beyond the natural order. It needs a good home, shunned by the other regional wildlife.
13506.name: Wormwrithe Haj Mota Hatchling
13506.hint: Acquired by completing the "Wormwrithe Haj Mota Hatchling" achievement.

13507.description: The graceful way this light garb caresses your every move makes for a sensuous experience. Perfect for dancing with your favorite troupe under the sacred moons Jone and Jode.
13507.name: Pellitine Dancer's Garb

13508.description: Ask a Sister of the Shrike how they came about their alluring apparel, and they'll answer: "From the Mother." Whether that's the Crow Mother or someone else, only they know.
13508.name: Negligee of the Coven Shrike

13509.description: The only thing worse than one titan is two. And the only thing worse than that is getting caught in the middle of them. Even if you make it out alive, you won't be the same. Their power will mark you forever.
13509.name: Twin Titan's Retribution
13509.hint: Acquired by completing the "Ossein Cage Conqueror" Achievement.

13510.description: Who says that necromancy has to be dull? Magnifico's power is revealed to his followers in its full glory, utilizing Redguard motifs in an unprecedented way to adorn his vessel as a lich. Undeath has never looked this good.
13510.name: Magnifico's Majesty

13511.description: Argonians and Khajiit are not the only ones who like a good long bask. In the days before mortals the Dragons loved to lounge with the warm sun on their scales. Make use of this illusion, and enjoy your own draconic scales.
13511.name: Scaly Sun Basker

13512.description: "Study of the Great Source led to experimentation. And experimentation led to a convenience: near-instantaneous travel. Limitations exist for now. Still, I find it better than aching muscles after a long ride."âExcerpted from Firstborn Alenthe's journal
13512.name: Celestial Recall

13513.description: Delvers of underground spaces often bring back smaller pieces of this material for use in crafting flower-laden tiaras. Merchants now proclaim their intentions to bring these baubles to the mainland as beautiful curiosities.
13513.name: Solstice Bismuth Tiara
13513.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Writhing Wall" in Solstice.

13514.description: Remember well the green flame used by Orpheon the Tactician, who sought an Elder Scroll and failed due to your efforts.
13514.name: Dust of the Conqueror's Flame
13514.hint: Acquired by completing the "Lep Seclusa Conqueror" achievement.

13517.description:
Celia Tyde may be a pirate, but you can trust her to safeguard your valuables in the hold of her Lost Fleet vessel.

Aetheric winds mean you can't summon her in Cyrodiil or on Battlegrounds, though you and your groupmates can use her services.
13517.name: Celia Tyde, Lost Fleet Bursar

13518.description: You and your group can prep for sanguine slaughter by summoning Voko to change and save armory builds outside of your home. A lack of wine and dancing disinterests him from offering his services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.
13518.name: Voko, Carnaval Weapondancer

13520.description: Chef Donolon's apprentice, Mogh, made this impressive and delicious Jubilee Cake using all the skills and techniques his master passed on to him.
13520.name: Jubilee Cake 2025
13520.hint: Obtained by completing the 2025 Anniversary event.

13521.description: The Nord explorer Elsbytte and her faithful mammoth Muffins roam the wilds of Tamriel in search of adventure. Invite them to stay awhile! After adding them to your home, you can set them on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with Elsbytte.
13521.name: Elsbytte

13522.description: Pragmatic garb worn by Hollow Moon thieves of Grahtwood.
13522.name: Hollow Moon Garb
13522.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Flipping the Coin" in Grahtwood.

13523.description: Imposing armor worn by Reachfolk warriors who have taken over Northwind Mine in the Rift.
13523.name: Northwind Disguise
13523.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Scouting the Mine" in the Rift.

13524.description: Battle-tested armor worn by Imperial legionaries assigned to Hallin's Stand.
13524.name: Seventh Legion Armor
13524.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Hallin's Burden" in Bangkorai.

13525.description: Well-worn armor used by mercenaries stationed in Phaer.
13525.name: Phaer Mercenary Armor
13525.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The First Patient" in Auridon.

13526.description: A protective outfit worn by Veiled Heritance agents in Quendeluun.
13526.name: Quendelunn Veiled Heritance Garb
13526.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Veiled Choice" in Auridon.

13527.description: Sturdy armor worn by the Vulkhel Guard Marines.
13527.name: Vulkhel Guard Marine Armor
13527.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "A Hostile Situation" in Auridon.

13528.description: Utilitarian robes worn by Bloodthorn cultists in on Betnikh.
13528.name: Bloodthorn Robes
13528.hint: Acquired by completing the "Unearthing the Past" quest in Betnikh.

13529.description: Regulation armor worn by the guards of Fort Amol.
13529.name: Fort Amol Guard Armor
13529.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Sleeping on the Job" in Eastmarch.

13530.description: Supple robes worn by Gold Coast Mercenary couriers.
13530.name: Courier Uniform
13530.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Enemy of My Enemy" in Malabal Tor.

13531.description: The official uniform worn by militant members of House Indoril.
13531.name: Vanguard Uniform
13531.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Aggressive Negotiations" in Stonefalls.

13532.description: The symbol of the Iron Wheel is worked subtly into the fabric of this simple servant's outfit.
13532.name: Servant's Outfit
13532.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Long Game" in Hew's Bane.

13533.description: "This morning, a wolf painted with dawn's glow awaited. Thanking Kynareth for prayers answered, I fed it, and we ventured out. That night, darkness settled on the wolf, broken only by the lunar luminescence of its markings."âAda of Winterhold's Journal
13533.name: Winterhold Empyrean Wolf
13533.hint:
|cffffffTime of day during mount-up determines which variant you ride.|r

Acquired in the Season Zero Tamriel Tome.

13534.description: "A friend told me these durzogs came from a magical mishap with an extremely fortunate result. But they're so masterful, how can that be true? Either way, I love mine."âDragonknight Ellean
13534.name: Ash-Tipped Durzog

13535.description: "What's worse than a surprise sep adder? A surprise sep adder blighted by Peryite. Unless? You tame it. Then you've got a friend for life sure to keep biting insects away. And, you don't need to follow Peryite to benefit."âDaixth
13535.name: Blighted Sep Adder

13537.description: Born amidst High Isle's volcanic vents, this pup somehow looks both dangerous and cute. But don't let it lull you into complacency! It can burn through a slipper in two breaths if it gets too excited.
13537.name: Ash-Tipped Durzog Pup

13538.description: Members of Legion Zero tuck their ophidian friends into a pack in anticipation of their dark blessing. Once they let the snake taste the Blood of Coldharbour, they create an undying mind-shriven companion.
13538.name: Mind-Shriven Reef Viper

13539.description: "Colorful layers provide secret places for you to hide your coins while browsing the bazaar. A perfect blend of style and practicality, yes? Give it a swirl, yes, very nice."âFazudah
13539.name: Bazaar Bargain Hunter

13540.description: "This is a formal ceremony, yes? Fazudah sees a sash with a wrap. Loose, so that you can kneel and rise, kneel and rise. But embellished! With metal â¦ plates? No. Coins. To remind you the cost of history. Perfect!"âFazudah
13540.name: Upscale Orsinium Attire

13541.description: "There is no such thing as too much, sahida. Not in fashion. This could have been simple, plain, fit for a common fighter. Yes. But in the claws of Fazudah it became so much more!"âFazudah
13541.name: Orsinium Grappler Gear

13542.description: "What's for dinner?" they ask. Your response: "You."
13542.name: Hunger

13543.description: Worshipers on pilgrimage in Mara's name mayârarelyâwake to find one of her favored wolf steeds awaiting them. A not-so-gentle nudge from the Divine Mother.
13543.name: Mara's Glory Wolf

13544.description: Fungal spores from the Telvanni Peninsula, when placed in a medium of Quagmire soil and mixed with Pits minerals, grow into a pungent slime. Both rider and beast, after imbibing, travel through a mix of the waking world and dream world.
13544.name: Nightmare Alchemy Vvardvark

13545.description: Cult alchemists in Rimmen distill Tenmar plants watered from the Pits and grown in Dreamstride soil. A few drops from the resulting tincture for both rider and steed bless their missions for Peryite and Vaermina.
13545.name: Nightmare Alchemy Senche

13546.description: Cult priests form a compound with Blackwood herbs and bone salvaged from Quagmire and the Pits. The glowing solution guides this elk and its rider to Prince-favored destinations.
13546.name: Nightmare Alchemy Elk

13547.description: A mix of Skingrad wine, some ashy remnants of Quagmire dreams, and ooze from a Pits-born plague hopper make for a heady solution. After imbibing, neither rider or steed can waver from goals set by the Nightmare Queen and the Master of Tasks.
13547.name: Nightmare Alchemy Tharriker

13548.description: "A gloriously purple hat. Soft, yes? Feels like wearing nothing at all. And if you start a fight while wearing it to the ceremony, you'll cut a dashing figure as you â¦ cut dashing figures. Hah!"âFazudah
13548.name: Orsinium Ceremonial Hat

13549.description: "When good Neramo proposed a line of constructs, Fazudah searched the face of the moons. Then inspiration struck. This one adores Orsinium metalwork! And we have sturdy Wrothgar steel blended with Elsweyri design! And who does not like a bear?"âFazudah
13549.name: Hollowsteel Construct Bear

13550.description: "This one would have preferred a senche, but good Neramo just loves the wolf. Still rather elegant she thinks, perfect for a beautiful ride through the countryside. Though Fazudah herself isn't much for riding. She prefers her studio."âFazudah
13550.name: Hollowsteel Construct Wolf

13551.description: "We could have made anything, of course, but the indrik? Ahh, so sleek. Dreams and whimsy, made from metal! It looks cold, but good Neramo made it as loving as any real indrik. And you don't have to feed it."âFazudah
13551.name: Hollowsteel Construct Indrik

13552.description: "Good Neramo studied with the Spidersmith. So a many-legged multi-rider construct seemed a perfect choice: Dwarven chassis meets the design of mages and Khajiit, spun up in Orsinium steel. What would the Dwemer think if they could see it now?"âFazudah
13552.name: Duo-Dynamo Hollowsteel Spider

13554.description:
|cFFFFFF500 Slots|r

You can add the Furnishing Vault to multiple homes, plus retain access to stored items even if the vault isn't placed. Use either the placed vault or the Editor menu to retrieve, place, or store items. The vault holds furnishings only.
13554.name: Furnishing Vault

13555.description: With her grand tour under way, Duchess Elea Dufort hopes to see more of the world beyond High Isle and the Systres Archipelago. Have her visit you! After adding Elea to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
13555.name: Duchess Elea Dufort

13556.description: Talen-Lah and his band of necromancers run amok in the legendary lost xanmeer of Naj-Caldeesh. Stop them before their dark magic corrupts and destroys the ancient site.
13556.name: Naj-Caldeesh

13557.description: Atronachs summoned from far planes of Oblivion power a pulsing forge at the heart of Coldharbour. Help Dalenor the Summoner destroy Soulbinder Vykand's twisted fabrications before they make it to the hands of the Worm Cult.
13557.name: Black Gem Foundry

13558.description: Once a relaxing getaway for Corelanyan nobles, this elegant retreat features an outdoor pool along the shore, indoor steam baths, and spacious facilities that allow even the most battle-worn adventurer to treat themselves.
13558.name: Bismuth Steam Baths
13558.hint:
Gold Purchase Requires:
"West Solstice Grand Adventurer" Achievement

13559.description: Named after an amusing incident with Solstice's sloths, this airy room provides travelers and adventurers alike with a quiet space to recuperate. It can even accommodate your favorite arboreal friends!
13559.name: The Sleepy Sloth
13559.hint:
Purchase Requires:
"Room to Spare" House Quest Completion

13560.description: An entertainer's delight! Plays, recitals, and more once filled the stage in this Ayleid theaterâall dedicated to Merid-Nunda, the Bright One. Tucked away in the Colored Rooms, this opulent venue awaits its next riveting performance and adoring patrons.
13560.name: Theater of the Ancestors

13571.description: Stories claim High Elves and Goblins once traded peacefully at King's Haven Pass. After relations between the two soured, the Coral-Splitter Goblins claimed the area as their own.
13571.name: Painting: King's Haven Pass

13572.description:
Unlocks the Dragonknight class skill line Ardent Flame for use in subclassing.

Call down an Ardent Flame to burn your foes with lava and ash. Drop the fearsome Dragonknight Standard into combat and lash the battlefield with your fiery might.
13572.name: Skill Line: Ardent Flame
13572.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Ardent Flame Master."

13573.description:
Unlocks the Dragonknight class skill line Draconic Power for use in subclassing.

Draconic Power rises within to protect yourself and rend your foes. Soar into the fray with Dragon Leap to stun enemies and send them reeling.
13573.name: Skill Line: Draconic Power
13573.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Draconic Power Master."

13574.description:
Unlocks the Dragonknight class skill line Earthen Heart for use in subclassing.

Summon the Earthen Heart and master the discipline of obsidian and stone. Clad yourself in Magma Armor to withstand even the mightiest blows.
13574.name: Skill Line: Earthen Heart
13574.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Earthen Heart Master."

13575.description:
Unlocks the Templar class skill line Aedric Spear for use in subclassing.

Forge a spear of light capable of shielding you and burning the darkness from your foes. Lash out with a Radial Sweep to devastate your enemies on the battlefield.
13575.name: Skill Line: Aedric Spear
13575.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Aedric Spear Master."

13576.description:
Unlocks the Templar class skill line Dawn's Wrath for use in subclassing.

Smite your enemies by gathering and unleashing the power of Dawn's Wrath. Call down a fragment of the sun in a Nova to show what it means to face the fury of Stendarr.
13576.name: Skill Line: Dawn's Wrath
13576.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Dawn's Wrath Master."

13577.description:
Unlocks the Templar class skill line Restoring Light for use in subclassing.

Stendarr's mercy wells up from within, the golden glow of Restoring Light. Cast the Rite of Passage to knit flesh and allow your allies to stand against any assault.
13577.name: Skill Line: Restoring Light
13577.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Restoring Light Master."

13578.description:
Unlocks the Nightblade class skill line Assassination for use in subclassing.

Assassination, the art of killing unseen. Nothing is more devastating than the Death Stroke, a punctuation to the Nightblade's deadly dance.
13578.name: Skill Line: Assassination
13578.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Assassination Master."

13579.description:
Unlocks the Nightblade class skill line Shadow for use in subclassing.

As a Nightblade you exist within Shadow, allowing for an unseen approach. Then, gather the Consuming Darkness to ensure your enemies cannot escape your merciless blade.
13579.name: Skill Line: Shadow
13579.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Shadow Master."

13580.description:
Unlocks the Nightblade class skill line Siphoning for use in subclassing.

With the art of Siphoning you call to the blood itself, drawing out life essence to heal wounds. Cast out your diabolical arts to Soul Shred, and end a fight in dramatic fashion.
13580.name: Skill Line: Siphoning
13580.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Siphoning Master."

13581.description:
Unlocks the Sorcerer class skill line Dark Magic for use in subclassing.

Dark Magic draws from the unknowable depths of Deadric Realms to curse your foes. Dropping Negate Magic onto a pitched battlefield is sure to control the flow of combat.
13581.name: Skill Line: Dark Magic
13581.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Dark Magic Master."

13582.description:
Unlocks the Sorcerer class skill line Daedric Summoning for use in subclassing.

Crack wide the jaws of Oblivion. Use Daedric Summoning to call forth allies from beyond Nirn. The unstoppable Storm Atronach is the mightiest of these unnatural allies.
13582.name: Skill Line: Daedric Summoning
13582.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Daedric Summoning Master."

13583.description:
Unlocks the Sorcerer class skill line Storm Calling for use in subclassing.

Lightning is pure energy, the crackling power of Storm Calling. Give yourself over to the elements and Overload to become force incarnate.
13583.name: Skill Line: Storm Calling
13583.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Storm Calling Master."

13584.description:
Unlocks the Warden class skill line Animal Companions for use in subclassing.

Call forth your Animal Companions to summon buzzing, flying, terrible beasts to your side. Your mighty Wild Guardian is a fearsome ally, loyal come what may.
13584.name: Skill Line: Animal Companions
13584.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Animal Companions Master."

13585.description:
Unlocks the Warden class skill line Green Balance for use in subclassing.

Channel the magic of the deep woods by mastering Green Balance. Grow the Secluded Grove to restore even deathly wounded allies and swing a combat in your favor.
13585.name: Skill Line: Green Balance
13585.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Green Balance Master."

13586.description:
Unlocks the Warden class skill line Winter's Embrace for use in subclassing.

Tales of the Winter's Embrace call down biting winds and shape icy shields. Your Sleet Storm punishes adversaries with debilitating cold and uncertain terrain.
13586.name: Skill Line: Winter's Embrace
13586.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Winter's Embrace Master."

13587.description:
Unlocks the Necromancer class skill line Grave Lord for use in subclassing.

Grave Lord is the purest of necromantic arts. Cull life from the living, and summon the Frozen Colossus to lash out at the enemies of the dead.
13587.name: Skill Line: Grave Lord
13587.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Grave Lord Master."

13588.description:
Unlocks the Necromancer class skill line Bone Tyrant for use in subclassing.

As a Bone Tyrant you call forth the bones of the dead to protect yourself. Transform yourself into a Bone Goliath and stand against even the most withering assault.
13588.name: Skill Line: Bone Tyrant
13588.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Bone Tyrant Master."

13589.description:
Unlocks the Necromancer class skill line Living Death for use in subclassing.

The tradition of Living Death channels spiritual energy to restore wounds. Restore life to the dead with the might of Reanimate.
13589.name: Skill Line: Living Death
13589.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Living Death Master."

13590.description:
Unlocks the Arcanist class skill line Herald of the Tome for use in subclassing.

As a Herald of the Tome, your esoteric knowledge becomes a devastating weapon. Summon the Unblinking Eye to bring the full power of Apocrypha to bear against your enemies.
13590.name: Skill Line: Herald of the Tome
13590.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Herald of the Tome Master."

13591.description:
Unlocks the Arcanist class skill line Soldier of Apocrypha for use in subclassing.

Rise, Soldier of Apocrypha. Be armored by knowledge. Manifest the Gibbering Shield to protect you and your allies with your lore.
13591.name: Skill Line: Soldier of Apocrypha
13591.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Soldier of Apocrypha Master."

13592.description:
Unlocks the Arcanist class skill line Curative Runeforms for use in subclassing.

Precise Curative Runeforms restore wounded allies or lend magical strength to weapons. Construct the Vitalizing Glyphic to pulse eldritch healing to everyone around you.
13592.name: Skill Line: Curative Runeforms
13592.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Curative Runeforms Master."

13597.description:
A once-common tool among the Dwemer for ensuring compliance in their animunculi.

A component required for the Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider mount.
13597.name: Dwarven Control Rod

13598.description:
Aspiring mechanists work many long hours refitting the awkward Dwarven Spider chassis into something comfortable enough to ride in.

A component required for the Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider mount.
13598.name: Comfortable Spider Chassis

13599.description:
The heart of any Dwarven device is the dynamo; a combination reactor and distributor for its soul gem power source.

A component required for the Law of Julianos Dwarven Spider mount.
13599.name: Whirring Dwarven Dynamo

13600.description: "Varmiina gifts her servants with the Sight of Dark Portents. Some claim they see the future with their glowing eyes. But consider that she may just show you what she wants you to see, yes?"âMazza-Mirri's Guide to Dark Spirits
13600.name: Dark Queen's Sight

13601.description: Nightmare tendrils caress your skin. They taste the coppery blood-tears flowing from your eyes. And they mark you as one who belongs forever to Vaermina.
13601.name: Quagmire's Touch Face Marks

13602.description: Dark wisps tease at your skin, tugging. Twisting. Tormenting. With agonizing tenderness, Vaermina's dreams promise you the safety of home while enfolding you within the terror of isolation. These experiences leave marks, as you now know well.
13602.name: Quagmire's Touch Body Marks

13603.description: "That which freezes others in terror sets you free, my lovely dreamwalker. Especially when treading among your ghastly night terrors. As such, these sinuous marks now grace your body, summoning you to our temple to dearest Vaermina."âNightcaller Jezezre
13603.name: Night Terrors Face Marking

13604.description: Snakes unwind behind the mask of dreams and slither free in these marks, showing themselves so that onlookers know you serve the Lady of Nightmares. Others who seek secrets locked behind the doors of slumber may gather to learn what you have to teach.
13604.name: Night Terrors Body Marking

13605.description: Glorious rot denies the artist a canvas on which to show fealty to Peryite. Luckily these face markings are magically imbued to remain, even if your skin sloughs off.
13605.name: Peryite's Fervor Face Marks

13606.description: "The Prince of Pestilence has writ large upon your skin, acolytes! Skeevers, because they snarl in the face of adversity. A bug to symbolize rot and decay. And Peryite in Dragon form, to remind you of the glory of our cause!"âPriest Blein Brown-Teeth
13606.name: Peryite's Fervor Body Marks

13607.description: Hagraven supplicants bear the inked claw of the matron upon their face. If they later leave her service, the mark fades over time. Or so the witchfolk claim.
13607.name: Hagmatron's Face Markings

13608.description: Inked markings are drawn, as if by dark magic, across the bodies of Hagraven supplicants.
13608.name: Hagmatron's Body Markings

13609.description: "Watch yourself around Sea Elf Serpentguards. Especially the ones with face tats. They ride those snakes for fun. Buy them a drink and you'll hear tales to raise your hair! Or feathers, if you're Argonian."âAugustelle Voriol
13609.name: Serpentguard Rider Face Marks

13610.description: Sea Elf Serpentguard riders test their mettle against waves, wind, and lightning. They prove their prowess against the denizens of the deep sea. A rider's first serpent is cause for commemorative celebration. Hence, these markings.
13610.name: Serpentguard Rider Body Marks

13611.description: Nightmare dominates the inner world of Vaermina cultists. Be wary. Stare too long into the eyes of these devotees and you may be pulled into a waking dreamscape of your own.
13611.name: Tiara of the Nightmare Queen

13612.description: No mere pretty bauble, this sinister cuff murmurs words into your ear when you have none of your own to share. The question is, will these words allay your fears or nourish them?
13612.name: Whispers of Fear Earcuff

13613.description: "My worship of the King of Worms did not end with his death. I craft this replica with dark morpholiths in reverence and fealty, in hopes one day I can join him at his side."âCroam's Journal
13613.name: Worm King's Crown
13613.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Support the Fellowship" in Solstice.

13614.description: Toxic green says "danger" and ensures only the right kind of people come up to talk to you.
13614.name: Viper's Strike

13615.description: Frame your face with a style that exhibits your inner passion and love of life.
13615.name: Curly Tresses

13616.description: "Eyes. Everywhere. Following my path, unblinking. In the paving stones, watching. On my arms, waiting. The mirror shows me they are me. I am them. What nightmare wrought by Vaermina do I now walk within?"âTorn parchment being chased by dark winds
13616.name: Phantasma of Terror

13617.description: Intimidate your foes the (noisy) Nord way.
13617.name: Nordic Yell and Yawp

13618.description: "Before the ritual even began, the cultists performed their customary fire dance. The terror in my heart died away, it was so beautiful. Then the blades came out. I was the only one to escape the sacrifice that night."âExcerpt from Loth Icefist's Journal
13618.name: World-Eater's Fire Dance

13619.description: Many plants bring calming energy and peace to a space. This one, if anything, offers the complete opposite.
13619.name: Ghastly Glowstalk
13619.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Daedric Scourge" in Deetra Grotto.

13620.description: Be wary of what you imbibe during one of Sanguine's many revels. Imagine what would have happened had you sipped from this particular vintage!
13620.name: Red Revelry Bottle
13620.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Regent of Sunport" in Solstice.

13621.description: The twin flames of Alduin and Akatosh swirl around the bearer of these sacred orbs. Perhaps one day one orb will win out over the other. And perhaps not.
13621.name: Dragonclash Flame Orbs

13622.description: The Shadow Queen doesn't gift the service of her faithful crows to just anyone. Of all the tasks they can take on for you, though, they love prying loose shiny runes the most.
13622.name: Gloamcrow Runegathering

13623.description: Announce your exitâand your allegiance toâAlduin, the First Dragon. Perhaps those who gaze upon the fiery drama of your departure may seek to join you in worship of the World-Eater.
13623.name: World-Eater's Fiery Recall

13624.description: Let the First Cat's sands of time guide you to your next destination.
13624.name: Alkosh's Timely Recall

13723.name: Bust: Overfiend Kazpian
13723.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Ossein Cage.

13724.description: Trophy taken from Overfiend Kazpian in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Ossein Cage.
13724.name: Trophy: Overfiend Kazpian

13725.description: Place this furnishing in your home to call upon the weather magics of the Maormer. The skies above will stay as you wish until you use its power again. Homes without skies are not impacted by its spells.
13725.name: Sea Witch Weather Totem

13726.description: When trained from a pup, these hyenas are sought-after battle mounts. Fiercely loyal to their riders, these relentless pursuers possess endless strength and endurance. Two or more together will form a pack and rile each other into a frenzy.
13726.name: Hew's Bane Hyena
13726.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

13727.description: Count the beads on a navigator's belt to see how many successful voyages they've sailed. These skilled seafarers say this practice originated from lost Yokuda.
13727.name: Seasworn Navigator

13728.description: "Praise to Peryite for sending me this skillful skeever swarm. May their teeth find purchase in these runestones and spare my poor, diseased fingers."âDealni, Priest of Peryite
13728.name: Skeever Swarm Removal

13729.description: High rituals to the Shadow Queen require wood hewn by one of her Wraith-of-Crows.
13729.name: Wraith-of-Crows Woodchop

13730.description: With Nocturnal's blessing, dukes and duchesses in the Blackfeather Court stand ready to grab resources on the wing.
13730.name: Gloamwing Gather

13731.description: It is said those who hear the call of the Void most strongly are changed by it. Eyes of unending darkness, hair or feathers that swallow the light. Few see these changes firsthand beneath the dire raiment they wear.
13731.name: Elder Void Priest Raiment

13732.description: "Fazudah knows it is not always snowing in the mountains! "âFazudah
13732.name: Orc-Style Snow Goggles

13733.description: Personify the chilly depths of your vengeance by assuming the guise of a frost troll.
13733.name: Frost Troll

13734.description: "Formal ceremonies, rare as they are among the Wood Elves, require the Greenspeaker to don formal garb. The artisans who craft the antler embellishments possess great skill given the number and placement. Impressive, really."âMarostaale
13734.name: Greenspeaker's Garb

13735.description: "Summerset designs demand tradition, tradition, tradition. Fazudah pushes boundaries with fashion. She is brilliant, yes? But she is a businesswoman first and foremost. Keep your customer always in mind! You can't make art without coin." âFazudah
13735.name: Summerset Gala Wedding Gown

13736.description: A simple spell using petals from the Rose-of-Archon transforms a well-crafted veil into something magical.
13736.name: Shimmering Gala Gown Veil

13737.description: Call forth crows sent by the Mistress of Shadows to help you retrieve your shining metals.
13737.name: Murder of Crows Mining

13739.description: "Drink deep of his gifts and be blessed for your devotion. For Sanguine cherishes all who embrace his revelry."âSwallow Thy Remedy and Find Peace
13739.name: Roseblood Bat

13741.description: Fledgling mages are known to practice basic illusions on torchbugs, shifting the insect's natural color. In this case it appears someone was a little overzealous with their spellwork.
13741.name: Illusionist's Torchbug

13742.description: Pulsing with heat, this vvardvark is ideal for the Dark Elf scholar who doesn't mind an occasional burn. Its molten skin allows it to traverse the Ashlands with ease, while its whip-like tongue singes and cooks insects as soon as it catches them.
13742.name: Magmaflow Vvardvark

13743.description: Though its pale coloring makes this brekka calf look fragile, it's anything but. These small creatures boldly venture away from the herd to confront everything from ash hoppers to desert lions with the same dauntless bravery.
13743.name: Chalk-White Brekka Calf

13744.description: Their affectionate demeanor and sweet tooth make them easy to tame, however they've been known to root up gardens in search of berries and fruit to snack on.
13744.name: Dragonstar Fawn

13745.description: These furtive bantam guar are particularly skittish. Their mottled coloring helps them blend in with the foliage of Port Telvannis, though their eyes sometimes give them away. They're experts at avoiding predators and would-be pet owners with ease.
13745.name: Port Telvannis Bantam Guar

13746.description: "This one had never designed a beast before! But Magister Varkenel was so kind! And Fazudah is quite pleased with how the colors turned out! They are so cuddly, and yet so dangerous. I am obsessed!"âFazudah, Elsweyr
13746.name: Honorfeather Fledgling Gryphon

13747.description: The hyenas of Hew's Bane are fiercely loyal and violently territorial, so the taming process must start early. When properly imprinted on their owners, the cubs are eager to please and positively affectionate, though they often nip when overexcited.
13747.name: Hew's Bane Hyena Cub
13747.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

13748.description: Bred to handle high heat and arid environments with ease. Their pale coloring keeps them cool, and wasteland travelers say they need far less water than their pigmented counterparts.
13748.name: Chalk-White Brekka

13749.description: All indriks are ethereal, but this one brings with it a warm breeze and the smell of fresh blossoms. Something about being in its presence makes one want to lie down and doze in the sun, or find a stream in which to swim.
13749.name: Isle of Contemplation Indrik

13750.description: From the time they're born, these elk have a strong sweet tooth. This is at odds with their imposing antlers and intimidating appearance, but the Orcs of the Dragontail Mountains use it to their advantage, easily training them with treats and food.
13750.name: Dragonstar Elk

13751.description: "It's a warm ride, that's for sure. Don't worry though, the skin isn't actually molten, just very, very hot. The tongue though. Watch out for the tongue."âMondran Redoran, Ebonheart
13751.name: Redoran Foyada Vvardvark

13752.description: "The result from a decade of collaboration between a forgemaster and a master of Daedric summoning.  A beast of sharp edges, molten veins, daggers for claws and knives for teeth. My life's work."âForgemaster Gordronak
13752.name: Forgefire Blade Lion

13753.description: Cuddle up to your favorite stuffed companion and let its glow lull you into a safe sleep.
13753.name: Slumberglow the Great

13754.description: It's never really just one sneeze, is it?
13754.name: Sneaky Sneeze Attack

13755.description: A dance begun, your feet take flight. Vaermina sings, you dream of night. The moons shine through your nightmare fate, but newly bound you see too late.
13755.name: Dreamharrowed Dancer

13756.description: "Why wouldn't I turn inanimate moonstone into a cuddly pet construct you can use to light up your library at night? What exactly did you become a mage to do?"âOhhendel, Sunport Mages Guild
13756.name: Moonstone Bear Cub

13757.description: "This one envisions lunar crescents. Yes, yes, a crown, but not a crown, understand? Its arc drifts above you not unlike the stars above, shining overhead. Over your head, in fact."âFazudah
13757.name: Hollowsteel Crown

13758.description: Bucolic comfort awaits! This cozy cottage nestled among stalwart trees and bubbling brooks provides a charming escape from the strife of the outside world. Grab a book, pack a picnic basket, and let nature enfold you in its many wonders.
13758.name: Hiddenspring Cottage

13759.description: Twisted by magical growth, a crumbling chapel to the God of Wisdom and Logic now hangs above the river Strid. A nearby Colovian manor house provides shelter from the elements for any who dare rest within this tangle of restless greenery.
13759.name: Wildgrown Chapel of Julianos

13760.description: "First Creator, Final Destroyer. Void embrace the fallen and felled. Void devour the banished and judged. Void become me so that I may serve your will."âDeath-Dancer Recitation
13760.name: Dread Father's Goat

13761.description: Though all jerboa are fast, these are particularly agile, making them a nightmare to keep track of. Luckily, they have a strong nesting instinct that guides them back home, no matter how far they run.
13761.name: Pridehome Jerboa

13762.description: "It's a good pet, no? Khenarthi has blessed it with her power, as you can see. Why bless a pony and not a senche? She works in mysterious ways. Just mind the static when you pet it. It gets zappy."âShikruz, merchant
13762.name: Khenarthi's Thunder Pony

13763.description: This construct's stony body gives it endurance over long rides but, more importantly, the moonstone from which it's constructed is useful for spells. And this bear is more than willing to help.
13763.name: Moonstone Bear

13764.description: During Hissmir's Fish Boon Feast, anglers work to catch as many fish as possible to help feed those who are in need. Many choose to wear this bespoke outfit in the spirit of camaraderie.
13764.name: New Life Fish Boon Angler

13765.description: For the Iron Orcs, history is worn on the skin. Warriors bear their scars proudly, and great victories and historic moments are often preserved in the form of individual tattoos. As such, tattoo artists have become highly respected in their society.
13765.name: Iron Rage Face Tattoos

13766.description: While hard-earned battle scars are highly respected by the Iron Orcs throughout the Dragontail Mountains, commemorative tattoos like these are also a matter of pride. To insult an individual's tattoo is to question their honor, often on pain of death.
13766.name: Iron Rage Body Tattoos
