13802.description: Trophy taken from the Black Gem Monstrosity in honor of an Undaunted victory in Black Gem Foundry.
13802.name: Trophy: Black Gem Monstrosity
13802.hint: Awarded for completing Black Gem Foundry.

13803.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Veteran Black Gem Foundry.
13803.name: Bust: Black Gem Monstrosity
13803.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Black Gem Foundry.

13804.description: A miniature statue of a Nereid Water Singer, alight with power.
13804.name: Statuette: Nereid, Water Singer

13805.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, Dark Lord of Torture.
13805.name: Statuette: Molag Bal, Torturer

13806.description: A painting representing Carapace Caverns, a bismuth-veined cave now plagued by an ancient undead curse.
13806.name: Painting: Carapace Caverns

13808.description: Enterprising Wood Elves realized long ago that mammoths were the perfect means to transport a war party. Their broad backs and massive frames are perfectly suited for multiple riders, and their size makes them an intimidating force on the battlefield.
13808.name: Warparty Timber Mammoth

13809.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Vaermina's Terror style.
13809.name: Vaermina's Terror Belt

13810.description: Tooth and eye. Bone and blood. The Mistress of Nightmares combines or switches or transforms all lost in her Quagmire dreampaths. If you somehow free yourself from Vaermina's grasp after too long a nightmare, you remain ever corrupted by her eyebite.
13810.name: Eyebite Nightmares

13811.description: Shine light on all that is dark!
13811.name: Brandish Lantern

13812.description: Reach your destination quickly by walking through your dreams. Or are they actually nightmares sent by Vaermina?
13812.name: Dreamwalker's Recall

13813.description: A soft exhale is all it takes to send seeds flying from a Hist bulb.
13813.name: Seed-Heavy Hist Bulb
13813.hint: Acquired by completing the "Naj-Caldeesh Conqueror" achievement.

13814.description: This bronze sheen is a mark of honor. It means you've been chosen to protect the ancient xanmeers of Solstice. Though the magics that bind to your flesh are light, the responsibility lies heavy upon your shoulders.
13814.name: Xanmeer Defender
13814.hint: Acquired by completing the "Feast of Shadows Delver" achievement.

13815.description: Did you really mean to break that black soul gem?
13815.name: Slippery Soul Gem
13815.hint: Acquired by completing the "Black Gem Foundry Conqueror" achievement.

13816.description: Applies to Mages' Fury, Endless Fury, and Mages' Wrath. Select in Skills menu.
13816.name: Mages' Fury, Ruby Red

13817.description: Applies to Dark Exchange, Dark Conversion, and Dark Deal. Select in Skills menu.
13817.name: Dark Exchange, Ruby Red

13818.description: Applies to Siphoning Strikes, Leeching Strikes, and Siphoning Attacks. Select in Skills menu.
13818.name: Siphoning Strikes, Lilac Purple

13819.description: Applies to Strife, Funnel Health, and Swallow Soul. Select in Skills menu.
13819.name: Strife, Violet Purple

13820.description: Applies to Magma Armor, Corrosive Armor, and Magma Shell. Select in Skills menu.
13820.name: Magma Armor, Azure Blue

13821.description: Applies to Molten Weapons, Igneous Weapons, and Molten Armaments. Select in Skills menu.
13821.name: Molten Weapons, Azure Blue

13823.description: Never be alone again! This snake friend is here to keep you company.
13823.name: Snake Sidekick

13824.description: Swift as the wind, with hoofbeats like thunder and the crackle of lightning in its mane, this strange beast will always be in the eye of the storm with you.
13824.name: Khenarthi's Thundersteed

13825.description: "No pity or mercy shall be afforded the wretch who stands against the Warrior Wave."âPlea for Open Eyes
13825.name: Warrior Wave Badger-Bear

13826.description: "I don't know how we would've made it through the desert without Azeta. Her sharp eyes and strong wings led us to prey we never knew was there. We followed her cries to a hidden water source that saved our lives."âJournal of hunter Bazdif, Hammerfell
13826.name: Khefrem Spotted Eagle

13828.description: "It was a pleasure to partner with the incomparable Fazudah on beast concepts. The bold choices, the incredible colors. And as she says, I'm confident these creatures will cause a stir wherever they goâthe best part of traveling!"âMagister Varkenel
13828.name: Pinnacle of Honor Quasigriff

13829.description: "Honor your ancestors. He who permits their words and deeds to languish breaks his own blade and casts it to the burning wind."âPlea for Open Eyes
13829.name: Warrior Wave Antelope

13830.description: "Take up the sword. Draw strength from the ancestors. Forge yourself in the fire of righteousness and you too will be sharpened with true honor."âThe Unveiled Azadiyeh
13830.name: Warrior Wave Senche-Cheetah

13831.description: "The words of our fathers' fathers cry out for sweet water, but the legends they once carried crumble to dust. If we do not tend to them, we know that a new Ending Time, worse again than those before, draws near."âPlea for Open Eyes
13831.name: Warrior Wave Fennec Fox

13833.description: "The bird-beast serves Tava in all things. Stand with it in battle and add its strength to your song. By talon and beak, at dawn and dusk, it cries in harmony with its singer."âAn inscription found near the Battle of Six Hands
13833.name: Glinting Talon Quasigriff

13835.description: Tales of the Warrior charging through the night bring a sense of peace to those gathered on storm-sodden evenings.
13835.name: Celestial Warrior Ornaug

13836.description: "If you're gonna capture echalettes to domesticate them, you should make yourself look like them. At least, that's how I go about things. Echatere musk doesn't hurt, either. Just a dab behind the ears, now. It's â¦ potent."âHerdleader Mulrugug
13836.name: Springfawn Echalette

13837.description: "When possible, novice necromancers should study the brains of living subjects. This allows for sophisticated creations in the future, though methods for subduing and restraining subjects are still being developed."âPractical Necromancy, Second Edition
13837.name: Dark Experimental Face Scars

13838.description: "The advancement of necromantic knowledge often requires living tissue. An understanding of muscular connections and skeletal structures improves necromantic constructs. One must simply find a subject to study."âPractical Necromancy, Second Edition
13838.name: Dark Experimental Body Scars

13839.description: Forged in the crucible of combat? Show the world by taking on this blade-sharp mantle.
13839.name: Forgefire Blade Mantle

13840.description: "This one's Orc hosts have beautiful piercings and tattoos. How could I ignore using the body as a canvas too? This art speaks to Orsinium steel and Khajiiti culture in a way even she is impressed with. And she thinks very highly of herself!"  âFazudah
13840.name: Orsinium Artisan

13841.description: "Khenarthi's chosen are unmistakable. Their eyes have seen her thundering wrath and her enlightened guidance. The Sands Behind the Stars are no mystery to them, for she has shown their truth firsthand."âKhenarthi's Wings, translated
13841.name: Khenarthi Stormfury Eyes

13842.description: "The wisdom of the Builders was in their patience. They did not just shape the Stone, they listened to it. They waited for it to speak its true shape to them, and then they made it so."âHecicla, Xor-Hist
13842.name: Stone-Nest Xanmeer Body Tattoos
13842.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Roots in Stone" in Solstice.

13843.description: Applies to Flurry, Bloodthirst, and Rapid Strikes. Select in Skills menu.
13843.name: Flurry, Peryite

13844.description: The spirit of New Life imbues your gathering blade!
13844.name: New Life Frostgathering

13845.description:
A miniature engraved archway representing the "door to wisdom" sometimes carried by devotees of Julianos.

A component required for the Wildgrown Chapel of Julianos house.
13845.name: Diminutive Runed Archway

13846.description:
A stack of grimoires used in the philosophical studies of magistrates, advocates, and clergy of Julianos.

A component required for the Wildgrown Chapel of Julianos house.
13846.name: Heavy Philosophical Tomes

13847.description:
This old lectern from a magistrate's office is worn, slightly splintered, and defaced with a few carved initials of previous owners.

A component required for the Wildgrown Chapel of Julianos house.
13847.name: Lawkeeper's Lectern

13848.description:
It is unclear whether this fragment of stained glass from a chapel of Julianos was obtained through reclamation or vandalism.

A component required for the Wildgrown Chapel of Julianos house.
13848.name: Stained Glass Fragment

13849.description:
Security-minded wizards use paving stones like this to seal warding enchantments on their towers.

A component required for the Wildgrown Chapel of Julianos house.
13849.name: Thaumaturgic Paving Stone

13850.description: Modern vosh balls are made of hard leather, but traditionalists insist on metal with a leather shell. Perfect for ore-mining practice throws.
13850.name: Malacath Vosh Ball Mining

13851.description: The gifting of colorful blooms for a celebrant to pin to their coiffure is a newer custom in Solstice. What event are you celebrating?
13851.name: Solstice Pinned Blooms
13851.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Gates of Mor Naril" in Solstice.

13852.description: A thrilling display of sword mastery and magic wings you on your way to your next destination.
13852.name: Honorfeather Recall

13853.description: Applies to Arrow Spray, Acid Spray, and Bombard. Select in Skills menu.
13853.name: Arrow Spray, Vibrant Yellow

13854.description:
Raise a banner in honor of your comrades-in-arms!

|cFFFFFFAppearance is specific to your character's alliance.|r
13854.name: Alliance Banner
13854.hint: Acquired by combining 50 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with a Arena Gladiator's Bluster, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

13855.description: Applies to Twin Slashes, Blood Craze, and Rending Slashes. Select in Skills menu.
13855.name: Twin Slashes, Coin Gold

13856.description: Applies to The Unblinking Eye, The Languid Eye, and The Tide-King's Gaze. Select in Skills menu.
13856.name: The Unblinking Eye, Hollowjack

13857.description: Join in the celebration by playing this percussion instrument beloved by the Wood Elves.
13857.name: Valenwood Skull Blocks

13858.description: Those dummies cannot stand up to your martial skill!
13858.name: Dummy Demolisher

13859.description: "And so Fazudah said, 'What about purple?' And he said, 'Well what about it?' And Fazudah said, 'It would be stunning!' And so here we are. And it. Is. Stunning!" âFazudah
13859.name: Twilight Indigo Tresses

13860.description: "Your combat coiffure deserves as much attention as your war gear, yes? Especially when wading into battle. Up and away from the face is best. Bound tightly. Yes, yes, you must keep your vision clear. To see the foes before you!"âFazudah
13860.name: Orsinium War Plaits

13861.description: "Why make eye-catching earrings from Coldharbour's very fabric? I need explain nothing to one such as you, worm casting. Die!"âCirterisse of Coldharbour
13861.name: Azure Plasmstone Earrings
13861.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Fleeing the Shadows" in Solstice.Â

13862.description: "Staring daggers at someone is so much more effective with color like this, no? Fazudah simply adores what the Orcs do with metal. Sometimes it just needs a little Elsweyr flair!"âFazudah
13862.name: Hollowsteel Eyes

13863.description: "Warriors from Orsinium make excellent models, yes? So strong and stoic. But throw color on them and they strut like any freshly groomed Senche-raht. Fazudah just wishes they were shorter. Hard to paint their faces up there."âFazudah
13863.name: Honorfeather Face Paint

13864.description: "The Magister's beasts were inspiring! Fazudah simply had to put brush to journal! The rider should look as majestic as their mount, yes! After all, what is more intimidating to an enemy than baring one's body in a spectacular display?"âFazudah
13864.name: Honorfeather Body Paint

13865.description: When you free a vitrified soul, take a moment to solemnly observe their transition to Aetherius and beyond.
13865.name: Writhing Wall Remnant
13865.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Crossing the Wall" in Solstice.

13866.description: Applies to Rending Claws, Claw Fury, and Bloodclaws. Select in Skills menu.
13866.name: Rending Claws, Verdant Green
13866.hint: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath for Undaunted Keys.

13867.description: Forged by the talented hands of Crown-trained armorers. They turn metals cleaved from Hammerfell earth and worked in local forges into durable protection for this well-trained elephant. Better to be on this warbeast than in front of it.
13867.name: Na-Totambu War Elephant

13868.description: Applies to Steadfast Ward, Healing Ward, and Ward Ally. Select in Skills menu.
13868.name: Steadfast Ward, Verdant Green
13868.hint: Purchased from Filer Tezurs in the Infinite Archive for Archival Fortunes.

13869.description: Applies to Fire Rune, Scalding Rune, and Volcanic Rune. Select in Skills menu.
13869.name: Fire Rune, Dazzling White
13869.hint: Acquired by completing the "Black Gem Foundry Vanquisher" achievement.

13870.description: Applies to Weakness to Elements, Elemental Drain, and Elemental Susceptibility. Select in Skills menu.
13870.name: Weakness to Elements, Orange
13870.hint: Acquired by completing the "Naj-Caldeesh Vanquisher" achievement.

13871.description: Applies to Caltrops, Anti-Cavalry Caltrops, and Razor Caltrops. Select in Skills menu.
13871.name: Caltrops, Bone
13871.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Caltrops" achievement.

13872.description: Applies to Swarm, Fetcher Infection, and Growing Swarm. Select in Skills menu.
13872.name: Swarm, Murder of Crows

13873.description: Applies to Dive, Cutting Dive, and Screaming Cliff Racer. Select in Skills menu.
13873.name: Dive, Nocturnal Crow

13874.description: Applies to Dragon Leap, Ferocious Leap, and Take Flight. Select in Skills menu.
13874.name: Dragon Leap, Nocturnal

13875.description: "One of my favorite tactics in battle is to assume the form of a bone colossus and join my horde. I'm less likely to be targeted as a result."âYmirra, Master of Bone and Scythe
13875.name: Bone Colossus

13877.description: For some Orsinium blacksmiths, facial tattoos denote their experience in the field, who they trained under, and what techniques they specialize in. For others, it's a purely aesthetic choiceâeither to cover a burn or express their love for the craft.
13877.name: Forgefire Blacksmith's Face Art

13878.description: "Honestly, the tattoo hurt less than the burn underneath it. People think of warriors and fighters having a dangerous trade, but blacksmithing's not for the faint of heart."âForgemaster Gordronak
13878.name: Forgefire Blacksmith's Body Art

13879.description: Set these exquisite birds free to celebrate any special occasion.
13879.name: Release the Doves

13880.description: A traditional Vengeance Day dance, in celebration of retribution well-claimed in the previous year.
13880.name: Traditional Ring Dance

13881.description: Discovered by guild mages in the aftermath of the Writhing Wall campaign, this dread realm hosts a bone colossus personally crafted by Wormblood. Wrest this stronghold from the worms and use the colossus to practice your best combat moves!
13881.name: Cradle of the Worm Colossus

13882.description: Experience all of Y'ffre's seasons in a single day! This estate blends a Druid-crafted four-season garden and the beauty of a Breton's noble villa. Grab a trowel and start making this garden getaway your own!
13882.name: Druidspring Conservatory

13883.description: Applies to Defensive Posture, Absorb Missile, and Defensive Stance. Select in Skills menu.
13883.name: Defensive Posture, Spell Breaker

13884.description: "I'm telling you, it's magic. Really! The hat isn't just for show. Don't look at me that way. Show some respect. It could turn you into a toad for that. It would just take a while, that's all."âOhhendel, Sunport Mages Guild
13884.name: Eminent Slothcerer
13884.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Final Dark" in Solstice.Â

13885.description: "Give your obedience to none save the gods of Yokuda. The Far Shores recede from he who leans upon thin-blooded shoulders, scornful of his feeble grasp."âPlea for Open Eyes
13885.name: Warrior Wave Painted Camel

13886.description: Sailors need clothing that gives them freedom to go about their duties on deck. Little wonder that among Redguard sailors, you can still see elements of the first Warrior Wave's seafaring crews reflected in their outfits.
13886.name: Swift-Winds Sailor

13887.description: These colorful beasts split their time between sunning on rocks and cooling in tidal pools. Watching one scratch its back may just make your day! And be prepared to provide scritches if you choose to take care of one.
13887.name: Diamondscale Ornaug

13888.description: "A friend to all and enemy to none. That's the wandering brewer for you. Ask for the Sea of Ghosts Brew to try a horker milk special blend!"âSirirenna of the Bottomless Mug
13888.name: Wandering Brewer

13889.description: "Sturdy fabric and leather. Dwemer-crafted metal to protect the shoulders and wrists. Oh, and pouches and scroll-holders. That's what you need to be a proper delver of lost and forgotten ruins."âRaynor Vanos
13889.name: Raynor's Traveling Robes
13889.hint: Acquired by purchasing the Season Zero Premium + Bonuses Tamriel Tome.

13890.description: Once used by war smiths to test designs for their larger cousins, these tiny beasts have a gentle temperaments and make for favored pets. To this day, diminutive battle sigils mark them as beloved family members.
13890.name: Na-Totambu Pocket Elephant

13891.description: Found by a pig farmer outside Skingrad, this burning beast was rooting around in her troughs. The boar, though clearly affected by the Wildburn, just wants what we all want: a full belly and a warm bed.
13891.name: Wildburn Boar

13892.description: "Sail the waters of the Azurian Sea long enough and you're bound to see the migration of the water-moths. That's where I got this fellow. It had a weak wing and landed on my ship, so I took care of it. Now, it refuses to leave me."âNavigator Stacia
13892.name: Azurian Moth

13893.description: Those dealing with night terrors may find the soothing purr of this Celestial cub chases away such sleep interruptions. Perhaps the Warrior protects their slumbers?
13893.name: Celestial Warrior Senche Cub

13894.description: "I believe Stuhn blesses our nymphlings. After all, they are near my home. And that means I can swim with them in the mornings. They like to nibble at my toes. That took some getting used to."âOrthald of Shor's Stand
13894.name: Whale Shark Pangrit Nymphling

13895.description: "Grant the bird-beast's young succor in the name of Tava and Diagna. Strengthen it each day so that it may lend its song to yours."âAn inscription found near the Battle of Six Hands
13895.name: Glinting Talon Fledgling Gryphon

13896.description: "Never thought I'd say this, but one good thing came out of the Wildburn. This tharriker. Look at it. Nothing's gonna bother you when you're on it. Just mind the tail, now."âStablemaster Marcus Buca
13896.name: Wildburn Tharriker

13897.description:
"You sure you have control over this one, Raynor?"
"I assure you, dear sister, thatâoh er hmm. Just let me â¦"
"Let you what? And why is it blinking like that? Is it angry?"
"There! Can you â¦ oh, you're already on it."
"Not by choice!"
13897.name: Duo-Dynamo Dungeon Delver Spider
13897.hint:
Acquired in the Season Zero Tamriel Tome.

|cFFFFFF|t32:32:EsoUI/Art/Tutorial/radialIcon_joinMount_over.dds|t Multi-Rider Mount (1 Driver, 1 Passenger)|r|

13899.description: After a drunken wrestling match near Shor's Stand became a hug-the-pangrit contest, several Nords trained these curiosity-driven creatures to the saddle. Now they happily wander Solstice and beyond, trying out new tasty treats from their doting riders.
13899.name: Whale Shark War Pangrit

13900.description: "The whisper of roses adorns thee well. To revelries go, where smiles enspell. And as you dance away the night, the gown's thorns press. You feel their bite."âFrom Rose Revel's Whispers
13900.name: Thorn's Bite Revelry Gown

13901.description:
"And what's this one do, Raynor?"
"I've made some decorative tweaks. But I'm not done yet."
"My question remains."
"Again, Kireth, I'm not done. But for now, it follows you."
"It doesn't explode randomly?"
"Of course not!"
"You said that last time, too."
13901.name: Dungeon Delver Theodolite
13901.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero Tamriel Tome.

13902.description: According to Alik'r assassins, the hidey holes these spiders lurk in are somehow favored by Sithis. By feeding one and luring it back to your lodging, Sithis can watch over you too.
13902.name: Kiss of Sithis Spider

13903.description: "Would you believe this little furball snuck past every trap in a Dwemer ruin to find me? She tracked me for two days. Dafty me forgot to leave her treats with her minder. So now this little one comes with me on every adventure."âMemoirs of a Daredevil
13903.name: Daredevil's Dapper Cub

13904.description: "Do I take my fate into my own hands merely by riding this beast? Indubitably, yes. But just as it's in the lion's nature to strike at that which threatens it, it is in mine to brave danger while riding upon it."âMemoirs of a Daredevil
13904.name: Daredevil's Dapper Lion

13905.description: The Tum-Taleel along the Keel-Sakka River occasionally train crocodiles to help them gather tribute from those crossing the river's bridge. Currently, they have no trained crocodiles due to reasons they prefer not to explain. Their loss, your opportunity!
13905.name: Keel-Sakka Crocodile Hatchling

13906.description: "Pluck a feather from a blue terror bird, and this one will buy a round of drinks for all! No, Turami, fledgling feathers do not count."âNirshala
13906.name: Sapphire Fledgling Terror Bird

13907.description: A Hammerfell tale says that if you follow one of these gem-bellied creatures from dawn to dusk, it will go to ground near a hidden source of water. Where it vanishes into the earth, dig, and you'll find enough water for days.
13907.name: Gem-Bellied Sep Adder

13908.description: "Look, if you call a critter 'danger frog,'  it's either deadly poisonous or the locals are yanking your tusks. With these little hoppers, both are true. Don't ask me how I know."âShurithikh
13908.name: Krona-Konu Danger Frog

13909.description: A bedtime story on Solstice tells of how the hermit crabs living around Broken Light Temple used to be a brilliant white. When Meridia's blessing shattered, these creatures also lost their light and have remained midnight-dark ever since.
13909.name: Broken Light Hermit Crab

13910.description: Wind whispers through brittle leaves. The heady scent of roses sweeps over you. What comes? Will it be friend or foe? Does it bring pain or pleasure? Do these labels even matter when it comes to yourâand Sanguine'sâdesires?
13910.name: Thorn's Bite Withersteed

13911.description: Superstitious sailors along Abecean trade routes like to keep one caged light-furred rat aboard, claiming it knows when pirates draw near.
13911.name: Abecean Ship Rat

13912.description: "After the fabric for the turban receives its sacred dye, the artisan hangs it from a great height so that Tava may bless it with her drying winds."â Everyday Practices of the Warrior Wave
13912.name: Captain's Turban

13913.description: When Riften's rat problem caused grain shortages years ago, merchants brought these skilled hunters in. Shortly after, the problem became piles of dead rats gifted to their favorite people, but all agreed that's a small price to pay for rodent control.
13913.name: Riften Rat Tracker

13914.description: Love is in the air! Use this amulet to show your festive spirit during the Hearts Week holiday. Certain locations or individuals may respond in unexpected ways!
13914.name: Amulet of the Heart
13914.hint: Obtained by completing the Hearts Week quest, Matters of the Heart.

13915.description: Applies to Superheated Ward, Volcanic Ward, and Magma Fist. Select in Skills menu.
13915.name: Superheated Ward, Azure Blue
13915.hint: Purchased from Stylemaster Merchants for Gold.

13916.description: Applies to Inferno, Incinerate, and Cauterize. Select in Skills menu.
13916.name: Inferno, Azure Blue
13916.hint: Purchased from Stylemaster Merchants for Gold.

13917.description: Applies to Dragonknight Standard, Shifting Standard, and Standard of Might. Select in Skills menu.
13917.name: Dragonknight Standard, Azure Blue
13917.hint: Purchased from Maj al-Ragath for Undaunted Keys.

13928.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Dapper Daredevil style.
13928.name: Dapper Daredevil Greatsword

13929.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Dapper Daredevil style.
13929.name: Dapper Daredevil Bow

13930.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Dapper Daredevil style.
13930.name: Dapper Daredevil Shield

13931.name: Dapper Daredevil Staff

13932.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Dapper Daredevil style.
13932.name: Dapper Daredevil Sword

An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Apocryphabound style.

13933.name: Apocryphabound Battle Axe

13937.name: Apocryphabound Sword

13938.name: Namira's Hunger Greatsword

13939.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Namira's Hunger style.
13939.name: Namira's Hunger Bow

13940.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Namira's Hunger style.
13940.name: Namira's Hunger Shield

13941.description: An Outfit look for staves in the Namira's Hunger style.
13941.name: Namira's Hunger Staff

13942.description: An Outfit look for one-handed weapons in the Namira's Hunger style.
13942.name: Namira's Hunger Axe

13943.description: An Outfit look for two-handed weapons in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13943.name: Warrior Wave Marine Maul

13944.description: An Outfit look for bows in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13944.name: Warrior Wave Marine Bow

13945.description: An Outfit look for shields in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13945.name: Warrior Wave Marine Shield

13946.name: Warrior Wave Marine Staff

13947.name: Warrior Wave Marine Axe

13948.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13948.name: Warrior Wave Marine Jack

13949.description: An Outfit look for headgear in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13949.name: Warrior Wave Marine Helmet

13950.description: An Outfit look for legs in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13950.name: Warrior Wave Marine Guards

13951.description: An Outfit look for shoulders in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
13951.name: Warrior Wave Marine Arm Cops

13965.description: Show off your outfit with a graceful pirouette.
13965.name: Elegant Twirl

13966.description: A favorite among veteran sailors, these flashy hoops are said to bring Kynareth's blessing to those brave enough to sail rough seas.
13966.name: Old Salt's Sea Hoops

13967.description: "SatakalÂ is the making and the unmaking, the birth and the death, love and fear."âKnowing Satakal
13967.name: Satakal Eye Binder

13968.description: "Take on the bird-beast's plumage in the name of Tava and Diagna. Listen well to the song of wind and sword before calling upon it in battle."âAn inscription found near the Battle of Six Hands
13968.name: Tava's Glinting Talon

13969.description: Never be the last to use a chair in a tavern tiff.

14006.description: Let this miniature voskrona guardian inspire you!
14006.name: Inspiring Voskrona Figurine

14007.description: "There's only one thing I really missed in service to Meridia."âDarien Gautier
14007.name: Exalted Bread
14007.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Golden Knight" in Solstice.Â

14008.description: Turquoise accents. The glint of steel. The wings of the Warrior Wave. Do these call to you?
14008.name: Yathian Tilework

14009.description: By fury of outward expression be forewarned. Choose not to heed that warning, and icy wrath from void-dark eyes may be the last thing you see.
14009.name: Rage of the Warrior Wave

14010.description: "Move with the current. Find the waters of the ibis and dance, warrior. Then come back to face me and earn markings like mine."âFarja Ibis-Dancer
14010.name: Ibis Dancer Face Tattoos

14011.description: Some among the Warrior Wave watched flocks of ibis, then used what they learned from these birds to practice balance and coordination. Those who mastered these stances tattooed themselves in veneration of these beautiful birds.
14011.name: Ibis Dancer Body Tattoos

14012.description: "To be the Worldskin is to be everything, and to be everything is to be nothing."âKnowing Satakal
14012.name: Satakal's Coils Face Tattoo

14013.description: "Fear not the unbelievers, for believer and unbeliever alike shall be eaten by the Serpent God."âKnowing Satakal
14013.name: Satakal's Coils Body Tattoo

14014.description: "Stand tall if you wish to emulate ancient sailors of the Warrior Wave. But be ready to flow like the seas themselves. When you master their ways, I have a marking for you."âArtist-Adept Aimira
14014.name: Warrior Wave Face Marking

14015.description: Rumors claim that artists who mark unworthy people with this sacred art fall prey to seasickness until they stop this practice.
14015.name: Warrior Wave Body Marking

14016.description: You take pride in your strength. And why wouldn't you? Haaaaa!
14016.name: Feat of Strength!

14018.description: Pontius made a name for himself getting soldiers to safety when Imperial City fell to the Daedra. Now this survivor has a knack for turning old gear into useful crafting materials. Still, bad memories keep him away from Cyrodiil and the Battlegrounds.
14018.name: Pontius Remus, Lupine Scavenger

14019.description: "What, you've never seen an adventuring blacksmith before now? A shame. We can swing at anvils and Daedra alike just fine, plus shoe a horse in our sleep."âEleana the Adventuring Blacksmith
14019.name: Blacksmith

14020.description: Applies to Healing Seed, Budding Seeds, and Corrupting Pollen. Select in Skills menu.
14020.name: Healing Seed, Blazing Orange

14022.name: Grim Focus, Malacath's Fury

14023.name: Frost Cloak, Blazing Orange

14024.name: Fatecarver, Aetherius

14025.description: Applies to Snipe, Focused Aim, and Lethal Arrow. Select in Skills menu.
14025.name: Snipe, Sanguine's Rose

14026.description: Applies to Radiant Destruction, Radiant Glory, and Radiant Oppression. Select in Skills menu.
14026.name: Radiant Destruction, Ice Blue

14027.name: Puncturing Strikes, Honorfeather

14028.name: Bone Armor, Carmine Red

14029.name: Render Flesh, Carmine Red

14030.description: Applies to Abyssal Impact, Cephaliarch's Flail, and Tentacular Dread. Select in Skills menu.
14030.name: Abyssal Impact, Azure Blue

14031.description: "Ever lost yourself in the pure pleasure of a mount's tack?  And the fur! So soft! J'aar just wants to curl up with this sleek senche forever."âJ'aar of Senchal
14031.name: Armored Senche of Anu

14032.description: Applies to Runespite Ward, Impervious Runeward, and Spiteward of the Lucid Mind. Select in Skills menu.
14032.name: Runespite Ward, Azure Blue

14033.description: Applies to Soul Trap, Consuming Trap, and Soul-Splitting Trap. Select in Skills menu.
14033.name: Soul Trap, Wormwrithe
14033.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist II: Soul Trap" achievement.

14034.description: "Lope through the night on this dark wolf. You may find adventure. You may find fortune. What you won't find is a boring experience. Embrace chaos and nothing stays the same."âJeetum-Tulm of Stormhold
14034.name: Armored Wolf of Padomay

14035.description: Sigils of Anu cover this majestic barding. Is that why this beast strides so confidently? With a stately, ordered gait? Perhaps.
14035.name: Armored Elk of Anu

14036.description: Move heavy in shadow. Charge into chaos. Claw at the void. Roar into darkness.
14036.name: Armored Bear of Padomay

14037.description: In a swirl of skittering webs and vermillion magic, the image of a gauntlet bearing the Egg of Arac floats in the air. It may be only an illusion, but this projection of the Egg of Arac is frightening enough to drive off small birds and amphibians.
14037.name: Egg of Arac
14037.hint: Acquired by completing the "Relic Gauntlet Bearer" achievement.

14038.description: The Gleaming Lamp's light burns for a short, yet resplendent, time outside of the Night Market. Formed in a blaze that rivals even Meridia's Dawnstar Gem, the Gleaming Lamp does its best to destroy any shadows around it.
14038.name: Gleaming Lamp
14038.hint: Acquired by completing the "Relic Gloom Warder" achievement.

14039.description: A dazzling display of the Windglass reforming from the sands of the Parch. Able to withstand sandstorms and buffeting gales, this delicate hand fan's stunning beauty hides surprising strength.
14039.name: Windglass
14039.hint: Acquired by completing the "Relic Wind Slicer" achievement.

14050.description: Hie yourself home from the Carnaval fete on blood red wings.
14050.name: Roseblood Wings Recall

14051.description: Whether you encounter this goat while it perches in a tree, bleats on a roof, or consumes your favorite slippers, you will never be the same. Or so say the High Elves of Alinor. If asked for more detail, they refuse to talk further.
14051.name: Goat of Chaos

14052.description: These cats possess a distinctive black-and-white pattern that breeders hope to start working into other feline varieties. For now, though, enjoy a warm lap and deep-throated purrs on cold Glenumbra nights.
14052.name: Daggerfall Longhair Cat

14053.description: Some Stone-Nest builders who explore their guardianship of stone choose to tattoo their faces with sacred mineral pigments. The people of Xor-Hist now share this practice with those who understand that what they craft will live well beyond their years.
14053.name: Stone-Nest Xanmeer Face Tattoos
14053.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "To Know the Void" in Solstice.

14054.description: "These stripes! On a pony-sized creature? Oh, how adorable! I must have three! Or maybe nine. Quick, Cahusque. Go to Greenshade itself if you must, but make this happen!"âLady Audrine Roreles
14054.name: Greenshade Zebra Pony

14055.description: The natives of Craglorn associate the stripes of their very own Belkarth cub with lucky beginnings. As a result, feeding these young felines tasty tidbits is customary when starting a new business or new adventure.
14055.name: Belkarth Senche-Tiger Cub

14056.description: Scholars debate whether this beast is crafted from the primal force of order, a pretty illusion on a mundane pony, or something else entirely. Regardless of provenance, the effect is the same: a splendid creature that draws eyes.
14056.name: Manifestation of Order Pony

14057.description: "I'm not sure how this happened, but one day my book about the Eye of Magnus took in a guest of sorts. Now the s'wit is flapping around the library, which amuses me, yes. But my studies! How am I to complete them?"âApprentice Ulmiso Venim
14057.name: Eye of Magnus Tomeshell

14058.description: Crow-Eye Reachfolk believe that a message awaits wise folk who follow the white raven, a symbol of stability and order. If one follows you, expect fewer unpleasant surprises in return for keeping it safe and fed.
14058.name: Luminous Raven

14059.description:
A small clay statuette in the shape of a bat, painted with red polish.

The first of three components required to create the Roseblood Bat.
14059.name: Crimson Bat Statuette

14060.description:
Petals that fall from Sanguine's prized roses are not known to wilt, and are always slightly damp with blood.

The second of three components required to create the Roseblood Bat.
14060.name: Red Rose Petals

14061.description:
A deadly-sharp rose thorn from one of the myriad rosebushes that grow in Sanguine's eternal paradise. Watch your finger!

The last of three components required to create the Roseblood Bat.
14061.name: Sharp Rosebush Thorn

14062.description:
In the halls of the Daedra, their crude mockeries of Tamrielic traditions extend to the courtesies of courtly dancing as well.

A component required for the Roseblood Wings Recall customized action.
14062.name: Embellished Dance Card

14063.description:
Darkly beautiful and ringed with bloody thorns, this fashionable accoutrement lures in dance partners while also pricking those who get too close.

A component required for the Roseblood Wings Recall customized action.
14063.name: Rosy Boutonniere

14064.description:
Victims of this deadly poison are found with reddened lips; the mark of one last dalliance with forbidden romance.

A component required for the Roseblood Wings Recall customized action.
14064.name: Sanguine's Goodbye Kiss

14065.description: "When one hears the song of Jephre, one cannot help but join the dance. That is what it means to live. All creation is his symphony, and a single life is but one movement in the greater piece."âWood Elf proverb
14065.name: Jephre-Pledged Tharriker

14066.description: The striped senche-tigers of Belkarth detest the reek of reptiles. So strongly, in fact, that their riders use them to avoid snakes and other scaled creatures. This does not apply to Argonians, however, whom they adore and often aggressively cuddle.
14066.name: Belkarth Senche-Tiger

14067.description: "Songs of water, songs of life. Songs of beauty without strife. Songs of wishes, songs of dreams. Songs of homes in deep, clear streams."âBallad of the Nereid Noble
14067.name: Nereid Noble

14068.description: A Merethic-era construct made from enchanted stones found near the shoreline. Its ancient origin is visible in the creature's stony exterior. Beauty slowly eroded, revealing hidden depths refined by age.
14068.name: Abecean Sea-Crystal Wolf

14069.description: "I wasn't so sure about riding one of these striped beasts, but I'm in love now that I have. They're so solid. And that fringe they have for a mane! I may start breeding them for others to enjoy."âThaenolith
14069.name: Greenshade Zebra

14070.description: A miniature statue of a Cathay-Raht roaring at foes.
14070.name: Statuette: Roaring Cathay-Raht

14071.description: A miniature statue of Boethiah, the Daedric Prince of Cruelty and Torture.
14071.name: Statuette: Boethiah, Schemer

14072.description: A painting of Sunport, the capital city of the balmy island of Solstice.
14072.name: Painting: Sunport Approach

14073.description: Cutting purses? Child's play. Grifting grifters? More difficult, but still easy enough for you. Stealing a treasure that's always in plain sight? Now that'll earn you the golden markings of a Riften rogue.
14073.name: Golden Riften Rogue Body Markings

14074.description: It takes a special kind of Ratway rogue to earn these golden markings. Did you steal an entire city's treasury? Perhaps. But you'll never tell.
14074.name: Golden Riften Rogue Face Markings

14075.description: Granted by the Lady of Air to a faithful few.
14075.name: Tava's Golden Gaze

14076.description: "Fair warning, friend. If you're staying with me tonight, my sep adder likes to wander in the dark. So if you think you see a winged ghost tonight, it's probably her. Please don't scream. She hates that."âOverheard at Sentinel Bazaar
14076.name: Duality Feathered Sep Adder

14077.description: The Night Market provides vast opportunities, including a former bank vault in need of a new owner. Hoard your wealthâand your faction's secretsâinside. Plus decorate your den with faction furnishings as you gain favor with your chosen group!
14077.name: Night's Den

14078.description: Need a friendly port in a hurry? Escape to Buccaneer Bay! Forget your woes (or let your woes forget you) in a sunny seaside setting. And don't worry about raiders. Stories of ghost pirates lurking in the depths keep them away.
14078.name: Buccaneer Bay

14079.description: "Grappling in frigid weather requires some forethought, such as how to keep one's ears warm and one's fur dry. But if you don't add fashionable embellishments such as a plume, how are you to stand out from the other grapplers, hmm?"âFazudah
14079.name: Orsinium Grappler Cap

14081.description: "Watch out for strangers wearing winged headdresses. They may have the most delectable voice you've ever heard, but their eyes â¦ oh their eyes. Right down into the void you go if you stare into them."âLucina Magius
14081.name: Padomay's Headdress

14082.description: There is true grace in order, as this design demonstrates. Requested specially by a deep-thought philosopher, this artful garment exemplifies the simplicity of stasis. When one's clothing lays as it should, order in all other areas of life follows.
14082.name: Tunic of Symmetry

14083.description: "Waves and wind are constants in the lives of sailors, yet none embrace them more fiercely than the descendants of the Warrior Wave."âThe Voyage of the Windjammers
14083.name: Windjammer Braids

14084.description: Practical and stylishâensures your hair does not get caught in rigging or obscure your line of sight.
14084.name: Warrior Wave Locs

14085.description: "These old things? Gifts from a worshiper of the Hungry Cat after I stalked and killed prey on Predator Mesa. No small feat that. Perhaps you too should visit the mesa? Hunt some hunters."âStalker Deshara
14085.name: Mesa Stalker Piercings
14085.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero Tamriel Tome.

14086.description: Turquoise swamp jellies are known for being particularly clingy once they've bonded with their owner. Some find the embrace of the gelatinous tendrils to be quite comforting, but most find it to be an acquired taste.
14086.name: Turquoise Swamp Jelly

14087.description: Whoever modified this Dwemer construct certainly didn't want for riches. More than an aesthetic choice, it's a statement that even some scholars can afford the best things in life.
14087.name: Golden Dwarven Spider
14087.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

14088.description: An Outfit look for waists in the Warrior Wave Marine style.
14088.name: Warrior Wave Marine Belt

14089.description: Some Nords believe Shor sent these bears to protect the dead interred in the endless barrows of Skyrim. Their instinct for protection serves their riders well even leagues beyond their snowy home.
14089.name: Bleakridge Cream Bear

14090.description: "The blue on this beast reminds me of the ice glaciers in the Sea of Ghosts. Though I doubt this creature would enjoy the freezing weather back home. That makes two of us."âHild of Ald Isra
14090.name: Ald Isra Striped Guar

14091.description: "You may question this one's methods, but Rakamu does what he must. He protects the weak, stops injustice, and steals from those fat cats who have forgotten how to share. It is also great fun. You will join him now, yes?"âRakamu the Bandit
14091.name: Tenmar's Fang Senche-Raht

14092.description: There's a certain elegance in the acceptance of chaos. The twisting shoulders of this gown evoke the formless and unknowable, while the high slits in the skirt allow for wild, frenetic movement at any ritual or gathering.
14092.name: Finery of Elegant Chaos

14116.description: To the Lord of Revelry, the prick of a rose's thorn is ecstasy. The pain, illuminating.
14116.name: Sanguine Runegathering

14117.description: "Unbelievable. Some enterprising mage created a mount with perfect Direnni plumage. Can you imagine the time? The effort? Elves certainly do love their details."âElona Mantel, Daggerfall Mages Guild
14117.name: Direnni Sage Quasigriff

14120.description: A miniature statue of a well-trained Tojay-Raht, who guards against all foes.
14120.name: Statuette: Defending Tojay-Raht

14121.description: A miniature statue of St. Olms, the Dark Elf patron saint of House Indoril.
14121.name: Statuette: St. Olms the Just

14122.description: "Every moment you hesitate, my influence creeps farther."âMaarselok
14122.name: Painting: Lair of Maarselok

14123.description: An Outfit look for chests in the Mesa Stalker style.
14123.name: Mesa Stalker Cuirass
14123.hint: Acquired in the Season Zero Tamriel Tome.

14187.description: A quick clash of blades stirs the blood and readies sparring sailors for the true danger that awaits.
14187.name: Saber Sparring

14188.description: Celebrate your victory on the battlefield in the fashion of the Warrior Wave's greatest swordmasters.
14188.name: Warrior Wave Celebration Dance

14189.description: "My prayers are answered! The magnificence of this steed near makes me weep. No longer will I suffer under the yoke of unending oppression. May Padomay's Void claim any who dare stop me from spreading chaos!"âExcerpt from a Yellowing Journal
14189.name: Manifestation of Chaos Steed

14190.description: "I just wanted to reclaim my old life. To put aside chaos, death, and change. To study in peace. Each day, I prayed for stability. A sign I could return home. And now, a horse is outside my door. What does it mean?"âExcerpt from Sage Latona's Journal
14190.name: Manifestation of Order Steed

14191.description: "This armor is so sleek, yes? Not a Mages Guild creation, no! Nor is it Ayleid. No, ma-hadaliit, this armor design originated with a sorcerer-king of ancient Ne Quin-al! Praise Magrus!"âRithantii Amiri
14191.name: Eye of Magrus Senche

14192.description: These adorable canines look small, but their big personalities more than make up for their stature. Embrace their cuteness. But be ready for their insistent herding at the first sign of danger.
14192.name: Dawngold Corgi
14192.hint: Acquired by purchasing the Season One Premium + Bonuses Tamriel Tome.

14193.description: "Little bugger must've crawled out of the sewers. I tried sending it back into the muck, but it wouldn't stop following me around. Now it's grown on me. The slime, not so much."âSifvid Lake-Heart, Riften
14193.name: Riften Slug

14194.description: Though its plumage represents loyalty to Clan Direnni, this little gryphon appears to have no allegiance to anyone. Loud, disobedient, and mildly destructive. Good thing it's cute.
14194.name: Direnni Sage Fledgling Gryphon

14195.description: A recent addition to the shoreline around Lillandril, this ruby-striped ornaug caused quite a stir when it first emerged from the water. With some help from Sapiarch zoologists, these feisty creatures now serve as mounts in Summerset.
14195.name: Lillandril Ornaug

14196.description: Specially bred for their vibrant colors, these brekkas are prized by wealthy Hammerfell merchants and nobles. Their lack of natural camouflage is by design, making for large flamboyant herds for the rich and luxurious to enjoy.
14196.name: Nightruby Brekka

14197.description: A facsimile created to honor the living spider mounted on a gauntlet which allowed its user to grapple their way through the Skittering Precinct.
14197.name: Egg of Arac Replica

14198.description: A recreation of the powerful Gleaming Lamp. While the original is capable of casting enough light to keep the hungering Baleful Darkness at bay, this lamp is perfect for chasing the shadows out of dimly lit corners.
14198.name: Gleaming Lamp Replica

14199.description: The Windglass keeps the sandstorms and cascading walls of sand from buffeting adventurers about in the Parch, but in the safety of their own home a replica is more than sufficient.
14199.name: Windglass Replica

14200.description: "Impressive, isn't it? You'll be the talk of the town, with music to announce your entrance wherever you go. Just don't ask me how to make it stop."âBard Cygwenn, Elden Root
14200.name: Jephre's Lyrical Lute

14201.description: You know exactly where to go next, don't you? Just like sailors of the Warrior Wave.
14201.name: Confident Navigator

14204.description:
Victim of a magical incident, Cambio Zammes now buys and launders ill-gotten goods. Perhaps one day he'll have a nest egg large enough to undo his transformation. 

He steers clear of Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds, and his services are only for you.
14204.name: Cambio Zammes, Rooster in Exile
14204.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

14206.description: Don't you dare touch my precious coins!
14206.name: Not My Coins!

14207.description: Adventure. Power. Mischief. Tests of strength. All await in the Night Market, as any who curate here knows.
14207.name: Night Market Curator

14345.name: Warrior Wave Cleave

14346.description: You have carved the rune of the Deadlands upon your soul. Its doors swing both ways for you, traveler of Oblivion.
14346.name: Jaws of Oblivion Recall

14347.description: Made popular in Daggerfall, this coiffure frames your exquisite face in a delightfully coy manner.
14347.name: Daggerfall Side Tress

14348.description: Those within the Chaos of Padomay cult believe they can "touch Padomay's void" to transform into feathered-and-furred beings. Mages Guild scholars, however, believe these folk are under a permanent illusion spell, which they'd happily break.
14348.name: Chaos of Padomay

14349.description: Like the firmament itself, you stand strong in your marble-skinned, statuesque form. You remain stable in the face of chaos itself. Best of all, perhaps, is when you cause people to jump when you suddenly move after standing still for so long.
14349.name: Eternal Marble

14350.description: When local systems fail to protect the innocent from harm, forest archers may step in to mete out needed justice and equity. Every now and again, a tattoo artist finds one on their doorstep, seeking out full body art that speaks to their way of life.
14350.name: Arrow's Sting
14350.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

14352.description: "Chaos overwhelms my ability to think. So today I'm working with order-blessed metal to calm my nerves. I'll make earcharms based on a philosopher's diagrams I found. Maybe wearing them will help. Certainly can't hurt."âAlain Dailland's journal
14352.name: Order's Symmetry Earcharms

14353.description: Some claim that looking upon this exquisite mask causes a faint sense of fallingâas if the world would not be there to meet their next step. But wearing it, oh, that's as if chaos caresses their very skin.
14353.name: Padomay's Voidmask

14354.description: When High Isle natives travel away from home, they often pluck a sunflower and wear it as a reminder of what they're leaving behind.
14354.name: Sunflower Hairpin

14355.description: Chaos isn't subtle. Bearing these face marks is a sign of a person's ability to adapt to any situation, dance in the fire, and reject monotony at every turn.
14355.name: Face Marks of Padomay

14356.description: To the untrained eye, the swirling tangle of black lines seem formless and indecipherable, but true worshipers of chaos swear they shift and change in a never-ending dance.
14356.name: Body Marks of Padomay

14376.description: You perform exquisitely on this elegant harp. How harmonious.
14376.name: Harp of Harmonious Order

14377.description: "Swim with the fish, I was told. Just drink this potion first, they urged. Now look at me. I'm â¦ quite gorgeous really. And the fish take me as one of their own. Delightful!"âOlvus Vidia
14377.name: Southern Leviathan

14378.description: The Thieves Guild culture is strangely boastful for a group whose members thrive on secrecy. Darkening the hands and feet is a tactical choice to blend into the night. Painting the guild mark on one's back, however, is a challenge to the authorities.
14378.name: Night's Shadow Body Paint

14379.description: The smear of black across the eyes has a two-fold benefit for would-be thieves: it better preserves one's vision in low lighting, and it helpfully obscures the features. All the better for making a clean getaway.
14379.name: Night's Shadow Face Paint

14380.description: "Beautiful and terrible Azurah, mistress of magic and dawn, bless this one with your potent vision. May your prophecy flow in this one's veins and open the way to the true path."âKhajiiti Invocation of the Dawn
14380.name: Sign of Magrus Body Marks

14381.description: Among the Khajiit, it is believed that those favored by Azurah may have their third eye opened for them. No one is quite sure what visions one may see once the eye is opened, only that the messages should not be taken lightly.
14381.name: Sign of Magrus Face Marks

14382.description: Finding order in one's body is the first step toward finding order in the world. Many philosophers find the complex geometry of these designs deeply comforting, as one shape flows beautifully into the next.
14382.name: Body Marks of Anu

14383.description: "Study your reflection. Breathe deep and do not flinch. Find the symmetry of your features, the inherent design of your visage."âMeditations on Order, translated
14383.name: Face Marks of Anu

14384.description: "Why do I have black hair that fades to white? Is it order? Chaos? Why pick one?"âLellian the Brash
14384.name: Fade to Light War-Locks

14385.description:
Sanguine's sense of irony knows no bounds; gripping the flanks of the steed tightly with your thighs risks pricking by the painful thorns.

A component required for the Thorn's Bite Withersteed mount.
14385.name: Blooming Saddle
14385.hint:
Acquired from the Stupendous Jester's Festival Box during Jester's Festival.
Can be purchased from the Impresario starting in the Anniversary Jubilee.

14386.description:
The gold leaf on these ebony stirrups is supernaturally resistant to grime and flaking.

A component required for the Thorn's Bite Withersteed mount.
14386.name: Gilded Stirrups
14386.hint:
Acquired from the Glorious Anniversary Jubilee Gift Box during the Anniversary Jubilee.
Can be purchased from the Impresario starting in Zeal of Zenithar.

14387.description:
Strangely carved antlers, somewhere between bone and driftwood in texture, but composed of neither.

A component required for the Thorn's Bite Withersteed mount.
14387.name: Withered Antlers
14387.hint:
Acquired from Zenithar's Sublime Parcel during Zeal of Zenithar.
Can be purchased from the Impresario starting in Witches Festival.

14580.description: The emptiness of the void reaches out. Answer it.
14580.name: Void Recall of Padomay

14581.description: Oh, yes. You have that crowd right in the palm of your hand. Play it up!
14581.name: Play to the Crowd

14582.description: The opposing energies of order and chaos exist in this very small orb. And yet you can channel both.
14582.name: Channel Duality

14583.description: "What if â¦ hear me out â¦ we asked the Mad God for a giant rooster to peck at that runestone? Cock-a-doodle-shriek, a rune in its beak!"âDeneen, Tenth of the Nine Fools, whose remains still litter the area near a shattered runestone
14583.name: Runegathering of the Mad God

14585.description: "The blessed of Magrus may summon his claw aid them in their daily tasks."âNirai Third-Eye
14585.name: Claw of Magrus Harvest

14586.description: Those who slip through society to steal wealth and information know the value of a quiet hideaway. This mausoleum provides silence and a hidden space in which to lie low until the next heist.
14586.name: Rogue's Refuge
14586.hint: Acquired by completing the "Get Away from It All" achievement.

14587.description: Water-lovers rejoice! This pocket realm features picturesque waterfalls, lively fountains, and magical pools under colorful skies. Whether you walk on water or swim while you creatively furnish this space is up to you.
14587.name: Dancing Waters Wellspring

14588.description: The power of Anu's light calls you away.
14588.name: Luminous Recall of Anu

14591.description: "And the Lady told me to fear not. Mercy is at hand. And Almalexia's compassion flowed to me. But because I did fear, it found no home, leaving me with nothing but deep unease."âMeditation on Fear
14591.name: Statuette: Lady of Mercy

14592.description: Tuck this adorable guar statuette into a nook in your home. When guests see it, they're sure to grin.
14592.name: Statuette: Friendly Guar

14593.description: Find your way to Shimmerene to view this impressive monastery. Getting inside, though, may be problematic at present.
14593.name: Painting: Monastery of Serene Harmony

14609.description: This Star-Gazer observatory majestically dominates its cliffside Reach location, where its domed main building provides a clear view of the sky. The addition of other eye-catching features delight those who study celestial topics.
14609.name: Star-Gazer's Vigil

14654.description: Followers of Anu prefer order over chaos. Stasis over change. Those whose eyes are painfully bright to look upon and who bear his sigil upon their brows dedicate themselves to these precepts above all else.
14654.name: Eyes of Anu

14655.description: "You may know Magrus as Magnus, the Sun God. We Khajiit honor him by letting him see through our eyes as he wishes, which lends them a certain gentle blue glow. And the face markings? Exquisite and sleek, are they not?"âShogarra
14655.name: Eyes of Magrus

14656.description: These coveted swirls around the eyes are proof of a knight's proven history of honor and care for their steed. Symbols of a rider's dedication to the chevalier's creed.
14656.name: Chevalier's Honor Face Tattoo
14656.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

14657.description: "You and your horse must act as one upon the tilt yard. Your steed is your honor is your life. Some riders mark their skin with permanent reminders of this bond between beast and knight."âThe Chevalier's Society Manual
14657.name: Chevalier's Honor Body Tattoo
14657.hint: Acquired in the Season One Tamriel Tome.

14732.description:
In the halls of the Daedra, their crude mockeries of Tamrielic traditions extend to the courtesies of courtly dancing as well.

A component required for the Roseblood Wings Recall customized action.
14732.name: Sanguine Red Silk

14733.description:
Darkly beautiful and ringed with bloody thorns, this fashionable accoutrement lures in dance partners while also pricking those who get too close.

A component required for the Roseblood Wings Recall customized action.
14733.name: Sanguine Spool of Thread

14734.description:
Victims of this deadly poison are found with reddened lips; the mark of one last dalliance with forbidden romance.

A component required for the Roseblood Wings Recall customized action.
14734.name: Sanguine Soul Gem

14738.description: This dark mask, though beautiful to gaze upon, hides your expressions from those who hope to understand you better. Exactly what you want.
14738.name: Mask of Elegant Chaos

14739.description: Art can create order from chaos. This band, crafted by skilled artisans, proves that.
14739.name: Band of Symmetry

14740.description: "Wrap yourself in this garb, child. Just as Jone and Jode wrap us in their blessed moonlight. In this way you carry the wonders of the Two-Moons Dance throughout your travels. And you are never alone."âMoon Priest Nadeza
14740.name: Ne Quin-Al Wrap

14741.description: Members of the House of Reveries know how to make a statement, and formal occasions are no exception. While many performers may still adopt a mask to conceal their identities at high society events in Summerset, their refined taste is never in question.
14741.name: Reveries Formal Wear

14771.description: Grants the bonuses conferred by ownership of the Season One Premium Tome: two Caches of Tome Points and a unique cosmetic.
14771.name: Season One Premium Tome Bonuses

14772.description: Quen needs your help establishing a new Thieves Guild in Daggerfall. Aid her in bringing three rival gangs together and completing a daring heist to steal a powerful relic from the legendary Nowhere Vault of Sage Voernet.
14772.name: Daggerfall Thieves Guild
14772.hint: Note: Though this storyline takes place after the Abah's Landing Thieves Guild story, you can play either quest in any order.

14773.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.
14773.name: Werewolf Form, Black
14773.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist: Werewolf Form" achievement.

14774.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.
14774.name: Werewolf Form, Ashen
14774.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist II: Werewolf Form" achievement.

14775.description: Applies to Werewolf Transformation, Pack Leader, and Werewolf Berserker. Select in Skills menu.
14775.name: Werewolf Form, White
14775.hint: Acquired by completing the "Skill Stylist III: Werewolf Form" achievement.

14776.description: When the Daedric Prince of Madness decides to take a holiday, it falls to you to serve as his guide and keep his insane desires from destroying Nirn. Travel to all the most exciting Tamriel destinations alongside the charmingly dangerous Sheogorath!
14776.name: Sheogorath Takes a Holiday

14777.description: Applies to Molten Weapons, Igneous Weapons, and Molten Armaments. Select in Skills Menu.
14777.name: Molten Weapons, Cooled

14781.description: Once a favorite of Sheogorath, this mischievous tomeshell has caused enough trouble to annoy even the Daedric Prince of Madness. Best if you give it a new home.
14781.name: Mad God's Tomeshell
14781.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Last Laugh".

14788.description: When the Mad God gives you cheese, take it.
14788.name: Sheogorath's Blessed Cheese
14788.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "A Taste of the Finer Things".

14789.description: Grants ownership to the U50 PTS Premium Tome.
14789.name: U49 PTS Premium Tome

14790.description: Grants the bonuses conferred by ownership of the U50 PTS Premium Tome: two Caches of Tome Points and a unique cosmetic.
